title_en: User-Centric Event Reporting with Follow-Up Information
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and method for receiving hazard and event information in a mobile unit and using that information to warn a user of an event or future hazard with reference to the mobile unit's location and/or intended direction of travel. A hazard location algorithm compares a forecast location of each mobile unit with a forecast hazard and transmits a warning to each mobile unit that is predicted to encounter the hazard. As the mobile unit moves, its actual position is updated in an event center, and a revised warning is transmitted to the mobile unit as applicable. Warnings include audio warnings for playback and/or visual warnings for display on the mobile device. Users may also wirelessly report events or hazards to a central server in an event center by sending data to the event center via a wireless communications network. Secondary information may be included, based on the selected event type.

title_en: Notification information transmission device, notification information transmission program, and notification information transmission method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To transmit notification information to a plurality of terminals in appropriate order.SOLUTION: A disaster notification server 10 includes: a destination table 54 storing data on a plurality of registered terminals that are transmission destinations of notification information; a notification transmission part 18 for transmitting the notification information to the plurality of registered terminals; a confirmation response reception part 32 for receiving reception responses transmitted by terminals which have received the notification information; and an association part (a response time calculation part 34 and a response time/average value update part 38) for acquiring times from transmission of notification information to any of the plurality of terminals by the notification transmission part to reception of reception responses by the confirmation response reception part, and associating average acquisition times with the respective terminals of the data in the destination table 54, to which the notification information had been transmitted. The notification transmission part determines an order of transmitting the notification information to the plurality of terminals on the basis of the average times associated with the respective terminals.

title_en: Visual and Audio Warning System Including Test Ledger for Automated Door
abstract_en: Apparatus and method for a warning system for an automated door capable of moving between open and closed positions, the door having engagement ends adjacent to a peripheral edge when the door is closed. Audio and visual warning indicators attached to engagement ends of the door, frame and header indicate when the door is opened, closed, opening and closing, or about to open or close, thus keeping the door ADA compliant. A hand-held wireless communicator transmits automated door safety check, test, and inspection requests to a server which records test requests, results, date, time, door identification and unique hand-held wireless communicator identification. The hand-held wireless communicator includes GPS capabilities enabling the server to record the specific location of the hand-held wireless communicator while performing tests. The server sends default emails or texts if scheduled safety checks, tests or inspections have expired after a predetermined time.

title_en: Safty device for Control panel
title_ko: 수배전반의 안전관리장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A safety management device of a distribution board is provided to control opening and closing of a door and a safety state of a distribution board using various kinds of sensors and alarm devices, thereby providing safe work environments. CONSTITUTION: A human body detection sensor detects access by an operator. A temperature sensor detects internal temperature of a panel. A fire detection sensor detects fire inside and outside a distribution board(200). A display unit displays the internal temperature of the panel, a power transmission state of the distribution board, and an opening state of a panel door. An alarm unit operates an alarm lamp and an alarm buzzer. A manipulation part comprises an alarm manipulation part for controlling operation of the alarm unit. The door opening part opens or closes the panel door(210) according to user manipulation. A controller controls opening and closing of the door.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수배전반 안전관리기와 도어개폐기로 구성되는 장치를 현장에서 판넬 도어 전면부에 부착하여 시공할 수 있으며, 수배전반의 안전 상태를 감지하여 실시간으로 알려주어 인가된 작업자가 안전하게 작업할 수 있도록 유도하는 수배전반의 안전관리장치에 관한 것으로, 작업자의 접근을 감지하는 인체감지센서, 판넬 도어의 개폐를 감지하는 도어감지센서, 판넬 내부로의 송전 여부를 감지하는 송전감지센서, 판넬 내부의 온도를 감지하는 온도감지센서, 수배전반 내외부의 화재를 감지하는 화재감지센서로 구성되는 센서부; 판넬 도어의 개폐 상태, 수배전반의 송전 상태 및 판넬의 내부 온도를 표시하는 표시부; 상기 센서부에 의하여 판넬 내부에 불안 요소가 발생하는 경우 경보 램프와 경보 부저를 통하여 위험을 외부로 알리기 위한 경고부; 도어의 개폐를 위하여 비밀번호 입력하고 변경하는 비밀번호 조작부, 상기 경고부를 동작을 제어하는 경고 조작부로 구성되는 조작부; 작업자의 조작에 따라 판넬 도어를 개폐하는 도어개폐부; 및 상기 센서부의 감지 신호 및 상기 조작부의 입력 신호에 따라 상기 표시부 및 경고부를 제어하며, 상기 도어의 개폐를 제어하는 제어부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Water level monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a water level monitoring and early warning system which is composed of on-site monitoring devices, a transport network, a monitoring center server and monitoring center clients, wherein,the on-site monitoring devices are connected to the monitoring center server by the transport network, and outputs of the monitoring center server are connected to the monitoring center clients; the on-site monitoring devices comprise a plurality of ultrasonic water level gauges and the power supply mode is solar energy; the transport network is a public network; the monitoring center clients comprise information display units and data analysis units; and the monitoring center clients are also provided with threshold configuration units. With the adoption of the water level monitoring and early warning system, the on-site monitoring devices are placed in different regions for configuration according to specific circumstance of the regions easy to generate flood disaster, and surface water information is collected by the ultrasonic water level gauges so that the water level monitoring and early warning system is formed. With the adoption of the water level monitoring and early warning system, the management mode of unattended operation can be realized in the wild so as to save manpower resource, ensure safety of staff and update and monitor data in real time.
assignees: NANJING YIZHOU ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of alert message notice system and Notification Method and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of alert message notice system and Notification Method and mobile terminal, the communication subsystem in the system includes alert message buffer process module and module is presented in end side message；Alert message buffer process module, for caching the alert message from alert message sender, receives after belonging to the new alert message of same alarm events with the alert message of caching, performs the one or more in following operation：Delete the alert message of the caching, updated according to the alert message of the new alert message and the caching after alert message, the alert message after module sends the renewal, the alert message after the caching renewal are presented to the end side；End side is presented module and is used to received alert message be presented to terminal device.This programme can solve the problems, such as the alert messages of same alarm events to same user terminal repeatedly the bad experience of unnecessary alert message to repeatedly receiving same alarm events of unnecessary notice and user the problem of.

title_en: Apparatus and method of broadcasting emergency information using automatic channel switching
title_ko: 자동 채널변환을 이용한 재난 정보의 방송 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A broadcasting apparatus of disaster information and a method thereof are provided to broadcast a disaster condition in a specific region and to increase the efficiency of a system. CONSTITUTION: A disaster information processing unit(110) transfers changed information to an information process controlling unit. Each modulator performs COFDM(Coded Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) modulation of a multiplexing signal. Each of the modulators outputs the COFDM signal. An RF(Radio Frequency) transmitting unit(150) transmits the signal selected by a signal switching unit.
abstract_ko: 자동 채널변환을 이용한 재난 정보의 방송 장치를 제공한다. 상기 장치는 복수의 일반방송의 서비스정보, 비트율정보, AVC(Advanced Video Coding) 파라미터 셋팅정보, BSAC(Bit Sliced Arithmetic Coding) 샘플링 주파수 정보, 오디오 스트림의 비트율 정보, 데이터 스트림의 비트율 정보를 기초로 상기 복수의 일반방송의 스트림들에 대해 중복되는 파라미터의 조합을 구하는 정보처리 제어부, 상기 조합에 맞추어 재난정보의 스트림을 부호화하는 재난정보 생성기, 상기 부호화된 재난정보의 스트림을 다중화하여 다중화 신호를 출력하고, 상기 서비스정보, 상기 비트율정보, 상기 AVC 파라미터 셋팅정보, 상기 BASC 샘플링 주파수 정보, 상기 오디오 스트림의 비트율 정보 및 상기 데이터 스트림의 비트율 정보를 주기적으로 모니터링하며, 변경된 정보를 상기 정보처리 제어부로 전달하는 재난정보 처리기, 상기 다중화 신호에 대해 (Coded Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing: COFDM) 변조를 수행하여 COFDM 신호를 출력하는 변조기, 상기 COFDM 신호 또는 상기 복수의 일반방송에 따른 신호를 선택하는 신호 절체기, 및 상기 신호 절체기에 의해 선택된 신호를 RF 송출하는 RF 송신기를 포함한다.

title_en: Tunnel emergency remote control system
title_ko: 터널 비상 영상 원격 감시제어시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A tunnel emergency monitoring remote control system is provided to monitor accidents or emergency situations occurred inside a tunnel on a real time basis, thereby effectively handling the emergency situations by automatically transmitting monitoring images. CONSTITUTION: A sound measurement device(200) installed inside a tunnel detects sound created from a target place. An image recording device(300) records images of surrounding places and vehicles within a fixed section of the tunnel by receiving a recording signal transmitted through an image remote controller(400). The image remote controller detects an abnormal state by receiving a sound signal measured through sound measurement device or a detection signal transmitted from an emergency situation detection device. The image remote controller transmits a message to a user according to a detection result or acquires the image by transmitting a recording signal to the image recording device. The emergency situation informing device(500) informs an emergency situation to the user by receiving an emergency signal from the image remote controller. A traffic information collection device(700) transmits emergency situation information to a mobile terminal or a navigation terminal by acquiring the emergency signal and location information transmitted from the image remote controller.
assignees: HUSE CO LTD;DAE YOUNG CO LTD

title_en: Qr code application system for expiry date notification
title_ko: Ｑｒ코드를 활용한 유통기한 알림시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An expiration data notification system using quick response code is provided to enable a consumer to manage the product prior to the expiration data, by generating QR code using a mobile terminal and by scanning the generated QR code and by implementing an expiration data notifying setup. CONSTITUTION: A QR code of a purchased product is scanned through a mobile terminal. The scanned information is displayed in a screen. A user sets an expiration data notification of the purchased product on basis of the displayed information. The notification is reported once more at the expiration date of the product. Various medium-using modes or vibration modes are set according to the expiration date notification set, which the user selects.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 이동통신 단말기에 특정 제품이름 및 해당 제품에 대한 유통기한을 등록해 놓으면, 등록된 유통기한이 되는 시간에 이를 사용자에게 알려주는, 이동통신단말기를 이용한 유통기한 알림방법 및 장치에 관한 것이다. 이를 위하여 본 발명은, 이동통신 단말기를 이용하여 특정 제품에 대한 유통기한을 알려주는 방법에 있어서, 특정 제품에 대한 제품이름 및 유통기한 정보를 입력하는 제품정보 입력과정과, 상기 입력된 유통기한이 되면 해당 제품에 대한 유통기한 알림정보를 출력하는 알림정보 출력과정을 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 하는 이동통신 단말기를 이용한 유통기한 알림방법 및 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Implementation method, terminal and system for enhanced railway emergency call
abstract_en: The invention discloses an implementation method, a terminal and a system for an enhanced railway emergency call; the method comprises the steps of setting the local activation state of an enhanced railway emergency call (eREC) group identifier or an railway emergency call (REC) group identifier of a terminal by the terminal according to the received line identifier update information, wherein the enhanced railway emergency call group identifier is composed of a line identifier bit and a railway emergency call group identifier bit; when the terminal receives a group calling notification message, judging whether the group identifier carried by the group calling reference in the group calling notification message is matched with the group identifier in the local activation state of the terminal, if so, adding the group calling service, otherwise, ignoring the group calling notification message. According to the method, the enhanced railway emergency call is implemented without changing the air interface message, so that the implementation cost of the enhanced railway emergency call is saved.

title_en: Cell broadcast center and message distribution method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To adequately select a serving general packet radio service support node (SGSN) even for coping with occurrence of failure in the SGSN in a system announcing occurrence of an earthquake or the like to a specified area by broadcasting, where an Iu-flux having mesh connections among the SGSNs and radio network controllers (RNC) is adopted.SOLUTION: A CBC 30 comprises: a storage part 31 storing a distribution route management table retaining distribution route information showing a route to a distribution target area; a transmission part 32 transmitting messages to an SGSN and RNC on the distribution route determined by referring to a content retained by the distribution route management table; a health check part 34 performing a health check on a route shown by the distribution route information retained by the distribution route management table stored by the storage part 31; and an update part 35 updating the content retained by the distribution route management table according to a result of the health check.

title_en: Digital broadcast receiver, digital broadcast reception method, digital broadcast transmitter, and digital broadcast transmission method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To transmit earthquake motion alarm information updated speedily.SOLUTION: Earthquake center information of a page type of "1" and target local area information of a page type of "0" are alternately transmitted one by one. When information of the earthquake motion alarm information is updated, this cycle is disturbed to change an update flag even in the middle of the cycle, and the updated information is transmitted. As the updated flag is changed only by earthquake motion alarm information the content of which is updated, it is required only to observe change of the update flag and to obtain only the earthquake motion alarm information the content of which is updated, which allows speedy update processing.

title_en: Method and apparatus for processing signal associated with warning notification in wireless communication system
title_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 경고 통지에 관련된 신호를 처리하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Based on a proposed method, the UE can initiate a certain timer in order not to allow non-emergency calls when warning notification is given in a certain area. In particular, the UE can receive a paging message including warning indication from a network, and starting a delay timer upon receiving the paging message if the UE belongs to a delay-tolerant category. The UE performs a random access procedure after the delay timer is expired. Namely, the UE that receives the paging message for warning, such as the ETWS and CMAS, immediately check whether it belongs to a certain category proposed by this document to trigger a delay timer to wait for a certain period of time until it attempt the call initiation procedure.
abstract_ko: 제안된 방법에 따르면, 사용자 단말(UE)는 경고 통보(warning notification)가 특정 지역에 주어진 경우, 비-비상통화(non-emergency calls)를 허락하지 않도록 특정한 타이머를 개시할 수 있다. 구체적으로, UE는 네트워크로부터 경고지시가 포함된 페이징 메시지를 수신하고, 만약 상기 UE가 지연내성(delay-tolerant) 카테고리에 속하는 경우, 상기 페이징 메시지 수신에 따라 지연 타이머(delay timer)를 개시할 수 있다. 상기 UE는 랜덤 액세스 절차를 상기 지연 타이머가 만료된 다음 수행할 수 있다. 즉 ETWS 및 CMAS와 같은 경로를 위한 페이징 메시지를 수신한 UE는, 해당 단말이 본 문서에서 제시하는 특정한 카테고리에 속하는 경우, 통화 개시 절차를 수행하기 위해 특정 시간을 대기하도록 지연 타이머를 개시할 수 있다.

title_en: Security crisis management system and method for coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a security crisis management system and a security crisis management method for a coal mine. The system comprises a security crisis monitoring module, a security crisis management module, a security crisis evaluation module, a security crisis early-warning module and a security crisis response module, wherein the security crisis monitoring module monitors the actual operating state of the coal mine, converts the actual operating state into corresponding data information and sends the corresponding data information to a crisis information database; the security crisis management module stores the crisis information of the current operating state in the crisis information database and updates the crisis information of the operating state of the coal mine in real time; the security crisis evaluation module analyzes and evaluates the current security operating situation of the coal mine; the security crisis early-warning module judges whether an accident possibly occurs in the coal mine according to an evaluation result, and gives an alarm if a risk exists and the accident possibly occurs; and the security crisis response module performs corresponding crisis elimination handling according to crisis alarm information, so a dangerous source is eliminated, and the accident is prevented. By the invention, a production accident can be effectively prevented, and the degree of damage caused by a sudden accident can be controlled to the greatest extent.
assignees: SHANXI LU AN ENVIRONMENTAL ENERGY DEV CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Geological disaster Internet of things group testing and group defense system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster Internet of things group-testing group-defense system, which comprises a pull switch module, a processor, a communication module, a power module, a monitoring data management system, an image acquisition device and a solar power supply device; the pull switch module collects the crack state of the disaster body at the location of the monitoring node in real time; triggering the processor to enter a working state and uploading the monitored data to a monitoring data management system; the utility model adopts the internet of things technology, collects the information of disaster points through the crack sensor, and realizes the information management, the quick query and update, the automatic analysis and processing of the disaster points data through the wireless GPRS network transmission, and implements the graded alarm of the early warning short message according to the analysis and processing result, so that the geological disaster prevention and control work is changed into the passive mode as the active mode, and the early discovery and the early processing of the disaster are realized; the geological disaster monitoring and management work efficiency, the prevention and control and management capacity and level are greatly improved, and the whole device is low in energy consumption and low in cost.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMM RES & DESIGN INST CO LTD;CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES

title_en: Engineering structure displacement wire-bracing type wireless automatic monitor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an engineering structure displacement wire-bracing type wireless automatic monitor. The engineering structure displacement wire-bracing type wireless automatic monitor comprises a pull switch module, a processor, a communication module and a power supply module. The pull switch module is used to collect a geological condition signal at a location of monitoring nodal point in real time, trigger the processor to enter a working state, and upload monitoring data to a monitoring data management system. An alarm pull switch and an early-warning pull switch are adopted, the monitoring data is sent to the monitoring data management system at fixed period through a general packet radio service (GPRS) or a text message, and therefore informatization management, quick query and update of data of a disaster position are achieved. A classified alarm of an early-warning text message is carried out according to analysis and processing of a result, and therefore geological disaster prevention and control work is changed from passivity to initiative, and early-detecting and early-processing of a disaster condition can be achieved. In addition, work efficiency of geological disaster monitoring and management is greatly improved, and ability and level of geological disaster prevention and control management are improved. Due to the fact that the engineering structure displacement wire-bracing type wireless automatic monitor is started only in a preset time and when trigger signals are received, energy consumption is low and cost is low.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMM RES & DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Emergency command system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problem that since map data showing a building or a road or the like recorded in an emergency command system in a fire department headquarters are updated once a year, any building may not be registered in the address of a notification destination on the map data when receiving emergency notification, and that since the member of a fire station manually operates a maintenance device, and adds information such as a building at the notification destination to the map data while looking at the content of a letter of instruction, it is time-consuming.SOLUTION: Disclosed is an emergency command system configured to automatically determine whether or not a building is registered in the address of a notification destination on map data, and to, when determining that any building is not present, add the information of the notification destination to the map data.

title_en: Method and system for braking train in earthquake
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method and a system for braking a train in an earthquake which can optimize the braking of the train when the report of the earthquake is incorrect and warning cancel information is received or safety is confirmed early by the conventional configuration of train braking in which the feeding is not stopped.SOLUTION: In this method for braking a train in an earthquake, an earthquake detection side control device 10 to which a seismograph 13 is connected is installed, and earthquake information is transmitted from the radio transmitter 11 of the earthquake detection side control device 10 to the radio receiver 6 of the on-vehicle control device 5 of the train 1 to operate a power mode control device based on the earthquake information. Then a master controller and an inverter control device are operated to switch over a power mode to a train stop control mode so that a train brake control device can be operated.

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Physician Location Tracking
abstract_en: A medical personal location tracking system provides efficient physician location reporting based on physician client device location. The medical communication system permits physicians to define location tracking control settings to control when and where the client device sends location data to a server and database. Subject to the location tracking control settings, the location tracking system provides location updates for the physicians so that requestors that wish to contact the physicians or know the location of one or more physicians can access the server to obtain location data. To obtain medical assistance to a medical emergency, an emergency alert may be generated and sent to physicians within a defined geographic area. Upon receipt by a physician, a physician may accept the emergency alert and travel to the medical emergency and be provided updates regarding the medical emergency. The person generating the emergency alert may track the location of accepting physicians.

title_en: Methods, devices, and computer program products improving the public warning system for mobile communication
abstract_en: The present invention relates to devices, methods and computer program products in relation to mobile communication. In particular, it relates to those devices, methods and computer program products of communication networks in relation to e. g. so-called Public Warning Systems (PWS). In order to provide improvement, an apparatus comprises: a control module configured to receive a specified message including an indication of a public key for verification of broadcast messages, in response to having received the indication, select a timer period associated with the indication of the public key received, launch a timer for the selected timer period, and, upon expiry of the timer, cause to indicate acceptance of the public key.

title_en: Electronic medical information card and system and method of use
abstract_en: An electronic medical information card ( 1 ) for storing an individual's emergency medical information on. The medical information card is stored in a storage sleeve ( 2 ) to attract the attention of medical personnel. The storage sleeve may be removably attachable to a user's driver's license, wallet, purse and so forth so that it may be easily seen by a first responder. The information on the electronic medical information card may be updated by an individual over the internet by sending updated information to a central location that updates the information in a central database and allows the user to download the updated information back onto the electronic medical information card. The electronic medical information card may also be used in conjunction with an Advanced Automatic Collision Notification system or GPS system to alert emergency personnel of the location of an emergency and to relay medical information.

title_en: Apparatus and method to detect cardiac arrhythmia
title_ko: 응급상황 인지를 위한 부정맥 검출방법 및 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An arrhythmia detecting method for recognizing emergency and a device thereof are provided to determine only regularity of a heartbeat, thereby diagnosing arrhythmia. CONSTITUTION: An arrhythmia detecting unit detects a heartbeat from an electrocardiogram signal received from a sensing unit(220). The arrhythmia detecting unit detects arrhythmia of the heartbeat by using regularity of pulse time. When the detected arrhythmia is constantly detected as a set arrhythmia reference number within set effective time, a controlling unit determines a current situation as an emergency situation(230,240). A warning generating unit outputs a warning signal to an external(250). [Reference numerals] (210) Selecting an initialize compensating factors(= 0); (220) Detecting arrhythmia from a pulse time between a previous heartbeat and next heartbeat; (230) Detecting the AR of the arrhythmia within Te?; (240) Determining as an emergency situation; (250) Generating alarm signals; (260) Reset; (AA) Start; (BB) End
abstract_ko:
응급상황을 인지할 수 있는 부정맥 검출 방법 및 장치가 개시된다.   
부정맥 검출부는 이전 심박동과 이후 심박동의 시간 간격인 박동시간을 이용하여 심박동의 부정맥을 검출할 수 있다. 
제어부는 부정맥이 기설정된 유효시간 이내에 연속하여 기설정된 부정맥 기준횟수만큼 검출되면, 응급상황으로 판단할 수 있다.

title_en: Interactive Multi-Channel Communication System
abstract_en: An interactive system, centered around a web application, securely hosted on one or more secured servers and connected to the internet, designed to facilitate and expedite critical communications among a group or groups of individuals. The web application maintains the capacity to send automated text messages to an individual's mobile phone regarding an urgent matter or emergency. The recipient is afforded the ability to respond securely via a mobile version of the web application, preferably to indicate the best course of action pertaining to the matter to the sender. In the event that a response is not achieved, or other rules are followed, the present invention automatically escalates notification to a back-up individual to address the matter. The present invention is preferably intended or best suited to function within a clinical setting, such as a hospital or nursing home.
assignees: DAVIS ALAN H;DAVIS KATHY D;JONES JACKIE L;DALY MEL P

title_en: Method for transmitting and updating public warning system (PWS) key update information and corresponding equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for transmitting and updating public warning system (PWS) update information and corresponding equipment. The method comprises the following steps that: a network-side network element triggers a PWS key update indication process, and informs an access network to broadcast the PWS key update indication information to a terminal; after receiving a message of PWS key update request, the network-side network element transmits a message of PWS key update response to the terminal and carries the PWS key update information; after receiving the broadcasted PWS key update indication information and determining the PWS key update, the terminal triggers a PWS key update process, transmits the message of PWS key update request to the network-side network element and carries the PWS key update request information; and the terminal receives the message of PWS key update response transmitted by the network-side network element, and stores the PWS key update information in the message of PWS key update response. In the invention, the PWS key update request can also be initiated by the terminal. The method can achieve the update of the PWS key information in UE (User Equipment) and increase the security of the PWS service.

title_en: PWS key updating methods, network side equipment and terminal in wireless communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses PWS key updating methods, network side equipment and terminal in a kind of wireless communication system, the renewal update method performs following steps by network side equipment：Two public warning system (PWS) keys and the identification information of the two PWS keys are issued to terminal in initial access process, one of them is currently used PWS keys, another is next PWS keys used；Key configured information is issued, wherein at least includes：The identification information for the PWS keys that network side equipment is being currently used；After the message for the carrying key updating configured information that the terminal is sent is received, the PWS keys of the terminal request are issued to the terminal.The present invention need not increase new signaling process, it is not required that individually trigger signaling process, only can complete the renewal of PWS keys on stream existing.

title_en: Vehicle terminal for anti-damage/anti-theft, method for anti-damage/anti-theft using the same
title_ko: 파손/도난방지를 위한 차량단말, 그리고 이를 이용한 파손/도난감지방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A terminal of a vehicle for preventing breakage and theft, and a method using the same are provided to check the state of a vehicle. CONSTITUTION: A method for preventing breakage and theft using a terminal of a vehicle is as follows. When the driving mode is changed into a parking mode by a shift lever, impact monitoring data and location data are collected. When the impact monitoring data corresponds to an emergency situation, emergency warning message is output on a mobile terminal(30). When the location of a vehicle is changed, the location of the vehicle is transferred to the mobile terminal. [Reference numerals] (20) Communication network
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 파손/도난방지를 위한 차량단말, 그리고 이를 이용한 파손/도난감지방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은, 상기 차량의 변속레버가 주차모드(PARKING) 모드로 변경되면, 충격감시데이터 및 위치데이터를 수신하는 제 1 단계; 및 상기 충격감시데이터에 대한 판단결과 긴급상황인 경우, 긴급상황메시지를 모바일단말로 전송하며, 상기 위치데이터에 대한 판단결과 위치변경인 경우, 위치조회메시지를 생성하여 상기 모바일단말로 전송하는 제 2 단계; 를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 의해, GPS를 이용한 차량과 모바일단말의 양방향 통신을 함으로써 차량 위치를 조회도 할 수 있으며, 주차된 위치에서 차량이 벗어난 경우 알려주도록 하는 효과를 제공한다. 또한, 본 발명은, 주차 뒤, 접촉사고, 파손, 도난 등으로 충격이 발생한 경우 있을 때 모바일단말에 메시지 형식으로 통지함으로써, 차량상태를 바로 알 수 있도록 하는 효과를 제공한다. 뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, 차량의 파손 또는 도난의 경우 매립된 비상용카메라로 차량의 상태 및 도로 상황을 파악하여 파손 또는 도난에 최선책인 방안을 강구하도록 하는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Medical parameters notification system
abstract_en: The medical parameters notification system includes a portable device to be worn on the body by at least one adjustable connector. The portable device houses a control assembly for controlling data acquisition from a sensor cluster on the back side of the portable device and wirelessly transmits the data to an emergency response and/or monitoring station. The at least one adjustable connector is configured to insure consistent contact of the sensor cluster with the wearer's skin. A display is disposed on one side of the portable device to show select information and messages. In the event of an emergency, the medical parameters notification system automatically notifies an emergency response and/or monitoring station along with transmission of biometric data. Any false alarms can be cancelled, before transmission, by a selectively operable button on the portable device, which also serves to operate different functions of the system.

title_en: Power management apparatus in public address system
title_ko: 전관 방송 시스템에서의 전원 관리 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A power management apparatus in an emergency broadcasting system is provided to continuously offer broadcasting services in an emergency situation by providing emergency power. CONSTITUTION: A boost type DC/DC(Direct Current) unit(240) controls operations according to a detection signal of AC(Alternative Current) outputted from an AC detection unit. The boost type DC unit boosts the size of the inputted DC. The boost type DC unit outputs the boosted DC to an isolated DC unit. An emergency charging unit(270) stores electric charges. When the supply of DC is terminated from an ADC(Analog to Digital Converter), the emergency charging unit supplies the charged current to the isolated DC unit. [Reference numerals] (220) Insulation type DC/DC unit; (230) AC detection unit; (240) Boost type DC/DC unit; (250) Battery charging unit; (260) Battery; (310) Preamplifier; (320) Main-amplifier; (340) Output speaker selection unit; (AA) MIC CD LINE; (BB) SP; (CC) AC
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전관 방송 시스템에서의 전원 관리 장치에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 전관 방송 시스템에서의 전원 관리 장치는 입력받은 음원신호를 증폭하여 외부로 출력하기 위한 음원 출력 모듈, 교류(AC) 전원을 직류(DC) 전원으로 변경하기 위한 ADC(AC/DC Converter), 상기 ADC에서 출력된 직류전원의 전압 크기를 정해진 전압 크기로 변압하여 상기 음원 출력 모듈에 제공하기 위한 절연형 DC/DC 부, 상기 교류 전원을 검출하기 위한 AC 검출부, 상기 AC 검출부에서 출력되는 교류 전원의 검출 신호 여부에 따라 구동 여부가 제어되며, 입력되는 직류 전압의 크기를 승압하여 상기 절연형 DC/DC 부로 출력하기 위한 승압형 DC/DC부, 상기 승압형 DC/DC부에 연결되어 있으며, 충전 및 방전을 수행하는 배터리 및 상기 AC 검출부에서 출력되는 교류 전원의 검출 신호 여부에 따라 구동 여부가 제어되며, 상기 배터리를 충전하기 위한 배터리 충전부를 포함한다. 본 발명에 의하면 전관 방송 시스템에서 전원 공급이 중단되는 비상상황 발생시에 방송음이 끊기지 않고 비상 전원을 공급할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Notification and tracking system for mobile devices
abstract_en: An notification and tracking system for a mobile device. The system includes a mobile device application that is adapted to be stored in memory on the mobile device. The application, upon activation, determines the GPS coordinates of the mobile device, records digital images over a period of time, sends a preset message from the mobile device to at least one recipient, preferably an emergency responder, such as a security monitoring station, and sends the GPS coordinates and the digital images. The coordinates and images may be sent to a remote server for storage and which can be accessed by the emergency responder. The coordinates and images are periodically updated and sent while the program is activated.
assignees: REITNOUR PHILIP A;REITNOUR BENJAMIN F;REITNOUR NICHOLAS R;REITNOUR JOHN T;EMERGENSEE LLC

title_en: The monitor whose ubiquitous security is strengthened and operating in a row

abstract_ko: 2개 이상의 변압기 2차측 출력이 입력되는 2개 이상의 입력단자와 입력단자에 배선된 2개 이상의 마그네틱스위치와 마그네틱스위치의 출력과 배선차단기 사이의 독립된 프로그램된 배선 및 원격제어서버를 통한 쇼트차단기와 마그네틱스위치의 ON/OFF 제어를 통해 입력단자와 배선차단기 사이의 프로그램된 독립된 배선을 선택하는 원격제어서버 및 보안성이 강화된 메인서버로 구성되어 마그네틱스위치의 접점을 변경하여 프로그램 배선을 선택할 경우 쇼트차단기 접점을 OFF 접점으로 전환 후 핑테스터기로 단락검사 후 쇼트차단기 접점을 ON접점으로 전환하여 전원을 투입하는 변압기별로 배선차단기 사이에 프로그램된 독립된 배전 계통도를 구성하는 것을 특징으로 하는 유비퀘터스 보안성이 강화된 감시장치, 방송장치 병렬운전 수배전반.

title_en: Seismic monitoring system and method of validity verifying for event using the same
title_ko: 지진 감시 시스템 및 이를 이용한 이벤트 유효성 검증 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A seismic monitoring system and an event validity verifying method using the same are provided to prevent a false alarm. CONSTITUTION: An earthquake detector(10A,10B), installed at a scanning object, transmits measurement data including peak ground acceleration. A rapid earthquake alarm system(20) receives measurement data from the earthquake detector and compares the measurement data of multiple sources during the same data time if the measurement data received is more than a threshold value. The earthquake rapid alarm system determines whether a correlation coefficient of the measurement data of multiple sources is within an allowable value or not and verifies the validity of a seismic event. The earthquake detector comprises a seismic sensor(11A,11B), GPS(Global Positioning System) sensors(13A,13B), and a seismograph(12A,12B). The seismic sensor measures the peak ground acceleration of the installed scanning object. The GPS sensor calculates a measured time value of the measured data in the seismic sensor. The seismograph receives the peak ground acceleration data from the seismic sensor and receives the measured time value as data time from the GPS sensor. The seismograph transmits the peak ground acceleration and the data time as the measurement data as the measured data of the seismograph. [Reference numerals] (11A) Seismic sensor A; (11B) Seismic sensor B; (12A) Seismograph A; (12B) Seismograph B; (21) Authentication module; (22) Reference module; (23) Non-processing material standby unit; (24) Reference material standby unit; (25) Reception timer; (26) Event generation unit; (AA) Communication network
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 이벤트 감지의 신속성을 유지하면서 발생된 이벤트의 유효성을 즉각적으로 검사하고 오경보를 방지할 수 있는 지진 감시 시스템 및 이를 이용한 이벤트 유효성 검증 방법에 관한 것으로, 감시대상물에 설치되어 최대지반가속도(PGA)를 포함하는 측정 데이터를 송신하는 적어도 둘 이상의 지진 감지기; 및 상기 지진 감지기로부터 수신되는 측정 데이터를 수신하고, 임계값 이상의 측정 데이터 수신 시 동일 데이터 시간의 양측 측정 데이터를 비교해서 양측 측정 데이터의 상관치가 허용치 이내인지 여부를 판단해 지진 이벤트의 유효성을 검증하는 지진신속경보시스템; 을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Mobile terminal fire alarm method and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mobile terminal fire alarm method, comprise the following steps: detection of fires danger also sends detection signal; In described detection signal saltus step and send when exceeding predetermined value alerting signal with control mobile terminal report to the police, cancel when obtaining feedback in the given time and reporting to the police, communication preset number when not obtaining feedback in Preset Time also sends fire signal and clawback signal to described preset number, to make described preset number clawback mobile terminal; Clawback according to described preset number sends alerting signal and reports to the police to control mobile terminal, and obtains rejection feedback in the given time or when not obtaining feedback, send rescue signal to described preset number.Compared with prior art, the present invention can send clawback signal while sending fire signal to preset number, makes preset number clawback mobile terminal, and optionally connected the passing to of user illustrates concrete the condition of a disaster or maloperation to rescuer, prevent false alarm further, and be convenient to the expansion of rescue work.

title_en: Method for delivering urgent information for vehicle in shadow region
title_ko: 통신 음영지역에서의 차량용 긴급 정보 전달 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An emergency information transfer method in a communication shadow area is provided to transfer emergency information such as disaster broadcasting to a vehicle in a tunnel. CONSTITUTION: If emergency information is maintained(S100), an emergency information processing device transmits emergency information to a vehicle within a tunnel(S150). The emergency information processing device receives emergency information from the other vehicle(S200). The emergency information processing device compares the received emergency information with the other emergency information. The emergency information processing device determines whether the emergency information received from the other vehicle is the latest information(S250). [Reference numerals] (AA) Start; (BB, EE, FF, II KK) Yes; (CC, DD, GG, HH) No; (LL) End; (MM) Emergency information transceiving(exchanging) and renewal determining; (NN) Emergency information receiving and renewal; (S100) If emergency information is maintained ?; (S200) Emergency information receiving(transmitting); (S250) Whether the emergency information received from the other vehicle is the latest information?; (S300) Renewal from receiving information; (S400) Emergency information receiving stop; (S450) Is there emergency information receiving need ?; (S500) Emergency information receiving/renewal; (S550, S350) Tunnel pass?
abstract_ko: 통신 음영지역에서의 차량용 긴급 정보 전달 방법이 개시된다.  이 방법은 차량이 DMB 재난 방송을 통해 긴급 정보를 수신하되, 통신 음영지역인 터널에서는 DMB 재난 방송을 통해 긴급 정보를 수신할 없으므로, 이미 긴급 정보를 수신한 타 차량으로부터 차량 간 통신을 통해 긴급 정보를 수신하게 한다.  즉, 본 발명은 차량과 인프라 간 통신이 지원되지 않는 상황에서도 차량 간 통신을 통해 긴급 정보 전달 및 갱신을 가능하게 하는 것이다.

title_en: An automatic alarm apparatus for rainfall or water level with dual communication and a method for the same
title_ko: 통신 이중화가 가능한 자동 우량 또는 수위 경보장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An automatic rainfall amount or water level alarm device and method are provided to prepare for the generation outrage of communication by using CDMA(code division multiple access) communications when an error is generated in VHF(very high frequency) communications. CONSTITUTION: An automatic rainfall amount or water level alarm device comprises a rainfall amount station(100), a control station(300), an alarm station(400), and a monitoring station(500). The rainfall amount station observes amount of rainfall and transmits a rainfall value to the control station in the request of the control station. The rainfall amount station transmits an alarm event signal to the control station when the rainfall value is greater than or equal to a set reference value. The control station transmits a rainfall value request signal every constant time and receives the rainfall value or the alarm event signal and transmits an alarm notice signal to the control station. The control station receives the alarm notice signal and outputs an alarm message according to the alarm notice signal. The monitoring station is connected to the control station and monitors the control station and instructs a warning command or an announcement command. [Reference numerals] (100) Rainfall amount station; (200) Water level station; (300) Control station; (400) Alarm station; (500) Monitoring station
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 통신 이중화가 가능한 자동 우량 또는 수위 경보장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 강우의 양을 관측하며, 통제국의 요청 시 상기 통제국에 우량값을 전송하고, 우량값이 기 설정 기준값 이상인 경우 상기 통제국에 경보 이벤트 신호를 전송하는 우량국; 상기 우량국에 일정 시간 간격으로 우량값 요청 신호를 송신하며, 상기 우량국으로부터 상기 우량값 또는 상기 경보 이벤트 신호를 수신하고 경보국에 경보발령 신호를 전송하는 통제국; 상기 통제국으로부터 경보발령 신호를 수신하고, 상기 경보발령 신호에 따라 경보 메시지를 출력하는 경보국; 및 상기 통제국과 연결되어 상기 통제국을 모니터링하고, 경보 명령 또는 안내 방송 명령을 지시하는 감시국을 포함하되, 상기 우량국 또는 상기 경보국은, 제1 통신 방법에 의하여 상기 통제국과 통신한 뒤 기설정 시간 내에 상기 통제국으로부터 수신 확인 신호를 수신하지 못할 경우 상기 제1 통신 방법이 실패한 것으로 판단하고, 상기 제1 통신 방법이 기설정 횟수만큼 실패한 경우 제2 통신 방법을 이용하여 상기 통제국과 통신하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 통신 이중화가 가능한 자동 우량 또는 수위 경보장치 및 방법에 따르면, 우량국과 통제국을 포함하는 각 구성 간의 통신을 이중화하여, 기본적으로는 VHF 통신을 사용하되 VHF 통신에 오류가 발생하면 CDMA 통신을 사용함으로써 통신 장애 발생을 대비할 수 있다. 또한 본 발명에 따른 통신 이중화가 가능한 자동 우량 또는 수위 경보장치 및 방법은, 평시에는 통제국이 일정 시간(1시간) 간격으로 우량국에 우량값을 요청하도록 하고, 우량값이 기준값 이상인 비상 상황일 경우에는 우량국이 자체적으로 통제국에 경보를 송신할 수 있도록 하여 우량국의 전력 사용을 대폭 절감할 수 있다.

title_en: System of warning for ship
title_ko: 지능형 선박용 경보 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An alarm system for intelligent ship is provided to prevent crewman or passenger from falling from ship. CONSTITUTION: An alarm system for intelligent ship monitoring part(100,200,300) and an image monitoring system(1000). The image monitoring system comprises an image collecting part, an image monitoring part, and an image analyzing part. The image collection part collects the image from the monitor. The image monitory part creates virtual boundary line in the image collected and recognizes objects shown around the virtual boundary line. The image monitoring system analyzes the moving direction of the object acknowledged and recognizes the stance of the situation. The monitoring part comprises a fixed type camera and a PTZ(Pan Tilt Zoom) camera.
abstract_ko: 지능형 선박용 추락 및 침입 경보 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 지능형 선박용 추락 및 침입 경보 시스템은, 선박 주변의 영상을 수집하는 다수의 감시부 및 상기 영상에 가상경계선을 생성하고, 상기 가상경계선의 주변에서 발생된 이상 상황을 감지하여 경보를 발생하는 영상감시시스템을 포함하고, 상기 영상감시시스템은, 상기 감시부로부터 영상을 수집하는 영상수집부, 상기 영상수집부에 수집된 영상에 가상경계선을 생성하고, 상기 가상경계선 주변에 나타나는 물체를 인식하는 영상감시부, 상기 영상감시부에서 인식된 물체의 이동 방향을 분석하여 이상상황이 발생한 것으로 인식하는 영상분석부를 포함한다.
assignees: NAT MARITIME POLICE AGENCY;IVS TECHNOLOGY CORP

title_en: System and method for managing transient notifications using sensors
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are systems, methods, and non-transitory computer-readable storage media for managing transient notifications using sensors. A system identifies a set of notifications to be presented to a user on a device and determines via sensors whether the user will likely receive and process communications or other separate events associated with the set of notifications. A composite notification is generated based on the set of notifications. Based on the determination, the system presents the composite notification to the user on a device. The composite notification can be of the same type as the set of notifications, a different type or a hybrid version. The composite notification can be delayed based on the determination. The transient and/or persistent original notifications that were to be sent are associated with missed calls, voicemail messages, email messages, text messages, calendar events, tasks, system notifications, and software updates.

title_en: Intelligent portable agriculture data acquisition and decision-making monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the agriculture intelligentization field and specifically relates to an intelligent crop monitoring device. The intelligent crop monitoring device comprises a portable cabinet arranged in greenhouse crop field, wherein the portable cabinet is internally provided with a multi-sensor data acquisition module, a GSM/GPRS module, an intelligent decision-making module, a signal transmission line, a power supply circuit, an input keyboard arranged at an end face of the portable cabinet, a man-machine interface like a liquid crystal display window, the intelligent decision-making module comprises a core controller STM32F103VBT6 and an SD card interface circuit, the SD card interface circuit is used for a crop expert system knowledge database storage module formed by a pluggable SD card, and the system knowledge database storage module is connected with the core controller STM32F103VBT6 through the SD card interface circuit. The intelligent crop monitoring device employs the pluggable SD card with convenience for update to store different crop expert system knowledge databases, solves problems of unattended operation for energy-saving daylight greenhouse all-weather field monitoring and intelligent disaster early warning and realizes automatic management of a crop environment and high-quality high-efficiency safety ecology production of the greenhouse crop.
assignees: WUXI CAS INTELLIGENT AGRICULTURAL DEV CO LTD;HEFEI INST PHYSICAL SCI CAS

title_en: Dynamic assignment of cell broadcast message identifiers
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for broadcast communication from a broadcast entity to terminals of a wireless communication network. A request for broadcast access to the wireless communication network is received, the request comprising an indication of a predetermined feature. In response, a dynamic association is established between the feature and an identifier selected from a pool of currently unused identifiers. Messages are then received from the broadcast entity, the messages associated with the predetermined feature. The messages are then broadcast along with the identifier. Broadcasting may be via Cell Broadcast Service (CBS), with the CBS Message Identifier as said identifier. The terminals are configured to optionally use the identifier for selective message processing. Upon a predetermined expiry condition, the identifier may be returned to the pool for re-use. Information regarding the temporary association may be published to the terminals.

title_en: Geoscoping for enhancing security in public warning systems
abstract_en: There are provided measures for geoscoping for enhancing security in public warning systems. Such measures exemplarily comprise retrieving geoscope information being associated with a public key dedicated for verifying signed warning messages of a public warning system, wherein the geoscope information defines a scope of validity of information verifiable by said public key, receiving a signed warning message of the public warning system, verifying a signature of the received signed warning message using said public key, determining whether or not a current location is within the scope defined by the retrieved geoscope information, and accepting the received signed warning message if both the signature of the signed warning message is successfully verified using said public key and the current location is determined to be within the scope defined by the retrieved geoscope information.

title_en: Motor vehicle anti-collision safety system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Motor vehicle anti-collision safety system, it is made up of radar, car speed sensor, message processing module, distance display module, audio alert unit, the gentle post device for ejecting of safe gas column, described safe gas column is located at the head of car body, gas column device for ejecting is close to the sidepiece of safe gas column, speed information and the objects in front range information that detects in real time are fed back to message processing module by described car speed sensor and radar respectively, and message processing module makes corresponding safe action to after above-mentioned information processing.Owing to adopting above-mentioned version, after power actuated vehicle adopts above-mentioned anti-collision safety system, brake system can be started in time, thus collision free, once collide, under the effect of safe gas column, also can impulsive force effectively be cushioned, avoid and create greater casualties because of collision, for mankind's security of the lives and property provides powerful guarantee; The present invention also has high, the safe and reliable feature of intelligence degree.<!--1-->

title_en: Open communication method in a heterogeneous network
abstract_en: An open communication method between at least two sub-networks of different routable network addressing schemes comprises receiving a packet for a specific application, the packet including an application identifier, determining if the packet is to be relayed to another of the at least two sub-network based upon the application identifier; determining if a node receiving the packet is a broker node, relaying the packet to a broker node if not a broker node, forwarding, by the broker node, the packet to at least one node in another of the at least two sub-networks, broadcasting a status packet from a broker node to each sub-network that the broker node is configured to communicate, receiving the status packet from the broker node, and updating a broker table using information from the status packet, wherein only a broker node updates the broker table.
assignees: TELCORDIA TECH INC;TOYOTA INFOTECHNOLOGY CENTER U S A INC

title_en: Method and device for updating public warning system (PWS) secret key
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for updating a public warning system (PWS) secret key. The method comprises the following steps of receiving an updated PWS secret key by user equipment (UE) when preset conditions are met, wherein the updated PWS secret key is issued from network side equipment through a non-access stratum down message; updating a current PWS secret key by the UE by adopting the received PWS secret key. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, an effect that the safety protection of a PWS is enhanced through real-time updating of the PWS secret key is achieved.

title_en: Earthquake precaution evacuation manoeuvre method by using earthquake early warning system
abstract_en: The invention provides an earthquake early warning manoeuvre method based on an earthquake early warning system for carrying out of an emergency evacuation manoeuvre. During the manoeuvre, earthquake magnitude and position of an earthquake focus of a simulated earthquake are set through a manoeuvre controlling device. When the manoeuvre starts, earthquake early warning receiving terminals located everywhere receive earthquake early warning signals. An earthquake early warning controlling output device automatically starts voice output equipment, wherein the voice output equipment gives earthquake early warning alarms. Proper risk avoiding measures (if the early warning time received is shorter than risk avoiding time, people hide in near places, if the early warning time received is longer than the risk avoiding time, people withdraw to a safe area quickly) are adopted in different places according to different earthquake early warning alarms received. Various forms of manoeuvres about the distance of the earthquake focus, the earthquake magnitude and the like are carried out by using the method, people receiving the manoeuvres form conditioned reflex and are capable of adopting proper risk avoiding measures according to different earthquake early warning time and intensity of the earthquake.

title_en: Parking meter expired alert
abstract_en: Methods and systems for a complete vehicle ecosystem are provided. Specifically, systems that when taken alone, or together, provide an individual or group of individuals with an intuitive and comfortable vehicular environment. The present disclosure builds on integrating existing technology with new devices, methods, and systems to provide a complete vehicle ecosystem.

title_en: Celluar phone with electric foot ring from emergency signal to catching apparatus
title_ko: 전자발찌 착용자 접근 경보수단을 가진 이동통신단말기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A mobile communication terminal having an alarm unit which notifies the approach of an electronic anklet wearer is provided to secure the personal safety of a user by issuing a warning alarm in case an electronic anklet wearer having the record of sex offense approaches within the safety behavior radius range of the user. CONSTITUTION: The wearer approach alarm unit of a mobile communication terminal comprises a receiver(1), a filter(2), a switch(3), an amplifier(4), and an AD converter(5). The filter identifies an electronic anklet transmission signal received in the receiver. The switch is automatically turned on by the filter. The amplifier amplifies the electronic anklet transmission signal delivered from the switch and delivers the amplified signal to the AD converter. The AD converter converts the electronic anklet transmission signal into a digital signal and delivers the signal to the processing unit of the mobile communication terminal. [Reference numerals] (1) Receiver; (11) Processor; (12) Controller; (14) Display; (15) Confirmation button; (16) Vibration motor; (17) Speaker; (18) GPS data reception; (19) Memory; (2) Filter; (3) Switch; (4) Amplifier; (5) A/D converter; (6) Time relay; (AA) Location information transmission;
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전자발찌를 착용한 성범죄 전력자가 사용자의 안전행동반경 범위 내에 들어올 경우 경보를 발하여 자신의 신변 안전을 도모할 수 있는 전자발찌 착용자 접근 경보수단을 가진 이동통신단말기를 제공하려는 것으로서, 전자발찌의 발신신호 감지 및 인식수단을 내장하여 통상의 이동통신단말기에 내장된 진동모터, 스피커를 통해 경보를 발하며, 또는 이와 함께 동시적으로 디스플레이에 경보문구로 표시되거나 LED가 점멸되어 사용자에게 알림으로써 신속하게 신변 안전을 위한 행동을 취할 수 있게 하며, 전자발찌 발신신호가 감지되는 즉시 ON되어 증폭기에 의해 증폭된 후 디지털신호로 변환하여 이동통신단말기의 처리부로 전달해 경보케 하는 증폭기와 아날로그/디지털 컨버터를 포함한다.  상기 경보수단은 사용자의 안전행동반경 내에 전자발찌 착용자가 존재하는 사실이 처음 확인된 후로 정해진 시간 동안 동안 반복적으로 경고를 발하고, 경고유효시간 경과 후에는 경고대기상태로 전환되며, 계속해서 전자발찌의 발신신호가 포착되면 상기한 바와 같은 내용의 경보가 반복되고 전자발찌의 발신신호가 소멸되면 경보가 해제되는 타임 딜레이도 포함한다.

title_en: Fire alarm system for hearing-impaired person
title_ko: 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire alarm system for the hearing impaired is provided to immediately find fire occurrence and location, regardless of where people with hearing impairment are present indoors. CONSTITUTION: A fire alarm system for the hearing impaired includes a plurality of wireless alarm devices(100). The wireless alarm device is installed in the vicinity of a fire detector(50) installed in the ceiling of each room. The wireless alarm device includes a fire detection reception unit(110), a control unit(130), and a wireless transception unit(140). The control unit lights a light-emitting unit if a fire detection signal is received from the fire detection reception unit or the wireless transception unit. The control unit transmits the fire detection signal and a unique ID to the other wireless alarm devices when a fire detection signal is received from the fire detection reception unit. The other wireless alarm devices display a location corresponding to the unique ID based on the unique ID received from the wireless transception unit on a display unit. [Reference numerals] (50) Smoke detector;
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재감지신호를 무선으로 여러 장소로 송수신하여 청각장애인이 실내 어느 장소에 있더라도 신속하게 화재가 발생하였음을 알려줄 수 있는 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템에 관한 것이다. 이를 위하여, 본 발명은 화재시 청각장애인에게 화재경보를 줄 수 있는 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템에 있어서, 상기 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템은 복수 개의 무선경보장치를 포함하며, 상기 무선경보장치는, 화재감지기로부터 감지된 신호를 전송받는 화재감지수신부; 상기 화재감지수신부의 신호를 증폭시키는 증폭부; 상기 무선경보장치에 설치된 각종 부품을 제어하는 제어부; 상기 제어부에 의하여 다른 무선경보장치와 무선으로 신호를 송수신하기 위한 무선송수신부; 상기 제어부에 의하여 발광하는 발광부를 포함하여 구성되며, 상기 제어부는 상기 화재감지수신부 또는 무선송수신부로부터 화재감지신호가 수신되면 상기 발광부를 발광시키는 것을 특징으로 하는 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템을 제공한다. 
따라서, 본 발명에 의하면 실내에 기존 설치된 화재감지기의 변경 없이 용이하게 청각장애인용 화재경보시스템을 설치할 수 있으며, 청각장애인이 실내 어디에 있든 신속하게 화재발생 여부 및 화재발생 장소를 파악할 수 있어 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 해 준다.

title_en: Medical alert system
abstract_en: Systems and methods for providing medical identification tags wearable by a person that include barcodes (e.g., Quick Response (QR) barcodes, or the like) to provide personal medical information to users (e.g., first responders) with mobile devices capable of scanning the barcodes. The system also facilitates automatic notifications to relatives or others associated with the wearer of the medical identification tag when the barcode is scanned, which may indicate an emergency condition. Wearers of the medical identification tags may modify or update the stored personal medical information as needed.

title_en: E-vehicle battery black box system
title_ko: 이차전지 모니터용 블랙박스장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A black box for a secondary battery monitor is provided to control charging and discharging current by measuring the voltage, current, and temperature of a secondary battery in real time, thereby preventing over charging and over discharging. CONSTITUTION: A black box for a secondary battery monitor(1) comprises a black box module(200) which supplies power to an electric vehicle or a device, storing measured voltage, current, and temperature data, and image data of a secondary battery, and informs a user of abnormal signals of a secondary battery through a smart phone. The black box module consists of an input and output connection terminal, a fuse part, and a BMS(Battery Management System)(210), a cooling fan(220), and a black box(230). [Reference numerals] (AA) Input connection terminal; (BB) Output connection terminal
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 종래의 리튬이온전지 및 리튬폴리머전지에 사용되는 PCM(Protection Circuit Moudule), 혹은 BMS(Battery Management System)이 전기차 및 전기구동장치화재시 이차전지와 함께 전소되어 사고분석 자체를 파악할 수 없고, 이차전지의 사고발생시, 전기차 사용자의 스마트폰으로의 알림기능이 없어, 전기차 및 전기구동장치화재시 대형사고의 문제점을 개선하고자, 입·출력접속단자, 퓨즈부(Fuse), 블랙박스연계형 BMS(Battery Management System), 냉각팬, 이차전지모니터용 블랙박스로 이루어진 이차전지 모니터용 블랙박스 모듈(200) 
로 구성됨으로서, 탈부착식 구조로 형성되어 BMS기능과 함께 혹은 단독으로 사용하여, 이상상황에 해당하는 데이터를 실시간으로 저장 및 분석할 수 있고, 전기차 뿐만 아니라 전기구동장치의 이차전지에도 호환시켜 적용시킬 수 있으며, 이차전지모니터용 블랙박스모듈에 저장된 측량데이터와 영상데이터를 통해 리튬이온전지 및 리튬폴리머 전지 등의 개별 구성 전지의 밸런싱(BALANCING)에 의한 용량 감소, 과충전 등에 의한 사고유발, 잔량 경고 이후의 사용시간 예측, 및 소비자의 연료 경고 이후의 행동 예측, 전기차의 전기차 및 전기구동장치 사고 및 전기차용 이차전지 성능 향상에 막대한 영향을 주는 고속 충전, 고율방전에 의한 잔량예측, 사용환경의 급속한 변경 등에 대한 이차전지의 반응 등을 예측할 수 있는 데이터를 획득할 수 있고, 무엇보다 이차전지의 이상신호발생시, WiFi 통신모듈을 통해 전기차 및 전기구동장치 사용자의 스마트폰으로 사전에 알려줄 수 있어, 대형사고를 미리 예방시킬 수 있는 이차전지 모니터용 블랙박스장치를 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Multifunctional projection exit light
title_ko: 다기능 프로젝션 유도등
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A multifunctional projection exit light is provided to display various pictograms with one exit light by displaying the pictograms implemented by a projection, and to transmit spot images to a central control chamber in case of urgent emergency through bidirectional communications, and to guide an escape in a right direction according to the spot condition by changing the pictogram of the exit light in a remote place. CONSTITUTION: A projection exit light includes a light source(212), a pictogram board(213), an optical mechanism(216), and a screen(220). The pictogram board is separated from the light source, and generates a pictogram by selectively transmitting light. The optical mechanism processes the pictogram to be formed on the screen. The screen displays the pictogram which passes through the optical mechanism. [Reference numerals] (202) Intensity of illumination; (211) Power unit; (212) Light source; (213) Pictogram 1; (214) Pictogram selection unit; (215) Control unit; (216) Optical unit
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유도등의 그림문자를 프로젝션을 이용하여 구현하고 피난자의 신속한 피난을 도와줄 수 있는 경보기능 및 피난자와 중앙 통제실과의 영상통신기능 등을 포함하는 다기능 프로젝션 유도등에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 유도등은 광원과, 다수의 그림문자 표지를 구비하고 있고 광원에 의하여 발생한 빛을 선택적으로 투과시켜 그림문자 이미지를 생성하기 위한 그림 문자판과, 그림문자판의 다수의 그림문자 중 하나를 선택하여 표시하도록 하는 그림문자 선택부와, 그림문자 이미지를 광학적으로 처리하여 스크린에 맞게 그림문자가 맺히게 하는 광학 메커니즘과, 광학 메커니즘을 통과한 그림문자를 표시하는 스크린으로 구성된다. 따라서 본 발명에 따르면 다수의 그림문자 표지를 준비한 후 설정이나 원격 선택신호에 따라 선택된 그림문자를 표시하여 동일한 유도등으로 다양한 종류의 그림문자를 표시할 수 있고, 이에 따라 피난경로가 변경되어도 유도등을 교체할 필요가 없어 사용이 편리하며 화재발생위치에 따라 올바른 방향으로 피난하도록 유도할 수 있다. 그리고 일련의 에니메이션용 그림문자들을 준비해 놓은 후 순차적으로 그림문자를 선택하여 반복 표시할 경우에는 에니메이션과 같은 동적인 그림문자를 피난표지로서 표시할 수도 있다.

title_en: Distress signal receiver using car and method thereof
title_ko: 차량용 재난신호 수신기 및 그 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A disaster signal receiver for vehicles and a method thereof are provided to output a disaster broadcast through a vehicle A/V system by receiving a disaster signal transmitted by a nation. CONSTITUTION: If an ON-state of an ignition key is detected from an ignition state detecting unit, a control unit(140) confirms the extraction of a disaster signal from a disaster signal receiving unit. The control unit generates an operation control signal of an A/V system. The control unit generates a frequency alteration control signal. An A/V system operating unit(150) operates the A/V system according to the operation control signal of the A/V system. The A/V system operating unit outputs a disaster broadcast by altering a frequency of the A/V system according to the frequency alteration control signal. [Reference numerals] (110) Key input unit; (120) Driving state detecting unit; (130) Disaster signal receiving unit; (140) Control unit; (150) A/V system driving unit; (200) A/V system
abstract_ko:
재난지역 안에 차량 진입시 자동으로 국가에서 송출하는 재난신호를 수신하여 차량의 오디오/비디오 시스템(A/V시스템)을 통해 재난방송을 출력해줄 수 있도록 한 차량용 재난신호 수신기 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 
개시된 차량용 재난신호 수신기는 재난신호 수신기의 동작신호를 입력하기 위한 키 입력부와; 차량의 시동 상태를 검출하기 위한 시동상태 검출부와; 안테나를 통해 수신한 신호로부터 재난신호를 추출하여 출력하는 재난신호 수신부와; 상기 키 입력부를 통해 재난신호 수신기의 동작신호가 입력되고, 상기 시동상태 검출부로부터 차량의 시동 키가 온 상태가 검출되면 상기 재난신호 수신부로부터 재난신호가 추출되는지를 확인하여, 재난신호 추출 시 자동으로 오디오/비디오 시스템(A/V시스템)의 동작 제어신호를 발생하고, 주파수 변경 제어신호를 발생하는 제어부와; 상기 제어부로부터 발생하는 오디오/비디오 시스템의 동작 제어신호에 따라 자동으로 오디오/비디오 시스템을 동작시키고, 상기 주파수 변경 제어신호에 따라 상기 오디오/비디오 시스템의 주파수를 변경하여 재난 방송을 출력해주는 오디오/비디오 시스템 구동부를 구비한다.

title_en: Ship approach warning system and warning method for bridge protect
title_ko: 교량 보호를 위한 선박 접근 경보 시스템 및 경보 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A ship approach warning system for bridge protection and a warning method thereof are provided to prevent a ship from colliding with a bridge by sensing a ship which approaches the bridge and enters the sensing area and warning it. CONSTITUTION: An approach detection unit is constituted with a laser radiation unit (100), a control unit, a laser light receiving unit, a detection unit (300) and a micro processor unit (MPU) (600). The laser radiation unit and the laser light receiving unit are installed at the bridge center of the right lower part of the superstructure of a bridge. The detection unit provides an output of the laser light receiving unit and an output of a photo detector sensed in the laser radiation unit. A condenser lens (202) is installed in the front of an avalanche photo diode (APD) of the laser light receiving unit. A warning driver (700) is controlled by being connected to an output port of the MPU.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 바다의 연도교(連島橋)나 연륙교(連陸橋) 또는 강에 설치된 장대 교량의 보호를 위하여 접근 중인 선박을 감지하여 경보를 발할 수 있도록 하는 교량 보호를 위한 선박 접근 경보 시스템 및 그 경보 방법을 개시한다. 
본 발명은 교량에 접근하는 선박을 감지함에 있어서 감지 영역에 음영이 발생됨을 최소화함과 아울러, 최대 감지 거리를 비행하여 복귀하는 신호에서 각종 노이즈를 포함한 입사 신호에서 유효 신호를 산출하기 위한 연산처리과정에서 소요되는 시간을 단축시킬 수 있도록 하여 넓은 영역에 걸쳐서 실시간으로 교량 상부 구조 보호를 위한 선박 접근 경보가 가능하게 된다. 
또한, 본 발명은 조류가 선박의 상방에서 비행하여 선박의 높이로 오인되지 않도록 조류와 선박에 의한 입사 신호 파형을 식별할 수 있도록 함으로써 작동의 신뢰성을 높일 수 있게 되는 효과가 있다. 
아울러, 본 발명은 선박이 교량의 교각에 똑바로 접근하는 경우에만 경보를 발하도록 하여 선박과 교량의 교각이 충돌됨을 방지할 수 있도록 하여 교량과 선박의 충돌을 방지함으로써 막대한 사회적 손실 및 인명, 재산상의 손실을 방지할 수 있게 되는 유용한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Intelligent fire alarm system and management method based on fire location information
title_ko: 화재발생 위치정보를 포함한 화재 알림 경보 제공 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire informing and alarming data providing method and a system capable of including the fire occurrence location information are provided to enable a quick and safe escaping. CONSTITUTION: A location based intelligent fire alarm system comprises a fire receiver operating protocol processer, a generation server operating protocol processor, a management monitoring unit, and a communication unit. The fire receiver operating protocol processer performs the fire location information processing by operating with the fire receiver which includes the fire sensor. The generation server operating protocol processor starts or cancels the fire alarm to a generation server which manages a home network device for the fire alarm within the generation. The management monitoring unit displays and controls the fire occurrence location expression or the processing status on a screen in the graphic. The communication unit provides a communication protocol for sending and receiving the fire occurrence location information by the wire/wireless communication and a communication port. [Reference numerals] (100) Fire alarm system; (115) Management monitor; (120) Receiver synchro protocol S/W; (130) Complex server synchro protocol S/W; (140) Fire alarm driving S/W; (150) Fire alarm starting S/W; (160) Fire alarm stopping S/W; (170) DEMS; (180) GUI; (200) Complex server; (210) Fire alarm synchro S/W; (300) Wall pad; (320) Voice alarm device; (340) Virtual alarm device; (400) Fire receiver; (500) Fire detecter
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재발생에 의한 경보 알림 문제점을 해결하여 입주자 안전을 위한 화재발생 알림 경보를 제공하는 것으로, 현재 보급 중인 홈 기기에 첨단 IT 기술을 실현하여 음성경보 및 시각 경보 기능을 적절하게 동작하게 함으로써 화재발생 후 입주자들에게 신속하게 화재발생을 알리며 안전한 대피를 할 수 있도록 한다. 이를 위해 홈기기, 경보장치, 유/무선 통신 네트워크 및 관리 서버를 구성으로 하고, 관리 서버에 화재위치정보 처리 프로세스를 구현하여 공동 주거지 역 내 또는 세대 내 입주자에게 신속한 화재 경보가 가능하도록 하는 화재알림 경보를 제공한다. 특히 본 발명에 따른 시스템 및 방법은 화재발생 위치정보를 포함한 화재 알림 경보를 제공하여 입주자가 화재위치를 파악하여 안전한 대피로로 이동할 수 있도록 함을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Communication apparatus, system, control program, and control method
abstract_en: [Problem] The objective of the invention is to arrange that even in a case where a function to prevent secret information, which has been stored in a communication apparatus, from being leaked has been enabled, the function be disabled if a vibration is of a case where the function is not necessary. [Solution] A communication apparatus, which is one of a plurality of communication apparatuses constituting a communication network, is characterized by comprising: a detection unit that detects a vibration of the communication apparatus; a communication unit that receives, from another one of the plurality of communication apparatuses, a notification indicating that a vibration has been detected at the other communication apparatus; and a control unit that, when the detection unit has detected a vibration, causes the state of the communication apparatus to transition to a warning state in which the information managed by the communication apparatus is protected and that, when it has been determined, on the basis of the notification, that the vibration is of an earthquake, cancels the warning state.

title_en: Packet exchange device, packet exchange program, packet exchange method, and mobile wireless device
abstract_en:
Problem
To efficiently process emergency messages.
Solution Means
A packet exchange device has a reception means for receiving the position registration update request from a mobile wireless device that includes a control means for attaching an emergency call identifier to a position registration update request when an emergency call is transmitted and a transmission means for transmitting the position registration update request; a decision means for determining whether an emergency call identifier is attached to the position registration update request received by the reception unit, a priority order determination means that sets the mobile wireless device that transmitted the position registration update request at a higher priority than a mobile wireless device that transmitted a position registration update request without an attached emergency call identifier when the decision unit verified the emergency call identifier for the update of the position registration, and a position registration means for registering the position of the mobile wireless device in the order determined by the priority order determination means.

title_en: Emergency communications mobile application
abstract_en: An automated system, method or computer program product for providing emergency communications can include an emergency communications application and a MyFlare emergency communications server. The MyFlare emergency communications application can run on a mobile device and can be configured to, when activated, interface with the MyFlare emergency communications server to send preconfigured emergency messages to a preconfigured set of emergency contacts. Different emergency profiles can be preconfigured for which different emergency messages can be sent. Additionally, a different set of emergency contacts can be assigned for different emergency profiles. The emergency communications application can be configured to capture additional information, such as but not limited to GPS location of the device, photo, video, or sound recording, in preconfigured time intervals. The updated information can be sent to the one or more preconfigured emergency contacts as part of the initial emergency message or a subsequent emergency notification update.

title_en: Communication System for Emergency Response Teams
abstract_en: A communication system for emergency first responders provides a unique software application (“app”) used on a handheld tablet (for example, an iPad®) and web-based platform to aid with dispatch, communications, scene management, documentation, records, and billing of 9-1-1 emergency medical calls. A “thin” web-based client is viewable through the Internet, including wirelessly from within emergency vehicles, and communicates with a main system that is designed around a core-layered architecture with at least one system database and a web-based interface. The system facilitates report entry and delivery to hospitals and end-user administration, including the ability to create new fields for the e-PCR, notifications about relevant data conditions, continuous reporting capabilities, and en route updates.

title_en: System for emergency public alert service
title_ko: 긴급 공공 경보 서비스 제공을 위한 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system for providing an emergency public alert service is provided to provide an amber alert service to a user of a smart device using a data communications network. CONSTITUTION: In case at least one of a predetermined time condition and a predetermined moving distance is satisfied, a communications unit (120) transmits device information to a location information collecting server or an amber alert service providing device. The device information includes location information reflecting location changes. The communications unit receives data for providing an amber alert service from the amber alert service providing device or a different smart device. A display unit (130) displays the data for providing the amber alert service to a user. [Reference numerals] (100,102,104) Smart device; (110) Location update confirming unit; (120) Communications unit; (130) Display unit; (140) Priority control unit; (150) GPS receiver
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 스마트 기기는 상기 스마트 기기의 위치가 이동함에 따라 발생되는 위치 변동 사항을 체크하는 위치 갱신 판단부; 미리 설정된 시간 조건과 미리 설정된 이동 거리 조건 중 적어도 어느 하나의 조건을 만족하는 경우 상기 위치 변동 사항이 반영된 위치정보를 포함하는 기기정보를 위치정보 수집 서버 또는 앰버 경고 서비스 공급장치로 송신하고, 상기 앰버 경고 서비스 제공을 위한 데이터를 상기 앰버 경고 서비스 공급장치 또는 다른 스마트 기기로부터 수신하는 통신부; 및 상기 앰버 경고 서비스 제공을 위한 데이터를 사용자에게 표시하는 디스플레이부를 포함하여 구성됨으로써, 트래픽 또는 전력부하 문제없이 스마트 기기의 최근 위치정보를 송신할 수 있고, 비상 상황 발생에 대한 정보 및 그에 따라 대처 방안을 신속하게 알려줄 수 있다.

title_en: Secondary battery control device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a technology for managing a secondary battery connected in parallel with a commercial power supply.SOLUTION: An input section for inputting the storage amount to be secured against a blackout inputs the electric storage amount to be secured against a blackout to a secondary battery in preparation against an interruption of a commercial power supply. A charging-timezone input section inputs a timezone for charging the electric power from a commercial power supply to the secondary battery. A control section 34 makes the secondary battery being charged during the timezone being input by the charging-timezone input section. In this configuration, the control section 34 further comprises: a first calculation part 48 for calculating the necessary charging time for charging up to an updated storage amount to be secured against a blackout, when the updated storage amount to be secured against a blackout is newly input to the input section for inputting the storage amount to be secured against a blackout, and the new amount is more than the amount stored in the secondary battery; a second calculation part 50 for calculating a charging start time of the charging that is required to make the storage amount of the secondary battery become the storage amount to be secured against a blackout; and a notification part 52 for causing the charging start time calculated by the second calculation part 50 to be notified of.

title_en: The Disaster Emergency Alert System of using DPS Broadcast of T-DMB
title_ko: 지상파 디엠비 기반 디피에스 방송을 이용한 재난재해 긴급 경보 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 재난재해 상황 시 재해지역의 피해 당사자들 또는 관계자들에게 신속하고 정확한 정보를 제공하기 위한 방송시스템에 관한 것으로 더욱 상세하게는 재난 안전 대책본부, 도로 교통 센터, 기상청, 소방본부, 경찰청에서 제공하는 정보를  통합본부에서 데이터를 수집하여 정보의 유효성과 신뢰성을 검사한 후 T-DMB기반의 DPS방송을 통해 송출하여 각 재해지역의 수신 단말을 통해 관계자들에게 다양한 표출 매체를 통해 신속한 정보를 제공하는 기능을 특징으로 한다. 본 고안은 현재까지의 경보 시스템이 긴급 재난이나 , 재해 등이 발생하거나 , 예측이 되는 지역에 대한 경보 발령에 많은 시간이 소요되어, 실제적인 사전 예방 시스템으로서의 역할을 못하고 있고, 또한 정전으로 인해 재난경보 시스템이 제 기능을 못하는 문제를 보완하고, 경보 발령에 있어 즉시성과 신속성, 정확성을 향상하여 재난 경보 시스템으로서 갖추어야 할 수단과 , 경보 발령 시스템을 구비하게 함으로써 자연 재해나 인재 등으로 인한 막대한 인명 및 재산 손실을 획기적으로 줄이는 것을 목적으로 한다.
