title_en: Personal security device
abstract_en: A security device with a locator module and an identifier module sends an alert signal to warn others of an emergency situation. The security device uses a wireless transceiver to transmit the alert signal and a monitoring center. Location information updates and an audio signal are sent to the monitoring station. The security device may be located within an outer casing that conceals its functionality.

title_en: Low Cost Automotive Accident Alert System
abstract_en: An alert apparatus has a digital processor coupled to an accelerometer and wireless pairing circuitry for pairing wirelessly with a smartphone, software that executes operations or firmware, an OBD connector that monitors the onboard diagnostics system of a vehicle for specific information, monitors the accelerometer for deceleration exceeding a preset value, updates position of the automobile periodically, and, in the event of a determination that an accident has occurred, and transmits an alert signal to the smartphone via wireless pairing circuitry, which then sends alert communications to emergency services and contacts.

title_en: System and method for delivering mobile wireless broadcast messages in designated languages
abstract_en: A mobile wireless system and method are described for distributing emergency alert messages to mobile wireless devices in multiple languages. The emergency alert system receives an alert message including a geographic area identification, and a text alert. The emergency alert system renders one or more translations of the text alert from the text alert. The one or more translated versions of the text alert are provided in particular foreign languages based upon designated foreign languages corresponding to the geographic area identification. The emergency alert system transmits the text alert and one or more translated text alerts commercial mobile wireless service provider networks for broadcasting the text alert and the translated text alert(s) via mobile wireless transmitters having a coverage area falling within a region corresponding to the geographic area identification.
assignees: LEMBERG VYACHESLAV;THALANANY SEBASTIAN;SAXENA NAROTHUM;US CELLULAR CORP

title_en: A kind of emergency maintenance based on target following and renewal integral system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of emergency maintenance based on target following with update integral system and method, include speedily carrying out rescue work, patrol and examine, safeguard mobile terminal and speedily carry out rescue work accordingly, send work, statistical analysiss, the early warning service system integrated with data renewal；The method passes through 1）To mobile object（Including vehicle, personnel）Dynamic tracking, speedily carries out rescue work, patrols and examines, dynamically the reporting of maintenance task, and 2）The generation of job order, distribution, transmission, 3）The automatic classification of work order performance, 4）O＆M business datum according to patrolling and examining, keeping in repair, speedily carry out rescue work generation dynamically updates pipeline facility data base, and 5）Data updates the integrated management with business such as statistical report form generations, the potential safety hazard of facility can be eliminated in time, strengthen its security reliability, improve the Up-to-date state of basic data and the Ability of emergency management of pipe network facilities rescue and relief work, and then improve corresponding enterprise labor efficiency, and enterprise management level.

title_en: Mine side slope deformation monitoring and early warning system and early warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, in particular to a mine side slope deformation monitoring and early warning system and an early warning method thereof. The early warning system is composed of a ground control subsystem, a space wireless communication network and a communication auxiliary subsystem of monitoring workers, wherein the ground control subsystem, the space wireless communication network and the communication auxiliary subsystem are used for carrying out communication connection. The ground control subsystem is composed of a GPS mine side slope monitoring subsystem and a GPS monitoring data processing subsystem. The GPS monitoring mine side slope subsystem comprises a set of displacement measuring robots, a receiving antenna, a data transmission module, a GPS receiver and a power supply system, wherein the GPS receiver is used for receiving mine side slope deformation data collected by the displacement measuring robots. Various data are collected in real time, the monitoring data are processed, and the uploaded data are fast and automatically stored, transmitted, updated, counted and managed. The mine side slope deformation monitoring and early warning system has the advantages that the mine side slope displacement is dynamically monitored in real time, and safety production of a mine is guaranteed.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring invasion using the radio wave
title_ko: 전파를 이용한 침입 감시 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The technical objective intended by the present invention is to provide a method and a system for monitoring invasion using radio waves which can satisfy increase of sensing rate and decrease of error rate, by widening trade off point of the sensing rate and the error rate. As a unit to solve the above technical objective, the method for monitoring invasion using radio waves of the present invention includes: (a) a step in which a transmitting unit outputs a first radio wave and a receiving unit receives a second radio wave passing through a specific space; (b) a step in which a sensing unit generates a first channel matrix for the specific space, by using the first radio wave and the second radio wave; (c) a step in which the sensing unit generates a new second channel matrix, by calculating a direction vector along which the second radio wave is incident from the receiving unit; (d) a step in which the sensing unit calculates the amount of changing of the second channel matrix changed by an invasive object in the specific space as a judgment index; and (e) a step in which the sensing unit judges invasion in the specific space by referring to a pre-established reference value according to the judgment index. The system and the method for monitoring invasion using radio waves according to the present invention monitor physical invasion in the specific space, but can satisfy increase of sensing rate and decrease of error rate at the same time. abstract_ko:
본 발명이 이루고자 하는 기술적 과제는, 감지율과 오보율의 트레이드오프(trade off) 포인트를 넓혀, 감지율의 상승과 오보율의 감소를 동시에 만족할 수 있는 전파를 이용한 침입 감시 방법 및 시스템을 제공하는 데 있다. 
전술한 기술적 과제를 해결하기 위한 수단으로서, 본 발명은 전파를 이용한 침입 감시 방법에 있어서, (a) 송신부는 제1 전파를 출력하고, 수신부는 특정 공간을 거친 제2 전파를 수신하는 단계; (b) 감지부는 상기 제1 및 상기 제2 전파를 이용하여, 상기 특정 공간에 대한 제1 채널 행렬을 생성하는 단계; (c) 상기 감지부는 상기 수신부에서 상기 제2 전파가 입사되는 방향 벡터를 계산하여, 새로운 제2 채널 행렬을 생성하는 단계; (d) 상기 감지부는 상기 특정 공간에서 침입 물체에 의해 변화하는 상기 제2 채널 행렬의 변화량을 판정지수로 산정하는 단계; 및 (e) 상기 감지부는 상기 판정지수에 따라 기 설정된 임계값을 기준으로 상기 특정 공간에 대한 침입 여부를 판정하는 단계; 를 포함하는 전파를 이용한 침입 감시 방법을 제공한다. 
이상의 본 발명에 따른 전파를 이용한 침입 감시 방법 및 시스템은 특정 공간에서 물리적인 침입 여부를 감시하되, 감지율의 상승과 오보율의 감소를 동시에 만족시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Processing emergency alert system messages
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods and apparatus for processing an emergency alert message (e.g., a national warning system message e.g., an Emergency Alert System (EAS) message). The methods may comprise a digital media server receiving the message. The digital media server may notify client devices (that are connected to that server via a residential Local Area Network) that it has received such a message. The client devices notified may be those that have requested (e.g., to the digital media server) that they are notified if the digital media server receives such a message. The digital media server may convert the message from being in a first format to being in a second format. The digital media server may acquire, and provide for use by the client device, information that may be used a client device to ascertain whether the message is a new, an updated, or a duplicate message.

title_en: Method and apparatus for alert validation
abstract_en: Methods, apparatuses, and computer program products are described herein that are configured to enable validation of an alert condition. In some example embodiments, a method is provided that comprises detecting an alert condition. The method of this embodiment may also include generating a set of messages based on one or more key events in a primary data channel and one or more significant events in one or more related data channels in response to the alert condition. The method of this embodiment may also include determining a validity of the alert condition based on the set of messages that express the one or more key events, the one or more significant events, a relationship between the one or more key events and the one or more significant events, an alert context and the one or causes of the alert condition.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning system and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster early warning system. The geological disaster early warning system comprises a comprehensive database, a data analysis module and an early warning module; the comprehensive database is used for storing real-time monitored related data; the data analysis module is used for performing analysis processing on the monitored data by using a corresponding analysis algorithm, wherein the corresponding analysis algorithm can be opened and edited in a use process according to requirements of a user so as to be modified and updated; and the early warning module is used for performing corresponding early warning on the monitored data analyzed by the data analysis module by using a set corresponding threshold value. According to the geological disaster early warning system, since the analysis algorithm inside the data analysis module can be directly opened and correspondingly edited, and therefore, when the user needs to edit the analysis algorithm, the user can directly edit the algorithm in the use process so as to realize corresponding modification and update without the re-development of a corresponding data analysis module required; and therefore, the geological disaster early warning system is advantageous in convenient operation and high application efficiency. The invention also provides a geological disaster early warning method.
assignees: WUHAN DIDA INFORMATION ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Breathing apparatus for emergency
title_ko: 긴급대피용 호흡장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a breathing device for an emergency evacuation to cope with an accident of suffocation due to lack of oxygen and more specifically, to a breathing device for an emergency evacuation which uses by wearing the breathing device for an emergency evacuation in a holder of a working vest; receiving an oxygen for breathing from a small oxygen container in case of emergency; removing a carbon dioxide which is contained in outbreathing; and reusing for breathing. The breathing device for an emergency evacuation comprises: a face module which is used for breathing by being adhered in a face of user; an oxygen supplying module which supplies the oxygen in the face module; a communication module which communicates and alerts with each user or a control center. The face module has a face body which is adhered in the face by having a concave part in the center to cover nose and mouth, an adapter which is formed in the concave part, a first check valve which is formed in one side of the face body; a band to fix in the a head; wherein the adapter comprises: an oxygen supplying part which receives the oxygen from the oxygen container of the oxygen supplying module; a filter to remove the moisture and carbon dioxide; a respiratory sac which is adhered in a respiratory sac connecting part in one side of the adapter to store and reuse fresh oxygen and expiratory air.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 산소결핍에 의한 질식사고에 대응하기 위한 긴급대피용 호흡장치에 관한 것으로서, 상세하게는 작업조끼 등의 거치대에 긴급대피용 호흡장치를 착용하고 있다가 긴급시에 소형 산소용기로부터 호흡용 산소를 공급받고, 날숨에 포함된 이산화탄소를 제거하여 다시 호흡에 사용하는 긴급대피용 호흡장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 긴급대피용 호흡장치는 사용자의 안면에 밀착되며 호흡에 사용하는 면체모듈, 상기 면체모듈에 산소를 공급하는 산소공급모듈 및 사용자 상호간 또는 관제센터와 경보 및 통신을 하는 통신모듈을 포함하고, 상기 면체모듈은 중앙 부분이 오목하여 코와 입을 가리고 안면에 밀착되는 면체와 오목부에 형성되는 어댑터, 상기 면체의 일측에 형성되는 제1 체크밸브 및 머리에 고정할 수 있는 밴드로 구성되고, 상기 어댑터는 상기 산소공급모듈의 산소용기로부터 튜브로 산소를 공급받는 산소공급구, 수분과 이산화탄소를 제거하는 필터 및 상기 어댑터의 일측단의 호흡낭연결구에 부착되어 신선한 산소 및 사용자의 날숨 공기를 저장하고 재사용하기 위한 호흡낭을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Workflow-based quick response system and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a workflow-based quick response system and application of the system in a mobile production line of airplane general assemblies. The system comprises an abnormal information obtaining module, an information classification and confirmation module, an early warning information releasing module and a response information synchronizing module, wherein the abnormal information obtaining module captures and submits abnormal information based on a mixed information capturing mechanism; the information classification and confirmation module comprehensively analyzes, determines and processes the abnormal information based on a quick response workflow; according to information generated in the quick response workflow, the early warning information releasing module displays early warning information via different early warning display devices; and the response information synchronizing module is connected with the early warning information releasing module via serial ports to query and update information in the quick response workflow. The system can be used to display, manage and monitor different production emergency information in the airplane assembling process, can help relevant departments take measures rapidly to decrease direct man-hour consumption in assembling, eliminates delay in production process, improves product quality, and finally realizes the requirement of zero-latency production.

title_en: Earthquake warning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an earthquake warning device capable of effectively emitting high-decibel sound alarm and radio alarm when an earthquake occurs. According to the device, the components of a mercury switch or a heavy hammer switch, a sensitivity switch, an emergency knob switch, an audio alarm cancel switch, an interlocking contactor, an interlocking contactor closed contact, a breaking type button, a sound alarm, a radio alarm, a rechargeable batteries and a hand generator are in electrical connection through conductive wires, and then the above components are orderly installed and combined with components of an alarm shell, an alarm base, a resonance supporting spring and a radio wave emitting antenna to form a mercury switch earthquake warning device or a heavy hammer switch earthquake warning device.

title_en: Video monitoring system alarm indentity identifying method, Apparatus and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of video monitoring system alarm indentity identifying method, Apparatus and system, described method includes: the alarm of detection front end, and notifies that mobile phone signal is intercepted unit and gathered the mobile phone signal in corresponding monitoring region accordingly；Resolve described mobile phone signal, and send acknowledged alarm message to the phone number parsed；Choose whether to eliminate the alarm of described front end according to the acknowledged alarm feedback message obtained.The video monitoring system alarm indentity identifying method that the present invention provides can be implemented easily in video monitoring system, and reliability is high, wherein involved relevant pre-conditioned can arrange flexibly, improves the accuracy that video monitoring system alerts.

title_en: Real-time monitering and diagnostic system for turn-out branching-off point and crossing
title_ko: 분기기 및 선로전환기 실시간 감시 및 진단 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for monitoring and diagnosing a branching-off point and a track turning point and comprises a track turning point safety information reception unit for receiving the safety information of a track turning point sensing unit for sensing the safety operation of the track turning point which provides power to convert the branching-off point ,which converts the direction of the track to convert the progress direction of a train, into a normal position and an opponent position; an adhered locking apparatus safety information reception unit for receiving the safety information of an adhered locking apparatus sensing unit for sensing the safety operation of the adhered locking apparatus for locking by adhering a tongue rail to a basic rail according to the conversion of the branching-off; an adhered detecting point safety information reception unit for receiving the safety information of an adhered detecting point sensing unit for sensing the safety operation of the adhered detecting point for detecting the adhered state of the basic rail and the tongue rail; and a comparison processing unit for analyzing the position and cause of faults by analyzing the safety information inputted from the track turning point safety information reception unit, the adhered locking apparatus safety information reception unit, and the adhered detecting point safety information reception unit. According to the present invention, the system accurately and rapidly responds to faults of operation and maintenance by transmitting an error message or emergency warning when abnormal information is generated after analyzing the safety information of the track turning point, the adhered locking apparatus, and the adhered detecting point by receiving the safety information using the cable in real time. abstract_ko:
본 발명은 분기기 및 선로전환기 실시간 감시 및 진단 시스템에 관한 것으로; 열차의 진행 경로를 변경하기 위해 열차가 운행되는 선로의 방향을 변환하는 분기기를 정위 또는 반위 방향으로 전환할 수 있도록 동력을 제공하는 선로 전환기가 안전하게 작동하는지 감지하는 선로 전환기 센싱부의 안전정보를 수신하는 선로전환기 안전정보 수신부와; 상기 분기기 전환에 따라 기본레일에 텅레일이 밀착되면 쇄정하는 밀착쇄정장치가 안전하게 작동하는지 감지하기 위한 밀착쇄정장치 센싱부의 안전정보를 수신하는 밀착쇄정장치 안전정보 수신부와; 기본레일과 텅레일의 밀착 상태를 감지하는 밀착검지기가 안전하게 작동하는지 감지하는 밀착검지기 센싱부의 안전정보를 수신하는 밀착검지기 안전정보 수신부와; 상기 선로전환기 안전정보 수신부와 밀착쇄정장치 안전정보 수신부 및 밀착검지기 안전정보 수신부로부터 입력되는 안전정보를 분석하여 고장 유무 및 고장 위치와 원인을 분석하는 비교처리부;로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 선로전환기와 밀착쇄정장치 및 밀착검지기의 안전정보를 실시간으로 케이블을 통하여 병렬로 수신하여 정상 또는 비정상 여부를 분석한 후 만약 비정상 정보가 발생된 경우에는 비상경보 또는 에러 메시지를 송출함으로써 운영 및 유지보수 요원 등이 이상 또는 고장이 발생한 위치를 정확히 알 수 있어 신속하고도 정확한 대처를 할 수 있다.

title_en: Compact local operation pannel
title_ko: 콤팩트 현장조작반
abstract_en: Although a conventional industrial site operating panel is intermittently operated, installation costs are too high and installation spaces are too big, thereby a space usability and safety are compromised and the conventional site operating panel is limited in terms of a kind of operator information, availabilities, and distances. To solve the above-mentioned problems, circuits are miniaturized, the size of the site operating panel is reduced, and operator information is diversified. A main frame (41) is added in a motor control panel (20) and information for the site operating panel and an alarm lamp (60) is transmitted to and received from the site operating panel (10) in a digital format via a dedicated cable. Therefore, the motor control panel (20), site operating panel (10), and alarm lamp (60) are integrated in one system. A specialized system, which is 100% compatible with specific sites without modifying conventional circuits and configured to be 1:1 matched with loads, is thus provided according to the present invention, such that construction and maintenance costs are reduced. A machinery room is provided to improve accessibility of operators. The site operating panel is installed in various ways such as on walls or ceilings as well as on grounds, such that installation convenience is improved and negligent accidents are prevented. A voice alarm and the alarm lamp are installed, such that a remote status monitoring is enabled. 일반적으로 산업용으로 사용되는 현장조작반은 간헐적으로 운전되는 용도에 비하여 시설 비용이 많고 공간차지가 너무 많아서 공간의 활용성과 안전에 문제가 있어왔으며 운전자정보의 종류 및 수단과 거리에 있어서도 극히 제한적이었다. 
위 문제를 해결하기 위하여 회로를 소 세력화하여 선로 및 현장조작반의 크기를 줄이고 운전자 정보를 다양화하였다 
그 방법으로 전동기제어반(20)내의 유니트(40)내에 본체(41)을 추가하여 전원이 부가된 상태에서 입·출력이 될 수 있도록 디지탈 부호로 변환하여 전용케이블을 통하여 현장조작반(10)에 현장조작반과 경광등(60)에 필요로하는 정보를 송·수신하도록 구성되어  전동기제어반(20)-현장조작반(10)-경광등(60)을 일괄시스템으로 구성 되도록 하였다. 
그래서 본 발명은 위의 문제점을 개선하기 위하여 부하와 1:1로 구성되고 기존의 회로와도 변경없이 100%호환되는 현장과 꼭맞는 특성화된 시스템을 개발하여 공사비 및 유지관리비를 절감하고 기계실 공간을 확보, 작업자에게 편리한 접근성을 제공하고, 시공방법에서도 지상설치만 가능한 것을 벽걸이 또는 천정걸이 형식 등 다양한 방법으로 설치할 수 있도록 하여 설치의 편리성 및 전기안전사고를 방지하도록 하였으며, 음성경보 및 경광등을 설치할 수 있도록 하여 원거리에서도 상태를 감시할 수 있도록 하는 시스템이다.

title_en: A security system for atm using face recognition and the method of using the same
title_ko: 얼굴인식기능을 활용한 금융자동화기기 보안 시스템 및 보안 방법
abstract_en: A security system for an ATM using a face recognition function according to the present invention includes: a camera which photographs the front image of the ATM; a display unit which is formed on the front of the ATM and displays a financial transaction service screen; and a control unit which controls the operations of the camera and the display unit and recognizes the face of a person from the image obtained through the camera by using a face recognition algorithm. If two or more faces are recognized on the image obtained through the camera, a warning screen is displayed to a user through the display unit. [Reference numerals] (310) Warning/Please note of the personal information leakage; (AA) User; (BB) Rear access; (CC) Transaction in progress; (DD) Deposit withdrawal; (EE) Account transfer; (FF) Additional service; (GG) Cancel
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 얼굴인식기능을 활용한 금융자동화기기 보안 시스템 및 보안 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 금융자동화기기의 전면에 구비된 카메라를 이용하여, 사용자가 금융자동화기기를 이용하는 경우, 카메라를 통해 금융자동화기기 전방의 영상을 획득하고, 얼굴인식기능을 통해 획득된 영상에 나타나는 얼굴을 인식하여, 획득된 영상에서 2인 이상의 얼굴이 인식되면, 사용자 이외의 배후접근자와 금융자동화기기 간의 거리를 감지하여, 배후접근자가 금융자동화기기로부터 일정 거리 이내에 일정 시간 이상 존재하는 것이 감지되면, 금융자동화기기의 디스플레이 화면을 통해 사용자에게 배후접근자가 있음을 알리는 경고 메시지를 제공하는 동시에, 경고음을 출력하여 배후접근자가 금융자동화기기, 즉 사용자의 배후로부터 일정 거리 이상 떨어지도록 유도함으로써, 사용자의 개인정보 유출을 방지함은 물론, 배후접근자의 범행 시도를 미연에 방지할 수 있도록 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 얼굴인식기능을 활용한 금융자동화기기 보안 시스템 및 보안 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은, 얼굴인식기능을 활용한 금융자동화기기 보안 시스템에 있어서, 금융자동화기기에 구비되어 상기 금융자동화기기 전방의 영상을 촬영하는 카메라; 금융자동화기기 전면에 구비되어 금융거래 서비스화면을 표시하는 디스플레이부; 및 상기 카메라 및 디스플레이부의 동작을 제어하며, 얼굴인식 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 카메라를 통해 획득된 영상에서 사람의 얼굴을 인식하는 제어부;를 포함하여 구성되어, 상기 카메라로부터 획득되는 영상에서 2인 이상의 얼굴이 인식되는 경우, 상기 디스플레이부를 통해 사용자에게 배후접근자의 존재를 알려주는 경고화면을 표시하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A kind of method and system for guiding mobile personnel and equipment keep away calamity
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of method and system for guiding mobile personnel and equipment keep away calamity.Method and step is as follows：1）It is mobile that audiomonitor is preset keeps away calamity prediction scheme；2）Each monitored location matches have regional location code, keep away calamity prediction scheme active coding, and are broadcasted；Keep away calamity prediction scheme active coding to be determined according to disaster scenarios it, the different type of disaster, cause different destructions corresponding different prediction scheme active codings or prediction scheme active coding combination respectively；3）Move the real-time audit area position code of audiomonitor, keep away calamity prediction scheme active coding, if the regional location code listened to, keeping away calamity prediction scheme active coding and pointing to current mobile audiomonitor, then update the positional information of the mobile audiomonitor of storage according to current region position code, and activated by keeping away calamity prediction scheme active coding and preset keep away calamity prediction scheme；If it is not, then ignoring；Proceed monitoring in real time.The particular location of audiomonitor holder can be accurately judged to move, so as to keep away calamity guiding for its progress.

title_en: Method and apparatus for communicating emergency information
abstract_en: A method that incorporates teachings of the subject disclosure may include, for example transmitting, by a system comprising a processor, via a first emergency media channel a first video stream comprising first evacuation routing information for a first evacuation group responsive to receiving a notification of an emergency event, instructing, by the system, a first media processor device to select the first emergency media channel while disabling selection of other media channels according to the first evacuation routing information, where the content of the emergency media channel is presented at a display device by way of the first media processor device, and enabling, by the system, the first media processor device to select the other media channels responsive to receiving user input acknowledging the emergency media channel. Other embodiments are disclosed.

title_en: Method of and system for provisioning public safety communication devices via a wireless local area network protocol to communicate with one another in a common talk group configuration
abstract_en: Public safety (PS) communication devices are provisioned at an incident scene to communicate with each other in a common talk group configuration. Talk group information is contained in a beacon message that is broadcast by an initiating PS device in an access point mode of operation via a Wi-Fi network protocol compatible with at least one version of IEEE standard 802.11. The beacon message is received via the same Wi-Fi protocol at another PS device in a station mode of operation and processed to configure the other PS device with the talk group information.
assignees: SERGEEV VLADIMIR A;IGUMNOV DMITRY V C PRAKASH;KLEIN DAVID E;MOTOROLA SOLUTIONS INC

title_en: Display device, portable terminal, display system and map display method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To update a map indicating a route to an evacuation site easily and at low cost, and thereby safely evacuate a user at disaster occurence.SOLUTION: A display device connected to a portable terminal 200 comprises: a first communication part 110 for transmitting/receiving data to/from the portable terminal 200; a first acquisition part 112 for acquiring from the portable terminal 200 map data which is data of a map indicating a route from a specified point of the display device 100 to an evacuation site at disaster occurence; a detection part 104 for detecting a warning signal from a broadcast signal; and a display control part 108 for displaying a map indicated by the map data on a screen when the detection part 104 detects the warning signal.

title_en: System for having access to flood-prevention early warning service based on Android tablet terminal and construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for having access to a flood-prevention early warning cloud service based on an Android tablet terminal and a construction method. The construction method includes the steps of real-time data acquiring of the flood-prevention early warning cloud service, early warning rule management and setting, early warning analysis, early warning information pushing and message noticing and data acquiring, storage and display of a flood-prevention early warning client side system of the Android tablet terminal. Rain condition, water condition, weather, dangerous circumference situation and disaster situation system service interfaces and other system service interfaces are packaged by the flood-prevention early warning cloud services to acquire real-time data, early warning service modules are partitioned according to flood-prevention work needs, corresponding early warning rules are made, data format content is formed, real-time information is analyzed accordingly, and early warning information is pushed to the tablet terminal; message notice pushed by the flood-prevention early warning cloud services is monitored based on the flood-prevention early warning client side system of the Android tablet terminal, latest early warning information data are downloaded from the cloud services or early warning information is acquired in an active request mode and is classified, updated and displayed according to different early warning modules.

title_en: Supplemental rescue resources
abstract_en: A supplemental rescue resources system can receive an emergency alert message from a mobile device and use data from the message and other sources to determine and select appropriate supplemental rescue resources, which may include may include any person that has volunteered or is otherwise a participant in the system that is not an on-duty emergency responder. The supplemental rescue resources system may select a supplemental rescue resources based on the location of such resources relative to the location of an incident, and/or the qualifications and/or preferences of such resources. The supplemental rescue resources system may direct resources to the incident and notify emergency services providers of the supplemental resources. The supplemental rescue resources system may request and/or receive additional information from supplemental resources, emergency services providers, and/or those reporting incidents and use this information to adjust the notified supplemental resources, update emergency services providers, and/or update affected parties.

title_en: Notification information outputting device using message input means located in a remote place
title_ko: 원격지에 위치한 메시지 입력수단을 이용한 알림정보 출력장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for outputting notification information using a message input means located in a remote place and, more particularly, to an apparatus for outputting notification information, which is capable of changing messages outputted from the apparatus collectively or separately using a message input means located in a remote place. An apparatus for outputting notification information using a message input means located in a remote place according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a wireless communication unit which wirelessly receives a message including device identification information from the message input means, but receives the message when the device identification information is identical to a predetermined identification information; a memory unit which stores the received message; an output unit which outputs, to the outside, the message stored in the memory unit as notification information including video and audio; and a control unit which controls the wireless communication unit, the memory unit, and the output unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원격지에 위치한 메시지 입력수단을 이용한 알림정보 출력장치에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 원격지에 위치한 메시지 입력수단을 이용하여 알림정보 출력장치에서 출력되는 메시지를 일괄적으로 또는 개별적으로 변경할 수 있는 알림정보 출력장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 알림정보 출력장치는, 원격지에 위치한 메시지 입력수단을 이용한 알림정보 출력장치로서, 상기 메시지 입력수단으로부터 장치 식별정보가 포함된 메시지를 무선으로 수신하되, 상기 장치 식별정보가 기설정된 식별정보와 동일할 경우 메시지를 수신하는 무선통신부; 수신된 상기 메시지를 저장하는 메모리부; 상기 메모리부에 저장된 메시지를 영상 및 음성을 포함하는 알림정보로서 외부에 출력하는 출력부; 및 상기 무선통신부, 상기 메모리부 및 상기 출력부를 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Warning image display method and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of warning image display method and system, the video channel sequence corresponding to each alarm set point current is preserved at server, simultaneously according to the guard signal received and recovery this video channel sequence of signal real-time update of reporting to the police, and obtain the video data of each video passage in the video channel sequence of renewal, and the video data transmitting got is given client terminal and carries out a point screen display and show or scroll; Or the video channel sequence after upgrading is sent to client terminal, obtain the video data of each video passage by the video channel sequence received from warning video data deposit end for client terminal, and the video data obtained are carried out a point screen display and shows or scroll, make client terminal can show the warning video of multiple alarm set point simultaneously, it is convenient to record the situation of each alarm set point.

title_en: Techniques for clock recovery following a power outage
abstract_en: Clock reference data may be recovered or updated in networks that include line-powered devices and other devices susceptible to power outages. For example, for a mobile information collection network, one or more devices with extended clock holdover may be strategically deployed throughout the mobile information collection network to provide reference clock data. As another example, battery-powered devices may be woken up in order to provide clock reference data to other devices. Alternatively or additionally, the battery-powered devices may be configured to periodically broadcast their clock reference data to other devices.

title_en: Communication terminal device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a communication terminal device capable of appropriately controlling an update of a program such as firmware in the communication terminal device, when receiving emergency information such as an emergency earthquake advance report.SOLUTION: A communication terminal device 100 performs notification of notification information based on emergency information received through a network 300. The communication terminal device 100 comprises: a control unit 110 for controlling the communication terminal device; a receiving unit 150 for receiving the emergency information; and a notification unit 180 for performing notification of the notification information based on the received emergency information. When the receiving unit 150 receives the emergency information, the control unit 110 prohibits update processing of a program for a predetermined time which is previously set in the case where the received emergency information includes information exceeding a reference value for determining whether to prohibit the update processing of the program.

title_en: A kind of indoor emergency response context aware navigationsystem and navigation method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of indoor emergency response context aware navigationsystem and navigation method. Described navigationsystem at least comprises positioned sensor network, server and early warning sensor, and described positioned sensor network is by the locating base station of the wired or wireless connection of same server, form with the mobile terminal of locating base station wireless connections and/or positioning label and the LED screen with locating base station wired connection; Described early warning sensor is with server wireless connections. The multiple context of described navigation methods combining indoor environment calculates guidance path, and sight residing for user presents guidance path to user in several ways adaptively, it is provided that real-time, accurate, personalized navigation Service. The present invention can be used for large complicated indoor venue personnel positioning, emergency evacuation, Post disaster relief, the security control such as hospital, market, office building, station etc., it is possible to the science of raising public place emergency response disposal, promptness, validity.

title_en: A vehicle cooperation communication system sending a agent message
title_ko: 긴급메시지의 전송이 가능한 차량 협력 통신 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a vehicle cooperation communications system capable of preferentially processing an urgent message. The vehicle cooperation communications system of the present invention comprises a receiving module which is installed in a second vehicle to receive an urgent message including sending cycle information and a message valid time from a peripheral first vehicle; a control module to control the urgent message to be sent to at least one peripheral third vehicle according to the sending cycle information during the message valid time; and a sending module to send the urgent message to the third vehicle according to the control of the control module.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 긴급메시지를 우선적으로 처리할 수 있는 차량 협력 통신 시스템을 개시한다. 
본 발명의 차량 협력 통신 시스템은 제2차량에 설치되며, 주변의 제1차량으로부터 송신 주기 정보 및 메시지 유효 시간을 포함한 긴급메시지를 전달받는 수신 모듈; 상기 메시지 유효 시간 동안 상기 긴급메시지를 상기 송신 주기 정보에 따라 주변의 적어도 하나의 제3차량으로 송출하도록 제어하는 제어 모듈; 및 상기 제어 모듈의 제어에 따라 상기 긴급메시지를 상기 제3차량으로 송출하는 송신 모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: Public address system having emergency information apparatus
title_ko: 긴급알림용 pa 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a PA system for urgent notification capable of accurately notifying a resident of an emergency situation when emergency (for example, a fire) occurs in a building. The present invention is composed of a fire sensor (114) electrically connected to a public address control device (104), installed in a passage of the building, and sensing smoke in real time according to the control of the public address control device (104); a CCTV (116) electrically connected to the public address control device (104), installed in the passage of the building, and making a video of the emergency situation (for example, a fire) in real time according to the control of the public address control device (104); an IPTV (118) electrically connected to the public address control device (104), installed in a house in the building, and displaying in real time the emergency situation (for example, a fire) made into the video by the CCTV (116) according to the control of the public address control device (104); and a communication part (122) electrically connected to the public address control device (104) to notify the emergency situation (for example, a fire) to a smart phone (120) of the resident according to the control of the public address control device (104).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물에 긴급상황(예를 들어, 화재 등)이 발생할 경우, 거주자에게 긴급상황을 정확하게 알려 줄 수 있도록 한 긴급알림용 PA시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명은 전관방송 제어장치(104)에 전기적으로 연결됨과 아울러 건물의 복도에 설치되되, 전관방송 제어장치(104)의 제어에 따라 실시간으로 연기를 감지하는 화재감지센서(114)와; 전관방송 제어장치(104)에 전기적으로 연결됨과 아울러 건물의 복도에 설치되되, 전관방송 제어장치(104)의 제어에 따라 실시간으로 긴급상황(예를 들어, 화재 )을 촬영하는 CCTV(116)와; 전관방송 제어장치(104)에 전기적으로 연결됨과 아울러 건물에 살고 있는 가정집에 설치되되, 전관방송 제어장치(104)의 제어에 따라 CCTV(116)에서 촬영되는 긴급상황(예를 들어, 화재 )을 거주자에게 실시간적으로 디스플레이해 주는 IPTV(118)와; 전관방송 제어장치(104)에 전기적으로 연결되어 전관방송 제어장치(104)의 제어에 따라 거주자의 스마트폰(120)으로 긴급상황(예를 들어, 화재)을 알려 주는 통신부(122)로 구성된다.

title_en: Automatic operating head structure for unmanned automatic fire extinguisher
title_ko: 무인 자동 소화기의 자동 작동 헤드 구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatically operating head structure of an automatic fire extinguisher and, more specifically, an automatically operating head structure of an automatic fire extinguisher capable of automatically spraying a fire extinguishing agent filled in a fire extinguisher main body. The automatic fire extinguisher includes a automatically operating hollow head main body having a spray nozzle spraying the fire extinguishing agent filled in the fire extinguisher main body; an operation pin arranged in a passage which supplies the fire extinguishing agent filled in the fire extinguisher main body to the spray nozzle of the automatically operating head main body; and a heat sensing body which changes an original shape or is damaged when the temperature of a space where the automatic fire extinguisher is located corresponds to a preset temperature. The automatically operating head main body comprises a screw unit, an operation head body, a plurality of long holes, and a fixing screw.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무인 자동 소화기의 자동 작동 헤드 구조에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 소화기 본체에 충전된 소화 약제를 자동으로 분사하는 무인 자동 소화기의 자동 작동 헤드 구조로서, 중심이 관통된 중공 형상으로 상기 소화기 본체에 충전된 소화 약제가 분사되는 분사노즐을 형성하는 자동 작동 헤드 본체; 상기 소화기 본체에 충전된 소화 약제를 상기 자동 작동 헤드 본체의 분사노즐로 공급하는 통로에 배치되는 작동 핀; 및 상기 무인 자동 소화기가 위치한 공간의 온도가 미리 설정된 온도에 해당하면 그 본래 형상이 변형되거나 파괴되도록 작동하는 감열체를 포함하며, 상기 자동 작동 헤드 본체는, 상기 소화기 본체에 구비되는 소화기 본체 연결부와 나사 결합 방식으로 체결되는 나사부; 상기 나사부에 일체로 연장되면서 상기 나사부의 내경보다 큰 내경을 갖도록 확장되며, 내부에 상기 작동 핀이 삽입 체결되는 작동 핀 체결부를 형성하는 작동 헤드 몸체; 상기 작동 헤드 몸체의 외경 길이방향으로 형성되는 복수의 장공; 및 상기 감열체가 배치된 상기 작동 헤드 몸체의 말단 내경을 일부 개방시키면서 상기 감열체를 고정시키기 위해 체결되는 고정 나사를 포함하여 구성하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 무인 자동 소화기의 자동 작동 헤드 구조에 따르면, 개선된 단일 구조를 갖는 자동 작동 헤드 본체를 구성함으로써, 기존의 무인 자동 소화기의 자동 작동장치에 구비되는 스프링의 탄성 수단과 외부 핀 캡이 제거되고, 개선된 단일 구조의 단순화를 통해 구성 부품이 감소되고 조립이 용이해지며 그에 따른 원가 및 조립 공정의 시간이 절감될 수 있음은 물론, 무인 자동 소화기의 성능은 그대로 유지될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 화재를 감지하는 기능을 하는 감열체가 소화 약제가 분사되는 분사노즐과 같은 방향으로 설치되어 있어서 화재가 감지되는 방향과 소화 약제가 분사되는 방향을 일치시킴은 물론, 작동 헤드 몸체에 형성된 복수의 장공을 통해서도 소화 약제가 스프링클러 형태로 분사될 수 있도록 함으로써, 소화 약제를 넓게 분사시켜서 화재 발생 장소의 불씨를 초기에 원활하게 진화할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Digital security system, method and program
abstract_en: Provided are a digital security system, method and program that are capable of reporting an emergency in terms of security without allowing a suspicious person to become aware of the reporting, even when the report is made right in front of the suspicious person, and to do so while also improving reliability by preventing report errors and failures. The digital security system is provided with: an abdominal muscle pressure signal acquisition unit (101) that acquires an abdominal muscle pressure signal from an abdominal muscle pressure sensor (10) which detects the abdominal muscle pressure of a user, and that also acquires a respiratory signal from a respiratory sensor (20) that detects the respiration of the user; an abdominal muscle pressure signal extraction unit (102) that cancels out the respiratory signal component from the acquired abdominal muscle pressure signal and extracts an abdominal muscle pressure signal for which the impact of respiration is suppressed; an abnormality determination unit (112) that determines whether there is an abnormality on the basis of the abdominal muscle pressure signal from which the respiration signal component has been cancelled out; and a warning transmission unit (203) that reports an abnormal state on the basis of the abnormal state occurrence determination results.

title_en: Browser-based alerting system
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are methods and systems for displaying alerts in a web browser. An alert repeater is configured to receive an alert from an alert provider. A geographical determiner is configured to determine an effective geographical area for the alert. The alert repeater sends the alert over a browser update communication channel to an alert receiver in a web browser within effective geographical area. The alert receiver then displays the alert in the web browser.
assignees: WILTZIUS THOMAS CHRISTIAN;CUSHING KATHRYN;MARRA GREGORY MATTHEW;WALD GIDEON;GOOGLE INC

title_en: RFID labeling-based highway emergency warning message (EWM) data packet identification and reception method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a RFID labeling-based highway emergency warning message (EWM) data packet identification and reception method. The method comprises that 1, a RFID responder is installed at each inlet of a highway, wherein the responder comprises ID information of the highway and information related to mileage from the starting inlet of the highway to the responder and ID information data of parts of the same highway along different driving directions are different, 2, when a vehicle goes through an inlet of the road provided with the RFID responder, a reader installed in the vehicle reads highway ID information and mileage information in the responder, 3, a vehicle-mounted CPU effectively processes and records the acquired ID information and mileage information, accumulates the recorded mileage to the mileage computed at the intersection, and continuously updates the memory cell, and 4, through EWM information received by an OBU, according to preferential identification and comparison between the ID information and mileage information in the EWM data packet, the vehicle determines a relative position relationship with a vehicle in an accident and then determines if the EWM information needs to be read or transmitted.

title_en: Building evacuation system with positive acknowledgment
abstract_en: An emergency notification and response system is linked to a fire alarm system, a security system and to a communication network over which it sends and receives emergency messages to and from building occupants and to emergency response personnel. The emergency notification and response system comprises a notification module which operates to receive signals from a fire detection system and send one or more messages to building occupants to investigate the validity of a possible fire event, and to respond to the message with an indication that a fire event is in progress or not. Depending upon information received in the response, the notification module sends an evacuation message to a selected sub-set of the building occupants that includes instructions for evacuating the building.

title_en: Multimedia alerting
abstract_en: A method, system, apparatus, and device provides alert information to a user of a device. In response to an alert notification of an alert, one or more alert geographical tiles of interest that are affected by the alert of a plurality of geographical tiles are determined; one or more location-enabled devices each having a location that falls within an alert geographical tile of the one or more alert geographical tiles are determined; a portion of the alert is retrieved from an alert database and processed to generate a media version of the alert; an alert text notification of the alert having the text portion of the alert, an alert identifier of the alert, a reference identifier for the media version of the alert, the one or more alert geographical tiles, and the one or more one or more device identifiers for each of the one or more devices is constructed; the one or more device identifiers for each of the one or more devices, the alert text notification and the alert identifier of the alert is retrieved and the alert text notification is transmitted to the one or more devices corresponding to the retrieved one or more device identifiers.

title_en: Systems and methods for worker location and safety confirmation
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and software are provided herein for worker location and/or safety confirmation. In at least one example, a user will carry a user device which include monitoring functionality. This device will monitor for concerning event such as an unexpected location, a lack of user movement, a press of an emergency button, over time, or time out condition, or any other indication of a concerning event. If an alert associated with the event is not acknowledged by the user, the user device may transmit an alert to a user station and/or a network. In turn, the user station and/or network will transmit an alert to a remote station regarding the status of the user device.

title_en: Emergency notification using indoor positioning
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for providing location based assistance using indoor positioning data. One of the methods includes receiving, by a user device, selection of an alert request, the alert request specific to an emergency for a user of the user device, initiating, by the user device, a timer having a predetermined duration, automatically gathering, by the user device, physical indoor location data for the user device, automatically sending, by the user device, a message indicating the alert request to an assistance system upon expiration of the timer, the message comprising the physical indoor location data, and automatically facilitating, by the user device, communication between the user of the user device and the assistance system.

title_en: Earthquake alarming instrument
abstract_en: The present invention relates to earthquake pre-warning technical field, in particular to earthquake alarming instrument.This earthquake alarming instrument, including: shock detection circuit, control circuit and warning circuit；Shock detection circuit, for producing vibration signal according to the geology vibrations detected；Control circuit, for generating alarm control signal according to vibration signal；Warning circuit, is used for performing alarm control signal and carrying out earthquake alarm.This earthquake alarming instrument that the present invention provides, utilize the progressive time of earthquake, when earthquake tentatively occurs, shock detection electric circuit inspection in earthquake alarming instrument goes out vibration signal, control circuit utilizes this vibration signal to send rapidly alarm, being achieved in effective early warning of earthquake, prompting personnel withdraw rapidly when earthquake occurs, and thus reduce the loss brought because of earthquake.

title_en: A Fire Evacuees' Context- Information Providing Method and A System therefor
title_ko: 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention comprises a CCTV; a flame/smoke sensor; a server which includes a person detection module, a context information module, a fire dynamics simulator (FDS), and a building exodus, receives images from the CCTV, and transmits the context information on evacuees in a building to an emergency operation center; a person characteristic information database which has person detection information, such as person patterns; a building information database which has information on the building, such as the drawing of the building; a detection information database which stores the person detection information by areas in the building; and an emergency operation center which receives the context information from the server in a fire and sends a rescue team to the building.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 대피자의 상황정보를 종합방재 센터의 구조대에게 제공하는 시스템에 있어서, CCTV, 화염/연기 감지 센서,  상기 CCTV의 영상에서 사람을 검출하고 대피자의 수와 위치를 확인하는 사람 검출 모듈, 상기 사람 검출 정보와 상기 센서의 정보를 기반으로 대피자의 상황정보를 생성하는 상황 정보 모듈, 화재의 현상을 가상 모델링하는 시뮬레이션하는 FDS(Fire Dynamics Simulator), 건물 상주 인원들의 대피경로를 계산하는 Building Exodus를 포함하며, 상기 CCTV로부터 영상을 수신 받고 화재시 상기 건축물의 대피자에 대한 상황정보를 종합방재 센터로 전송하는 Server, 상기 사람 패턴과 같은 사람 검출 정보를 가지고 있는 사람 특징 정보 데이터베이스, 상기 건축물의 도면과 같은 건축물의 정보를 가지고 있는 건물 정보 데이터베이스, 상기 사람 검출 모듈에서 검출된 사람 검출 정보를 건축물 내부의 지역별로 저장하는 검출 정보 데이터베이스, 화재시 상기 Server로부터 상황정보를 수신 받고 구조대를 상기 건축물로 보내는 종합방재 센터로 이루어진 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 시스템과,  
상기 CCTV으로부터 영상을 입력받는 영상 입력 단계, 상기 CCTV의 동작여부를 확인하는 CCTV 작동 여부 확인 단계, 상기 CCTV가 동작하지 않을 경우 경보를 제공하는 사람 검출 오류 경보 단계, 사람을 검출하는 사람 검출 단계, 화재가 발생하였는지 확인하는 화재 발생 확인 단계, 평시에 종합 방재 센터로 정보를 전송한 전송 주기를 확인하는 전송 주기 확인 단계, 사람 검출 정보를 상기 검출 정보 데이터베이스에 저장하는 사람 검출 정보 갱신 단계, 화재가 발생한 지역을 확인하고 FDS를 통해 화재 현상, 화재 위험 지역 및 인명 사상 지역 정보를 계산하여 화재 상황 정보를 계산하는 화재 상황 정보 확인 단계, Building Exodus를 통해 인명 가상 대피 정보와 잔류 인원에 대한 정보를 계산하는 화재 인명 정보 확인 단계, 사람 검출 정보와 화재 상황 정보, 화재 인명 정보들을 종합방재 센터로 전송하는 인명 상황 정보 전송 단계로 이루어진 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 의한 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 시스템 및 방법으로, 기존 건축물의 CCTV를 통해 화재시 대피인원 및 잔류 인원에 대한 상황정보를 획득하기 때문에 종래의 시스템들이 시스템 구축을 위해 생체 신호를 수집하는 센서, 위치 정보를 제공하는 센서, 상기 센서들로부터 정보를 수신 받는 PDA와 같은 장치들로 인해 시스템 구축이 어렵고 시스템 사용이 복잡한 종래의 문제점들을 해결할 수 있으며, 실시간으로 상기 건축물의 대피인원 및 잔류인원들에 대한 가상의 대피 정보를 정확하게 시뮬레이션하고 화재 현상 모델링을 기반으로 화재 상황을 정확하게 시뮬레이션하기 때문에 보다 정확한 인명 구조를 위한 정보의 수집이 가능하며, 상기 시뮬레이션정보, 사람 검출 정보를 실시간으로 종합방재 센터로 전송하여 구조대가 인명을 구조하기 위한 구조 시간의 단축과 정확한 구조를 하는데 효과적이다. 
또한, 평시에도 사람 검출정보를 전송하기 때문에 화재시 본 발명에 의한 시스템이 문제가 발생하게 될 경우 평시에 전송되어진 최근 정보를 기반으로 보다 신속하게 상기 건축물의 구조를 수행할 수 있다는 장점이 있다.
assignees: UNIV HANNAM INST IND ACAD COOP

title_en: A Disaster Broadcasting Device
title_ko: 재난방송장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster broadcasting apparatus which is installed at several areas and informs a disaster promptly when the disaster occurs and, more particularly, to a disaster broadcasting apparatus which can minimize battery consumption without using a separate GPS module because the position of the disaster broadcasting apparatus can be detected automatically on the basis of a received terrestrial DMB signal. The disaster broadcasting apparatus can perform normal disaster broadcasting in an emergency situation when a part of a communication network is damaged due to the multiplexing of a communication network, by broadcasting a signal corresponding to established priority first by establishing the priority as using a triple communication network of a mobile communication network signal, a terrestrial DMB signal and a VHF signal, and can increase efficiency of maintenance by being able to upgrade, add, change and delete a function of a control program remotely by being able to update the control program remotely. Also, the disaster broadcasting apparatus can enable a neighboring resident to grasp and manage an urgent patient situation rapidly before a rescue team arrives, by receiving an RF signal of a a health care device in a neighboring area and broadcasting received information about an urgent patient to a neighboring village.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 여러 지역에 설치되어 재난재해 발생시 이를 신속하게 알리는 재난방송장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로는 수신된 지상파DMB 신호를 바탕으로 재난방송장치가 설치된 위치를 자동으로 감식할 수 있어 별도의 GPS모듈을 사용하지 않게 되어 배터리 소모를 최소화할 수 있고, 이동통신망 신호, 지상파DMB 신호 및 VHF 신호의 3중 통신망을 활용하면서 또한 우선순위를 설정하여 설정된 우선순위에 해당하는 신호가 먼저 방송되도록 하여 통신망의 다중화로 일부 통신망이 손상된 긴급 상황에서도 정상적인 재난방송이 이루어질 수 있도록 하고, 제어프로그램을 원격으로 업데이트시킬 수 있어 원격으로 제어프로그램의 업그레이드, 기능 추가·변경·삭제가 가능하여 유지보수의 효율성을 높이고, 아울러 인근 지역의 헬스케어기기의 RF 신호를 수신하여 수신된 응급환자 관련 정보를 인근 마을에 방송하여 구조대가 도착하기 전에 응급환자 상황을 인근 주민이 신속하게 파악하여 대처할 수 있도록 하는 재난방송장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: wireless broadcasting system for the park
title_ko: 공원 무선방송시스템
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a better multimedia environment for park users by installing a wireless broadcasting system in a park. The wireless broadcasting system for park, according to the present invention, comprises: an integrated management server (1), a site control unit (12) installed on side for each zone, and a wireless broadcasting receiving unit (10). A Monitor (8) and an electronic display board (7) are connected to a site media player (4) in the site control unit (12). Voice is transmitted to the wireless broadcasting receiving unit (10) wirelessly through a transmitter (5) and the antenna (6). The wireless broadcasting receiving unit (10) is composed of a solar cell (16), a battery, a radio receiver (15), an amplifier (14), and a speaker (13).
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따르는 공원 무선방송시스템은 통합관리서버(1), 각 구역별로 현장에 설치된 현장제어부(12), 무선방송수신부(10)로 구성되며, 상기 현장제어부(12)에는 현장미디어 플레이어(4)에는 모니터(8), 전광판(7)이 연결되고, 송신기(5),안테나(6)를 통해 무선으로 무선방송수신부(10)에 음성이 전달되며, 무선방송수신부(10)는 태양전지(16) 등 밧데리,무선수신기(15),증폭기(14),스피커(13)로 구성되어 있다. 통합관리서버(1)의 방송가능한 컨텐츠는 음원(MP3),RADIO,TTS 및 제작된 방송 컨텐츠를 지원하며, 현장에 전광판(7) 설치시 전광판 운영 S/W를 지원하며, 모니터(8)를 설치할 경우에 지원되는 컨텐츠는 WMV,AVI,MPEG,SWF,HTML,JPG,GIF,BMP 데이터 포맷을 지원하고, 방송스케쥴은 시간,요일,기간별로 관리하며, 스케쥴변경시 관련 콘텐츠는 단말기로부터 자동 배포되고, 단말기에서 요일별로 방송시간을 설정할 수 있고, 방송 중계단말기는 설정된 스케쥴대로 방송을 진행중 관리자에 의해서 원격제어로 강제방송이 전송되고, 단말기에 전원을 ON/OFF제어를 설정할 수 있으며, 단말기에 방송 유무를 확인할 수 있도록 FEEDBACK확인기능이 있으며, 현장에 설치된 현장제어부(12) 및 무선방송수신부(10)의 전원은 태양전지를 사용한다. 또한, 필요시 외부 데이터(예 기상데이터,재난관리 등)와 연동하여 자동으로 표출되도록 하는 공원 무선방송시스템이다.

title_en: Audio and lighting alert apparatuses and methods
abstract_en: An apparatus is described including a camera, a weather sensor, an alert button, a speaker, a light and a sign fixed to a support structure. Changed conditions can be acknowledged in one or more of the camera, the weather sensor and the alert button. Changed conditions can be broadcast from one or more of the speaker, the light and the sign. Additional embodiments are also described.

title_en: Forest Fire Alarm real-time monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Forest Fire Alarm real-time monitoring system.It comprises: forest ranger's carried terminal, relaying research station and Surveillance center; Described forest ranger's carried terminal comprises the first central processing unit, with the GPS module being connected respectively with described the first central processing unit, intercom system, the first wireless frequency expansion module and alarm, is also included as the supply unit of above-mentioned module for power supply; Described relaying research station comprises the second central processing unit, with the video acquisition device being connected respectively with described the second central processing unit, warning public address set, the second wireless frequency expansion module and the first wireless communication module; Described Surveillance center comprises control computing machine, and with the second wireless communication module and the Forestry Information database server that are connected respectively with described control computing machine, described Forestry Information database server also comprises map display system.So just can the also synchronous forest ranger of real-time update make an inspection tour information and Forest Fire Alarm information.

title_en: Safety protection equipment in poly butylene succinate production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the safety protection equipment in poly butylene succinate production, comprise: the tetrahydrofuran (THF) mixed solution withdrawing can being arranged at the eluting column in succinic acid workshop, being arranged at knockout tower in poly butylene succinate workshop and thermal sensing device, being connected with knockout tower, succinic acid workshop is connected with poly butylene succinate workshop by transport pipe; Also comprise: the video acquisition device being arranged at distribution substation, be arranged at infrared intrusion detector and the fire protection warning assembly of poly butylene succinate finished goods warehouse; Be arranged at the quick collector of cigarette of heat exchange station; Distribution substation connects succinic acid workshop, poly butylene succinate workshop respectively by flame resistant cable; Heat exchange station connects succinic acid workshop, poly butylene succinate workshop respectively by thermal conductive pipe; Poly butylene succinate finished goods warehouse is connected with poly butylene succinate workshop by transport pipe.The utility model improves safety precaution work from production monitoring, fire-fighting, video monitoring, infrared monitoring.
assignees: JINHUI ZHAOLONG HIGH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for automated dispatch of mobile devices in a communication system
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for automated dispatch of mobile devices is provided herein. An infrastructure controller device receives one of an alert and request for a response with respect to an associated location and identifies a first set of mobile devices for responding to the one of the alert and request. The device transmits a first dispatch request to each mobile device in the first set requesting dispatch to the associated location. The device subsequently identifies a higher priority mobile device for responding to the one of the alert and request relative to a lower priority mobile device. Responsive to this identification, the device transmits a second dispatch request to the higher priority mobile device requesting dispatch to the associated location, and further transmits a recall notice to the lower priority mobile device withdrawing the first dispatch request to the lower priority mobile device.

title_en: Network telephone broadcast all-in-one
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of network telephone broadcast all-in-one, comprise: power supply inputs, body, it is characterized in that, also comprise: for the extension set plate controlling phone, broadcasting call signal amplifies, for optical fiber transmission signal and the fiber optical transceiver equipment processing call, audio frequency, for the Switching Power Supply of power supply process, for the transformer that broadcast singal amplifies and audio signal is amplified; For giving the power board that extension set plate is powered and broadcast singal amplifies, optical fiber interface; Power interface, signaling interface, speaker interface, loudspeaker, door lock, microphone, button, police guard at as entrance; Wherein, extension set plate, fiber optical transceiver equipment, Switching Power Supply, transformer; Power board, optical fiber interface; Power interface, signaling interface, speaker interface, loudspeaker, door lock, microphone, button, police guard at as entrance is all located on body.There is echo cancelltion and ambient noise inhibit feature; Can be connected with fire-fighting signal; Sound clarity is smooth, and occupied bandwidth is low, long transmission distance, safe and reliable.
assignees: CHANGZHOU TIANZHI COMM EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Wireless fire sensing system of apartment house for the deaf
title_ko: 청각 장애인을 위한 공동 주택 무선 화재 감지 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 소리를 듣지 못하는 청각 장애인을 위한 공동 주택 무선 화재 감지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 아파트 등 공동주택에서는 화재가 발생하였을 때 현관 밖의 소화전에서 소리로 화재에 대한 위험 경고를 큰 경종 소리로 알려 주게 된다. 그러나 소리를 듣지 못하는 청각 장애인의 경우 밖에서 들리는 경고 소리를 듣지 못해 집안에서 화재 경보 대응을 하지 못하게 되어 위험에 처할 수 있는 가능성이 있다. 소방법에 의거, 이미 설비인증 받은 소화 시설은 어떠한 형태로든 변경, 변형이 안되기 때문에 기존의 화재 경보기에는 일체 손을 댈 수가 없다. 하여 기존의 화재 경보기 부근에 근접 부착할 수 있는 무선 경보 소리 감지 발신기를 통해 빛이나 진동으로 경보를 집안의 청각 장애인에게 확실하게 알려 주어 화재경보시 안전하게 대응할 수 있게 한 청각장애인을 위한 공동 주택 무선 화재 감지 시스템으로 매우 유용한 고안인 것이다.

title_en: Social information provision system, social information distribution apparatus and user terminal device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To distribute social information which is time-sequentially varied, for each category and in such a manner that a user can acquire and browse the social information in an optimal style as required.SOLUTION: In a social information distribution apparatus, basic information including locations of a plurality of information sources and social information time-sequentially issued from the plurality of information sources are stored while being sorted for each of items which are divided beforehand, and the stored social information is analyzed in accordance with a designated purpose, corrected as needed and updated as a part of items. Social information to be defined as a broadcasting object is selected from the stored social information and a broadcasting style including at least a classification of a broadcasting zone, a broadcasting time zone and the number of times of repeats within the broadcasting time zone in the case of broadcasting the selected social information is determined. The selected social information is sent out to the designated broadcasting zone by broadcasting waves in accordance with the determined broadcasting style. A user terminal device performs positioning of a current location and displays the social information on a display while including a relation between a location indicated in the social information distributed from the social information distribution apparatus and the current location on which the positioning has been performed.

title_en: Automatic switching from primary to secondary audio during emergency broadcast
title_ko: 비상 방송중 주 오디오로부터 보조 오디오로의 자동 전환
abstract_en: An audio video display device (AVDD) includes: a display, a processor controlling the display, and a computer readable storage medium that is accessible to the processor. The computer readable storage medium includes instructions which, when executed by the processor, cause the processor to present, on the AVDD, AV content that is not associated with information pertaining to an emergency. The instructions cause the processor to receive, at the AVDD, data associated with an emergency alert and, to be responsive to receiving the data associated with the emergency alert, to change audio presented on the AVDD from a first audio presented on the AVDD and associated with the AV content to a second audio associated with the data to present the second audio. The second audio is presented on the AVDD automatically without receiving user input to change from the first audio to the second audio subsequent to receiving the data associated with the emergency alert.
abstract_ko: 오디오 비디오 디스플레이 디바이스(audio video display device: AVDD)는 디스플레이, 디스플레이를 제어하는 프로세서, 및 프로세서에 액세스될 수 있는 컴퓨터 판독가능 저장 매체를 포함한다.  컴퓨터 판독가능 저장 매체는 프로세서에 의해 실행될 때, 프로세서가, AVDD 상에 비상 사태에 관련된 정보와 연관되지 않은 AV 콘텐츠를 제시하도록 하는 명령어들을 포함한다.  명령어들은 프로세서가, AVDD에서 비상 경계와 연관된 데이터를 수신하도록 하고, 비상 경계와 연관된 데이터를 수신하는 것에 응답하여, AVDD 상에 제시되는 오디오를, AVDD 상에 제시되고 AV 콘텐츠와 연관된 제1 오디오로부터 그 데이터와 연관된 제2 오디오로 변경하여 제2 오디오를 제시하도록 한다.  제2 오디오는, 비상 경계와 연관된 데이터를 수신하는 것에 후속하여 제1 오디오로부터 제2 오디오로 변경하기 위한 유저 입력을 수신하지 않고 자동으로 AVDD 상에 제시된다.

title_en: Distribution and Cabinet Panel take in Measurement and Alert Device for Leakage Current With Resistance Element
title_ko: 저항성 누전 측정 및 경보기가 장착된 배전 및 분전반
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a distribution and cabinet panel mounting a resistive leakage current measurement and alert device and, more particularly, to a distribution and cabinet panel mounting a resistive leakage current measurement and alert device, capable of accurately checking a leakage state based on a detection result by accurately detecting an effective resistive leakage current flowing on the ground due to the degradation of an electric wire on the distribution and cabinet panel. The present invention includes a circuit breaker (2) to which utility power (1) is inputted, a DPDT relay (3), a load part (4), a current detecting unit (7), a control unit (8), a calculation and determination unit (11), a voice generating unit (12), and an alert generating unit (13). The distribution and cabinet panel mounting the resistive leakage current measurement and alert device according to an embodiment of the present invention prevents an electric shock accident and an electrical fire.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 저항성 누전 측정 및 경보기가 장착된 배전 및 분전반에 관한것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 배전 및 분전반에 전선 열화로 인해 대지에 흐르고 있는 유효한 저항성 누설전류를 정확하게 검출하여, 그 검출결과에 근거하여 누전 측정 및 경보가 이루어지도록 함으로써 관리자로 하여금 정확한 누전상태를 확인 할 수 있게 하는 저항성 누전 측정 및 경보기가 장착된 배전 및 분전반에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 상용전원(1)이 입력되는 차단기(2), 상기 차단기(2)는 DPDT 릴레이(3)에 입력되고, 상기 DPDT 릴레이(3)는 부하부(4)에 입력되고,  
상기 부하부(4)는 제어부(8)에서 동작신호(6)가 상기 DPDT 릴레이(3)에 입력되면 대지접지와 연결되어 저항성 누설전류를 검출한 측정값을 전류 검출부(7)에 의해 제어부(8)에 입력되고,  
상기 제어부(8)는 입력된 상기 측정값을 산출 및 판단부(11)에 입력하고, 상기 산출 및 판단부(11)에서 출력된 측정값을 판단하여 음성 발생부(12)와 경보 발생부(13)에 누전 측정값의 상태를 전송함과 동시에 관리자나 관리실(2)에서 누전상태를 확인 할 수 있게하는 저항성 누전 측정 및 경보기가 장착된 배전 및 분전반으로 구성하여 본 발명의 과제의 해결 수단이다. 
본 발명은 배전 및 분전반에 전선 열화로 인해 대지에 흐르고 있는 유효한 저항성 누설전류를 정확하게 검출하여, 그 검출결과에 근거하여 누전 측정 및 경보가 이루어지도록 함으로써 관리자로 하여금 정확한 누전상태를 확인 할 수 있게 하는 저항성 누전 측정 및 경보기가 장착된 배전 및 분전반을 제공하여 감전사고와 전기화재를 예방하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of Combined multifunctional danger avoidance cabin
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Combined multifunctional danger avoidance cabin, danger avoidance cabin divides Top Tank and base cabinet, the handtailor plate made for personnel's hedging and by 9 blocks of stainless steels of its base cabinet by slot and bolt connecting mode assembled, every block handtailor plate and reinforcement thereof are all proportionally filled with traditional insulation materials (aluminium silicate wool) and nano novel heat-barrier material (aerogel heat-insulating felt), the base cabinet of danger avoidance cabin is inner except having clothing bar for hanging except clothing at ordinary times, also be provided with safety cabinet, magazine, safety seat, apparatus of oxygen supply, cleaning system, warning system, defense device etc., form one and there is wardrobe and safety cabinet purposes at ordinary times, can hedging and the Multifunctional danger-avoiding equipment of seeking survival time in danger.When the emergency situations such as violence invasion, fire, earthquake occur, when people fail withdraw in time and be cooped up indoors, danger avoidance cabin can be entered and take refuge safely.Can hide, report to the police and survive for 3 adults in this danger avoidance cabin inner space, open hatch door or by escaping exit out after safety again.

title_en: A kind of district monitoring system based on PIC single chip microcomputer
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of district monitoring system based on PIC single chip microcomputer, comprising for receiving ammeter, water meter, gas meter and alarm probe four input of road pulse signal the single-chip microcomputer carrying out taking turns continuous query and carry out data analysis to the input port state of ammeter, water meter, gas meter and alarm probe within certain sampling period, for storing the storer of described input port state information and the central computer for inquiring about the storage information in storer and copy; Storer connects with single-chip microcomputer; Single-chip microcomputer is set up defences passage, passage of withdrawing a garrison, separate alert passage and passage of seeking help; This district monitoring system also comprises for carrying out the telepilot of radio communication with single-chip microcomputer; The output terminal of single-chip microcomputer is connected to liquid crystal display.This district monitoring system equipment is simple, with low cost, is convenient to safeguard, effectively can realize three tables and automatically gather charging, and have antitheft, take precautions against natural calamities, the function such as automatic alarm and remote monitoring.
assignees: SHAANXI YATAI ELECTRIC APPLIANCE CO LTD

title_en: Transmission apparatus, transmission method, reception apparatus, reception method, and computer program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To suitably transmit emergency alarm information by using a broadcast service.SOLUTION: A transmission apparatus 200 (broadcast station) inserts a start signal as signaling of emergency alarm information, writes the scale (category) of a disaster, the type of the disaster, the occurrence time of the disaster, the occurrence position of the disaster, and version information as a message of the emergency alarm information, and transmits them by using the packet structure of a physical layer. Even a simple and inexpensive reception apparatus 300 having a broadcast receiving antenna and a demodulator mounted thereon is capable of receiving the message of the emergency alarm information. A digital signage and a street lamp can be used to display a refuge direction and a map and a route to a refuge place, and the street lamp can be used to indicate a refuge path.

title_en: Transmitter, receiver and controlling method thereof
title_ko: 송신 장치, 수신 장치 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a transmitter. The transmitter comprises: a frame generation unit for generating a frame including data to be transmitted; and a preamble insertion unit for inserting a preamble into the frame, wherein when the predetermined emergency alert event is occurred, the preamble insertion unit inserts at least a portion of emergency alert service (EAS) messages to notify an emergency alert event to the preamble, adds an additional preamble including the rest of the EAS messages to the preamble, and changes an indicator value provided in the preamble so as to indicate whether the additional preamble is inserted or not. Accordingly, only EAS-related main information is transmitted in a preamble form, thereby guaranteeing a robust transmission. Also, by directly transmitting L1 information of the related data, power consumption can be reduced.
abstract_ko: 송신 장치가 개시된다. 송신 장치는 전송할 데이터를 포함하는 프레임을 생성하는 프레임 생성부 및 프레임에 프리앰블을 삽입하는 프리앰블 삽입부를 포함하며, 프리앰블 삽입부는, 기 설정된 긴급 경고 이벤트(Emergency Alert Event)가 발생하면, 긴급 경고 이벤트를 알리기 위한 EAS(Emergency Alert Service) 메시지의 적어도 일부를 프리앰블에 삽입하고, 나머지 일부의 EAS(Emergency Alert Service) 메시지를 포함하는 부가 프리앰블을 프리앰블에 추가하고, 프리앰블 내에 마련된 인디케이터 값을 변경하여 부가 프리앰블의 삽입 여부를 표시할 수 있다. 이에 따라, EAS 관련 주요 정보만을 프리앰블 형태로 전송함으로써 로버스트한 전송을 보장할 수 있고, 관련 데이터의 L1 정보를 직접 전송함으로써 전력 소모량을 줄일 수 있다.

title_en: Emergency mobile notification handling
abstract_en: Systems and methods for handling emergency notification messages such as Commercial Mobile Alert System (CMAS) alerts. In an example scenario, a call center maintains personal profiles of a number of clients, including contact information for persons or other entities designated by the clients to receive information about the clients. The call center receives from a device associated with a particular client of the call center that the client's device has received a text-based emergency notification message. The call center notifies one or more of the designated entities. The notification may include the content of the emergency notification message, and may include an audio version of the notification message. An indication or the notification message may also be placed in a database accessible to one or more of the designated persons or entities.

title_en: A kind of Hearing Impaired's special intelligent fire-alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Hearing Impaired's special intelligent fire-alarm.Comprise acoustic-optic alarm, base, power bin and smell alarm.Acoustic-optic alarm is arranged on base by screw, and power bin is arranged on base by plastics clip, and smell alarm and base integrated make shaping.Alarm receives automatic fire alarm signal or visitor's intercommunication signal, start micro motor by the interlock of parallel connection power supply line simultaneously, micro motor controls the airtight cover plate of smell alarm by motor shaft and rotates, be provided with barrier plate and control airtight cover plate maintenance 90 degree of maximum unlatchings, smell warning solution can volatilize fast, reminds Hearing Impaired or old man to withdraw in time.The utility model is with low cost, and install simple, alarm security is effective, is easy to promote.After the utility model is installed, effectively can promote the alarm rate to Hearing Impaired.Meet every national regulation requirement, make up the defect of domestic existing conventional fire warning device.
assignees: CHINA LIGHT INDUSTRY WUHAN DESIGN ENG CO LTD

title_en: The technical Skill of Smart phone and Application Control car collision, Sudden stop, Sudden Speed Reduction by Navigation's Situation Pursuit System and Smart phone's Situation Searching System.
title_ko: 자동차 내비게이션의 위치 추적 시스템과 스마트폰의 위치 찾기 기능으로 자동차 추돌을 위성의 거리 측정기능으로 방지하는 급제동, 급 감속 장치를 명령, 지시하는 애플리케이션과 스마트폰 기능기술.
abstract_ko:
본 고안품은 자동차가 서로 차량끼리 중앙선 침범 등으로 정면추돌 시와 사람과의 추돌(인사사고) 때문에 수많은 희생자가 생기고 심지어 고속도로 순찰 경찰관이 사고 처리 중에 고속도로 상에서 안개등의 기상악화 등의 관계와 운전자의 전방주시의무와 과속 때문에 등 운전자의 모든 운전의무사항을 불충실한 행위들 때문에 생기는 사고 등을 예방하고 특히, 어둠이 내린 시골 국도와 좁은 간선 도로변 등에서도 운전자의 시야확보 등이 잘 되지 않고 보행자들의 부주의 때문 소중한 생명을 잃는 사례가 많았습니다. 
     자동차 사고는 때와 장소를 가리지 않고 일어나고 있는데 우리나라는 전 세계에서 교통사고 1위이고 그런 사고를 사전에 막을 수 있는 모바일 기술력도 전 세계에서 1위인 IT강국의 자부심을 가진 나라이고 국민입니다. 물론 수치심도 가지고 있는 나라이고 국민입니다 
     지금 전 세계는 "사물인터넷 시대" 를 열렸고 우리나라에서도 "사물인터넷" 이란 용어가 대통령의 연설 중에서 나와 많은 국민들이 그 필용 성과 편리함을 잘 알게 되었고 더 많은 IT개발자들이 대 기업 등에 밀리고 눌려 주춤했던 어깨를 펴고 이젠 굉장한 아이디어들로 "사물인터넷" 세상을 열고 쏟아져 나오고 있습니다. 
     한번 생각을 해 보십시오. 자동차가 사람과의 추돌을 피하고 혹시 추돌이 예상되면 신호음 등으로 사전에 모바일 알림이가 그 역할을 해준다면 얼마나 안전 할 수가 있을까요. 
     칠흑 같은 어두운 밤길에서도 차량 운전자에게 전방1km 앞에 사람으로 예상되는 형상이 움직이고 있으니 감속이 꼭 필요하고 전방주시요함. 이라고 어두운 밤길에서 내비게이션에서 예쁜 음성으로 알려주면 얼마나 편리하고 안전한 운전과 운행을 할 수가 있겠습니까?! 
     그렇습니다. 이젠 본 고안품으로 그 어려웠던 "인사사고" 와 "차량추돌사고" 를 해결 할 수 있게 되었고 많은 국민의 고귀한 생명도 지킬 수가 있다는 것입니다. 또한 본 고안품의 전 인류가 다 혜택을 받고 누릴 수 있도록 할 것입니다. 
     외국의 발명특허의 사례를 보면 최첨단 군사용품 등을 이용한 열 감지기능과 레이드 등까지 응용, 이용한 전방 장애물을 사전에 감지하는 차량기능 장치는 개발되고 있으나 그 고안품은 차량에 설치해야할 장치기기가 너무 대형이고 차량운행에도 불편함이 많고 가격도 비싼 것이 단점으로 작용하고 있는데 본 고안품은 현재 사용 중인 차량의 내비게이션을 이용하고 물론 현재 사용하는 위성과의 주파수도 같은 것을 사용하고 위치추적 장치 시스템도 현재에 사용 중인 것을 그냥 사용하고 단, 본 고안품의 핵심기술기능을 "애플리케이션" 에 프로그래밍 하여 스마트폰의 기능을 함께 이용하여 이 모든 기능을 더 간단하게 수행하면서 보다 정확한 한 것이 특징이고 혁명이라고 할 수가 있다. 는 것이다. 물론 그 기능은 간단하나 그 기능만큼은 그 어떤 군사용품보다 성능이 우수하고 그 오차의 범위도 최소화 했다. 라는 것이다. 큰 특징이고 자랑이다. 
     그 기능을 요약하여 설명해보면 현재 스마트폰으로 사용자의 위치 추적을 위성을 이용한 이동통신사의 서비스를 자세하게 계산해보면 휴대폰의 신호 주파수만으로 약 2-3m의 오차범위 내에서 정확하게 사용자의 현 위치가 확인이 된다. 물론 이동통신사 마다의 작은 오차는 있으나 통상적으로 모두가 비슷한 범위 내에서 위치를 확인감지를 할 수가 있다. 
     그러나 본 고안품에선 차량용 내비게이션이 전방을 카메라로 촬영하여 추돌의 가능성이 있는 목표물(사람)과 주변 환경들(추돌요인이 될 것으로 예상되는 것.)을 실시간 촬영한 영상물로 위성으로 전송되어 현 위치와 거리까지 산출 되어 다시 차량의 내비게이션으로 운전자에게 음성메시지 및 3차원 영상 디스플레이로도 알려주고 있는 기능과 현 서비스 기능을 이용하고 스마트폰의 가족과 친구 위치 찾기를 위치 추적서비스를 조금 더 완벽하게 응용하고 이용하여 보다 정확한 위치와 거리를 계산하여 오차의 범위를 최소화하여 본 고안품의 기능을 완성케 한다는 것이며, 이를 더 정확하게 추돌방지 기능을 완성케 하기위하여 본 고안품의 심장부이고, 기능부라고 할 수 있는 스마트 폰의 "전용 애플리케이션" 을 이용하여 더 정확한 위치를 그 어떤 악천후 속에서도 정확하게 수행 할 수 있도록 "수행 도우미 매니저" 화 한 것이 특징이고, 특히 본 고안품에서는 차량의 제동창치를 명령하는 기능 장치를 제어하는 기능 및 명령장치가 프로그래밍 되어 있어 차량과 예비 추돌가능성이 있는 목표물이 발생 시엔 그 목표물과의 거리등을 정확하게 계산하여 차량의 내비게이션으로 운전자에게 1차적 경고를 음성과 영상 디스플레이로 문자와 3차원영상 메시지로 하고, 2차적으로 차량제동장치기능부에 명령하여 감속 기능 장치를 작동케 명령하여 안전 거리상내에선 속도를 감속케 하고, 그런 다음에도 추돌의 위험성이 개선되지 않고 차량이 추돌의 위험거리까지 목표물에 접근하면 최후의 보루로, 3차적인 조치로 차량을 급제동케 하는 기능이며 급제동은 운전자의 의사와 운전 행동적 행위와 상관 관계없이 본 고안품의 명령 장치에서 차량의 전기기능 제어 장치부에 강제 급제동을 명령하여 차량의 동력 전달 장치의 동력을 중단함은 물론이고 급제동장치를 동작케 하여 본 고안품의 추돌을 사전에 방지하는 기능을 모바일 기술력으로 완성케 한 장치다. 
     본 고안품은 우리나라의 이동통신사가 사용하고 있는 위성과 주파수를 사용하면서 내비게이션의 위성주파수 역시도 동일한 사이클을 사용하면서 완성하고, 사용법위를 벗어난 타국의 주파수 영역 대에서 본 고안품을 사용 시에는 그 나라에서 사용하는 내비게이션 주파수와 휴대전화 주파수로 변경하면 국내에서처럼 정상적인기능으로 작동이 가능하므로 본 고안품은 "글로벌" 한 고안품이고 전 세계에서 사용이 가능한 고안품이다. 
     또한 본 고안품은 어린이보호구역등 스쿨존과 위험지역, 사고 다발지역, 지방단체등과 도로교통법상의 감속이 필요하다고 인정하여 지정된 곳을 차량이 진입 할 시에도 자동적으로 본 고안품의 기능은 내비게이션의 안내 경고 음성 메시지가 나오고 자동으로 감속이 되나, 만약에 특수한 목적인 차량(소방차, 구급용 차량)이 운행 시엔 본 고안품을 내려 받아 업데이트 된 스마트폰 애플리케이션의 기능을 중지(off)시키면 강제 제동 및 감속장치가 작동되지 않고, 다시 필요시엔 (on)아이콘을 작동케 하면 또 
     본 고안품의 기능은 내비게이션이 장치된 차량과 본 고안품을 스마트폰의 애플리케이션을 내려 받은 모바일 기능성 스마트폰은 그 명령 프로그램은 모두가 철저하게 그 임무를 수행을 한다. 
     본 고안품이 참으로 이번 "영종도 영종대교 초대형의 교통사고 눈, 비 바람등과 안개 때문이라고 핑계치 말고, 이재부터라도 조속하게 본 고안품을 개발하여 그 안전성과 기능을 시행해 보십시다. 
     
     1. application(애플리케이션). 2. 앱 스토어(샵). 3. 사물인터넷시대 4. 시물레이션. 5. 블루투스. 6. 내비게이션. 7. 프로그래밍. 8. 자동차 자동 제어장치. 9. 급 제동장치 급 감속 장치(서행). 10. 강제 제동정차 (급제동). 11. 스쿨존(학교앞). 12. WIFI. 13. 증폭장치. 14. 모바일.

title_en: Smart home security warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of smart home security warning system, comprise microcontroller, the sensor load module be connected with microcontroller, input through keyboard module, telepilot load module, infrared emitting module, danger button module, sound and light alarm module and display screen output module, sensor load module comprises some the magnetic inductors, glass break detection device, infrared inductor, smoke alarm and the ceiling type thermosonde that are arranged at each defence area.The utility model is by arranging microcontroller and each functional module, the information in defence area each in family is detected automatically, automatically the warning functions such as fire prevention, antitheft, anti-gas leakage and flash appeal can be realized, and can be undertaken setting up defences and withdrawing a garrison by keyboard or remote controller module, easy to use, ensure that the security of life at home.
