title_en: A kind of water logging early warning and automation equipment of taking precautions against natural calamities
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of water logging early warning and take precautions against natural calamities automation equipment, aim to provide a kind of intelligent detecting and issue water logging disaster information, guide and force vehicle and pedestrian to withdraw the device in disaster region.The utility model comprises level detecting device, alarm and restricted speed signal device, and no through traffic and retention signal device, microcontroller device, Video surveillance and immobilization device, light curtain wall immobilization device, and audio frequency warning and immobilization device, audio frequency disperses device.Described level detecting device and alarm and restricted speed signal device, no through traffic is connected with retention signal device, described alarm and restricted speed signal device, no through traffic is connected with microcontroller device with retention signal device, and described microcontroller device and Video surveillance and immobilization device, light curtain wall immobilization device, audio frequency are guarded against and dispersed device with immobilization device, audio frequency and be connected.The utility model has been widely used in flood risk region, to the Information issued of water logging disaster with prevent and reduce natural disasters, and contingency management field.

title_en: High-speed railway rainfall information gathers and method for early warning and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of high-speed railway rainfall information collection and early warning system, including rainfall information harvester, current signal/numerical signal conversion equipment, for dynamically generating the device of reference threshold of rainfall calamity source, determination device that early warning program starts, positioner, for controlling the control car device of train speed, storage device and controlling device, control module is as the core of whole system, on the one hand control the operation of aforementioned each device, be on the other hand used for the external equipments such as the computer installation with outside and be attached realizing communication and control.In the present invention, reference threshold for the assessment of rainfall calamity source uses the mode dynamically generated, and in conjunction with the disaster of history, a situation arises, and is continuously updated account of the history after up-to-date early warning occurs, thus contrast with historical data, more completely and scientifically consider the risk Pre-Evaluation in a certain area.The present invention also provides for a kind of high-speed railway rainfall information collection and method for early warning.

title_en: High speed rail earthquake data information acquisition and method for early warning and system
abstract_en: A kind of high speed rail earthquake data information acquisition of present invention offer and early warning system, determination device, positioning device, control vehicle device, storage device and the control device for controlling train speed started including seismic wave information collecting device, current signal/numerical signal conversion equipment, the device of reference threshold for dynamic generation seismic risk, early warning program, core of the control module as whole system, on the one hand the operation of aforementioned each device is controlled, is on the other hand used for and the external equipments such as external computer installation is attached realization communication and control.In the present invention, reference threshold for seismic risk assessment is using dynamic generation by the way of, and in conjunction with the disaster of history, a situation arises, and is continuously updated account of the history after newest early warning occurs, to be compared with historical data, risk Pre-Evaluation that is more complete and scientifically considering a certain area.The present invention also provides a kind of high speed rail earthquake data information acquisition and method for early warning.

title_en: High speed railway crosswind information collection and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a high speed railway crosswind information collection and early warning system. The system comprises a crosswind information collection device, a current signal/numerical signal conversion device, a device for dynamically generating a reference threshold value of a crosswind disaster risk, an early warning program starting decision-making device, a positioning device, a train controlling device used for controlling the speed of a train, a storage device and a control device, wherein the control module serves as the core of the whole system, controls operation of all the devices, and also is used for being connected with external equipment such as an external computer device to achieve communication and control. The reference threshold value of the crosswind disaster risk is dynamically generated, and the historical conditions are continuously updated after the latest early warning happens in combination with the historical disaster occurrence conditions, so that compared with historical data, the risk pre-evaluation of a certain area is considered more completely and scientifically. The invention further provides a high speed railway crosswind information collection and early warning method.

title_en: Systems and Methods for Managing Check-in Communications
abstract_en: Systems, methods and devices for use in managing check-in communications are disclosed. One exemplary method generally includes receiving a notification request associated with a trigger event, where the notification request is indicative of multiple participants associated with the trigger event, and identifying the multiple participants. The method also generally includes, for each of the identified participants, sending a check-in communication to the participant and generating a warning event when the check-in communication is acknowledged by the participant and the acknowledgment includes a negative condition.

title_en: Emergency Power Supply System for Structure Modification and Easy Moving
title_ko: 구조변경과 이동이 용이한 비상전원공급장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a movable emergency power supply apparatus capable of changing its structure, which comprises an inverter, a control circuit, and a battery as individual modules for diverse arrangements in a body case and has wheels on the lower end or provides a knapsack to improve mobility and portability. A voice notification device which notifies whether or not power is knocked out during a blackout is mounted on the emergency power supply system so as to immediately inform the person interested of the blackout and the emergency power supply system can increase capacity to use and expandability by continuously connecting adjuvant cases with electric wires.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 구조변경과 이동이 용이한 비상전원공급장치에 관한 것으로, 더 상세하게는 전원공급장치를 구성하는 인버터, 제어회로, 배터리를 각각 개별적인 모듈로 구성하여 본체케이스 내에 다양한 배치가 가능하도록 하며, 하단에 바퀴를 형성하거나 배낭식으로 제공하여 이동성 및 휴대성을 향상시킬 수 있고, 정전시 정전여부를 알려주는 음성통보장치가 장착되어 관계자에서 즉시 통보가 이루어지도록 하며, 전원공급장치 본체케이스를 교체하지 않고 별도의 배터리가 내장된 보조케이스를 전선으로 연속 연결하여 사용용량을 증가시킬 수 있는 확장성이 용이한 비상전원공급장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Systems And Methods For Notifying Law Enforcement Officers Of Armed Intruder Situations
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method executed by one or more computer servers includes receiving a notification from a communication device, determining whether one or more other communication devices are within a stationary geofence, and in response to the notification, sending an emergency alert to the other communication devices determined to be within the stationary geofence. The computer-implemented method may further include receiving an acknowledgement of the emergency alert from at least one of the other communication devices determined to be within the stationary geofence and/or sending data indicating an approximate location of the communication device and an associated tolerance of the approximate location. Other example computer-implemented methods, communication devices including software applications, and systems are also disclosed.

title_en: Apparatus and method for changing alarm information in accordance with weather
title_ko: 기상에 따른 알람정보 변경 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for changing alarm information in accordance with the weather, the present invention, in particular, can dynamically control the timing of the alarm by collecting location, time, weather information and the like for a travel route and a destination routinely used by a user, can provide an alarm to the user by measuring the gap between a weather forecast and real-time observational data and determining whether the gap alarm conditions have been met, and can generate a disaster information list for an effective examination of a disaster by collecting location and weather information by means of informational messages to determine the danger level of the disaster.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기상에 따른 알람정보 변경 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 특히, 사용자가 루틴하게 이용하는 이동 경로 및 목적지에 대해서 위치, 시간 및 기상 정보 등을 수집하여 기상 상황에 따라 알람시간을 능동적으로 조정할 수 있고, 기상 예보와 실시간 관측 데이터의 갭을 측정하고 갭 알림 조건의 만족 여부를 판단하여 사용자에게 알림을 제공할 수 있으며, 제보 메시지를 통해 위치 정보와 기상 정보를 수집하여 재난 상황의 위급 정도를 판단하여 효과적으로 재난 상황을 파악할 수 있는 재난 정보 리스트를 생성할 수 있는 기상에 따른 알람정보 변경 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Automatic vending machine ready for power outage
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To allow a door to be opened only when the need arises to prevent a mischief, in a case in which a manual operation type merchandise carry-out mechanism operated after the door is opened is provided.SOLUTION: The vending machine receives a door open/close signal from a door switch unit 49. When the signal is switched from close to open, the vending machine outputs a door open notification signal and blinks a red lamp 23. The vending machine receives power information existing on a common bus line 35. When the information is switched from disconnection to re-connection, the vending machine outputs a power disconnection notification signal and blinks a green lamp 25. The blink is completed by a notification cancellation command by a route man. Therefore, when the door is opened, the lamp blinks and an evidence remains, and hence the opening of the door can be suppressed.

title_en: Temperature information collection and early warning method and system for high speed railway
abstract_en: The invention provides a temperature information collection and early warning system for a high speed railway. The system comprises a temperature information collecting device, a current signal/value signal conversion device, a device for dynamically generating a reference threshold of temperature disaster risks, a determining device started by an early warning program, a locating device, a train controlling device for controlling the speed of a train, a storage device and a control device. A control module serves as a core of the whole system, controls operation of the devices on one hand, and is used for being connected with external devices including an external computer device and the like to achieve communication and control. In the system, the dynamic generating mode is adopted in the reference threshold for evaluating the temperature disaster risks, the historical disaster situations are combined, and the historical situations are continuously updated after new early warning is given, so that the risk pre-evaluation of a certain region is considered more completely and scientifically with contrast to historical data. The invention further provides a temperature information collection and early warning method for the high speed railway.

title_en: Thunder and lightning information collection and early warning method and system for high speed railway
abstract_en: The invention provides a thunder and lightning information collection and early warning system for a high speed railway. The system comprises a thunder and lightning information collection device, a current signal/value signal conversion device, a device for dynamically generating a reference threshold of thunder and lightning disaster risks, a determining device startd by an early warning program, a locating device, a train controlling device for controlling the speed of a train, a storage device and a control device. A control module serves as a core of the whole system, controls operation of the devices on one hand, and is used for being connected with external devices including an external computer device and the like to achieve communication and control. In the system, the dynamic generating mode is adopted in the reference threshold for evaluating the thunder and lightning disaster risks, the historical disaster situations are combined, and the historical situations are continuously updated after new early warning is given, so that the risk pre-evaluation of a certain region is considered more completely and scientifically with contrast to historical data. The invention further provides a thunder and lightning information collection and early warning method for the high speed railway.

title_en: Survival backpack with notification system
abstract_en: A survival backpack has an airbag and emergency notification system. Upon triggering of the airbag, the system is activated and configured to connect with a third party communication device either immediately or upon expiration of a countdown sequence. The system may emit an audible alert to prompt the user to cancel the connection if rescue is not needed. When connected, the system may transmit a message or other information to another which may help in recovering or assisting the user of the backpack. The system may provide location information, which allows the third party communication device to dispatch emergency responders, and may enable two-way communication with local or remote rescuers.

title_en: Notification message sending method, device and system
abstract_en: Provided are a notification message sending method, device and system, which belong to the field of communications. The notification message sending method in the embodiments of the present invention specifically comprises: creating at least two subscription resources on a common service entity, and setting a notification message attribute corresponding to each of the subscription resources; and when the at least two subscription resources are changed, sending notification messages according to the notification message attributes corresponding to the subscription resources which are changed. The notification message attributes in the embodiments of the present invention can be set according to the requirements of a user, for example, the notification priority is set according to the degree of importance of a notification message, the notification validity time and notification priority margin time are set according to the emergency situation of the notification message, etc., so that the notification message is sent according to the degree of importance and the degree of urgency of the notification message, and the notification message with a high degree of importance or a high degree of urgency is sent first, so as to avoid the problem that an important notification message or a notification message of which the degree of urgency is high is unable to be sent out, thereby improving the sending efficiency of the notification message.

title_en: Flood risk mapping and warning system and method
abstract_en: A system and method are disclosed which can provide pluvial hazard predictions over large scale areas and which can be regularly updated to take into account topographical changes over time as well as planned changes. The system uses a plurality of different data inputs for analysing and extracting data relating to elements which may contribute to water flow changes including for instance curbs, hedges, walls, buildings and so on. The system and method can be used for a variety of other applications other than pluvial hazard detection and prediction.

title_en: multimedia Unity Control System
title_ko: 멀티미디어 통합 제어 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multimedia integrated control system, which comprises: an integrated control command inputting unit installed in a field, displaying selectable option items in a panorama form on a screen, and receiving a control command to allow a user to directly control a broadcasting system in the field; an audio/video source selector connected to a plurality of audio/video sources and selecting a specific audio/video source among the audio/video sources according to the user selection; an integrated audio controller for controlling, according to a remote command, an audio connected to the audio/video source selector and a plurality of audio devices to be selected, in order to output the same; and an operation computer for controlling the components, wherein the operation computer and the integrated audio controller integrate and control the entire broadcasting system, an emergency broadcasting can be possible by providing a fire signal to the integrated audio controller by a fire reception unit in an RS-485 communication method or a contact point signal through an emergency panel and an EM switch, the operation computer is communicated with a speaker reception unit through Internet protocol, and propagates a voice signal as a voice through each speaker of the speaker reception unit, and the speaker reception unit includes an optical integrated multimedia broadcasting apparatus with a built-in voice amplifier.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 멀티미디어 통합 제어시스템에 있어서, 현장에 설치되며, 화면에 선택 가능한 옵션 항목을 파노라마 형태로 펼쳐서 디스플레이해주고, 상기 현장에서 사용자가 방송 시스템을 직접 제어하기 위한 제어명령을 입력받기 위한 통합 제어명령 입력부와; 다수의 오디오/비디오 소스와 연결되고 사용자의 선택에 따라 상기 다수의 오디오/비디오 소스 중 특정 오디오/비디오 소스를 선택하기 위한 오디오/비디오 소스 선택기와; 상기 오디오/비디오 소스 선택기 및 다수의 오디오 기기와 연결되어 선택된 오디오를 원격 명령에 따라 조정하여 출력하는 통합 오디오 컨트롤러와; 상기 구성요소를 제어하는 운영컴퓨터와; 상기 운영 컴퓨터와 통합 오디오 컨트롤러는 전체 방송 시스템을 통합, 제어하며, 상기 통합 오디오 컨트롤러에는 화재수신반의 화재신호가 비상패널, EM 스위치를 통하여 RS-485통신방식이나, 접점신호로 통합 오디오 컨트롤러에 신호를 주어 비상방송이 가능하며, 상기 운영 컴퓨터은 스피커 수신부과 인터넷 프토토콜로 통신되며, 음성신호를 상기 스피커 수신부의 각 스피커를 통해 음성으로 전파하며, 스피커 수신부는 음성 증폭기를 내장하는 광통합 멀티미디어 방송장치를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 멀티미디어 통합 제어시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Portable alarming device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of portable alarming device.Above-mentioned portable alarming device comprises: radio-frequency antenna; Rf signal reception port, is connected with radio-frequency antenna; Low noise amplifier, is connected with rf signal reception port; The signal of multiple fm broadcast channel is carried out to the demodulator circuit of demodulation, be connected with low noise amplifier; GPS module satellite-signal being received and processes; Alarm output circuit, is connected with demodulator circuit; And MCU, be connected with GPS module, demodulator circuit and alarm output circuit respectively.By technique scheme, radio broadcasting type of alarm can be utilized to realize Rapid Alarm, notice can control alarm range again, does not cause public concern.Further, this device can also provide according to the dangerous matter sources positional information demodulated and the positional information of this portable alarming device and withdraw directivity prompting, the efficiency that raising crowd withdraws, and then has effectively ensured crowd's life security and avoided property loss.

title_en: Whole-network early warning protection system based on mobile interconnection
abstract_en: The invention relates to a whole-network early warning protection system based on mobile interconnection. The whole-network early warning protection system is formed by a plurality of wireless probes, a server, owner mobile equipment, a property computer, and a fire-fighting department computer, each wireless probe is provided with a camera capable of rotating for 360 degrees and a mobile network communication module, when the probes detect abnormal high temperature or heavy smoke, a communication network is automatically started, alarm information is transmitted to the server, the server confirms the position of the alarm information and sends the information to the property computer or the owner mobile equipment, property personnel or the owner starts the cameras to observe the field, the alarm is cancelled or the alarm instruction to the fire-fighting department is transmitted to a background server via the mobile equipment or the property computer according to the actual condition, and the background server cancels the alarm or transmits the alarm instruction to the fire-fighting department in a wireless manner. According to the whole-network early warning protection system, wireless transmission and real-time communication are realized, line laying is not needed, remote intelligent detection is realized, the owner, the property, and the fire-fighting department can be informed in time when fire alarms occur, and the loss is reduced to the minimum.

title_en: Situational adaptive highway alarm system
title_ko: 주변 상황 적응형 고속도로 경보 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a situation adaptive highway alarming system. The situation adaptive highway alarming system according to embodiments of the present invention recommends vehicles behind an accident location to drive slowly by letting multiple alarming devices communicate with each other and finding out surrounding drive speeds, actively prevents a secondary rear-end collision by giving the vehicles driving at high speeds a strong alarm about the current accident location to enable the vehicles to quickly drive out from the road. and supports users around the accident location to be mentally relieved and to concentrate on handling the accident such as giving aid to the wounded by changing the alarm to a lower level alarm or clearing the alarm if possibility of the secondary rear-end collision disappears as surrounding vehicles are backed up or drive slowly.
abstract_ko: 주변 상황 적응형 고속도로 경보 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 주변 상황 적응형 고속도로 경보 시스템은 다수의 경보 장치들이 서로 교신함으로써 주변 주행 속도를 파악하여 후방 차량에 대한 서행 운전 권고 뿐만 아니라 후방 차량들이 빠르게 주행하는 경우에는 현재 사고 지점에 대해 강력한 경고를 줌으로써 도로밖으로 신속하게 대피하도록 2차 추돌을 적극적으로 예방하며, 주변 차량들이 정체 또는 정지되어 2차 추돌 가능성이 사라진 경우에는 보다 낮은 수준의 알람으로 변경하거나 알람을 해제하여 사고 주변의 사용자들이 심리적으로 안정을 취하고 부상자 처리와 같은 사고 주변의 수습에 전념할 수 있도록 지원한다.

title_en: Systems and methods for messaging-based fine granularity system-on-a-chip power gating
abstract_en: System and method embodiments are provided for messaging-based System-on-a-chip (SoC) power gating. The embodiments enable fine granularity SoC power gating without introducing significant latency and substantially maximizes SoC power reduction. In an embodiment, a method in a first SoC resource for messaging-based power gating includes receiving at the first SoC resource a wakeup notification message (WNM) from a second SoC resource, wherein the WNM comprises a time at which a result message from the second SoC resource is expected to arrive at the first SoC resource; determining with the first SoC resource a wake-up time according to the time at which the result message from the second SoC resource is expected to arrive at the first SoC resource; setting a wake-up time timer to expire at the wake-up time; and waking up the first SoC resource when the wake-up time timer expires when the first SoC resource is asleep.

title_en: A kind of automobile engine oil pressure warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of automobile engine oil pressure warning device, comprise housing, tubular spring is provided with in housing, one end of described tubular spring is communicated with the main oil gallery of lubrication system by pipe joint, it is characterized in that, the other end of described tubular spring is provided with movable contact, the stationary contact corresponding with movable contact is connected with wiring terminal, wiring terminal is connected with emergency warning lamp, power supply by wire, and described stationary contact is provided with force snesor, and described force snesor is connected with the display device of automobile.Preferably, described housing is box-like.Improve the structure of existing automobile engine oil pressure warning device, more convenient driver is to the control of vehicle lubricating system, and validity is high.
assignees: SUZHOU KUEN ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Integrated automated solution for the management of services for the disabled and others
abstract_en: Methods and systems for managing services for disabled persons. A tracking database can be created and updated with information from a number of databases or with information based on an elapsed time. A smart tag can be issued to a disabled person upon request by processing and analyzing data contained in the tracking database. Information with respect to status of the smart tag can be viewed by enforcement authorities to detect the validity of the smart tag. The smart tag can be automatically activated or inactivated by mapping data from the tracking database to prevent fraudulent usage. The smart tag can be configured with a universal handicapped logo and a panic alert button for alerting a response service when the disabled person is in an emergency situation.

title_en: Systems and methods for emergency response dispatch
abstract_en: Computerized method for coordinating decentralized response to emergency events includes receiving at least one request for emergency assistance, alerting registered responders in a geographic area corresponding to an emergency site of said request for emergency assistance, acknowledging a response from at least one of the responders agreeing to dispatch to the emergency site. The computerized method can also include one or more of confirming arrival of said at least one responder at the emergency site, determining a need for additional resources, confirming transportation to a destination facility, confirming arrival of said at least one responder the at the destination facility, receiving a summary report of actions undertaken, and/or recognition of said at least one responder by the system to be available to receive subsequent requests for emergency assistance.

title_en: System for Alarm Broadcasting of Indoor and Method thereof
title_ko: 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an indoor warning broadcasting system which receives a warning signal by using a media dualized into wired communications and a DMB broadcasting, and transfers a warning situation to people in a building, and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a warning signal reception unit for receiving an external warning signal; and a main control unit for analyzing a warning signal received through the warning signal reception unit, verifying validity determination and redundancy determination, and notifying the received warning signal to the inside of the building according to a predetermined performance scenario if the warning signal is determined as a valid warning signal. Also, an indoor warning broadcasting receiver for notifying the warning situation to residents in the building which exists as a shadow area in a warning wave of a conventional method is installed, and the warning situation is notified to the residents by using indoor emergency broadcasting equipment or a premises broadcasting facility which are equipped in the building, thereby reducing or preventing death and injury, and property damage to actively cope with the warning situation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유선통신과 DMB 방송으로 이중화된 매체를 이용하여 경보신호를 수신한 후, 이에 따른 경보 상황을 건물 내 사람들에게 전달하는 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 외부의 경보신호를 수신받는 경보신호수신부 및 상기 경보신호수신부를 통해 수신된 경보신호를 분석하여 유효성 판단과 중복성 판단의 검증과정을 거친 후, 유효한 경보신호라고 판단되면 상기 수신된 경보신호를 미리 설정된 수행 시나리오에 따라 건물 내부로 알리도록 하는 메인제어부를 포함하여 구성된다. 
본 발명의 옥내용 경보 방송 시스템 및 그 방법에 따르면, 기존방식의 경보 전파에 음영지역으로 존재하던 건물 내 거주민들에게 경보상황을 전파하기 위한 옥내 경보 방송수신기를 설치하고, 건물 내에 구비하고 있는 옥내 비상 방송설비나 구내 방송시설을 이용하여 거주민들에게 경보상황을 전달함으로써, 경보상황에 대하여 능동적인 대처를 할 수 있도록 하여 인명피해와 재산 손실을 줄이거나 방지하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of field mountain torrents early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of field mountain torrents early warning system, comprise the water level alarm being provided with signal projector, be provided with the central controller of signal receiver and signal projector, be provided with early warning broadcasting equipment and the display screen of signal receiver, wherein signal projector and signal receiver all match with zigbee Radio Transmission Technology, between water level alarm and signal projector, between signal receiver and early warning broadcasting equipment and between signal receiver and display screen, be also provided with energy-conservation mu balanced circuit; Described energy-conservation mu balanced circuit is then by energy-saving circuit, and the mu balanced circuit be connected with energy-saving circuit forms.The utility model provides a kind of field mountain torrents early warning system, improves the instantaneity of mountain torrents early warning, withdraws provide the time more fully for personnel and property, reduce further the harm of mountain torrents to personnel and property.
assignees: CHENGDU WANJIANG GANGLI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Fire alarm service method, apparatus and system using local wireless data communication
title_ko: 근거리 무선 데이터 통신을 이용한 화재 경보 방법, 장치 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention automatically generates an alarm signal when a fire occurs by checking a fire state through enabling a terminal device to analyze sensing information received from a beacon device for sensing the fire, by receiving a beacon signal including a minor value changed according to the change of sensing information collected in a preset space in which the beacon device is located; simply checks the fire state through the beacon device in a place without a fire alarm by automatically reporting the fire to a registered emergency contact list at the same time; and quickly dealing with the fire when a user does not recognize the fire like a sleeping state.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비콘 장치가 위치한 일정 공간에서 수집된 센싱 정보의 변동에 따라 변경된 마이너 값을 포함하는 비콘 신호를 단말 장치에서 수신함에 따라 단말 장치가 화재 감지를 위해 비콘 장치로부터 수신된 센싱 정보를 분석하여 화재 여부를 확인하여 화재 발생 시 자동으로 경보를 발생할 수 있으며, 동시에 등록된 긴급 연락처로 자동으로 신고를 수행함으로써, 화재 경보기가 없는 장소에서도 비콘 장치를 통해 간편하게 화재 발생 여부를 확인할 수 있으며, 사용자가 수면중인 경우와 같이, 화재를 인지할 수 없는 상황에서도 화재 발생에 빠르게 대처할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Accelerator auxiliary assembly monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an accelerator auxiliary assembly monitoring device, the workman of operating area can in time handle the operation that in time stops the accelerator, ensures the safe operation of accelerator, reduces the accelerator because of the loss that the cancel closedown caused, has reduced the maintenance duration and the cost of maintenance of accelerator, reduces extravagantly. It includes the box structure, the box structure embeds there is the circuit board, electronic component, electronic component on the circuit board connects all auxiliary assembly of accelerator through external signal line respectively, the outer end of box is provided with the traffic lights group corresponding with the auxiliary assembly quantity of accelerator, every traffic lights group is including a red light light source, a green light light source, the corresponding a set of traffic lights group that is connected with of every accelerator auxiliary assembly, it is still including at least one emergency alarm bell, the red light light source of all traffic lights group connects in parallel to the emergency alarm bell, arbitrary red light light source lights then emergency alarm bell warning, the light source of traffic lights group exposes in the terminal surface of box, box structural arrangement is in the accelerator operating area.
assignees: SUZHOU BAOHING ELECTRIC WIRE & CABLE CO LTD

title_en: The method for monitoring communicable disease and system using the method, recording medium for performing the method
title_ko: 전염병 모니터링 방법 및 이를 이용한 시스템, 이를 수행하기 위한 기록매체
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method for monitoring infectious disease and a system using the same, and a recording medium for performing the same. The infectious disease monitoring system includes: a photographing device which transmits image data of an animal managed in a pen; a first server which judges the existence of an object suspected to have an infectious disease from the image data received from the photographing device, and transmits an infectious disease suspected symptom occurrence signal together with the image data of the object thereof if the object suspected to have the infectious disease exists; a second server which performs the re-diagnosis of the occurrence of the infectious disease by analyzing the image data of the object suspected to have the infectious disease if the infectious disease suspected symptom occurrence signal is received from the first server, and transmits an infectious disease suspected symptom warning signal if it is judged that the infectious disease occurs according to the result of the re-diagnosis; and a manager terminal which requests the image data of the animal to the first server, and displays the image data of the animal, if the infectious disease suspect symptom warning signal is received from the second server. Therefore, the method can construct the system capable of providing information to a manager of the pen, an officer of Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs and related organizations such as Korea Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and Ministry of Environment etc by understanding space situation of the pen in real-time and recognizing a situation where an infectious disease can occur predictively.
abstract_ko:
전염병 모니터링 방법 및 이를 이용한 시스템, 이를 수행하기 위한 기록매체가 개시된다.  
전염병 모니터링 시스템은 축사 내에서 관리되는 동물의 영상 데이터를 송신하는 촬상장치, 촬상장치로부터 수신된 영상 데이터로부터 전염병 의심객체가 존재하는지 판단하여 전염병 의심객체가 존재하면 전염병 의심객체의 영상 데이터와 함께 전염병 의심징후 발생신호를 송신하는 1차 서버, 1차 서버로부터 전염병 의심징후 발생신호를 수신하면, 전염병 의심객체의 영상 데이터를 분석하여 전염병 발생여부를 재진단하고, 재진단 결과 전염병이 발생이 되었다고 판단되면 전염병 의심징후 경보 신호를 송신하는 2차 서버 및 2차 서버로부터 전염병 의심징후 경보신호를 수신하면, 1차 서버로 동물의 영상 데이터를 요청하고, 동물의 영상 데이터를 표시하는 관리자 단말기를 포함한다. 
따라서, 축사의 공간 상황을 실시간으로 이해하고 전염병이 발생할 수 있는 상황을 조기에 예측 인지하여 축사 관리자와 농림축산식품부의 담당 공무원, 국가재난 질병관리 본부, 환경부 등 관련기관에 정보를 제공할 수 있는 시스템을 구축할 수 있다.

title_en: System and Method for Measuring and Monitoring Seismic data Applied to the City Building
title_ko: 도시건축물에 적용되는 지진데이터 측정 및 감시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for measuring and monitoring seismic data applied to a city building capable of preventing false detection and false alarm, and quickly inspecting effectiveness of an occurred event and rapidity of seismic event detection for construction of an earthquake quickly warning system for earthquake disaster alleviation of a city building. Moreover, the system for measuring and monitoring seismic data applied to a city building comprises: multiple seismic data measuring systems located at a distance different from an object to be monitored, and for performing pre-detector of an earthquake event by having a GPS receive module and an earthquake acceleration sensor; and an earthquake monitoring system for re-forming a noise-removed and single stacked data by visual-synchronization processing data transmitted from the multiple seismic data, and for finally determining whether of occurrence of an earthquake event by utilizing the pre-detected result and post-process detected result of an earthquake event in each of seismic data measuring systems by post-process detecting in order to check whether of occurrence of an earthquake event.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도시건축물의 지진재해경감을 위한 지진신속경보체계 구축을 위하여 지진 이벤트 감지의 신속성 및 발생 이벤트의 유효성을 빠르게 검사하고 오검출 및 오경보를 방지할 수 있도록 한 도시건축물에 적용되는 지진데이터 측정 및 감시 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 감시 대상물과 서로 다른 거리에 위치하고, GPS 수신모듈과 지진가속도센서를 포함하고 지진이벤트의 사전 검출을 수행하는 복수 개의 지진 데이터 측정시스템들;상기 복수 개의 지진 데이터 측정시스템들로부터 전송된 데이터를 시각 동기화 처리하여 잡음제거 및 단일 중합데이터로 재구성하고, 지진이벤트 발생 여부를 확인하기 위해 후처리 검출을 하여 각각의 지진 데이터 측정시스템에서의 지진이벤트 사전검출 결과와 후처리 검출결과를 활용하여 지진이벤트 발생 여부를 최종 판별하는 지진 감시시스템;을 포함하는 것이다.

title_en: Radio communication system and update method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To implement a radio communication system capable of easily confirming execution of air downloading.SOLUTION: A household receiver 20 comprises: a communication unit 21 for receiving a broadcast signal transmitted from a radio apparatus 16 in a broadcast system master station 10; a speaker 23 from which voice is output in the case that the broadcast signal includes an ID designating the household receiver; an LED 24 for lighting up in a predetermined display mode in reporting a processing state in the case of performing air downloading processing; and an information update unit 30 that comprises an update control unit 31, an update information holding unit 32, and a holding control unit 33 and executes air downloading to update a program set in the household receiver 20. The update control unit 31 performs processing of receiving update data by the air downloading before holding the update data in the update information holding unit 32; and performs update processing on the basis of held update information when receiving an update instruction signal. The update control unit 31 determines whether or not the update processing has finished, and reports it by lighting the LED 24 in a predetermined mode.

title_en: Meteorological early warning method of power transmission line icing gallop disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a meteorological early warning method of power transmission line icing gallop disasters. The method includes the following steps that: a temperature tester, a humidity tester, a wind speed tester and a wind direction tester are arranged in an area to be measured; minimum temperature, relative humidity, wind speed and wind direction in the area are measured, and a meteorological factor prediction field data matrix related to an icing gallop risk analysis model is established; icing gallop risk prediction is performed on a corresponding area with measuring points which satisfy conditions that minimum temperature ranges from -4.0 to 0.5 DEG C, relative humidity ranges from 70% to 100%, wind speed ranges from 5.8 to 13.7 meters per second and wind direction is northeast; the data of each prediction lattice point is circulated, so that gallop risk trend analysis data of all prediction measuring points at current time can be obtained. With the method of the invention adopted, whether icing gallop distribution exists in a prediction area can be judged, and real-time update can be realized by means of numerical value prediction data. The meteorological early warning method has the advantages of high accuracy, high practicability, high reliability and the like.

title_en: Methods and systems for presenting an alert when leaving a direct-mode coverage area
abstract_en: At least one embodiment takes the form of a process carried out by a given mobile radio in a group of mobile radios. The process includes broadcasting heartbeat messages in accordance with a group-wide symmetric-timing protocol and maintaining an in-range list of mobile radios. The in-range list is maintained at least in part by (i) adding mobile radios that are not already on the in-range list to the in-range list upon detecting transmissions from such mobile radios; (ii) maintaining, for each mobile radio on the in-range list, a respective keepalive timer in accordance with the group-wide symmetric-timing protocol; and (iii) removing mobile radios from the in-range list upon expiration of the respective keepalive timers. The process further includes presenting an alert via a user interface when a count of mobile radios on the in-range list falls below a notification threshold.

title_en: Delivery confirmation and non-live delivery of emergency alert system messages
abstract_en: A device may detect an emergency alert system message. The emergency alert system message may include a message to be provided for consumption by multiple users. The device may determine that the emergency alert system message has not been successfully delivered for consumption by a user. The device may store the emergency alert system message, for future delivery, based on determining that the emergency alert system message has not been successfully delivered for consumption by the user. The device may receive an indication to provide the emergency alert system message after storing the emergency alert system message. The device may provide the emergency alert system message, for consumption by the user, based on receiving the indication to provide the emergency alert system message.

title_en: Cabinet-type fire extinguisher with advance withdrawal guiding functionality and method for controlling the same
title_ko: 사전 퇴거 유도 기능의 캐비닛형 소화기 및 사전 퇴거 유도 방법
abstract_en: According to the embodiments of the present invention, a cabinet type fire extinguisher comprises: a fire receiver sensing a fire to generate a fire warning linking signal, an odorant emission signal, and a fire extinguishing gas emission signal and outputting a delay fire extinguishing gas emission signal; a fire extinguishing gas emission unit emitting a fire extinguishing gas in accordance with a delay fire extinguishing gas emission signal; and an odorant emission unit provided inside to at least one housing, opening a discharge valve of an odorant storage container storing a high-pressure inert gas, a high-pressure gas, and a liquid odorant or a powder odorant in accordance with the odorant emission signal to enable the odorant to be operated to be emitted from a nozzle connected to the discharge valve by expansion of the high-pressure inert gas.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예들에 따른 캐비닛형 소화기는 화재를 감지하여 화재 경보 연동 신호, 부취제 방출 신호 및 소화 가스 방출 신호를 생성하고, 지연 소화 가스 방출 신호를 출력하는 화재 수신반, 지연 소화 가스 방출 신호에 따라 소화 가스를 방출하는 소화 가스 방출부 및 고압의 가스, 액상 또는 분말 형태의 부취제와 고압의 비활성 가스를 저장하는 부취제 저장 용기의 배출 밸브를 부취제 방출 신호에 따라 개방하여, 부취제가 고압의 비활성 가스의 팽창에 의해 배출 밸브에 연결된 노즐로부터 방출되도록 동작하는 부취제 방출부를 적어도 하나의 하우징 내에 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Personal emergency triggering, notification and communication for smartwatches
abstract_en: A wearable mobile device executes a personal safety service client application to detect a triggering event indicating an emergency, wherein the triggering event is detected from user input received by the wearable mobile device. The application determines a location of the wearable mobile device, the location of the wearable mobile device corresponding to a location of the emergency, and provides an indication of the emergency and the location of the emergency to a personal safety service server. The personal safety service server sends a notification message via a push notification displayed on user devices of a predefined group of emergency contacts indicating the occurrence of the emergency and periodically receives updates to the location of the wearable mobile device from the personal safety service client application.

title_en: Method for guaranteed delivery of alert notifications through chain-of-command escalation procedures
abstract_en: Computer (server)-based system for detecting anomalous data patterns and generating alert notifications and guaranteeing delivery by soliciting acknowledgement by end-users. If acknowledgement is not obtained within a pre-determined timeframe, the notification is escalated to managing authority and the process repeats until acknowledgement is obtained or the full chain of command is exhausted.

The method for providing a location-based service using Bluetooth includes: a first step of requesting a confirmation process to a serve confirming whether or not a Bluetooth module having transmitted or broadcasted a Bluetooth-based wireless frequency signal is a Bluetooth module mapped with one or more designated location areas or performing the confirmation process; a second step of activating a positioning function of a location positioning module prepared in the terminal; and a third step of providing a location-based service for the location areas mapped with the Bluetooth module.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 블루투스를 이용한 위치 기반 서비스 제공 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 블루투스를 이용한 위치 기반 서비스 제공 방법은, 블루투스(Bluetooth)를 처리하는 블루투스부를 구비하고 위치 측위모듈을 구비한 단말기를 통해 실행되는 방법에 있어서, 상기 블루투스부를 통해 수신된 블루투스 기반 무선 주파수 신호에 포함된 코드 값을 이용하여 상기 블루투스 기반 무선 주파수 신호를 송출 또는 방송한 블루투스모듈이 하나 이상의 지정된 위치 영역과 매핑된 블루투스모듈인지 인증하는 서버로 인증 절차를 요청하거나 또는 상기 인증 절차를 수행하는 제1 단계와, 상기 인증 절차를 통해 상기 블루투스모듈 인증 시, 상기 단말기에 구비된 위치 측위모듈의 측위 기능을 활성화하거나 또는 활성화 상태를 확인하는 제2 단계와, 상기 위치 측위모듈의 측위 기능을 통해 측위된 위치 정보를 통해 상기 블루투스모듈과 매핑된 위치 영역에 대한 위치 기반 서비스가 제공되게 제어하는 제3 단계를 포함한다. 
한편 본 발명에 따른 블루투스를 이용한 위치 기반 서비스 제공 방법은, 블루투스(Bluetooth)를 처리하는 블루투스부를 구비한 사용자의 단말기와 통신하는 서버에 의해 실행되는 방법에 있어서, 지정된 코드 값을 포함하는 블루투스 기반의 무선 주파수 신호를 송출 또는 방송하는 블루투스모듈 중 특정한 모듈 이용처에서 보유한 블루투스모듈을 상기 모듈 이용처와 관련된 위치 영역과 매핑되게 처리하는 제1 단계와, 상기 단말기의 블루투스부를 통해 수신된 블루투스 기반 무선 주파수 신호에 포함된 코드 값의 유효성을 인증하여 상기 블루투스모듈이 상기 위치 영역과 매핑된 블루투스모듈인지 인증하는 인증 절차를 수행하거나 또는 상기 인증 절차의 인증 결과를 확인하는 제2 단계와, 상기 블루투스모듈 인증 시, 상기 인증된 블루투스모듈과 매핑된 위치 영역에 대한 정보 또는 상기 인증된 블루투스모듈과 매핑된 위치 영역에 대한 위치 기반 서비스를 위한 서비스 관련 정보를 상기 단말기의 프로그램으로 제공하는 제3 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: powerless patch device announcing position of safty tool in disaster status, and method of the same
title_ko: 재난상황에서 안전도구의 위치알림 무전원 패치 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to technology, reporting a position of a safety tool (example: a fire extinguisher, an oxygen mask) to prevent secondary damage in an area, shaded by a disaster situation. The technology is capable of attaching a patch, operated by generating power from surrounding environmental energy (example: light energy, temperature energy) without an extra power supply unit, to a safety tool, and reporting a disaster situation in an externally recognizable format (example: voice alarm, light source blinking) by identifying the patch when the disaster situation occurs. According to the present invention, since the patch device, attached to a safety tool, generates operational power from surrounding environmental energy without an extra power supply unit, the device is able to be used without expiration date unless the device is broken. Moreover, since the formation of power supply and the formation of disaster detection are integrated, malfunction occurs in power supply when malfunction occurs in a disaster detecting function, and then the display of the patch device becomes abnormal, and therefore, the malfunction of the disaster detecting function is not hidden and is determined to be immediately repaired.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난상황 발생으로 음영 상태가 된 지역에서 2차 피해 방지를 위해 안전도구(예: 소화기, 산소마스크)의 위치를 알려주는 기술로서, 별도의 전원공급수단 없이 주변 환경에너지(예: 빛에너지, 온도에너지)로부터 전원을 생성하여 동작하는 패치를 안전도구에 부착하고 이 패치에서 재난상황시 이를 식별하여 외부에서 인식가능한 형태(예: 음성 알람, 광원 블링킹)로 알리도록 하는 기술에 관한 것이다.  본 발명에 따르면, 안전도구에 부착되는 패치 장치가 별도의 전원공급수단 없이 주변 환경에너지로부터 동작 전원을 생성하기 때문에 패치 장치가 망가지지 않는 한 유효 기간 없이 사용할 수 있는 장점이 있다.  또한, 본 발명에 따르면 전원공급 구성과 재난검출 구성이 일체화되어 있어 재난검출 기능에 고장이 발생한 경우에는 전원공급에도 장애가 발생하여 패치 장치의 표시에 이상이 나타나게 되므로 재난검출 기능의 고장이 숨겨지지 않고 그때그때 판별하여 즉시 수리할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: System with a companion device and a primary device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for a companion device to receive current service information from a primary device comprising: (a) said companion device receiving from said primary device an emergency alert message including at least one of: (i) an identifier of said emergency alert message that uniquely identifies said emergency alert message; (ii) a date when said emergency alert message was generated together with a time when said emergency alert message was generated; (iii) a content format defining a content type of an initial said emergency alert message; (iv) a content of said emergency alert message received given by initial content element; (v) a URL which provides initial emergency alert message content for accessibility; (vi) an additional URL which provides additional information about said emergency alert message; (vii) a phone number for obtaining additional information about said emergency alert message; (viii) an e-mail address for obtaining additional information about said emergency alert message; (ix) a received additional emergency alert containing a continuation of another said emergency alert message; (x) a received one of a new or a repeat said emergency alert message; (xi) a received said emergency alert message that is not repeated; (xii) an identifier of said primary device; (xiii) a version of said primary device.

title_en: Mobile receiver for dmb disaster broadcasting and method using the same
title_ko: 이동형 dmb 재난방송 수신장치 및 이를 이용한 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile digital multimedia broadcasting (DMB) disaster broadcast receiver and a reception method using the same. The mobile DMB disaster broadcast receiver comprises: a disaster message reception unit which distinguishes and receives two or more DMB disaster broadcast messages transmitted from a plurality of channels; a location information generation unit which determines its own location information; a control unit which extracts a location information ID indicating location information from the received two or more disaster messages, and selects a disaster message to be output by referring to the extracted location information ID and its own location information; and an output unit which outputs the disaster message in accordance with instructions of the control unit. The control unit monitors its location information while outputting the disaster message, and when an area where the control unit is located has been changed, selects the disaster message to be output again.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 이동형 DMB 재난방송 수신장치 및 이를 이용한 수신방법에 관한 것으로, 이동형 DMB 재난방송 수신장치는 복수 채널로부터 전송되는 둘 이상의 DMB(Digital Multimedia Broadcasting) 재난 방송 메시지를 구분하여 수신하는 재난 메시지 수신부와, 자신의 위치정보를 확인하는 위치정보 생성부와, 수신된 둘 이상의 재난 메시지로부터 지역정보를 의미하는 지역정보 식별자를 추출하고, 추출된 지역정보 식별자 및 자신의 위치정보를 참조하여 출력할 재난 메시지를 선정하는 제어부 및 상기 제어부의 지시에 따라 재난 메시지를 출력하는 출력부를 포함하고, 상기 제어부는 재난 메시지를 출력하는 중에 자신의 위치정보를 모니터링하여, 자신이 위치하는 지역이 변경되면, 출력할 재난 메시지를 재 선정하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Mobile with function of nfc communication and safety aboarding service system
title_ko: 엔에프시 통신 기능을 가진 모바일 및 안전승차 서비스 시스템
abstract_en: The objective of the present invention is to provide a mobile device with an NFC communication function and a safe taxi service system enabling a user to safely use a taxi anytime anywhere. A mobile device transmits user identification information and current location information to a taxi system when get-on and get-off tagging is made. The mobile device displays taxi information received from the taxi system when get-on tagging is made and transmits a get-on notice message to a mobile device of a specific person. The taxi system sets valid multi-route to a destination by using the destination input after get-on tagging, and informs the mobile device of the specific person and/or a taxi server of an emergency situation when the taxi is out of the valid multi-route over a set time. The mobile device displays fare information received from the taxi system when a get-off tagging is made. The taxi system exchanges information with the mobile device through NFC communication, generates get-on notice information including the user identification information, a get-on time and the current location information, transmits the same to the taxi server when a get-on tagging is made, and transmits, to the taxi server, get-off information including the user identification information, the current location information, a get-off time and taxi fare information when a get-off tagging is made.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모바일에서는 NFC 통신을 이용한 승차 태깅 및 하차 태깅시에 탑승자 식별정보와 현재위치정보를  택시 시스템에 전송하며,  승차 태깅시에  택시 시스템으로부터 수신된 차량정보를 표시하고 승차 알림 메시지를 특정인 모바일로 전송하며,  승차 태깅 후에 입력된 목적지를 이용하여  목적지까지의 유효 다중 경로를 설정하고  택시가 설정시간 이상  유효 다중 경로를 벗어난 경우에 비상상황을  특정인 모바일 및 택시 서버 중 적어도 하나에 알리며,  하차 태깅시에  택시 시스템으로부터 수신된 요금정보를 표시하고, 택시 시스템에서는  모바일과 NFC 통신으로 정보를 교환하며,  승차 태깅시에  탑승자 식별정보, 탑승시간 및  현재위치정보를 포함하는 탑승 알림 정보를 생성하여 택시 서버로 전송하고,  하차 태깅시에  탑승자 식별정보,  현재위치정보, 하차시간 및 택시요금을 포함하는 하차 알림 정보를 택시 서버로 전송한다.

title_en: Situation awareness system based on intelligent video analysis technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a situation awareness system based on an intelligent video analysis technology. The situation awareness system disclosed by the invention has the beneficial effects that: the system collects, transmits, processes and displays situation information for an abnormal disaster site, realizes target detection, abnormality identification, threat analysis, risk early warning and other functions, has an open system structure, and can access other situation awareness means and realize information interaction and sharing. The application of the system in the field of disaster prevention and mitigation can not only promote the upgrade and update of the current widely used video monitoring systems, but also can realize the information fusion processing of various means mainly depending on videos to form an overall situation of an event site, and can compensate the shortcomings of the traditional video monitoring and effectively improve the handling ability of a commander on the scene situation.
assignees: TIANJIN ZHONGKE INST OF INTELLIGENT IDENTIFICATION IND TECH CO LTD

title_en: An monitoring system using dual wire and wireless monitor device
title_ko: 유무선 듀얼 감지장치를 이용한 보안 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a security monitoring system using a wired and wireless dual-sensing device. The configuration of the present invention is characterized in comprising: a dual-sensing device which includes elements for detecting heat rays and microwaves and is formed as a console or control box to be fixed and installed on a predetermined location such as houses, shopping centers, buildings, etc., wherein the dual-sensing device monitors a body and temperature information of an intruder or an unauthorized object and calls up corresponding state information; a user terminal configured to operate by executing operation applications, wherein the user terminal receives the body and the temperature information of the intruder or the unauthorized object according to the operation of the dual-sensing device, acknowledges the corresponding state information, or provides a voice conversation according to an emergency call based on an emergency situation or an emergency state; and an operation server which, as the dual-sensing device operates, receives transmission information of the dual-sensing device transmitted through a communication network according to a monitoring signal of the body and the temperature information of the intruder or the unauthorized object, and transmits an emergency situation notification to a police station and a fire station to support a quick response to the emergency situation. Accordingly, the security monitoring system can be used as a power saving sensing device installed outside a building or in a parking lot, etc. to save energy, which can reduce the price. Also, since a unified controller is provided to receive signals from the sensing device through wired and wireless communication and generate an alarm on its own, the security monitoring system can be linked with a home network device or an unmanned security terminal. Furthermore, since a wireless signal anti-collision technology and a digital processing technology are secured, more wireless signals can be processed as marketability increases.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유무선 듀얼 감지장치를 이용한 보안 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로 그 구성은 열선 검출 및 마이크로웨이브 검출을 위한 소자로 구성되어 가정, 상가, 건물 등의 일정지역에 고정설치되도록 콘솔, 컨트롤 박스 형태로 구성되어 침입자 또는 비인가된 물체의 인체감시 및 온도정보를 감시하여 해당 상태정보를 호출하는 듀얼감지 장치; 구동 앱을 실행하여 동작되도록 구성되고, 감시신호에 따라 통신망을 통해 듀얼감시 장치의 동작에 따라 침입자 또는 비인가된 물체의 인체감시 및 온도정보를 수신하거나, 해당 상태 정보를 확인하거나, 긴급상황 또는 비상상태에 따라 긴급호출에 따른 음성통화를 제공하는 사용자 단말; 및 듀얼감시 장치의 동작에 따라 침입자 또는 비인가된 물체의 인체감시 및 온도정보의 감시신호에 따라 통신망을 통해 전송되는 듀얼감시 장치의 전송정보를 수신하여 경찰서, 소방서에 긴급상황을 전송하여 비상시 신속한 대응을 지원하는 운영서버;을 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 따라, 에너지 절약을 위한 옥외나 지하 주차장 등의 저소비전류의 절전감지기로 활용하여 단가 경제성을 확보하고, 유무선을 통해 감지기의 신호를 수신하는 통합 콘트롤러를 제공하여 자체 경보를 발생시켜 홈네트워크 기기나 무인경비 단말기와 연동이 가능하여 무선신호 충돌방지, 디지털 처리기술을 확보함으로써 시장성 확대에 따라 무선신호 처리에 확장성을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Personalized real time outdoor guidance application for mass evacuation
abstract_en: A system including a cloud app executing on a cloud processor that detects an evacuation message, a portable device that receives a notification from the cloud app of the evacuation message, a processor of the cloud app that determines a current geographic location of the portable device and an evacuation destination for the portable device and that downloads a map to the portable device showing a route from the current location to the evacuation destination and a processor that updates the map based upon real-time events occurring along the route.

title_en: User treminal for interwoking with gateway installed in a vehicle and and method for guiding a change of traffic signal using smartphone application
title_ko: 차량 내에 설치된 게이트웨이와 연동하는 사용자 단말 및 스마트 폰 애플리케이션을 이용한 교통 신호 변경 안내 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for notification of a change in a traffic signal by using a smartphone application, which notify a change in a traffic signal to a driver via a user terminal, such as a smartphone, operating in conjunction with a wired or wireless gateway by using the Wi-Fi wired or wireless gateway without installing an additional device in a vehicle in the case of a low-cost vehicle in which an AVN is not installed. The user terminal comprises: a wireless communication module which receives image information, in which a traffic signal is photographed, from a gateway installed in a vehicle via short-distance wireless communication; an image processing unit which receives the image information from the wireless communication module, detects a pattern indicating the traffic signal from the image information by using an image processing algorithm, and recognizes a change in color of the detected pattern; a control unit which determines a change in the traffic signal based on a result of the recognition of the image processing unit; and an output unit which outputs an alarm notifying the change of the traffic signal, based on a result of the determination of the control unit.
abstract_ko: 차량의 게이트웨이와 연동하는 사용자 단말이 개시된다. 이 사용자 단말은, 차량에 설치된 게이트웨이로부터 교통 신호등을 촬영한 영상 정보를 근거리 무선 통신으로 수신하는 무선 통신 모듈과, 상기 무선 통신 모듈로부터 상기 영상 정보를 전달받고, 영상 처리 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 영상 정보로부터 상기 교통 신호등을 나타내는 패턴을 검출하고, 검출된 패턴에 대한 색 변화를 인식하는 영상 처리부와, 상기 영상 처리부의 인식 결과에 따라 교통 신호의 변경을 판단하는 제어부 및 상기 제어부의 판단 결과에 따라 상기 교통 신호의 변경을 알리는 경보를 출력하는 출력부를 포함한다.

title_en: Pro-active building protection system
abstract_en: An automated, computerized, method of pro-active building protection from weather condition damage involves: receiving a weather alert indicating a particular weather condition will be occurring within an area encompassing a perimeter about a building established by multiple sensors positioned around the building; in response to the weather alert, automatically executing a specific protocol to cause at least some actuators connected to protective devices of the building to change at least one protective device from a non-protective to a protective position; receiving a signal that is one of: a) a cancellation signal that the weather alert is no longer in effect, or b) an indication from at least some of the sensors that the particular weather condition is no longer endangers the building; and in response to receipt of the signal, automatically signaling the at least some actuators to return the at least one protective device to the non-protective position.

title_en: DWR-based message pushing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a DWR-based message pushing method. During the software application process in the prior art, the real-time updating of the service state or an abnormal emergency often occurs. When data are generated in the above condition, updated data are usually required to be sent to a client in real time by a system for facilitating users to obtain service messages in real time and handle with various emergency situations. The invention provides a DWR-based system, wherein the message of a server is pushed to the client in the reverse direction. Therefore, the client can receive a message notification in real time. Through updating data in a database in real time, the data of messages in the database are updated and transmitted to the client, so that users can conveniently check the data.

title_en: Personal alert safety system for calling emergency situation and method thereof
title_ko: 응급 상황 호출을 위한 개인 경보 안전 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a motion sensor to detect movements of a user; a motion determination module to determine whether the movements of the user are not detected above a predetermined time by the motion sensor or not; an alarm signal output module to produce and output an alarm signal if it determines that the movements of the user are not detected above the predetermined time by the motion determination module; an emergency signal production module to produce an emergency signal including an ID of the user and the elapse time after the expiration of the predetermined time in real time if it determines that the movements of the user are not detected above the predetermined time by the motion determination module; and a local area communication module to periodically transmit the emergency signal produced in the emergency signal production module with a local area communication method and to receive a surrounding emergency signal with the local area communication method. According to a personal alert safety system for calling an emergency situation and a method thereof as stated above, a risk signal is mutually shared by firefighters in real time and the firefighters can recognize a risk of a surrounding co-worker and rapidly rescues the co-worker since a mesh topology or an ad-hoc network are formed between personal alert safety systems attached to a body of the firefighters.

title_en: Wearable healthcare safety belt

abstract_en: Proposed is a wearable healthcare safety belt which collects various information on subjects to be protected such as children, the old and the infirm, women, etc. who are weak and subjected to crimes to determine whether the subjects are in danger, and transmits a message wirelessly to a recipient. The proposed wearable healthcare safety belt comprises: a pulsation measuring sensor which measures a pulsation of a user; a body temperature measuring sensor which measures a body temperature of the user; a position acknowledging sensor which measures a current position of the user; a circumstance recognizing sensor which collects information used for recognizing a current circumstance of the user; a message output unit which sends a danger notification message to a recipient; and a control unit which determines whether the user is in danger based on information from the pulsation measuring sensor, the body temperature measuring sensor, and the circumstance recognizing sensor, and controls the message output unit to output the danger notification message.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a robot surveillance system for detecting abnormal behaviors capable of improving the reliability of surveillance by recognizing the current location of a robot and if any abnormal signal occurs due to a dynamic obstacle or moved static obstacle at the location delivering the location information and the abnormal signal to a situation room. The system includes: an abnormal behavior surveillance module which detects any abnormal behavior of a dynamic obstacle or due to a moved static obstacle, transmits images in real time, and sends a warning if any problem; an AGV location movement control module which controls the movement of the location of an AGV; an AGV location measurement module which measures the location following the movement of the location of the AGV by the AGV location movement control module; a command execution control unit which checks a movement command from a situation management and control server and executes the movement command; and the situation management and control server which designates and inputs a route in advance, controls autonomous driving and driving route change in case of an obstacle, detects a dynamic obstacle by the abnormal behavior surveillance module, identifies a case where a static obstacle is moved on a map environment, and controls surveillance of abnormal behaviors.

title_en: A kind of vehicle collision avoidance method based on truck traffic
abstract_en: A kind of vehicle collision avoidance method based on truck traffic, comprises the following steps：1) initialize；2) self-position coordinate is calculated, and broadcasts own location information bag；3) the positional information bag of other vehicles is monitored, updates neighbours' vehicle positional information table；4) next second transport condition, and m=1 are predicted using Kalman prediction algorithms respectively；If 5) m ＞ N m , step 1) is jumped to, otherwise vehicle and vehicle m running data are judged in advance；6) safe distance of prediction level direction and vertical direction；7) distance between two vehicles of prediction horizontally and vertically；8) Optimized model is established；9) solving-optimizing model, judge whether to alarm according to solution to model, m=m+1, jump to step 5).The present invention can accurately calculate the prediction of collision time, so as to improve the probability that collision avoids, reduce collision accident incidence, the number of casualties and economic loss.

title_en: Method of preventing traffic accidents in crossroad for signal violation and overspeed, and system of the same
title_ko: 과속 및 신호위반에 의한 교차로 교통사고 방지 방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for preventing traffic accidents in an intersection and a system thereof. When signals change abruptly near an intersection, a vehicle approaching the intersection after a straight or left turn signal at the intersection frequently crashes into another vehicle entering the intersection after receiving a signal in another road while approaching the intersection without being able to stop at a stop line of the intersection due to the acceleration of the vehicle. To solve the problem, the intersection traffic accident prevention method and the system thereof according to the present invention are configured to sense an approaching vehicle, which travels at a speed equal to or greater than a predetermined speed while ignoring signals, or a vehicle, which enters the intersection in a straight path or after taking a left turn, through an image camera and sense the warning light and siren of an emergency vehicle through the image camera and a sound sensor in order to operate the warning lights or secondary traffic lights arranged on the traffic lights in each road and output warning text through electrical signs. The present invention can prevent a collision accident between a vehicle, which approaches the intersection while ignoring signals in the intersection and a vehicle entering the intersection in advance.
abstract_ko:
[기술분야/해결과제]   
본 발명은 교차로 교통사고 방지 방법 및 그 시스템에 관한 것으로, 교차로에서 직진 또는 좌회전 신호를 받고 교차로를 향하여 달려가고 있는 차량이 교차로 부근에서 갑자기 신호가 변경된 경우 차량의 가속도 때문에 교차로의 정지선에 정지하지 못하고 그대로 교차로를 통과하다가 다른 차도에서 신호를 받고 교차로로 진입하는 차량과의 추돌 사고가 빈번히 일어나는 문제점이 있었다. 
 [해결수단]   
본 발명의 교차로 교통사고 방지 방법 및 그 시스템은, 교차로에서 신호를 위반하고 소정의 속도 이상으로 달려오는 차량이나 교차로로 진입하는 직진 및 좌회전 차량을 영상카메라를 통해 감지하고, 영상카메라와 소리감지센서를 통해 긴급자동차의 경광등과 싸이렌을 감지하여, 각 차도의 신호등에 배치된 경광등 또는 보조신호등을 작동시키고 전광판을 통해 주의 문자를 출력하도록 구성하였다. 
 [기대효과]   
본 발명에 따르면, 교차로에서 신호를 무시하고 교차로로 달려오는 차량과 교차로로 진입하는 차량 간의 충돌사고를 미연에 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for handling emergency situation of wheel chair a passenger
title_ko: 휠체어 탑승자의 위급 상황 처리 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides an apparatus and a method for handling an emergency situation of a passenger of a wheel chair. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the apparatus for handling an emergency situation is allowed to be carried by a passenger boarding a wheel chair or is able to be mounted on the wheel chair. The apparatus for handling an emergency situation comprises a data obtaining module, a data processing module, an emergency situation recognition module and an emergency situation responding module. The data obtaining module obtains a data packet from a wheel chair apparatus including a wheel chair. The data processing module classifies the data packet into a bio signal measurement packet, a situation measurement packet and a bio signal analysis packet, corrects data values of the bio signal measurement packet and the situation measurement packet to generate a bio signal measurement valid packet and a situation measurement valid packet. The emergency situation recognition module receives the bio signal measurement valid packet, the situation measurement valid packet and the bio signal analysis packet from the data processing module and determines whether the passenger boarding the wheel chair is in an emergency situation based on the bio signal measurement valid packet, the situation measurement valid packet and the bio signal analysis packet to generate emergency situation determination information. The emergency situation responding module performs an alarm process in accordance with a degree of an emergency situation depending on the emergency situation determination information.

title_en: Emergency system using set-top box and control method thereof

abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency system using a set-top box. When an ON signal is received, a set-top box outputs images for channels, which are transmitted from a broadcasting station, to a display and is driven in a watching mode. When the ON signal is not received, the set-top box is driven in a standby mode. When the set-top is not switched from the standby mode to the watching mode for a preset time period, the set-top box transmits an acknowledgement request signal to a subscriber terminal whereas the set-top transmits an emergency signal when an acknowledgement signal is not received from the subscriber terminal. Also, when a manipulation signal is not applied to the set-top box for a preset time period in the watching mode, the set-top box transmits the acknowledgement request signal to the subscriber terminal, and transmits the emergency signal when the acknowledgement signal is not received from the subscriber terminal. According to the present invention, user safety is improved by detecting all of various types of emergency situations.

title_en: System and method for implementing personal emergency response system based on UWB interferometer
abstract_en: A non-wearable Personal Emergency Response System (PERS) architecture is provided, having a synthetic aperture antenna based RF interferometer followed by two-stage human state classifier and abnormal states pattern recognition. In addition, it contains a communication sub-system to communicate with the remote operator and centralized system for multiple users' data analysis. The system is trained to learn the person's body features as well as the home environment. The decision process is carried out based on the instantaneous human state (Local Decision) followed by abnormal states patterns recognition (Global decision). The system global decision (emergency alert) is communicated to the operator through the communication system and two-ways communication is enabled between the monitored person and the remote operator. In some embodiments, a centralized system (cloud) receives data from distributed PERS systems to perform further analysis and upgrading the systems with updated database (codebooks).

title_en: Landslide and Debris-flow Remote Monitoring System and the method thereof

abstract_en: A remote monitoring system for a landslide and a debris flow of the present invention includes: a data logger which is installed in soil, and receives self-supporting power to measure rainfall and pore water pressure of the ground and transmit data; and a remote server which receives data regarding the measured rainfall and the pore water pressure of the ground to calculate a first pore water pressure increase rate by using precipitation duration time, rainfall intensity, and soil moisture percentage, and estimates a second pore water pressure increase rate after a predetermined time by using the calculated first pore water pressure increase rate to transmit a warning. The present invention can, in a mountainous area in which power is not constantly supplied, provide against a disaster by monitoring a possibility of a landslide or a debris flow occurring during sudden rainfall and heavy rainfall by using the relationship among rainfall, pore water pressure, and effective stress.
