abstract_en: The present invention relates to a surge protecting device and a method thereof. The surge protecting device according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a molded case circuit breaker which includes a trip driving unit; a surge protector which cuts off surge flowing in an electrical system; a sensing circuit unit for surge protector cutoff; a signal converting unit which receives a signal of the sensing circuit unit for surge protector cutoff and converts the signal into a digital surge signal; and a microprocessor which controls to trip the trip driving unit for cutting off the surge protector. The surge protecting device according to an embodiment of the present invention can previously prevent a risk of a fire and a frequent breaker trip. The present invention can reduce costs by not installing a short circuit fuse or a thermal fuse in the surge protecting device additionally.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 서지 보호 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 서지 보호기의 열폭주를 예방하기 위한 단락 과전류 퓨즈나 열 폭주 방지회로를 추가로 설치할 필요가 없고, 사용 환경적 요인에 의한 서지의 강도에 따라 절연 파괴나 성능 저하로 교체 비용의 상승과 화재의 위험을 미리 예방할 수 있으며, 전력선 통신 등을 통해 기본 통신 정보에 포함되는 일반 통신 정보과 조건 통신 정보를 특정인에게 전송하고, 일정 시간 간격을 두고 일정치 이상의 통신 정보를 특정인에게 전송한 경우 상기 통신 정보를 중지하는 등의 다양한 기능을 포함하고, 맵 응용 API를 활용한 GUI를 통하여 각 정보에 대한 용이한 접근이 가능한 서지 보호 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 과를 개폐함과 함께 과부하, 단락 등의 이상 상태에 대해 를 차단하는 트립구동부를 포함하는 배선 차단기; 배선 차단기와 병렬로 연결되어 전기 계통에 흐르는 서지를 차단하는 서지 보호기; 서지 보호기의 접지선을 주회하여 형성되는 서지 보호기 차단용 감지 회로부; 서지 보호기 차단용 감지 회로부의 신호를 전달받아 디지털 서지 신호로 변환하는 신호변환부; 상기 디지털 서지 신호를 전달받아 기준치 이상의 디지털 서지 신호인 경우에만 상기 배선 차단기와 연동되어 서지 보호기를 차단하기 위해 상기 트립구동부를 트립시키도록 제어하는 마이크로 프로세서로 구성되되, 상기 마이크로 프로세서는, 전원선에 공급되는 전원의 정전, 누전 및 서지 횟수를 각 측정회로에서 감지하여 합한 값을 비휘발성 메모리에 저장한 후 표시장치에 디스플레이하는 측정값디스플레이모듈; 서지전류 측정회로에서 측정한 서지전류와, 영상변류기를 통한 누설전류 및 변류기를 통한 사용전류와, RTC에서 전송 받은 날짜와 시간 정보를 실시간 확인할 수 있도록 비휘발성 메모리에 저장한 후 표시장치에 디스플레이하는 실시간디스플레이모듈; 조건 통신 정보, 일반 통신 정보를 전송하고 일정 횟수 이상 통신 정보를 전송한 경우 통신 정보 전송을 중지하도록 제어 스위치를 작동시키는 통신 정지 모듈; 전송 조건을 변경하면 조건에 따른 통신 정보를 전송하는 조건 변경 통신 모듈; 현재 전원의 정전, 누전 및 서지 횟수 통신 정보 설정이 미리 되고, 전송 조건이 변경 안되는 경우 미리 정하여진 일반 통신 정보를 전송하는 일반 통신 모듈; 기존 전원선에 공급되는 전원의 정전, 누전 및 서지 횟수를 전달한 각 통신 정보를 현재 상태와 동일 상황인지 확인하여, 동일하면 미리 저장된 통신 정보 설정 조건에 따른 통신 정보를 전송하는 동일 상황 비교 모듈; 이기종간에도 일반 또는 조건 통신 정보 전송이 가능하도록 하는 이기종통신모듈; 일반 통신 정보 또는 조건 변경이 되어 새로운 조건에 따른 통신 정보의 인터럽트 알림(interruptive notification)을 사용하기 위해, 인터럽트 메시징(interruptive messaging) 모듈;을 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of weighting markov landslide method for early warning based on mean-standard deviation
abstract_en: A kind of weighting markov landslide method for early warning based on average value standard deviation, belongs to landslide disaster forecasting and warning field；This method includes：Landslide monitoring point velocity of displacement is collected, forms velocity of displacement set；Each affiliated state of velocity of displacement in velocity of displacement set is determined using average value standard deviation method, and build velocity of displacement status switch；Use weighted Markov chain predictive displacement speed next day predicted state；Landslide early warning is carried out to judge；Update velocity of displacement set；Landslide early warning result is evaluated；The stochastic behaviour of displacement parameter that the present invention is obtained from the evolution process of landslide, based on Markov chain theory, integrated use Landslide Evolution three-stage theory and average value standard deviation classification have surmounted understanding of the previous engineering circles to early warning of coming down；Specific prealarming process is given, available for the landslide early warning from displacement monitoring data Angle.

title_en: Post-verification support system, medical institution server, fire fighting server, post-verification support method, and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To achieve high efficiency of post-verification of rescue work.SOLUTION: Transported person information on a transported peron who was transported emergently is stored in a fire fighting database (DB) 10. A fire fighting server 20 notifies a medical institution server 40 of transported person information designated as a case to be post-verified. The medical institution server stores the transported person information stored in the fire fighting DB in a medical institution DB 30, receives a notification indicating the transported person information designated as a case to be post-verified, and sets a fact of being the case to be post-verified to corresponding transported person information in the medical institution DB. Regarding the transported person information to which the fact of being the case to be post-verified is set, a medical institution terminal 50 accepts input of verification information and transmits the input verification information to the medical institution server. The medical institution server stores in the medical institution DB the verification information received from the medical institution terminal. The fire fighting server updates the transported person information in the fire fighting DB on the basis of the verification information stored in the medical institution DB.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Building rescue information system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a building rescue information system, comprising: the wireless receiving and transmitting devices are arranged in escape tunnels or escape exits of each floor of the building and comprise receiving and judging units connected with the signal transmitting units and information transmitting units in signal connection with the receiving and judging units; after the receiving and judging unit receives the distance signal sent by the signal transmitting unit, at least judging the number of people trapped on each floor and the search and rescue information of the position where the people are located, converting the search and rescue information into a notification signal and transmitting the notification signal to the information transmitting unit; after the information transmitting unit receives the notification signal, the search and rescue information is uploaded to the building search and rescue information cloud server and is continuously updated. Before the rescue workers leave or arrive at the disaster site of the building (such as fire and earthquake), the correct number and position of the trapped persons in each floor can be immediately mastered to serve as important reference basis for rescue priority.

title_en: Methods and systems for managing alert messages
abstract_en: A method and a system for managing Cell Broadcast (CB) alert messages are provided. The method sends a CB alert message to a plurality of communication devices in an alert area through a wireless communication channel. The CB alert message is sent by a CB alert system. Further, each of the plurality of the communication devices includes a CB message handling application for handling such CB alert messages. The method further receives one or more acknowledgement messages from one or more communication devices. The one or more acknowledgement messages are received in response to receipt of the CB alert message at the plurality of communication devices. The one or more acknowledgement messages are received from the CB message handling application in respective communication devices.

title_en: Method and apparatus for notifying si update, eab update and pws message in wireless communication system
title_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 si 업데이트, eab 업데이트 및 pws 메시지를 통지하기 위한 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A method and apparatus for receiving system information (SI) in a wireless communication system is provided. A user equipment (UE), which may be in an enhanced coverage or operate with a narrower bandwidth than a cell bandwidth, receives an indication of at least one of SI update, earthquake and tsunami warning system (ETWS) notification, commercial mobile alert system (CMAS) or extended access barring (EAB) modification via a physical downlink control channel (PDCCH) from a network, and receives system information according to the received indication from the network.
abstract_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 시스템 정보(SI; system information)를 수신하는 방법 및 장치가 제공된다. 향상된 커버리지 내에 있거나 셀 대역폭보다 좁은 대역폭에서 동작하는 단말(UE; userequipment)은, SI 업데이트, 지진 및 쓰나미 경보 시스템(ETWS; earthquake and tsunami warning system) 통지, 상용 모바일 경보 시스템(CMAS; commercial mobile alert system) 통지 또는 확장된 접속 차단(EAB; extended access barring) 수정 중 적어도 하나에 대한 지시를 PDCCH(physical downlink control channel)를 통해 네트워크로부터 수신하며, 네트워크로부터 수신된 지시에 따라 시스템 정보를 수신한다.

title_en: Disaster indoor communication system with wireless communication network and the communication method thereof
title_ko: 무선네트워크부를 구비한 실내 재난 통신 시스템 및 실내 재난 통신 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an indoor disaster communication system equipped with a wireless network part and an indoor disaster communication method, which enable indoor disaster communication to be performed without discontinuation of communication even in a disaster situation, such as sinking or fire of a structure having a complex indoor constitution, such as a ship or a building. The indoor disaster communication system equipped with a wireless network part comprises a wireless network part which includes a plurality of wireless network nodes configured to selectively perform radio wave communication and sound wave communication in order to switch communication to the sound wave communication when flooding occurs during performance of the radio wave communication and which provides local area communication service inside a structure. In case of occurrence of a disaster, such as flooding or fire inside a ship or a large-sized building, communication is prevented from being discontinued inside a structure, a location and situation of a rescuee can be identified by a rescuer via a gesture or emergency message, and stable local communication service can be provided in case of a disaster by configuring the wireless network part by using an infrastructureless ad hoc network, thereby providing an effect of considerably facilitating rescue of human lives in case of occurrence of a disaster.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박 또는 건물 등의 복잡한 실내 구조를 가지는 구조물의 침몰, 화재 등의 재난 상황에서도 통신의 단절 없이 실내에서의 재난 통신을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 무선네트워크부를 구비한 실내 재난 통신 시스템 및 실내 재난 통신 방법에 관한 것으로, 
상기 무선네트워크부를 구비한 실내 재잔 통신 시스템은, 무선전파통신을 수행하는 과정 중 침수가 발생한 경우 음파통신으로 통신을 변경하도록 무선전파통신과 음파통신을 선택적으로 수행하는 다수의 무선네트워크노드들을 구비하여 구조물 내에서의 로컬영역 통신서비스를 제공하는 무선네트워크부;를 포함하여 구성되어, 
선박 또는 대형 건물 내에서의 침수, 화재 등의 재난 발생 시, 구조물 실내에서의 통신 단절을 방지하고, 제스처 또는 응급메시지를 통해 요구조자의 위치 및 상황을 구조자가 확인할 수 있도록 하며, 무선네트워크부를 인프라스트럭처를 구비하지 않는(infrastructureless) 애드 혹(ad hoc) 네트워크로 구성하는 것에 의해 재난 시에도 안정적인 국지적 통신서비스를 제공하며, 이에 의해 재난 발생 시의 인명 구조를 현저히 용이하게 하는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Stage setting apparatus of motor control method
title_ko: 모터구동방식 무대장치의 부하변동 모니터링 및 비교 분석 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for monitoring, comparing, and analyzing a change in load of a motor drive-type stage setting, which apply an algorithm, adapted to constantly monitor, compare and analyze the amount of load applied to a motor, to a motor drive-type stage setting, and thus the apparatus and method for monitoring, comparing, and analyzing change in load of motor drive-type stage setting can induce a user to check and maintain the stage setting in advance, thereby preventing inconvenience and cancelation of performance from being caused by a sudden mechanical failure, protecting people from a safety accident and the like, and contributing to success of performance. For this purpose, the method for monitoring, comparing, and analyzing a change in load of a motor drive-type stage setting according to the present invention comprises the steps of: determining whether an instruction for moving a batten is present; when the instruction for moving the batten is present, checking a moving direction, and performing a location moving instruction and residual distance calculation; determining whether a location of the moved batten corresponds to a limit location; stopping when the location of the moved batten corresponds to the limit location; and determining again whether the instruction for moving the batten is present. The method for monitoring, comparing, and analyzing a change in load of a motor drive-type stage setting monitors a load factor from a start of lifting or lowering of a batten, calculates and backs up an average value or maximum value of the load factor, provides a warning to a stage director or stage setting administrator in advance when a load factor higher than a preset load factor is detected, induces the stage director or stage setting administrator to perform regular check when the warning is a minor warning, induces the stage director or stage setting administrator to perform emergency checking when the warning is a strong warning, and executes a forced stop when the warning is an urgent warning.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 모터구동방식 무대장치에 있어서 항상 모터의 부하량을 모니터링 및 비교 분석하는 알고리즘을 적용하여 사전에 무대장치를 점검 및 정비를 유도함으로써 갑작스런 기계 고장으로 인한 불편과 공연의 취소, 안전사고 등으로부터 인명을 보호하고 성공적인 공연에도 기여할 수 있도록 한 모터구동방식 무대장치의 부하변동 모니터링 및 비교 분석 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 본 발명은  배튼의 이동지령 여부를 판단하여 배튼의 이동 지령이 있는 경우 이동방향 확인, 위치이동 지령 및 잔여 거리 연산을 실행한 후 이동한 배튼 위치가 규정위치인가 여부를 판단하여 규정위치이면 일단 정지한 후 배튼의 이동지령 여부를 재차 판단하는 단계를 포함하는 모터구동방식 무대장치의 관리방법에 있어서, 배튼이 상승 또는 하강을 시작할 때부터 부하율을 모니터링하고 평균값 또는 최대값을 연산 및 백업하여 미리 설정된 부하율 보다 높은 값이 측정될 경우 무대 감독이나 무대장치 관리자에게 이 사실을 사전에 경고하여 경경고일 경우 정기점검의 유도를, 중경고일 경우는 긴급 점검의 유도를, 중대경고일 경우에는 강제정지를 실행하도록 이루어진 것이다.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster information providing system and an operating method thereof. The mobile not only provides disaster information but also receives disaster information transmitted from an adjacent mobile or transponder. The transponder broadcasts information included in the disaster information in an RF communication region valid for a providing time and region, provides disaster information inputted through an input device and disaster information sensed by an external sensors to the RF communication region.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 정보 제공 시스템 및 그 구동 방법에 관한 것으로서, 모바일이 재난 정보를 제공할 뿐만 아니라 인접한 모바일이나 트랜스폰더로부터 전송되는 재난 정보를 제공받을 수 있으며, 트랜스폰더는 재난 정보에 포함된 정보를 제공하는 시간과 제공 영역에 대해 유효한 RF 통신 영역에서 브로드캐스팅하고, 입력 장치를 통해 입력되는 재난 정보 및 외부의 센서들로써 감지되는 재난 정보를 RF 통신 영역에 제공하는 모바일과 트랜스폰더를 이용한 재난 정보 제공 시스템 및 그 구동 방법을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Mobile terminal emergency alarm method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mobile terminal emergency alarm method and device. In one aspect, there is provided a mobile terminal emergency alert method, including: setting triggering alarm conditions; storing personal information of a user, and acquiring fingerprint information of the user according to the triggering alarm condition; inputting a fingerprint; identifying fingerprint information; judging whether the trigger signal is consistent with the stored user fingerprint information; and if the trigger signal is consistent with the stored user fingerprint information, sending an alarm signal, wherein the alarm signal contains the personal information of the user. According to the invention, the fingerprint information is set according to the needs of the user, the updated real-time geographical position information is obtained, the site is really recorded, and the problem that the information of the alarm person cannot be effectively identified is solved.

title_en: A kind of novel intelligent detects the interlink warning device of fire
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of novel intelligent detects the interlink warning device of fire, including shell, smoke inductor, signal connector and alarm, outer casing bottom is provided with smoke inductor, temperature detector is provided with above smoke inductor, temperature detector side is provided with battery compartment, manual pull station is provided with above battery compartment, signal connector is provided with above manual pull station, signal connector side is provided with alarm, signal connector opposite side is provided with display screen, emergency light is provided with above display screen, shell is disposed behind vacuum cup, vacuum cup side is provided with peg button, runing rest is provided with above peg button.Beneficial effect is：Can automatic detection smokescope and ambient temperature, and according to setting value automatic alarm, and can achieve interlink warning, be easy to withdrawing in time for floor gap personnel, while when there is fire at night, emergency light can help the timely safe escape of people, reducing casualties.
assignees: CHONGQING CHENGJI FIRE SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: The system informs the driver signal change
title_ko: 신호등 신호 감지에 의한 신호변경 운전자 알림 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for informing a driver about signal change by sensing of a traffic light signal. The preset invention comprises: a mount unit (110) attached with a front glass of a vehicle; a signal aspect sensor having a sensing angle; a speaker; an alarm lamp which turns off a lamp when the signal is changed; and a transceiver which receives a signal of the outside. The present invention has an effect of informing the driver of the remaining time of the signal to a display unit (240) so that the user can previously prepare for the signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 신호등 신호 감지에 의한 신호변경 운전자 알림 시스템은, 차량의 대쉬보드 상단 또는 차량의 전면유리에 부착되는 마운트부(110); 상기 마운트부(110)의 상면에 고정되고, 차량의 주행방향 상단을 지향하는 감지각을 가지는 신호현시 감지센서(100); 상기 신호현시 감지센서(100)와 연결되어, 신호 변경시 알람을 송출하는 스피커(210, 미도시); 상기 신호현시 감지센서(100)와 연결되며, 차량의 핸들 내부에 장착되어 신호 변경시 진동을 발생하는 진동 발생기(220, 미도시); 상기 신호현시 감지센서(100)와 연결되어, 신호 변경시 램프를 점등하는 알림 램프(230, 미도시); 상기 신호현시 감지센서(100)와 연결되어 외부의 신호를 수신하는 송수신기(300); 상기 스피커(210, 미도시), 진동 발생기(220, 미도시), 알림 램프(230, 미도시)는 알림부(200)로 통칭할 수 있으며, 상기 알림부(200) 및 송수신기(300)와 연결되어 제어명령을 수행하는 제어부(400); 를 포함하여 구성되며, 또한 신호등에 장착되고 신호등 제어판(500)과 연결되어 신호등의 신호변경 시간을 신호등 전방의 차량에 송출하는 신호 송출기(510); 를 더 포함하고, 상기 송출기(510)에서 송출하는 신호변경 시간 데이터를 상기 송수신기(300)에서 제어부(400)로 전송하여 현재 신호의 남은 시간을 파악할 수 있도록 사용자에게 시각적으로 표출하는 디스플레이(240)를 더 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하며, 신호등의 신호변경을 감지하는 신호현시 감지센서(100)를 장착하고, 신호등의 신호 변경을 운전자에게 진동, 알람, 플리커링으로 알려 주지시킴으로써 신호대기 동안의 운전자의 행동에 제약을 없애고 신호변경에 대비할 수 있게 하는 효과를 부여하며, 상기와 같이 신호등의 신호변경 시간을 신호등 전방의 차량에 송출하는 신호 송출기(510)에 의하여, 신호등에 근접한 차량의 신호변경 운전자 알림 시스템의 송수신기(300)에서 이를 감지하여 운전자에게 신호의 남은 시간을 디스플레이(240)로 알려 줌으로써 신호에 미리 대비할 수 있도록 하는 효과를 가진다.

title_en: Gust front automatic recognition method based on Doppler weather radar data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gust front automatic recognition method based on Doppler weather radar data, and the method comprises the following steps: 1), extracting a weak narrow band echo suspected area according to the radar performance characteristics of gust front through employing a local binaryzation algorithm; 2), carrying out the segmentation, connection and screening of the weak narrow band echo suspected area, and obtaining a skeleton image corresponding to a weak ridge-shaped belt; 3), obtaining an optical flow field through two low-pitching-angle radar images at a current moment and a former moment, supposing the matched skeletons at the former and latter moments in the skeleton images corresponding to the weak ridge-shaped belt obtained at step 2) as the suspected gust front, and recognizing the gust front according to the relation between the position and speed of the suspected gust front and the position and speed of a windstorm cell and the relation between the direction and speed of the suspected gust front. The method achieves the automatic detection of the gust front, achieves the timely early warning of disasters, and reduces the economic loss and casualty. Moreover, the validity of the method is verified.

title_en: Reception of emergency messages in mobile devices
abstract_en: Methods for receiving emergency messages on a mobile communication device having a first subscription and a second subscription sharing a radio frequency (RF) resource may include prioritizing, by a processor of the mobile communication device, the first subscription for a predetermined time period in order to receive an emergency message, determining, by the processor, whether the first subscription should be de-prioritized before the predetermined time period expires based on a reception history of the first subscription during the predetermined time period, and tuning the RF resource to the second subscription before the predetermined time period expires in response to determining that the first subscription should be de-prioritized before the predetermined time period expires.

title_en: Method and device for stopping scptm transmission
title_ko: Scptm 전송을 중단하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided is a method for a base station performing a multimedia broadcast multicast service (MBMS) session update in a wireless communication system, and a device supporting same. The base station may comprise: receiving, from a multi-cell coordination entity (MCE), a MBMS session update request message comprising a single-cell point-to-multipoint (SCPTM) transmission stop indication; and transmitting, to the MCE, a MBMS session update response message as a response to the MBMS session update request message.
abstract_ko: 무선 통신 시스템에서 기지국이 MBMS 세션 업데이트(Multimedia Broadcast Multicast Service Session Update)를 수행하는 방법 및 이를 지원하는 장치가 제공된다. 상기 기지국은 SCPTM 전송 중단 지시(Single Cell Point to Multipoint Transmission Stop Indication)를 포함하는 MBMS 세션 업데이트 요청 메시지(MBMS Session Update Request Message)를 MCE(Multi-cell Coordination Entity)로부터 수신하고, 상기 MBMS 세션 업데이트 요청 메시지에 대한 응답으로 MBMS 세션 업데이트 응답 메시지(MBMS Session Update Response Message)를 상기 MCE로 전송하는 것을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Automatic Extinguishing System for Kitchen Fire cause by Electrics and Gas
title_ko: 전기 또는 가스로 인한 주방 화재의 자동 소화 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic extinguishing system for a kitchen fire caused by electricity or gas. The system comprises a sensor device, a control device, an extinguishing device, a ventilating device, and a key operating device. Accordingly, by detecting and analyzing smoke, gas, flame, and temperature around a heating tool in a kitchen, fire preparation, fire notification, and protection execution are sequentially performed to automatically operate the extinguishing device after detecting a fire suspicious situation or a fire occurring situation early, so that a fire can be extinguished in an initial state.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기 또는 가스로 인한전기 또는 가스로 인한 소화 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 음식 조리용 가열 기구가 사용되는 실내 일측에 설치되고, 상기 가열 기구 주변의 온도, 불꽃, 가스, 연기 중 적어도 하나 이상을 감지하는 센서 장치; 상기 센서 장치로부터 감지된 센서 데이터를 수집하고, 상기 수집된 센서 데이터를 분석하여 화재 레벨을 설정하며, 상기 설정된 화재 레벨에 따라 화재 제어 신호 또는 환풍 제어 신호를 발생하는 제어 장치; 상기 가열 기구의 상부 측에 설치되고, 상기 화재 제어 신호에 따라 소화약재를 분사 노즐을 통해 방출하는 소화 장치; 상기 가열 기구의 상부 측에 설치되고, 상기 환풍 제어 신호에 따라 실내 공기를 실외로 강제 배출시키는 환풍 장치; 및 상기 소화 장치 또는 환풍 장치의 구동시 자동 모드 및 수동 모드에 대한 모드를 결정하며, 상기 가열 기구 또는 화재와 관련한 사용자 조작 정보를 입력하는 키조작 장치를 포함한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 주방의 가열 기구 주변에서 발생하는 연기, 가스, 불꽃, 온도를 감지 및 분석함으로써 화재 의심 상황이나 화재 발생 상황을 조기에 발견한 후 화재 예비, 화재 경보, 방호 실행을 단계적으로 수행하여 자동으로 소화 장치가 작동되어 화재를 초기에 소화할 수 있으며, 음식물 가열시 발생하는 연기나 가스와 혼동하여 소화 장치가 오작동되는 것을 방지하면서 침착한 화재 대응을 수행할 있고, 온도 감지 데이터를 분석하여 화재 발화 지점에 대한 예측이 가능하고, 이 화재 발화 지점을 기준으로 분사 노즐의 분사 각도를 자동으로 조정하여 유효 방호 면적에 소화약제가 정확히 방출될 수 있도록 수 한다.

title_en: automotive notification information device
title_ko: 자동차 알림 정보판
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 자동차 부착용 안전용품으로, 자동차의 고장이나 사고시 자동차의 트렁크를 열어 방향표시를 위한 도형 및 문자 등을 다양하게 표출하여 비상상황을 후방 차량의 운전자에게 신속 정확하게 알려줌과 동시에 방향표시에 의해 후방 차량이 변경해서 주행해야 하는 차선을 지시하여 차량의 운전자가 보다 안전하고 신속하게 비상 상황에 대처할 수 있도록 한 자동차 알림 정보판을 제공한다.

title_en: A kind of landslide alarm system
abstract_en: This utility model is related to a kind of landslide alarm system, including ultrasonic monitor device, infrared monitoring device, PLC and sound and light alarm instrument, the ultrasonic distance determines device includes some ultrasonic range finders, and the monitoring feedback mechanism corresponding with ultrasonic range finder, the infrared monitoring device includes base plate, side plate, top board, baffle ring, elastic threads and active infrared alarm, ultrasonic range finder, wireless data receiver, sound and light alarm instrument is connected with PLC, can be existing to landslide as making early warning in time, prompting personnel withdrawn in time, ensure that the safety of people's lives and properties.

title_en: Multimedia Alert and Response System for Urgent and Local Requests
abstract_en: A Multimedia Alert and Response System for Urgent and Local Requests have been disclosed. In one version when an urgent request is received urgent rules are applied, a reverse call center is applied, and a service provider is connected telephonically with a live service provider person.

title_en: A method and apparatus for transmittng an warning message by using v2x services in a wireless access system
abstract_en: The present invention provides methods and apparatus for transmitting and receiving warning messages by using Vehicle to Everything (V2X) services. One of embodiments of the present invention is performed by a vehicle user equipment (VUE) and comprising steps of receiving a first Message transmission Guideline Package (MGP) message including geographical coordination information related with an MGP area and a value tag indicating time information for updating the MGP message; checking the value tag is changed or not; and transmitting a first warning message based on the first MGP message when the value tag is not expired; or transmitting a second warning message based on a second MGP message when the value tag is expired, wherein at least a transmission frequency or a transmission power for the second warning message are determined base on the second MGP message, and wherein the MGP area represents where MGP profiles are the same.

title_en: System for monitoring flooding of road and its method
title_ko: 도로침수 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for monitoring flooding on a road. Provided is the system for monitoring flooding on a road, the system comprising: a water level meter which is disposed in a predetermined position inside a manhole and which measures a water level of rainfall or sewage flowing through a sewer; a rainfall meter which is installed at a predetermined location around the manhole and which measures the amount of rainfall at the location; a flooding prediction and warning server which calculates a speed of a rise in the water level in the sewer by using water level data transmitted by the water level meter, which predicts a rise in a water level inside the manhole by using an SWMM model when rainfall occurring at the location is determined to continue by using rainfall data transmitted by the rainfall meter, and which generates flooding prediction data when a back flow to the manhole is predicted; an image acquisition means which is installed at a predetermined location on a road, which performs photographing for a traffic safety or crime prevention purpose under the control of a CCTV management server in an ordinary situation, and which photographs a water depth indicator installed on a facility of the road when a predetermined control right has been changed; and a monitoring server which receives image data acquired by the image acquisition means and which performs image detection and analysis regarding the water depth indicator. Furthermore, also provided is the method for monitoring flooding on a road. According to the present invention, provided is an advantage of provision of the system and method for monitoring flooding on a road, which can minimize installation of unnecessary CCTVs for the sole purpose of monitoring of the flooding on a road and which can improve accuracy.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로침수 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 개시된 도로침수 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법은, 맨홀 내 소정 위치에 설치되고, 관거 내를 흐르는 우수 또는 하수의 수위를 측정하는 수위계, 상기 맨홀 근처의 소정 지점에 설치되고, 상기 지점의 강우량을 측정하는 강우량계, 상기 수위계로부터 전송되는 수위데이터를 이용하여 상기 관거의 수위 상승 속도를 계산하고, 상기 강우량계로부터 전송되는 강우 데이터를 이용하여 상기 지점에 강우가 지속되는 것으로 판단되면, SWMM 모형을 이용하여 상기 맨홀 내 수위 상승을 예측하고 상기 맨홀로 역류가 예측되면 침수예보 데이터를 생성하는 침수예경보서버, 도로의 소정 위치에 설치되고, 평상시에는 CCTV관리서버의 관리에 따라 평상시에는 도로교통안전용 내지 방범용으로 촬영을 수행하다가, 소정의 제어권 변경시 도로의 시설물에 설치된 수심 표지물을 촬영하는 영상획득수단 및 상기 영상획득수단으로부터 촬영된 영상데이터를 전달받아 수심표지물에 대한 영상 감지 및 분석을 수행하는 모니터링서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 도로 침수 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 도로 침수 모니터링을 위한 불필요한 CCTV의 설치를 최소화하고 정확도를 향상할 수 있는 도로침수 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공할 수 있다는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Automated detection of an emergency by a user device
abstract_en: A user device may determine that an environmental parameter, sensed by the user device, satisfies a condition, and may detect an emergency based on detecting that the environmental parameter satisfies the condition. The user device may output, via the user device, an alarm notification, and may determine whether an input is received by the user device to cancel the alarm notification. The user device may notify an emergency device when the user device determines that input is not received by the user device to cancel the alarm notification.

title_en: Method for presence detection
abstract_en: A method for verifying the presence of users running a status check application on their wireless transceiver units is provided. The method comprises a presence check comprising setting up a group list of wireless transceiver units specific to the status check application. Each wireless transceiver unit having a group list ID. The method further comprises broadcasting an application specific presence check signal including a command message, from the initiating wireless transceiver unit and receiving the broadcast presence check signal including the command message, at the additional wireless transceiver unit. The method further comprises listening for a broadcast presence check acknowledgement, in the initiating wireless transceiver unit using the local network transceiver, and upon receipt of a presence check acknowledgement, including the group list ID from the additional wireless transceiver unit, updating the group list by marking the additional wireless transceiver unit as present.

title_en: Aircraft flight itinerary alerting system
abstract_en: A flight itinerary alerting system for monitoring a flight itinerary includes a monitoring system storing flight itinerary data like pilot contact data, first tier contact data, and second tier contact data. An alert routine executable on the monitoring system i) determines first or second tier alert conditions if no deactivation message is received upon expiry of a respective first or second duration following the expected arrival time, and ii) send an alert message through a communication network to a computer device of a corresponding first or second tier contact person upon determination of the respective alert condition. The multiple tiers of contact data with respective alerting criteria allows quick determination if search and rescue should be contacted with inherent redundancy, thus preventing overdue aircraft from being overlooked, while also minimizing false alarms in reporting overdue aircraft to search and rescue which might reasonably be accounted for by responsible persons.

title_en: Apparatus and method for preventing disaster caused by short-circuit in electric power systems
title_ko: 전력계통에서의 단락 발생시 재해 방지장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method to prevent a disaster when a short circuit occurs in a power system, using fail power short-circuited when a short circuit occurs on a load side of a power distribution line installed in a power system to decrease a short circuit current of a supply power side and decrease an output voltage of the load side, so as to prevent an electric accident due to the short circuit current. According to the present invention, the apparatus comprises: a warning generator to interlink with the power system (power distribution line) for supplying power to a single or three-phase, and to warn occurrence of a short circuit; a warning release signal input unit to release a warning; and a short circuit correction device. The short circuit correction device comprises: a short circuit power converter to generate a short circuit signal simultaneously with the occurrence of the short circuit when the short circuit occurs, to prevent a casualty accident due to an electric shock, reduce the output value of the load side while changing an electric connection position of a coil connected to a power input terminal, distribute the voltage inputted to the power input terminal to the coil of which the position is changed to reduce the short circuit current when earth fault occurs due to a short circuit as a ground potential difference of the short-circuited power is reduced more than a potential difference of the power, and to allow a harmonic wave to flow once in normal and inverse phases which are converted by 180 angular degrees when the harmonic wave is generated on the load side; a switch to transfer the short circuit signal; and a switch to output power cut-off and warning signals in accordance with an electric signal outputted from the switch.
abstract_ko: 전력계통에 구비된 배전선로의 부하측에서 단락시에 단락된 고장전력을 이용하여 공급전원측 단락전류를 감소시키고, 부하측 출력전압을 감소시켜, 단락전류로 인한 전기사고를 방지할 수 있도록 한 전력계통에서의 단락(합선)시 재해 방지장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 개시된 전력계통에서의 단락(합선)시 재해 방지장치는, 단상 또는 3상을 통해 전력을 공급해주는 전력계통(배전선로)과 연계하고, 단락(합선) 발생을 경보하는 경보 발생기와; 경보해제를 위한 경보해제 신호 입력부와; 단락보정장치를 포함하며 상기 단락보정장치는, 상기 단락이 발생하면 단락 발생과 동시에 단락전기신호를 발생하고, 단락 된 전력의 대지 전위차를 전원의 전위차보다 감소하여 단락으로 인한 지락(누전)이 발생하면 감전에 의한 인명사고를 예방하며, 전원입력단자에 연결된 코일의 전기적인 연결 위치를 변경하고 전원입력단자에 입력되는 전압을 상기 위치를 변경한 코일로 분산시켜 단락전류를 감소시키면서, 부하측의 출력전압을 감소시키며 부하측에서 고조파가 발생하면 상기 고조파를 180도 변환되는 정상위상과 역상위상에 한 차례 흐르게 하여 발생한 고조파를 상쇄하는 단락전력변환기와; 상기 단락 전기신호를 전달하기 위한 스위치와; 상기 스위치에 의해 출력되는 전기신호에 따라 전력차단 및 경보신호를 위한 스위치를 포함한다.

title_en: Fire fighting apparatus
title_ko: 소방배관의 누수를 감지할 수 있는 소방장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting device capable of sensing a leakage of a firefighting pipe. The firefighting device includes a connection pipe (10) and a leakage sensing unit (20). The connection pipe (10) comprises: a pipe body (11) wherein the inside is penetrated and a protrusion (11a) is integrally formed on both ends; a nut (12) installed on the circumference of the pipe body (11) to rotate and having a hanging protrusion (12a) integrally formed and corresponding to the protrusion (11a); an elastic ring (13) installed between the protrusion (11a) and the hanging protrusion (12a) and pushing the hanging protrusion (12) in one direction; and a water inlet (14) collecting water leaking from the firefighting pipe (P) by being integrally formed on the circumference of the pipe body (11). The leakage sensing unit (20) comprises: a water sensor (21) installed in the water inlet (14) and sensing and outputting the water; an alarm unit (22) operated by the water sensor (21) and installed in the water inlet (14), wherein the alarm unit (22) emits light and warning sound to a periphery; a battery (23) supplying power to the water sensor (21) and the alarm unit (22); and a protective cover (24) covering the alarm unit (22) and the battery (23) and protecting the same from external force. According to the embodiment of the present invention, the firefighting device can largely reinforce a coupling force of the connection pipe and the firefighting pipe by the elastic ring and can inform a manager of the leakage of the firefighting pipe by rapidly sensing the leakage of the firefighting pipe by a leakage sensor. Therefore, the firefighting device facilitates management of a facility.

abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of Gas Disaster method for early warning based on normal distribution-test identification gas effusion intensity, comprising: the time series of driving face in coal mine gas density is obtained from safety monitor and control system；Lilliefors normal distribution-test and Shapiro-Wilk normal distribution-test are carried out to the time series of driving face in coal mine gas density；Judge gas density time series whether Normal Distribution: be that then current time driving face in coal mine Gas is in normal phase, take subsequent time update after gas concentration time series carry out normal distribution-test；Otherwise current time driving face in coal mine Gas is in the abnormal stage, further determines whether driving face in coal mine Gas has entered the abnormal stage.The present invention monitors pre-procedure risk state in real time, and the abnormal point that discovery face gas is gushed out issues warning information with this, is conducive to gas accident prevention and control.

title_en: Cloud platform routing data processing method and physical server of cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing method of cloud platform routing data and a physical server of a cloud platform. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: monitoring a notification sent by a distributed coordination service cluster of a cloud platform by a target physical server of the cloud platform, wherein the notification is used for indicating that the distributed coordination service cluster stores first routing information issued by a central controller of the cloud platform, and the first routing information is routing information of a virtual machine in the target physical server; the target physical server acquires first routing information from the distributed coordination service cluster according to the notification; and the target physical server updates the second routing information stored in the target physical server according to the first routing information. The invention solves the technical problem of poor disaster tolerance performance of the processing system of the routing data.

title_en: VNF state detection notification method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a VNF state detection notification method, a VNF state detection notification device and a VNF state detection notification system, and relates to the field of network function virtualization, wherein the VNF state detection notification method comprises the following steps: the VNFM carries out unified state detection on the VNF network elements and judges whether the state of the VNF is changed or not, wherein the state of the VNF comprises a fault state and a fault recovery state; if the state of a certain VNF is changed, determining the current state of the VNF; and reporting the current state of the VNF to the NFVO so that the NFVO updates the network topology according to the current state of the VNF and advertises the updated network topology to other VNFs and VNFMs. The method, the device and the system provided by the invention are used for uniformly detecting the state of the VNF, are simple and easy to use, reduce a large amount of heartbeat messages among the VNF, save network resources, realize the disaster tolerance and bypass actions consistent with the VNF, and realize the dynamic presentation of the VNF network topology and the automatic recovery operation of the NFVO.

title_en: System and method for integrated emergency notification
abstract_en: A system and method for integrated emergency notification is provided. It may be decentralized and integrate essential notification functions to manage an emergency situation through a single system. Accordingly, in the event of an active threat or other emergency at a location (i.e., a building), the system and method according to embodiments of the present disclosure may provide an immediate, effective way to simultaneously notify/alert users that may be on-site as well as first responders and other interested parties of emergencies and provide a means of communicating site-specific information to one another, such as through a real-time chat feature. The system and method may provide color-coded floor plans that may be updated to show user status, automatically detect inactivity, and provide easy-to-use reference materials for standard response procedures that may be employed depending on the type of alert situation.

title_en: Systems for tracking medications
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to integrated systems, methods and apparatuses for assisting individuals in managing acute life-threatening conditions. A system in accordance with the current disclosure may comprise an electronic circuit configured to be attached to a container of a medication and one or more devices in communication with the electronic circuit in a private network. In an aspect, the one or more devices may work in concert to determine the safety level of an individual based on predetermined usage settings. In some aspects, the system may be configured to determine whether a medication would expire before its manufactured expiry date. In another aspect, the system may assist an individual in locating a medication. In a further aspect, the system may determine whether an individual is having an anaphylactic reaction. In some aspects, the system may detect a known allergen and alert the individual.

title_en: Warning Broadcasting System Using Two-Way Radio Transceiver
title_ko: 무전기를 이용한 경고방송 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a warning broadcast system comprising a situation monitoring and warning broadcast output device, an emergency situation monitoring device, and a radio. According to the warning broadcast system of the present invention, the situation monitoring and warning broadcast output device transmits a video of a surrounding situation in real time in a radio communications scheme using a first channel. Also, the emergency situation monitoring device receives the video of the surrounding situation in real time through the first channel, and outputs the received video of the surrounding situation on a display unit. When a security guard determines that an emergency situation occurs in the surrounding of the situation monitoring and warning broadcast output device by the video of the surrounding situation output by the display unit, the radio transmits a warning voice of the security guard in a radio communications scheme using a second channel. Furthermore, the situation monitoring and warning broadcast output device receives a signal of the warning voice in real time through the second channel, and outputs the received signal of the warning voice to a speaker unit as a warning broadcast. Therefore, according to the warning broadcast system of the present invention, a conventional system can be used by slightly changing the configuration of a conventional system installed in an apartment complex, thereby constructing and efficiently operating the same with the low costs.

title_en: Emergency alerting system and method including low-power set-top box that controls operation modes depending on context information

abstract_en: Disclosed are a disaster alarm system including a low-power set-top box capable of context-based operation mode control, and a method thereof. The disaster alarm method performed by a set-top box can comprise the steps of: switching to a network-assisted passive standby mode among operation modes of a set-top box in accordance with preset conditions; transmitting information on an operation mode of the set-top box and context information around the set-top box to a wake-up server; receiving a wakeup data packet generated based on the transmitted information; and switching the operation mode of the set-top box based on the received wakeup data packet.

abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a building vibration control system applicable to a plurality of buildings which share an earthquake detector and a vibration data analysis device.SOLUTION: Earthquake data creation means 8 of a vibration data analysis device 4 creates predicted earthquake data for respective regions on the basis of either vibration data transmitted from an earthquake detector 1 through the Internet 3 or earthquake data included in the emergency earthquake warning transmitted from the Meteorological Agency 2 through the Internet 3, and geological data 6 stored in a storage device 5. Control data creation means 9 creates control data corresponding to a plurality of active vibration control devices 12, 13, 15, 18, 20 and 21 on the basis of the predicted earthquake data created by the earthquake data creation means 8, and building data 7 stored in the storage device 5, and outputs the control data to the corresponding active vibration control devices 12, 13, 15, 18, 20 and 21 through the Internet 3. title_en: The apparatus of smart instrumentaion for radiation exposure with dose area product meter sft
title_ko: “sft”형 dap 계측기·유기섬광체형 방사선센서부로 이루어진 하이브리드형 스마트 방사선피폭 계측장치
abstract_en: Disclosed is a hybrid-type radiation exposure measurement apparatus comprising an SFT-type DAP measuring instrument and an organic scintillator-type radiation sensor part. The hybrid-type radiation exposure measurement apparatus comprises: the SFT-type DAP measuring instrument (100) of primarily measuring dose change according to the change of a cross-sectional area of an X-ray beam and transmitting the measured dose change to a smart control part; the organic scintillator-type radiation sensor part (200) of radiating the X-ray beam to the organic scintillator to reflect light of a specific wavelength, secondarily measuring a scintillation light signal according to the X-ray beam, and transmitting the secondarily measured scintillation light signal to the smart control part; a battery part (300) supplying power to each device; a short-distance communication module (400) of transmitting current effective dose exposure data and emergency situation notification messages; a display part (500) of displaying the current effective does exposure data and the emergency situation notification messages in real-time; a wired/wireless communication module (600) of transmitting the current effective does exposure data and the emergency situation notification messages, receiving a control instruction signal as a response signal for the transmission, and transmitting the received signal to the smart control part; and the smart control part (700) of controlling to transmit the current effective dose exposure data and the emergency situation notification messages to the short-range communication module and the wired/wireless communication module when the current effective dose exposure data is compared with a reference dose, and it is determined that the current effective dose exposure data is equal to or greater than the reference value. According to the present invention, the relationship between an X-ray dose and the obtained charge quantity counter can be clearly distinguished.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 종래 면적선량계를 내장하는 X선 조사야 제한장치의 구성요소 중 면적선량 센서를 외국에서 수입해서 사용하므로, 비용이 비싸고, 주변의 환경에 영향을 받아 정확한 선량 측정이 어려운 문제점과, 환자에게 조사되는 피폭선량이 기준치 이상일 경우에, 실시간으로 부저음을 통해 외부에 알림과 동시에, 기준치 이상의 현재 유효선량피폭데이터를 근거리 또는 원거리의 중앙관리서버로 전달시키는 장치가 없어, 그대로 환자 뿐만 아니라 방사선사에게 노출되어, 제2의 방사선 피폭사고가 발생되는 문제점을 개선하고자, "SFT"형 DAP 계측기(100), 유기섬광체형 방사선센서부(200), 배터리부(300), 근거리통신모듈(400), 디스플레이부(500), 유무선통신모듈(600), 스마트제어부(700)로 구성됨으로서, 엑스레이(X-ray) 장비의 분광기 선단에 탈부착 설치되어, 단면적의 변화에 따른 선량변화를 통해 1차 측정하고, 방사선피폭객체쪽을 바라보는 후단에서 유기섬광체의 섬광빛 신호를 2차 측정한 후, 1차방사선측정데이터와 2차방사선측정데이터를 기준으로 연산하여 현재 유효선량피폭데이터를 표출시킬 수 있어, 하이브리드식 측정방식으로 기존보다 80% 향상된 센싱정확도를 가지면서 방사선량피폭을 실시간 측정할 수 있고, 투명유연전극판의 금속물질이 ITO 또는 탄소나노튜브(CNT)로 금속 코팅되어, 엑스선 선량과 획득된 전하량 카운터의 관계를 뚜렷하게 식별할 수 있어, 전하량 획득율을 기존에 비해 80% 향상시킬 수 있으며, 모든 부품 구성과 설계를 국내 순수기술로 제작할 수 있어, 기존의 수입 면적선량계보다 50% 저렴한 가격으로 소비자들에게 제공할 수 있고, 현재 유효선량피폭데이터를 기준치 이상일 경우에, 부저음을 통해 외부에 알림과 동시에, 기준치 이상의 현재 유효선량피폭데이터를 근거리의 스마트 디바이스 및 원거리의 중앙관리서버로 전송시킬 수 있어, 기존에 비해 방사선피폭사고를 80%이하로 낮출 수 있고, 무엇보다 환자와 방사선사의 건강을 모니터링하면서 스마트 원격관리해줄 수 있는 "SFT"형 DAP 계측기·유기섬광체형 방사선센서부로 이루어진 하이브리드형 스마트 방사선피폭 계측장치를 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Device for preventing deformation of spring seat for sprinkler head
title_ko: 스프링클러 헤드용 스프링시트 변형방지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for preventing deformation of a spring seat for a sprinkler head installed on a ceiling so as to scatter a fire-extinguishing liquid in four directions when a fire occurs such that it is possible to fundamentally prevent water leakage caused by deformation of the spring seat due to excessive fastening in the process of assembling the sprinkler head. To this end, the present invention is characterized in that, in connection with assembling a spring seat (3) in a concave groove (2c) formed on an orifice portion (2b) of a body (2) and pressurizing the spring seat (3) by the orifice portion (2b) such that the assembly load of the spring seat (3) is adjusted, the height (H) of the orifice portion of the body (2) is set to be larger than the height (h) from the upper surface of a deflector (20), the concave groove (2c) formed on the orifice portion (2b) has a depth (d) at which the maximum effective load of the spring seat (3) has a maximum value when the head (100) is assembled such that the bottom surface of an inner loading plate (9) abuts the bottom surface of the deflector (20), and an upward protruding ledge (9a) is formed on the upper surface of the inner loading plate (9) so as to have a size smaller than the inner diameter of a water discharge opening (2a) such that the upward protruding ledge (9a) is connected to the bottom surface of the deflector (20).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 천장에 설치되어 화재 발생 시 소화액을 사방으로 살수하는 스프링클러 헤드(sprinkler head)용 스프링시트 변형방지장치에 관한 것으로, 스프링클러의 헤드를 조립하는 과정에서 과잉 체결로 인해 스프링시트가 변형됨에 따른 누수현상을 근본적으로 해소할 수 있도록 한 것이다. 이를 위해, 본 발명은 바디(2)의 오리피스부(2b)에 형성된 요입홈(2c)에 스프링시트(3)를 조립하여 오리피스부(2b)에 의해 스프링시트(3)를 가압하여 스프링시트(3)의 조립하중을 조절하는 것에 있어서, 상기 바디(2)의 오리피스부 높이(H)를 디플렉터(20)의 상면으로부터의 높이(h)보다 높게 설정하고 오리피스부(2b)에 형성된 요입홈(2c)의 깊이(d)는 인너 로딩 플레이트(9)의 저면이 디플렉터(20)의 저면에 닿도록 헤드(100)를 조립하였을 때 스프링시트(3)의 최대유효하중이 최대치가 되는 깊이로 설정하며, 인너 로딩 플레이트(9)의 상면에 출수구(2a)의 내경보다 작은 크기로 상향돌출턱(9a)을 형성하여 상기 상향돌출턱(9a)이 디플렉터(20)의 저면에 접속되도록 한 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Landslide, avalanche precaution device installation method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to disaster alarm field, especially a kind of landslide, avalanche precaution device installation method.Step is as follows：A, massif is observed, selects easy slide strip that monitoring unit is installed；B, level land, build template by laying bricks or stones, pour out concrete casing, pre-buried installation foot, concrete casing is installed inner chamber carry out it is smooth；C, after after concrete casing completely solidification, level meter and signal projector are installed；D, according to the position of monitoring unit install signal in capstan head, capstan head in signal is covered all monitoring unit, after after all monitoring unit installations, communication connection set up between monitoring unit and warning center by capstan head in signal；E, the foundation communication connection between warning center and local household.By setting monitoring unit to send pre-warning signal by signal projector in massif danger zone, after warning center receives pre-warning signal, danger zone resident is directly notified by modes such as broadcast, bulk SMSs, helps resident to withdraw in time.

title_en: Providing status information for secondary devices with video footage from audio/video recording and communication devices
abstract_en: Systems and methods for communicating in a network using share signals in accordance with various embodiments of the present disclosure are provided. In one embodiment, a method for communicating in a network may include receiving, from a first client device, a share signal including image data captured by a camera of a first audio/video (A/V) recording and communication device; transmitting, to a second A/V recording and communication device, a secondary device state request signal; receiving, from the second A/V recording and communication device a secondary device update signal that includes a status of the at least one secondary device in network communication with the second A/V recording and communication device; and generating and transmitting an alert to a second client device associated with the second A/V recording and communication device, wherein the alert includes the image data and the status of the at least one secondary device.

title_en: A Closed wet sprinkler heads that can prevent damage due to shocks
title_ko: 충격파손 방지구를 구비한 폐쇄형 습식 스프링클러헤드
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a closed wet sprinkler head with an impact-breakage prevention device, preventing breakage due to an impact when a sprinkler head installed in an indoor golf training room is hit by a strong hitting ball of users, thereby preventing an undesired damage due to unexpectable spray of fire water. According to the present invention, the sprinkler head (A) comprises a frame assembly (1), a heat detection unit (2), and a spray unit (3). The frame assembly (1) includes: a frame (100); a circular frame fixation plate (200) formed with a circular steel plate of a ring shape wherein a central part is perforated, having a plurality of piece coupling holes (210) perforated along the ring shape, and coupling the frame (100) to a ceiling finishing material (C) through a shock absorption material (B) by a piece (230); an impact receiving member (300) formed based on a circular rubber plate with a predetermined thickness; a support bush (400); and a head protection device (500).

title_en: CAE mechanical simulation method based on BIM information model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a CAE mechanical simulation method based on a BIM information model, which comprises the steps of reconstructing a BIM building three-dimensional geometric model through a grid simplification system, and importing the simplified BIM three-dimensional model into a CAE mechanical simulation system; extracting data information in a BIM information model system, judging the attribute of the change information, transmitting data influencing the mechanical simulation to a CAE mechanical simulation system, and driving the CAE mechanical simulation system to update; and feeding back the mechanical information obtained by the updated CAE mechanical simulation model to the BIM information model, and displaying the calculated mechanical information from the BIM information model. When building designers design on the BIM by applying the method, the mechanical information can be referred to, the design efficiency is improved, in addition, the effective early warning can be carried out on the disasters caused by stress damage in the construction process in the later period, meanwhile, the repeated modeling is avoided, and the cost is saved.

title_en: System for providing one touch multi-type integrated broadcasting against fire and earthquake
title_ko: 화재 및 지진에 대비한 원터치 멀티타입 통합방송 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an one-touch multi-type integrated broadcasting system against a fire and an earthquake. The system can continuously perform broadcasting without any interruption even if some errors of hardware or software occur through integrated broadcasting control defined by the hardware and the software while performing integrated broadcasting by quickly and accurately designating in an one-touch operation a type and a range of broadcasting which provides information on an earthquake or a fire even if an emergency situation like the earthquake or the fire, can change configuration of an input/output port, and can perform the integrated broadcasting by being synchronized even if a plurality of users are interacted.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 및 지진에 대비한 원터치 멀티타입 통합방송 시스템에 관한 것으로, 지진이나 화재와 같이 긴급한 상황이 발생되는 경우 해당 지진이나 화재에 대한 정보를 제공할 방송의 타입과 범위를 원터치로 신속하고 정확하게 지정하여 통합방송을 수행하는 것이 가능하도록 하면서, 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어로 정의된 통합방송 제어를 통하여 하드웨어 또는 소프트웨어의 일부 오류가 발생하더라도 끊어짐이 없이 방송을 지속적으로 수행할 수 있고, 입출력포트의 구성을 실시간으로 변경할 수 있으며, 복수의 사용자가 인터랙션을 하더라도 동기화되어 통합방송이 가능하도록 한다.

title_en: Smart surfaces for visuo-haptic notifications
title_ko: 시각-촉각 알림을 위한 스마트 표면
abstract_en: Disclosed are examples of a device, a system, and a method for providing a visuo-haptic notification. In one example, a visuo-haptic notification is provided using a surface. A signal for causing an actuator to change a position of a notification unit on the surface from an original position to a notification position is generated and outputted to the actuator to provide the visuo-haptic notification. In some examples, the notification unit on the surface has a display. The display may be visible when the notification unit on the surface is in the notification position and may not be visible when the notification unit on the surface is in the original position. At least a part of the visuo-haptic notification may be provided on the display.
abstract_ko: 시각-촉각 알림을 제공하기 위한 장치, 시스템, 및 방법의 예가 개시된다.  일 예에서, 표면을 사용하여 시각-촉각 알림이 제공된다.  액추에이터로 하여금 상기 표면의 알림부의 위치를 원래 위치로부터 알림 위치로 변경하게 하기 위한 신호가 생성되어 액추에이터에 출력되어 상기 시각-촉각 알림을 제공한다.  일부 예에서, 상기 표면의 알림부는 디스플레이를 갖는다.  상기 디스플레이는 상기 표면의 알림부가 상기 알림 위치에 있을 때 보이고 상기 표면의 알림부가 상기 원래 위치에 있을 때 보이지 않을 수 있다.  상기 시각-촉각 알림의 적어도 일부가 상기 디스플레이 상에 제공될 수 있다.

title_en: Emergency responder routing system for cardiac emergencies
abstract_en: A method and system for locating a nearest available responder to an emergency event. The method comprises determining a location of an emergency event by a central dispatch server. At least one responder is then identified based on an at least one responder data, which includes location proximity data, traffic congestion data, and time availability data. Then, an emergency request and routing data is sent from the central dispatch server to the at least one identified responder. After receiving the emergency request and routing data, the acceptance signal of the at least one identified responder is transmitted to the central dispatch server. When the at least one identified responder arrives at the determined location of the emergency event, a confirmation alert from the at least one identified responder's portable device is received, and a cancellation alert is sent to one or more other responders.

title_en: A kind of flood warning information real-time publishing system
abstract_en: A kind of flood warning information real-time publishing system, it includes flood signal acquisition terminal, flood signal acquisition terminal includes controller, the input of controller and the output end of sensor assembly are connected, sensor assembly includes flow sensor, level sensor, flow sensor, and the data output of controller is connected with communication module, and communication module is connected with cloud platform input, cloud platform output end is connected with monitoring client, and the power end of controller is connected with power supply.The utility model can solve existing flood warning device information and update slower, and Flood Information, which is communicated to masses, needs longer time, it is possible to flood damage emergency response occur not in time, causes the problem of certain people, wealth lose.

title_en: Stage setting apparatus of motor control method
title_ko: 모터구동방식 무대장치의 부하량 변동 모니터링 및 비교 분석 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and a method for load fluctuation monitoring and comparative analysis for a motor-driven stage setting. According to the present invention, an algorithm is applied for constant motor load monitoring and comparative analysis in a motor-driven stage setting. As a result, pre-inspection and pre-repair can be performed for the stage setting, persons can be protected from an accident, inconvenience and performance cancelation attributable to sudden mechanical malfunction can be prevented, and a contribution can be made to a successful performance. The motor-driven stage setting management method of the present invention includes a step in which the presence or absence of a batten movement command is determined. In a case where the command is present, movement direction confirmation, position movement commanding, and remaining distance calculation are performed, and then it is determined whether or not the position of the moved batten is a specified position. In the case of the specified position, a temporary stop is performed and then the presence or absence of a batten movement command is determined again. According to the present invention, load monitoring starts at batten ascent or descent initiation and an average or maximum value is calculated and backed up. In a case where a value that exceeds a preset load rate is measured, a stage director or a stage setting manager is pre-notified of the fact so that regular inspection, emergency inspection, and forced stop can be performed in the case of mild, heavy, and serious warnings, respectively.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 모터구동방식 무대장치에서 항상 모터의 부하량을 모니터링 및 비교 분석하는 알고리즘을 적용하여 사전에 무대장치를 점검 및 정비를 유도함으로써 갑작스런 기계 고장으로 인한 불편과 공연의 취소, 안전사고 등으로부터 인명을 보호하고 성공적인 공연에도 기여할 수 있도록 한 모터구동방식 무대장치의 부하량 변동 모니터링 및 비교 분석 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 본 발명은  배튼의 이동지령 여부를 판단하여 배튼의 이동 지령이 있는 경우 이동방향 확인, 위치이동 지령 및 잔여 거리 연산을 실행한 후 이동한 배튼 위치가 규정위치인가 여부를 판단하여 규정위치이면 일단 정지한 후 배튼의 이동지령 여부를 재차 판단하는 단계를 포함하는 모터구동방식 무대장치의 관리방법에서, 배튼이 상승 또는 하강을 시작할 때부터 부하량을 모니터링하고 평균값 또는 최대값을 연산 및 백업하여 미리 설정된 부하율 보다 높은 값이 측정될 경우 무대 감독이나 무대장치 관리자에게 이 사실을 사전에 경고하여 경경고일 경우 정기점검의 유도를, 중경고일 경우는 긴급 점검의 유도를, 중대경고일 경우에는 강제정지를 실행하도록 이루어진 것이다.

title_en: Electric wire tray having alarm function of fire
title_ko: 화재경고기능을 구비한 공동주택용 배전선 설치트레이
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재경고기능을 구비한 공동주택용 배전선 설치트레이에 관한 것으로서, 사이드레일(11)과 렁(12)으로 구성된 메인바디(10)와: 베이스(21)와 연결구(22), 탄성바인더(23) 그리고 전선고정구(24)로 구성된 서브바디(20); 및 케이스(31)와 연기감지부(32), 열감지부(33), 제어부(34) 그리고 경보부(35)로 구성된 화재감지겸용 경보기(30)로 구성된다. 
본 실시 예에 의하면 천정을 따라 설치되어 전선을 쉽고 간편하게 고정할 수 있으면서도 인출되는 전선의 가설경로를 필요에 따라 쉽고 간편하게 변경할 수 있으며, 화재발생시 즉각적으로 감지 및 이를 주변으로 경고하여 실내에 있는 사람들이 신속하게 대피하도록 유도해 줌에 따라 화재에 따른 피해발생을 최소화할 수 있는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Gateway system of attachable type
title_ko: 탈부착형 게이트웨이 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a detachable gateway system. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the detachable gateway system includes: a worker terminal (100); a detachable gateway (200); and a manager terminal (300). The detachable gateway system enables a long-distance communication operation even in a closed workspace such as a manhole or the like. More specifically, the detachable gateway system can install detachably gateway units in each workspace path section to enable a worker to execute a long-distance communication operation to communicate with the outside in a relay hopping manner.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 탈부착형 게이트웨이 시스템은, 작업자가 휴대하며, 작업자 주변의 작업환경 정보를 수집하도록 변경 가능한 교체형으로써 가스감지, 온/습도 감지, 산소포화도 감지, 분진 감지와 같은 환경감지를 작업 환경에 따라 선택하는 센서(110)를 장착하고, 상기 센서(110)로부터 수집되는 데이터를 실시간으로 외부로 송출하는 무선통신 모듈(120)을 포함하는 작업자 단말기(100); 데이터 수신과 데이터 송출을 수행하는 무선통신 모듈(120)과, 자체적으로 전력을 공급하는 배터리(210)와, 부착 마운트(220)를 구비하여 다수가 작업장 경로마다 장착되고, 상기 작업자 단말기(100)에서 송출되는 데이터를 수신하여 각 경로에 위치한 다음 무선통신 모듈(120)로 데이터를 송출하는 탈착형 게이트 웨이(200); 상기 탈착형 게이트 웨이(200)에서 송출되는 데이터를 수신하고, 작업자의 현재 상황을 모니터링하는 관리자 단말기(300);를 포함하고, 상기 센서(110)는, 작업자 단말기(100)의 센서(110)에서 이상상황을 감지하는 이상상황 감지단계(S100); 상기 이상상황 감지단계(S100)에서 감지된 센싱 데이터를 관리자 단말기(300)로 송출하는 이상 데이터 관리자 단말기 송출단계(S200); 작업자 단말기(100)에서 작업자에게 경고음을 표출하는 작업자 경보단계(S300); 탈착형 게이트 웨이(200)가 발광하여 작업자의 탈출로를 확보하는 탈출로 안내단계(S400); 관리자 단말기(300)에서 현재 이상상황이 감지된 작업자 단말기(100) 의 위치와 근처의 작업자를 서칭하는 작업자 서칭단계(S500); 상기 작업자 서칭단계(S500) 후 서칭된 근처의 타 작업자 단말기(100)에 대피신호를 송출하는 주변 작업자 대피신호 송출단계(S600);를 포함하는 알고리즘을 가져, 수집되는 데이터에서 작업자의 안전을 보장할 수 없는 데이터가 센싱된 경우 처리되도록 하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System and method for preventing false alarm of fire detection device
title_ko: 화재 감지 장치의 오경보 방지를 위한 화재 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire detection system. More particularly, the present invention relates to a fire detection system for preventing a fire detection device from a false alarm by determining a situation as a fire even if the situation is not a real fire. The fire detection system is composed of a plurality of fire detection devices and an integrated controller wirelessly or wired connected to the fire detection device. Especially, the plurality of fire detection devices are installed in a space to have the same effective detection area, and the integrated controller waits for fire alarm execution during a predetermined time period (T1-T2) when a first fire detection signal is received from any one fire detection device of the plurality of fire detection devices, and executes a fire alarm when a second fire detection signal is received from the other fire detection apparatus within the predetermined time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 화재 감지 장치가 실제 화재가 아닌 경우에도 화재인 것으로 판단하여 오경보하는 것을 방지하기 위한 화재 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로, 복수의 화재 감지 장치 및 화재 감지 장치에 무선 또는 유선으로 연결된 통합 제어기로 이루어지고, 상기 복수의 화재 감지 장치의 오경보 방지를 위한 화재 감시 시스템이 제공된다. 특히 복수의 화재 감지 장치는 동일한 유효 감시 영역을 갖도록 공간 내에 설치되고, 통합 제어기는, 복수의 화재 감지 장치 중 어느 하나 화재 감지 장치로부터 제1 화재 감지 신호를 수신한 경우 미리정해진 시간 구간(T1~T2) 동안 화재 경보 실행을 대기하고, 상기 미리정해진 시간 내에 다른 하나의 화재 감지 장치로부터 제2 화재 감지 신호를 수신한 경우 화재 경보를 실행하도록 구성된다.

title_en: Information display system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To allow for reliable recognition of emergency information by a viewer.SOLUTION: An information display system includes an image mixer 5 provided for each television receiver 4, and connected in a free-communication state with a television broadcasting apparatus 2, an information providing server 3 and the television receiver 4, and a cancel button 6 connected in a free-communication state with the image mixer 5, and detecting a predetermined operation by a viewer. Upon receiving emergency information from the information providing server 3 while receiving a television video from the television broadcasting apparatus 2, the image mixer 5 transmits a synthesized image where a television video and emergency information are synthesized to the television receiver 4, and when the predetermined operation is detected by the cancel button 6 while displaying the synthesized image, the image mixer 5 cancels synthesized image display state and transmits a television video to the television receiver 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: System, method, and recording medium for geolocation data discovery in streaming texts
abstract_en: A geolocation data discovery method, system, and non-transitory computer readable medium, include mining a textual alert message of an event from secure source data for a geolocational indicator, a temporal indicator, and a type of alert, embedding a geolocational tag location and a temporal tag time to the event based on the geolocational indicator and the temporal indicator mined from the textual alert message by the secure text mining, mapping the event with an icon related to the type of alert at the geolocational tag location on a navigational map at a time associated with the temporal tag time of the event, learning a false-positive event by comparing a secure sensor with an unsecure sensor as the secure source data, and removing updates to the icon on the map based on the learned false-positive event.

title_en: Safety system of Cross walk
title_ko: 횡단보도 안전시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a crosswalk safety system which can: calculate a passage forecast time (T) by a calculated movement speed (WV) after calculating the movement speed (WV) of a pedestrian; solve problems in which a movement speed is excessively delayed while securing the safe passage of the pedestrian by determining a display period of a pedestrian signal according to the calculated passage forecast time (T); accurately detect a display period by corresponding to the movement speed (WV) of the pedestrian by calculating the movement speed (WV) and the passage forecast time (T) with components of an X-axis direction which is a longitudinal direction of a crosswalk after detecting a movement vector of the pedestrian; secure a safe passage of a new pedestrian while minimizing delay of a vehicle by resetting the display period by calculating a change forecast time (T) by multiplying the calculated passage forecast time (T) with a multiple which becomes lower according to the set number of the display period while resetting the display period when a new pedestrian is detected after setting the display period of the pedestrian signal; and completely prevent an accident in advance by being formed to display warning data when the movement of a vehicle stopping on a stop line is sensed when a pedestrian signal is turned on or a vehicle violating a speed limit is sensed by being formed to sense a vehicle in real time. The crosswalk safety system includes: a crosswalk traffic light; a pedestrian detecting radar which senses a waiting area (S1) formed in a crosswalk or in both sides of the crosswalk; a vehicle detecting radar which senses a vehicle; and a traffic signal controller.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 보행자의 이동속도(WV)를 산출한 후 산출된 이동속도(WV)에 따라 통행예측시간(T)을 산출하며, 산출된 통행예측시간(T)에 따라 보행자신호의 현시주기를 결정함으로써 보행자의 안전한 통행을 보장함과 동시에 이동속도가 과도하게 지체되는 문제점을 해결할 수 있으며, 보행자의 움직임벡터를 검출한 후 횡단보도의 길이 방향인 X축 방향의 성분을 가지고 이동속도(WV) 및 통행예측시간(T)을 산출함으로써 보행자의 이동속도(WV)에 대응하여 현시주기를 더욱 정확하게 검출할 수 있고, 보행자신호의 현시주기를 설정한 이후, 신규보행자가 감지되는 경우 현시주기를 재설정하되, 현시주기의 설정 회수에 따라 낮아지는 배수를 산출된 통행예측시간(T)에 곱하여 변경예측시간(T`)을 산출하여 현시주기를 재설정함으로써 차량의 지체를 최소화하면서 신규보행자의 안전한 통행을 보장할 수 있으며, 실시간으로 차량을 감지하도록 구성되어 제한속도를 위반한 차량이 감지되거나 또는 보행자신호 점등 시 정지선에 정차 중인 차량의 움직임이 감지되는 경우 경고데이터를 표출하도록 구성됨으로써 안전사고를 사전에 철저하게 방지할 수 있는 횡단보도 안전시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Short message communication within a mobile graphical map
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a computer-implemented process is programmed or configured to allow a first mobile device to generate and send enriched pin data to a geographical messaging system. Enriched pin data may include latitude and longitude data, a timestamp, and a media element. Media elements may include image data, video data, text data, drawing data that defines a geographic location, route data that defines a geographic travel path, and/or pin expiration data. The geographical messaging system may then broadcast the enriched pin data to a second mobile device belonging to a team member in the same geographical region as the first mobile device. The second mobile device may then use the enriched pin data to display, on a geographical map, a map pin that corresponds to the enriched pin data. In one embodiment, the second mobile device may also use the enriched pin data to display, in a message chain, a message related to the enriched pin data.

title_en: Wired and wireless voice guiding terminal with multiple sensor and method for emergency message transmitting
title_ko: 유무선 음성안내 복합센서 단말기 및 이를 이용한 비상대피 음성안내 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wired and wireless voice guide terminal with a composite sensor and a voice guide method for emergency evacuation using the same, which can automatically select and play a voice file in adaptation to current locations and situations or can select and play the voice file from the outside based on detection information including a body detection sensor, a temperature and humidity sensor, a gas sensor, a smoke sensor, etc. The wired and wireless voice guide terminal of the present invention comprises: a sensor detection unit selectively including the body detection sensor, the smoke sensor, the gas sensor, and the temperature and humidity sensor, etc.; a voice file storage unit having a USB or an SD memory which can store a plurality of voice files and music files such as an MP3 or the like; a voice output unit including a speaker, an amplifier, and an MP3 play circuit; a wired and wireless communication unit connecting to an external server to transmit and receive data; and a microprocessor connected to the sensor detection unit to convert a sensor detection value into a digital value and transmit the same to an external server through the wired and wireless communication unit, receiving an external server command through the wired and wireless communication unit to select the voice files of the voice file storage unit, transmitting a command to play the voice files through the voice output unit, and renewing the MP3 files of the voice file storage unit with MP3 files provided from the external server through the wired and wireless communication unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인체감지센서, 연기센서, 가스센서, 온습도센서 등으로 선택 구성되는 센서 감지부와 MP3 등의 복수의 음성 파일, 음악 파일을 저장할 수 있는 USB 또는 SD 메모리로 구성되는 음성 파일 저장부, 스피커와 앰프, MP3 플레이 회로로 구성되는 음성 출력부, 외부 서버에 연결하여 데이터를 송수신할 수 있는 유무선 통신부, 상기 센서 감지부와 연결되어 센서 감지값을 디지털 값으로 변환하여 유무선 통신부를 통하여 외부 서버로 전송하고, 유무선 통신부를 통하여 외부 서버 명령을 수신하여 음성 파일 저장부의 음성 파일을 선택하고, 음성출력부를 통하여 재생할 수 있도록 명령을 송신하고, 유무선 통신부를 통하여 외부 서버에서 제공하는 MP3파일로 음성 파일 저장부의 MP3 파일을 갱신할 수 있는 마이크로프로세서로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 유무선 음성안내 복합센서 단말기와 이를 이용한 비상대피 음성안내 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System and method for managing mobile device alerts based on user activity
abstract_en: A system and method for managing alerts of a mobile communications device is provided. The system includes the device, a processor, and a sensor for monitoring activity of a user and generating sensor data indicative of the activity. The processor is configured for processing the sensor data to determine a current activity of the user; detecting an alert corresponding to an incoming communication; classifying the alert as being immediate or deferred based at least in part on the current activity. If the alert is immediate, the processor is configured to announce the alert without delay; otherwise, the processor is configured to announce the alert after a delay. The delay can terminate when a holdback timer expires or the current activity changes to an activity that indicates that the user can be notified.

title_en: Managing evacuation of a building in real time
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an evacuation management system, EMS, (40, 52, 60, 100, 200) operative to provide real-time evacuation information for evacuation of a building triggered (S202) by an alarm notification, based on determining (S214) the precise real-time location of a personal ultra-wideband UWB device, as determined by a UWB real-time location system, RT L S, a controller determines (S210) a real-time evacuation plan specific to the personal UWB device, based on the individual evacuation plan and input from the building facility, defines (S208) and sends to each personal UWB device real-time guidance information providing to the person carrying the personal UWB device which direction to move to reach a guided safe area (S212). then, based on the location signal, UWB RT L SA calculates the updated location of the personal device and sends it to the evacuation management system.

title_en: Device, system and method for crowd control
abstract_en: A device, system and method for crowd control is provided. An aural command is detected at a location using a microphone at the location. A computing device determines, based on video data received from one or more multimedia devices, whether one or more persons at the location are not following the aural command. The computing device modifies the aural command to generate a second version of the aural command based on one or more of the video data and multimedia data associated with the location. The computing device causes the second version of the aural command to be provided, to the one or more persons who are not following the aural command at the location, using one or more notification devices.

title_en: A risk information spread method for guranteeing reliable emergency service
title_ko: 비상 서비스의 신뢰성을 보장하는 비상 정보 확산 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to efficiently support a risk information push service in a mobile device which has difficulties like unexpected delays and acknowledgment. According to the present invention, provided is an emergency information spreading method using an information spreading system which comprises: a risk sensing device which is installed in a place where disasters are expected; an application server of a push message providing side which receives event information from the risk sensing device and generates a push message based on the event information; a push server which is connected to the application server via a network; and a plurality of user terminals which are connected to the push server via a network, and comprise a wired or a wireless device. The method comprises the steps of: registering the plurality of user terminals which want to receive a push notification to the push server; the application server receiving the event information detected from the risk sensing device; the application server generating a push message to transmit the same to the push server; and the push server transmitting the push message to the registered user terminals.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재해 발생 가능성이 있는 장소에 설치되는 위험 감지 장치, 위험 감지 장치로부터 이벤트 정보를 수신하고 이벤트 정보에 근거하여 푸쉬 메시지를 생성하는 푸쉬 메시지 제공측의 어플리케이션 서버, 어플리케이션 서버와 네트워크를 통해 결합되는 푸쉬 서버, 및 푸쉬 서버와 네트워크를 통해 연결되고 유선 또는 무선 장치로 이루어진 복수의 사용자측 단말을 포함하는 정보 확산 시스템을 이용하여 비상 정보를 확산하는 방법이 제공되고, 이 방법은, 푸쉬 알림을 받고자하는 복수의 사용자측 단말을 푸쉬 서버에 등록하는 단계; 상기 어플리케이션 서버가 위험 감지장치로부터 검출된 이벤트 정보를 수신하는 단계; 상기 어플리케이션 서버가 푸쉬 서버로 푸쉬 메시지를 생성하여 전송하는 단계; 및 푸쉬 서버에서 등록된 복수의 사용자측 단말에 푸쉬 메시지를 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: The APP for Smart-Phone that have the function for the emergency rescue request and the emergency warning
title_ko: 긴급구조요청 및 긴급경보기능을 가진 스마트폰 앱의 구성
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a configuration of an application for a smartphone having a function for emergency rescue requesting and emergency alerting, which automatically activate an alerting siren, a warning lamp screen, and an emergency rescue requesting voice function when a user feels a risk and simultaneously touches an emergency rescue request application for three seconds when a robber, kidnapper, sex offender or the like approaches the user in a secluded alley or a dark place. According to the present invention, when an SOS icon installed on a locked screen is immediately touched for 3 to 5 seconds when the user faces a robber, kidnapper, sex offender or the like, the alarm siren, warning light screen, and urgent emergency rescue voice are automatically activated to notify that the user is in a dangerous situation, thereby obtaining help from other persons near the user. In addition, the alarm siren, warning light screen, and urgent emergency rescue voice are automatically activated such that a perpetrator shrinks psychologically and stops committing the crime or escapes the area, thereby providing the user with a measure of safety.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 후미진 골목이나 으슥한 장소에서 강도나 유괴범 또는 성폭행범등이 접근할 경우 위협을 느낌과 동시에 긴급구조요청앱인 3초간 누르게 되면 자동으로 경보싸이렌 및 경광등화면 및 긴급긴급구조요청음성 기능이 작동되는 긴급구조요청 및 긴급경보기능을 가진 스마트폰 앱의 구성에 관한 것이다

; 상기의 스마트폰(1)의 잠금화면(100)상에 SOS아이콘(101)을 3~5초간 누름과 동시에 잠금화면(100)이 경광등화면(101b)으로 전환되는 구성을 가지는 것이 특징인 단계와 ; 상기 경광등화면(101b)상에서는 적색램프(201) 와 청색램프(202)가 반복적으로 점멸을 반복하는 구성을 가지는 것이 특징인 것과,
