title_en: Systems and methods for managing service log information
abstract_en: Methods and systems for processing insurance policies associated with properties may be provided. A home may be populated with smart devices that are connected to, or in communication with, a central (or “smart home”) controller, such as via wired or wireless communication. The smart devices are covered by an insurance policy, such as homeowners, renters, or personal articles insurance. The central controller may receive, with customer permission, service log information for the devices, and update an inventory list to include the service log information. The controller may detect that a smart device has been repaired, and then generate and transmit a notification to the customer. In some cases, the notification may prompt the customer to schedule a future repair event. The smart devices may be associated with appliances, electronics, computers, televisions, jewelry, vehicles, furniture, or other personal belongings. Insurance discounts may be provided based upon the service log/maintenance functionality.

abstract_en: The present invention provides a method and system for early warning device abnormality including decisions of device importance and warning validity. title_en: Warning of spectrum access revocation
abstract_en: Various communication systems may benefit from improved signaling. For example, certain communication systems may benefit from improved signaling before network access is revoked through a citizens broadband radio service. A method may include receiving at a network entity from a citizens broadband radio service device a warning message. The warning message may include a drop time after which communication between a network and a user equipment using the citizens broadband radio service will terminate. The method may also include triggering the performing of an action based on the warning message by the network before the drop time.

title_en: Safety detector and system for multi dwelling units and the like
abstract_en: An alarm system for detecting alarm conditions in a security group with a plurality of security zones. Such a system may include a plurality of sensor units each with at least one sensor, a first communication interface for broadcasting messages to other sensor units and a second communication interface for transmitting data packets over a computer network. A back end server is connected to a computer network. Each sensor unit is configured to, upon detection of an alarm condition, generate an alarm message, broadcast the alarm message over the first communication interface and transmit the alarm message over the second communication interface addressed to the back end server. The sensor units, upon receipt of an alarm message, rebroadcast the received alarm message over the first communication interface and transmit the alarm message over the second communication interface addressed to the back end server The back end server is configured to, upon receipt of an alarm message, update a list of alarm messages and retransmit the received alarm message to the plurality of sensor units.

title_en: Method, system, and device for protecting vehicle occupants
abstract_en: A system, method, and device for protecting a vehicle occupant over a computerized network. There is an electronic seat pad with an occupant sensor, a driver sensor control module that detects proximity a driver's portable electronic computing device relative to the vehicle; and a key-location sensor that detects proximity of a vehicle key to the vehicle. There is a system management module that determines alert statuses and sends alert and safety notifications to a remote notification device, which automatically registers an alert if a threshold level of safety notifications are not received. title_en: System for capsize warning of ship

abstract_en: The present invention relates to an overturn warning system (1000) for vessels. According to the present invention, the system (1000) includes: an information collecting part (100) pre-storing vessel specification information; 6-degrees-of-freedom movement information of a vessel from a frequency area and a time area; an overturn predicting part (300) predicting an overturn of the vessel by consecutively updating the 6-degrees-of-freedom movement information to overturn warning algorithm; and a distress signal generating part (400) generating a distress signal for dispatch to the scene of the accident when the overturn predicting part (300) determines that the vessel is overturned. As such, the present invention is capable of making a warning for danger and automatically transmitting a distress signal by predicting an overturn of a vessel losing its stability, thereby minimizing marine accidents and damage to people.

title_en: A Dual Preamble Random Access Protocol for Reducing Access Congestion in Disaster Situations
title_ko: 재난상황에서 액세스 혼잡을 줄이기 위한 듀얼 프리앰블 랜덤 액세스방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dual preamble random access method for reducing access congestion in disaster situations in which a terminal (UE) can increase the number of logically possible preambles by transmitting two different preambles to a base station (eNB), thereby reducing the collision probability and access delay between the terminals (UEs). The dual preamble random access method for reducing access congestion in disaster situations comprises the steps of: constructing a valid preamble pair by a terminal to transmit the pair to a base station; calculating, by the base station, an optimal ACB parameter on the basis of the number of terminals successfully accessed and the number of unnecessary response messages; generating a response message including the optimal ACB parameter calculated by the base station and broadcasting the response message to the terminal; requesting a connection by using resource allocation information included in the response message in the terminal that has received the response message; and when receiving a connection request message transmitted from the terminal by the base station, transmitting a connection completion message to the terminal.
abstract_ko: 단말기(UE)가 서로 다른 두 개의 프리앰블(preamble)을 동시에 기지국(eNB)으로 전송하여 논리적으로 가능한 프리앰블의 수를 늘리고, 이를 통해 단말기 간의 충돌 확률과 접속 지연을 줄일 수 있도록 한 재난상황에서 액세스 혼잡을 줄이기 위한 듀얼 프리앰블 랜덤 액세스방법에 관한 것으로서, 단말기에서 유효한 프리앰블 쌍을 구성하여 기지국에 전송하는 단계, 기지국에서 접속에 성공한 단말기 수와 불필요한 응답 메시지 수를 고려하여 최적의 ACB 파라미터를 산출하는 단계, 기지국에서 산출한 최적의 ACB 파라미터를 포함한 응답 메시지를 생성하여 단말기로 방송하는 단계, 응답 메시지를 수신한 단말기에서 응답 메시지에 포함된 자원 할당 정보를 이용해 연결을 요청하는 단계 및 기지국에서 단말기로부터 전송된 연결 요청 메시지를 수신하면 연결 완료 메시지를 상기 단말기로 전송하는 단계를 포함하여, 재난상황에서 액세스 혼잡을 줄이기 위한 듀얼 프리앰블 랜덤 액세스방법을 구현한다.

title_en: safety home using a location-based service applications
title_ko: 위치기반 서비스를 이용한 안심귀가 어플리케이션
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety home return application using a location-based service, capable of solving problems, caused when there is not any solution to a danger signal delivery button malfunctioning in case of an emergency, by reporting the emergency to a desired contact through a wrong route display function even without pressing an emergency reporting button. According to the present invention, the safety home return application includes: an address book setting button formed as an UI button to set contacts to report an emergency; a service on/off button formed as an UI button to start and terminate the service; a route changing button formed as a UI button to change a route as a user wants; a home button formed as a physical button to send a danger signal by being consecutively pressed; a destination setting function formed by a touch to set a destination; a route mark formed on a map to indicate a red route on the map; a wrong route mark formed on the map and generated to deliver a dangerous situation and a current position to the address book in case of entering a wrong route; a departure setting function formed by a touch to set a desired departure spot; and a GPS display window located on the top of the screen to check whether GPS is on/off. As such, the present invention is capable of solving problems, caused when there is not any solution to a danger signal delivery button malfunctioning in case of an emergency, by reporting the emergency to a desired contact through a wrong route display function even without pressing an emergency reporting button.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 위치기반 서비스를 이용한 안심귀가 어플리케이션에 관한 것으로서 경로 이탈 표시기능을 통하여 경로가 이탈 되었을 경우 긴급 알림 버튼을 누르지 않아도 원하는 연락처로 긴급 상황을 전달 할 수 있게 하도록 함으로써 기존의 위험 신호 전달 버튼이 눌러지지 않는다면 위급시 대처 방법이 없는  문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 안심귀가 서비스 어플리케이션에 있어서 위험 상황 발생시 알림을 해줄 대상들의 연락처를 설정할 수 있게 UI 버튼으로 형성한 주소록 설정 버튼, 서비스를 시작 종료 할 수 있게 UI 버튼으로 형성한 서비스 on/off 버튼, 경로를 원하는대로 변경 할 수 있게 UI 버튼으로 형성한 경로변경 버튼, 연속으로 홈버튼을 눌러 위험 신호를 보낼 수 있게 물리 버튼으로 형성한 홈 버튼, 도착지를 설정 할 수 있게 터치를 통해 형성한 도착지 설정 기능, 지도상에 붉은색을 경로를 표시할 수 있게 지도위에 형성한 경로 표시, 경로 이탈시 저장된 주소록으로 현재 위치와 위험 상황을 전달할 수 있게 이탈시 생성, 지도위에 형성한 경로 이탈 표시, 원하는 출발지를 설정할 수 있게 터치를 통해 형성한 출발지 설정 기능, GPS가 on/off인지 확인 할 수 있게 화면 최상단에 위치한 GPS 표시창으로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 경로 이탈 표시기능을 통하여 경로가 이탈 되었을 경우 긴급 알림 버튼을 누르지 않아도 원하는 연락처로 긴급 상황을 전달 할 수 있게 하도록 함으로써 기존의 위험 신호 전달 버튼이 눌러지지 않는다면 위급시 대처 방법이 없는  문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses the one-touch remote emergency warning device of public security bureau, belong to warning device field.The one-touch remote emergency warning device of public security bureau; including column of alarming; one-touch alarm keys and processor are connected with the alarm column; and one-touch alarm keys are electrically connected with the processor, the processor is electrical connected with remote supervisory and control(ling) equipment, and shock sensor is connected with the alarm column; the shock sensor is electrically connected with the processor; the alarm column is inserted in cement substrate, and protector corresponding with alarm column is offered in the cement substrate, and the alarm column upper end is fixedly connected with sealing plate.It, which can realize to work as, has criminal to tap alarm column; shock sensor sensing vibrations; so as to which fluid pressure drive device withdraws support plate by hydraulic push rod; alarm column falls into protector; and sealing plate sealing protector; effectively prevent criminal to tap, smash warning device, be effectively protected alarm column.

title_en: The cable machine cage for merging D-GPS and RFID causes calamity method for prewarning risk
abstract_en: The cable machine cage for merging D GPS and RFID causes calamity method for prewarning risk, includes the following steps：Judge region residing for construction personnel with prior-warning device, when worker is located in dangerous region, carry out phonetic warning；Real-time spatial position coordinate (the X of measuring cable machine cage 1 , Y 1 , Z 1 ), speed of service v and worker spatial position coordinate (X 2 , Y 2 , Z 2 ), compare the horizontal displacement between cable machine cage and worker and cable machine cage object strike influence area, take the form apart from early warning, early warning is carried out to construction personnel；When worker enters in cable machine cage object strike influence area, buzzer warning is carried out, until worker is withdrawn to safety zone.The method of the present invention calculates the influence area of cable machine cage object strike by location technology, effectively reduces Steric clashes and causes calamity risk, improves operating personnel's safety in work progress.

title_en: Incident Broadcast Retransmission in a Vehicular Network
abstract_en: A system for transmission of incident information includes maintaining a table of RSSI values for a plurality of stations. When an incident is detected, the system first sends a broadcast packet with incident information, and next sends a unicast packet to any station below a particular RSSI threshold until the unicast packet is acknowledged or a retransmission interval passes.

title_en: A kind of medical crutch with warning function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of medical crutchs with warning function, including cane head and cane leg, range sensor and control button area are provided on cane leg, cane leg is internally provided with GPS positioning module, control chip and power supply, GPS positioning module connect to realize data transmission and communication with control chip, chip is controlled by wirelessly being connect with PC/ mobile monitorings end, the control chip is connect respectively with power supply, control button area and range sensor.There are certain distances with ground for range sensor under normal circumstances, when there are emergency situations in the person that holds crutch, crutch was dropped in ground moment, range sensor and ground reduce apart from moment, this situation is transferred to control chip by range sensor, at this point, control chip will alarm to PC or mobile monitoring end and the location information for the person that sends crutch.The utility model can realize automatic alarm, manual alarm and cancel the function of alarming and transmit patient or old man present position；It is alternatively arranged as infusion support use.

title_en: A kind of side slope real-time stability monitoring and warning system based on rainfall
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of side slope real-time stability monitoring and warning systems based on rainfall, module, rainfall infiltration model building module and controller are established including data acquisition module, static flow model in porous media, data acquisition module is used for soil strength parameter and soil body penetration parameter；Data acquisition module is additionally operable to obtain the displacement variable of ground at each coordinate after different rainfalls；Static flow model in porous media establishes module for establishing the static flow model in porous media of side slope according to the soil strength parameter and soil body penetration parameter of ground at each coordinate；Rainfall infiltration model building module is used for the parameter in the static flow model in porous media of displacement variable update according to ground at each coordinate after different rainfalls, to obtain rainfall infiltration model；Controller is used to calculate the stationary value of the ground after rainfall, and the alert when stationary value is more than pre-determined stability value.The all sequencing of all modeling process, easy to operation and programming greatly reduced artificial calculation amount, and prediction result is more reliable by the present invention.

title_en: Server, vehicle terminal and method for providing emergency notification

title_en: A kind of earthquake alarm system and its device based on wireless internet of things

title_en: Disaster control communication system
title_ko: 재난발생 자동 검지 및 피난 관제 통신 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic disaster occurrence detection and evacuation control communication system. The automatic disaster occurrence detection and evacuation control communication system can detect disasters through double tracks between fire receivers and fire detectors, analyze the communication traffic in a disaster site, and guide a user through an evacuation route. According to the present invention, the automatic disaster occurrence detection and evacuation control communication system includes: multiple fire detectors which are installed in a building in a distributed manner to detect a fire on the site; multiple evacuation lamps being installed in the site to display the evacuation route; multiple CCTVs which are installed on the site to record the disaster situation and transmit the recording to a remote location; the fire receivers which can detect the location of the fire and report and initiate an alarm indicating the occurrence of a fire when the fire detectors sense the fire; on-site control terminals which operate the corresponding CCTVs to receive the on-site images and transmit the on-site images to the disaster control server in the remote location upon receiving the indication that a fire has occurred from the fire receivers as well as controlling the evacuation guide lamps in accordance with preset scenarios to guide the evacuation path; and the disaster control server which analyzes the traffic in the corresponding area to determine the validity of the disaster while storing the received disaster images to a database upon receiving the disaster information from the on-site control terminals as well as transmitting the disaster text to the mobile phones in the corresponding area. The automatic disaster occurrence detection and evacuation control communication system can sense the disaster precisely through the redundant tracks between the fire receivers and fire detectors as well as analyzing the communication traffic in the disaster site to prevent false alarms, thereby responding to disasters quickly.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재수신기와 화재감지기 사이의 이중화된 선로를 통해 재난을 감지하고 재난 현장의 통신 트래픽을 분석하여 신속하게 피난 경로를 안내할 수 있는 재난발생 자동검지 및 피난 관제 통신 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 시스템은, 건물에 분산설치되어 현장의 화재를 감지하기 위한 복수의 화재 감지기; 현장에 설치되어 피난 경로를 표시하는 복수의 피난 유도등; 현장에 설치되어 재난상황을 촬영하여 원격지로 전송하기 위한 복수의 CCTV; 상기 화재 감지기로부터 화재가 감지되면, 화재 위치를 판별하여 화재발생을 보고하고 경보하는 화재 수신기; 상기 화재 수신기로부터 화재발생을 수신하면, 해당 CCTV를 작동시켜 현장 영상을 수신받아 원격지의 재난 관제 서버로 전송하고, 미리 설정된 시나리오에 따라 상기 피난 유도등을 제어하여 피난 경로를 안내하는 현장 관제 단말; 및 상기 현장 관제 단말로부터 재난정보가 수신되면, 해당 지역의 트래픽을 분석하여 재난 허위 여부를 판단함과 아울러 수신된 재난 영상을 데이터베이스에 저장하고, 해당 지역의 휴대폰으로 재난문자를 전송하는 재난 관제 서버로 구성된다. 본 발명에 따르면, 화재수신기와 화재 감지기 사이의 이중화된 선로를 통해 재난을 정확하게 감지하고, 재난 현장의 통신 트래픽을 분석하여 오 경보를 방지함으로써 재난에 신속하게 대응할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Elevator rescue method based on user calling, elevator rescue device and intelligent equipment
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of communication, and provides an elevator rescue method based on user calling, an elevator rescue device and intelligent equipment, wherein the elevator rescue method based on user calling comprises the following steps: detecting whether an emergency rescue call button in an elevator is triggered; when detecting that an emergency rescue call button in the elevator is triggered, judging whether the emergency rescue call button is triggered by mistake; if the trigger is false trigger, sending a prompt to an emergency rescue center, and canceling a rescue instruction; and if the trigger is not false trigger, sending a maintenance rescue notification to an intelligent terminal of the maintenance personnel, and notifying the maintenance personnel to carry out rescue. By the method, the response speed of the emergency rescue call can be greatly improved, and the maintenance rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: System for controlling signal lamp and the method thereof
title_ko: 교통신호등 제어 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a traffic light control system and a method thereof. The traffic light control system which allows a connection between a mobile device of a vehicle in which an emergency has occurred and a traffic light controller, comprises: a mobile device for receiving an emergency notification message and destination information from a user through an application; a traffic control application server for setting a current location of the mobile device as a starting point when the emergency notification message is received from the mobile device, and relaying a connection between a traffic light controller located within a predetermined distance from the starting point and the mobile device; and a traffic light controller for changing a mode into a traffic signal control mode for supporting a movement of the vehicle in which an emergency has occurred when connected to the mobile device through the traffic control application server. Therefore, an emergency response time of a vehicle in case of emergency can be shortened by controlling a traffic signal to a destination using a smartphone application.
abstract_ko: 교통신호등 제어 시스템 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 교통신호등 제어시스템은 응급상황이 발생한 차량의 모바일 기기와 신호등 제어기 사이의 접속을 허가하는 교통신호등 제어 시스템으로서, 어플리케이션을 통해 사용자로부터 응급상황알림 메시지와 목적지정보를 입력받는 모바일기기, 모바일기기로부터 응급상황알림 메시지가 입력되면, 해당 모바일기기의 현재위치를 출발지로 설정하고, 출발지로부터 소정 거리 내에 위치한 신호등 제어기와 해당 모바일 기기 사이의 접속을 중계하는 교통제어 앱서버 및 교통제어 앱서버를 통해 모바일 기기와 접속되면, 응급상황이 발생한 차량의 이동을 지원하기 위한 교통신호 제어모드로 변경하는 신호등 제어기를 포함한다. 따라서, 스마트폰 어플리케이션을 이용하여 목적지까지 교통신호 제어를 통해 응급상황시 차량의 응급출동시간을 단축시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Method for calculating rip current warning index and apparatus thereof, computer program
title_ko: 이안류 경보 지수 산출 방법 및 장치, 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method, a device, and a computer program to calculate an offshore current warning index. The method includes: a step in which a nearshore current vector data generating part generates nearshore current vector data, which is a group of vectors having a flow direction and flowrate of a preset position on the target sea as components, by using wave prediction information of the target sea, which is an offshore current warning target, and a preset numerical simulation model; a step in which an effective vector extracting part extracts an effective vector satisfying a preset shore area condition from the generated nearshore current vector data; a step in which a vector diagram generating part generates a vector diagram indicating flowrate information by flow direction by using the extracted effective vector; and a step in which a velocity radius index calculating part calculates a velocity radius index, which becomes nearshore current generation determination criteria, based on each flow direction component of the effective vector and the flowrate information determined through the vector diagram. As such, the present invention is capable of practically preventing casualties caused by offshore currents.

title_en: Autonomous, solar-powered, vessel tracking and safety beacon devices and methods thereof
abstract_en: An autonomous, solar-powered, vessel tracking and safety beacon device includes a global positioning system coupled to at least a solar power system, one or more communication systems coupled to the solar power system, and a vessel tracking and safety beacon microcontroller system. The microcontroller system is coupled to the global positioning system, the one or more communication systems, and the solar power system. The microcontroller system comprises a memory coupled to a processor which is configured to be capable of executing programmed instructions comprising and stored in the memory to provide vessel location information from the global positioning system, detect when an emergency alert has been activated, determine based on the vessel location information from the global positioning system, and transmit the emergency alert, and other messages, such as text messages, email, weather updates, revisions to geo-zones, or notifications of nearby mariners in distress, using the determined one of the one or more communication systems.

title_en: City VANET multi-hop broadcasting method based on competition and finite state machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a competition and finite state machine based urban VANET multi-hop broadcasting method, wherein the state of each node comprises the following steps: n is a message which is not received; p is a possible received message; and R is the confirmed received message. A source node which learns the emergency constructs an emergency message with a sending node list and broadcasts the emergency message, and the state of the source node is set as R; if the state of the neighbor node is N, the state is changed to P; the node receiving the emergency message finds the message sending node and the nodes in the sending node list contained in the message in the local neighbor table, and if the nodes exist, the states of the nodes are set to be R. The receivers then calculate their own latencies based on the relative distances to the last hop node, the quality of the communication, etc. The node whose waiting time is first ended updates the urgent message and broadcasts it, and the new message can be regarded as an implicit ACK. If there is a neighbor with a state other than R, the sender will retransmit overtime. The invention is suitable for various network topologies, and ensures the real-time reliable transmission of the emergency message in the whole network.

title_en: Moving Robot and controlling method
title_ko: 이동 로봇 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile robot and a mobile robot control method. The mobile robot monitors a cleaning region by capturing an image while moving in a plurality of regions based on a map of the cleaning region. With the present invention, monitoring can be performed with a plurality of regions or a specific region designated. It is possible to monitor the entire region by capturing an image while rotating at a monitoring position by designating the monitoring position in the region. It is possible to set a specific position as the monitoring position in the region and perform imaging at a specific imaging angle with a monitoring direction designated at the monitoring position. Monitoring can be performed on a plurality of regions with a minimum movement. It is possible to capture an image of a blind spot by changing or adding the monitoring position based on obstacle information, and thus effective monitoring can be performed. A schedule can be set for monitoring at a specified time, and intrusion can be detected based on image analysis-based obstacle recognition. In the event of intrusion, a warning is output and an intrusion detection signal is transmitted, and thus security can be enhanced.

title_en: System and method for real-time classification of notams messages
abstract_en: Methods and systems are provided for classifying notice to airmen (NOTAM) alerts to a pilot of an aircraft. First, bundled NOTAMs are received during the flight planning process for the aircraft. A domain rules set for a filter engine on board the aircraft is created that prioritizes the bundled NOTAMs based on their criticality. The domain rules set is updated with weather data and day/night visibility analysis. The prioritized critical NOTAMs are stored on board in an electronic database and retrieved during the relevant phase of the flight path of the aircraft. The NOTAM messages are then displayed to the pilot on a graphical display device on board the aircraft.

title_en: Electronic Vehicle Tag Collection System
abstract_en: An electronic vehicle tag collection system that provides a decal chip for a motor vehicle license plate registration tag that stores information of the registered motor vehicle and the owner and has notification and calling capabilities to activate itself and provide location of the vehicle. assignees: BEIJING ZIGUANG XINRUI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of light rail train beam wind information collection and method for early warning and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of light rail beam wind information collection and early warning system, including the acquisition device for beam wind information, current signal/numerical signal conversion device, device, the device for controlling train speed for generating dynamic beam wind calamity source reference threshold, storage device and control device, core of the control module as whole system, on the one hand the operation of aforementioned each device is controlled, on the other hand for being attached realization communication and control with external equipments such as external computer installations.In the present invention, reference threshold for the assessment of beam wind calamity source is using dynamic generation by the way of, and in conjunction with the disaster of history, a situation arises, and is continuously updated account of the history after newest early warning occurs, to compare with historical data, the risk Pre-Evaluation in a certain area is more improved and scientifically considered.The present invention also provides a kind of light railway beam wind information collection and method for early warning.

title_en: Security alarm and bootstrap technique
abstract_en: The present invention relates to technical field of safety protection, in order to solve in existing safety alarm system, lead to congestion since the personnel of the same area are concentrated in an exit passageway when withdrawing to reduce the problem of withdrawing speed, provide a kind of security alarm and bootstrap technique, including alarming step and green indicating lamp directing step；Alarming step：When alert occurs, alert inductive signal is sent control module by the first induction module of alert sub-system, and the alarm module of control module control alert sub-system is alarmed；Wherein, green indicating lamp directing step is：When a certain second induction module of alert sub-system senses a certain exit passageway congestion, the congestion signal is sent to control module, the luminance adjustment module movement of control module control guidance subsystem, reduces the brightness of the green indicating lamp in the exit passageway by luminance adjustment module；The optical filtering part worn in guidance subsystem for personnel can mask the green indicating lamp other than particular color.
assignees: GUIZHOU RENHUAI XIKE COMPUTER TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of subway seismic data information collection and method for early warning and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of subway seismic data information collection and method for early warning and system, including seismic wave information collecting device, current signal/numerical signal conversion equipment, for the device of reference threshold, the determination device of early warning program starting, positioning device, control vehicle device, storage device and control device for controlling train speed of dynamic generation seismic risk, core of the control module as whole system, on the one hand the operation of aforementioned each device is controlled, on the other hand for being attached realization communication and control with external equipments such as external computer installations.In the present invention, reference threshold for seismic risk assessment is using dynamic generation by the way of, and in conjunction with the disaster of history, a situation arises, and is continuously updated account of the history after newest early warning occurs, to be compared with historical data, risk Pre-Evaluation that is more complete and scientifically considering a certain area.The present invention also provides a kind of subway seismic data information collection and method for early warning and systems.

title_en: Robotic companion device
abstract_en: Embodiments described herein relate to a robotic companion device for assisting a patient with daily tasks and/or medical emergencies. A robotic companion device may have sensors, actuators, and a computer system. The robotic device maybe able to receive sensor data, such as environmental information and a patient location. As the robotic device receives more data, it can learn (i.e., update decision tables) from the environment or patient in order to guide future actions. Additionally, based on the received sensor data, the robotic device is able to determine whether an emergency situation has occurred related to one or more patients and move to an area adjacent to the patient. Once near the patient, the robotic device can transmit a communication to a third party alerting them of the emergency situation. To improve patient interactions, the robotic device may mimic the gender, voice, lip movement, or facial appearance of a familiar individual.

title_en: Security alarm and guidance system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to management system of protection of security, in order to solve in existing security system, it concentrates on some region of exit passageway since personnel will appear when withdrawing and causes the exit passageway congestion to reducing the problem of withdrawing speed, provide a kind of security alarm and guidance system, including alert sub-system, guide subsystem and control module, guiding subsystem includes green indicating lamp, alert sub-system includes the first induction module, second induction module and alarm module, when alert occurs, alert inductive signal is sent control module by first induction module, control module control alarm module is alarmed；Guiding subsystem further includes having luminance adjustment module and optical filtering part, when the second induction module senses exit passageway congestion, the congestion signal is sent to control module, control module controls luminance adjustment module movement, reduces the brightness of the green indicating lamp in the exit passageway；Optical filtering part can mask the green indicating lamp other than particular color.
assignees: GUIZHOU RENHUA XIKE COMPUTER TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of multifunctional fire-fighting emergency direction board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of multifunctional fire-fighting emergency direction boards, including upper cover, lower cover, frame and organic glass, in two side bayonet slots of the frame insertion upper cover and lower cover, the upper cover is connect with lower cover by frame, and upper cover, lower cover and frame form direction board shell, the side of the upper cover is provided with power interface, the inside of the upper cover and lower cover is provided with strip groove, and strip groove corresponds to each other up and down, the inside of the strip groove is embedded in and is equipped with fire-resistant rubber item, the concave shape of fire-resistant rubber item, and it is interior equipped with groove.A kind of multifunctional fire-fighting emergency direction board described in the utility model, firstly, can be when fire power-off occurs, continuous flashing and voice broadcast, escape personnel is instructed to withdraw direction, and the reaction sensitivity that can be improved flashing and voice broadcast reduces the generation of failure, finally, can also be stable fix organic glass, it prevents from loosening, reduces security risk, bring better prospect of the application.

title_en: A kind of escape route generating method based on BIM
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of escape route generating methods based on BIM, including establish BIM model according to architecture information；The collection point ID of default sensor and with one-to-one first location information of the collection point ID, and by the collection point ID and first positioning information update to the BIM model；The warning message that sensor is sent is obtained, the warning message includes the corresponding collection point ID of sensor；The second location information of escape personnel is obtained, and escape route is generated according to the warning message, second location information and the BIM model.Escape route can be generated according to the environmental data of place where the accident occurred and the location information of escape personnel.Avoid escape personnel because of the loss of life and property caused by can not obtaining escape route or escape route inaccuracy.
assignees: XIAMEN HUAFANG SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of panel device of fire-fighting network information transmission equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of panel devices of fire-fighting network information transmission equipment, including panel shell, control panel, battery, processor, the panel housing forward end is provided with the control panel, the control front edge of board is provided with display, warning light is provided on the downside of the display, control button is provided on the downside of the warning light, loudspeaker is provided on the downside of the control button, panel shell upper end is provided with alarm lamp, panel shell side is provided with through-hole, the panel housing rear end is provided with device back plate, described device back plate rear end is provided with carry frame, the panel enclosure interior is provided with the battery, the battery side is provided with charger, the charger side is provided with DC-AC converter.Beneficial effect is: the utility model utilize much information transmission device real-time update fire information, and be equipped with battery, have a power failure when also can Fast Transferring Information, guarantee efficient information convey.
assignees: SHAANXI TIANZE ZHONGFU IND CO LTD

title_en: LoRa-based portable alarm technology for real-time location tracking and pedestrian safety service and information providing system
title_ko: 실시간 위치 추적 및 보행자 안전 서비스를 위한 LoRa 기반 휴대용 경보기 기술과 그 장치를 이용한 정보 제공 시스템
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide an information providing system using a LoRa-based portable alarm technology for real-time location tracking and a pedestrian safety service and a device thereof. The information providing system using a LoRa-based portable alarm technology for real-time location tracking and a pedestrian safety service and a device thereof comprises: a LoRa-based alarm device for a pedestrian to collect sensor data, use the sensor data to acquire a current location of a pedestrian, continuously update to monitor an emergency situation at all times and use monitoring in pedestrian safety data, generate pedestrian safety data based on such information, and transmit the pedestrian safety data to a pedestrian safety control server via LoRa communication; the pedestrian safety control server to store and manage corresponding pedestrian safety data, perform a process for an emergency situation if the emergency situation occurs, and check whether the LoRa-based alarm device for a pedestrian successfully communicates; and a smartphone application for a user and a protector which is an application used in registration and management of the LoRa-based alarm device for a pedestrian, and performs configuration for protector contact information and a report agency. Each component is connected to a network via a backbone network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실시간 위치 추적 및 보행자 안전 서비스를 위한 LoRa 기반 휴대용 경보기 기술과 그 장치를 이용한 정보 제공 시스템을 제공하기 위한 것으로서, 센서 데이터를 수집하고 이를 활용하여 현재 보행자의 위치를 파악하고, 항상 위기상황 여부를 감시하고 이를 보행자 안전 데이터에 활용할 수 있도록 지속적으로 갱신하며, 이런 정보를 바탕으로 보행자 안전 데이터를 생성하고 이를 LoRa 통신을 통해 보행자 안전 관제 서버로 전송하는 보행자용 LoRa 기반 경보기 장치와, 해당 보행자 안전 데이터를 저장 및 관리하며, 응급상황이 발생할 경우 이에 대한 처리를 수행하고, 상기 보행자용 LoRa 기반 경보기 장치가 통신 성공 여부를 확인할 수 있도록 하는 보행자 안전 관제 서버와, 보행자용 LoRa 기반 경보기 장치의 등록 및 관리에 사용되는 어플리케이션으로 보호자 연락처와 신고처에 대한 설정을 수행하는 사용자용 및 보호자용 스마트폰 어플리케이션으로 구성되고, 이때, 각 구성들은 백본망을 통한 네트워크 연결되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: NAT UNIV PUSAN IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Monitoring data processing method and landslide forecasting procedure for landslide
abstract_en: This application discloses the monitoring data processing methods and landslide forecasting procedure for landslide, are related to disaster alarm field, by laying monitoring point in premonitoring region, obtain the multi -components monitoring data of monitoring point.Multi -components monitoring data include the variation of physics-mechanics character at monitoring point, the Characters of Geographical Environment of monitoring point and weather condition.Multi -components monitoring data are handled, the changing features of multi -components monitoring data are obtained.This feature variation is input in tree-model again, exports the landslide risk index of the monitoring point.Since the proposition of innovation is handled the multi -components monitoring data of the monitoring point in premonitoring region using tree-model, and then realize to the round-the-clock monitoring of landslide and the real-time update of data, early warning can be issued to the dangerous of landslide in time by the analysis to data.

title_en: A kind of novel forest fire early-warning system and fire alarm method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of novel forest fire early-warning system and fire alarm method, the cruise and judge fire behavior that the unmanned plane of this system can be entirely autonomous do not need artificial interference；This system is based on infrared thermal imaging module and judges fire behavior, and false alarm rate is very low, and the accuracy of fire source judgement is high；This system is by infra-red thermal imaging system in conjunction with laser ranging system, it can fire units provide fire location, fire source shape, the relevant informations such as three-dimensional geographical conditions, fire spreading speed around fire source to the ground at the first time after finding fire behavior, fire-fighting efficiency is improved, validity of putting out the fire is improved.

title_en: Nuclear power plant's security against fire monitoring and managing method and system
abstract_en: A kind of nuclear power plant's security against fire monitoring and managing method and system, method include that the possibility for needing to carry out in each region is introduced into the field operation of fire risk to carry out real-time update in dynamic fire fighting database；And for each of dynamic fire fighting database region, risk assessment is individually carried out to each single item field operation that may introduce fire risk, superposed risk between assessing while being under the jurisdiction of the multinomial field operation of the same area, individually carried out based on every field operation risk assessment result and the superposed risk, assess the cumulative risk in each region in real time.Fire fighting database and live traffic are associated by the present invention, form dynamic database in real time, plant personnel is facilitated easily to inquire；Assessment risk in real time, it is also contemplated that the superposed risk between while multinomial field operation；Further, visualization Risk-warning and Precaution Tactics are provided for approving person；By the risk assessment criterion of different dimensions, the fire-fighting risk status in each region of power plant is provided.
assignees: SUZHOU NUCLEAR POWER RES INST;DAYA BAY NUCLEAR POWER OPS;CHINA GENERAL NUCLEAR POWER;CGN POWER CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus, method and computer program for providing information based on Air-quality index
title_ko: 대기 지수 기반 정보 제공 장치, 방법 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an air pollution index based information providing device comprises: an information collecting unit configured to receive location information of a user terminal and air pollution index information at the location from the user terminal; an information managing unit configured to update an air pollution index map including air pollution index information with regard to a plurality of locations based on the location information and the air pollution index information; and an information providing unit configured to generate an alarm including a message to be provided to a user based on the air pollution index map and the location information of the user terminal and provide the alarm to the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예는 사용자 단말로부터 상기 사용자 단말의 위치 정보 및 상기 위치에서의 대기 지수 정보를 수신하는 정보 수집부; 상기 위치 정보 및 상기 대기 지수 정보에 기초하여, 복수의 위치에 대한 대기 지수 정보를 포함하는 대기 지수 지도를 갱신하는 정보 관리부; 및 상기 대기 지수 지도 및 상기 사용자 단말의 위치 정보에 기초하여 사용자에게 제공할 메시지를 포함하는 알림을 생성하여 상기 사용자 단말에 전송하는 정보 제공부;를 포함하는 대기지수 기반 정보 제공 장치를 개시한다.

title_en: A kind of closely horizontal supporting rod piece of side slope and its side slope pre-add solid method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of closely horizontal supporting rod piece of side slope and its side slope pre-add solid method, the closely horizontal supporting rod piece of side slope includes slope protection cast, mobile jib, pillar, connection bar, warning device；Supporting rod piece and ground level are installed at less than 30 degree angles, supporting is carried out to tall and big side slope with nearly horizontal supporting way, shearing resistance greatly reinforces, and improves the barrier effect to landslide；And entire support system is pre-installed in mining activity area before mining, plays the role of protection and pre- landslide-proofing in advance, is made tall and big side slope not occur to come down or occur to issue clear early warning before landslide, is withdrawn personnel and the equipment of lower part in time；In the environment, without burying underground, design, construction, maintenance are easy for entire support system leakage；In addition, fast, easily group is built up at the construction field (site) by support system the present invention also provides a kind of side slope pre-add solid method, under the major premise for guaranteeing production safety, construction efficiency is turned up.

title_en: Landslide disaster forecasting procedure based on deepness belief network
abstract_en: Landslide disaster forecasting procedure disclosed by the invention based on deepness belief network, initially sets up Landslide Monitoring early warning system, acquires a large amount of disaster incitants, screens with MIV algorithm, filters out major casualty incitant；The disaster incitant filtered out is standardized process, is divided into test sample and training sample in specific proportions；Then, the landslide disaster forecasting model based on deepness belief network is constructed, setting structure is two layers of RBM and three layer of BP network composition；Using CD algorithm to RBM pre-training, network parameter is updated；Learnt using genetic algorithm supervised training, guarantees DBN network total optimization；Finally, the landslide disaster forecasting model that reconstruct has optimized, carries out landslide grade classification to output result, forecasts landslide possibility occurrence.Method disclosed by the invention accelerates convergence rate, prevents from falling into local optimum, promote landslide disaster forecast precision by extracting feature disaster incitant.

title_en: Monitoring data processing method, method for forecasting earthquake and system for earthquake prediction
abstract_en: Monitoring data processing method, method for forecasting earthquake and system for earthquake prediction, it is related to disaster alarm field, by laying earthquake monitoring point in premonitoring region, a variety of physical quantitys and chemical quantity for monitoring earthquake monitoring point are monitored, and obtain multi -components monitoring data.Multi -components monitoring data at the earthquake monitoring point because the variation characteristic of physical field and chemical fields caused by underground activities is related.Multi -components monitoring data are handled, the changing features of multi -components monitoring data are obtained.This feature variation is input in tree-model again, exports the earthquake monitoring point or the Earthquake risk index in the premonitoring region.Since the proposition of innovation is handled the multi -components monitoring data of the earthquake monitoring point in premonitoring region using tree-model, and then realize to the round-the-clock monitoring of earthquake and the real-time update of data, early warning can be issued to the danger that earthquake occurs in time by the analysis to data.

title_en: Method for early warning of urban rainfall flood inundated area
abstract_en: A method for early warning of urban rainfall flood inundated areas is characterized by comprising the following steps: the system comprises four functional modules: (M1) real-time observing water level in urban rainfall flood inundation area; (M2) a sensor layout module for municipal pipelines in urban rainfall flood flooding areas; (M3) an early warning indicator calculation module; (M4) a live and early warning plane domain output module. The invention has the beneficial effects that: 1. during the rain flood period, a city manager can mutually verify the water level data and the water surface image of the rain flood submerging area, so that the measured data is more convincing and effective; 2. a novel device and a method for measuring the water level of an urban rainfall flood flooding area are provided; 3. the water withdrawal process line of the rain flood inundated area can be accurately predicted.

title_en: A kind of more place gas monitor systems
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of more place gas monitor systems, it include: control centre's host computer, it is set to the host of different mine laneways and is uniformly arranged on multiple slaves of each mine laneway bottom, control centre's host computer is wirelessly communicated with host, multiple slaves connect the host of corresponding mine laneway by CAN communication bus, slave is used to generate warning information according to gas concentration data in collected mine laneway, host is for receiving gas density data and warning information and being sent to control centre's host computer, control centre's host computer is used to be arranged by host the gas density alarm threshold value of slave and transmits gas density data and warning information to command centre.The gas monitor system of the utility model realizes the automatic remote monitoring of more place coal mine gas concentrations to a certain extent, once gas density somewhere is more than threshold value, just will call the police, notifies miner to withdraw in time, reduces casualties.

title_en: Methods and apparatus for updating system information
abstract_en: According to embodiments described herein there is provided methods and apparatus for receiving notifications at a wireless device from a base station of upcoming system information (SI) updates. The wireless device is communicating with the base station using a contiguous subset of physical resources on a first carrier. A method in a wireless device comprises obtaining an indication of a subset of a plurality of paging occasions in a SI modification period that the wireless device is configured to monitor, wherein responsive to an upcoming update of SI the base station is configured to transmit a notification on each of the plurality of paging occasions in the SI modification period; and monitoring the subset of the plurality of paging occasions for notifications of upcoming SI updates.

title_en: Device and method for validating a public safety agency command issued to a vehicle
abstract_en: A process for validating a public safety agency command issued to a vehicle. In operation, a public safety agency controller receives a public safety agency command validation inquiry from a vehicle communication device. The inquiry indicates that the vehicle communication device has detected a public safety agency command issued to the vehicle and includes a first vehicle identifier and a first vehicle location. The controller receives a public safety agency command information including a second vehicle identifier and a second vehicle location from a public safety agency communication device. The validity of the public safety agency command is determined based on comparing the first vehicle identifier with the second vehicle identifier and comparing the first vehicle location with the second vehicle location. The controller then transmits a notification to the vehicle communication device identifying the validity of the public safety agency command.
assignees: MOTOROLA SOLUTIONS INC;KUCHARSKI WOJCIECH;JURZAK PAWEL;KAPLITA GRZEGORZ

title_en: Fine dust alarm broadcasting system
title_ko: 미세먼지 알림 방송시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fine dust notification broadcasting system which facilitates maintenance and repair. The fine dust notification broadcasting system comprises: a fine dust notification device including an environment measurement unit installed in an arbitrary area to measure outside environment information, a lighting module to emit light in multiple colors, and a control module to light the lighting module in a preset color if a measurement value of the environment information received from the environment measurement unit is higher than or equal to a prescribed value, and maintain or change the color by lighting of the lighting module if the measurement value of the environment information is changed to the prescribed value or higher or the prescribed value or lower at the lit time; a broadcast control server to receive the environment information from the environment measurement unit, and use the environment information to generate an announcement if the measurement value of the environment information is higher than or equal to the prescribed value; and a plurality of media output units which are installed in an arbitrary area, and receive the announcement from the broadcast control server to output the announcement. The broadcast control server includes: a broadcast generation unit to receive the environment information from the environment measurement unit, and use the environment information to generate an announcement if the measurement value of the environment information is higher than or equal to the prescribed value; and a mixing console for broadcasting to receive the announcement from the broadcast generation unit, and edit and control audio data of the announcement to transmit the audio data in a wired and a wireless manner.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 임의 영역에 설치되어 외부의 환경정보를 측정하는 환경측정부와, 다색으로 발광되는 점등모듈과, 상기 환경측정부로부터 전송받는 상기 환경정보의 측정값이 일정 값 이상일 경우, 기설정된 색상으로 상기 점등모듈을 점등시키고, 점등된 시점에서 상기 환경정보의 측정값이 일정 값 이상 또는 이하로 변경될 경우에는 상기 점등모듈의 점등에 따른 색상을 유지하거나 또는 변경시키도록 제어하는 제어모듈이 구비된 미세먼지 알림장치; 상기 환경측정부로부터 상기 환경정보를 전송받고, 상기 환경정보의 측정값이 일정 값 이상일 경우, 상기 환경정보를 이용해 안내방송을 생성하는 방송관제서버; 및 임의 영역에 설치되고, 상기 방송관제서버로부터 상기 안내방송을 전송받아 출력하도록 형성되는 복수의 미디어출력부;를 포함하고, 상기 방송관제서버는, 상기 환경측정부로부터 상기 환경정보를 전송받고, 상기 환경정보의 측정값이 일정 값 이상일 경우, 상기 환경정보를 이용해 안내방송을 생성하는 방송생성부와, 상기 방송생성부로부터 상기 안내방송을 전송받고, 상기 안내방송의 오디오 데이터를 편집 및 제어하여 유선 및 무선 송출이 가능하도록 형성되는 방송용 믹싱콘솔을 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 미세먼지 알림 방송시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: A kind of distributed implementation of the algorithm on ZigBee of escaping
abstract_en: The invention belongs to improved escape algorithm, ZigBee-network technical field, implementation of specially a kind of distributed escape algorithm on ZigBee.Improved algorithm includes initialization, weight updates and 3 processes of Route guiding.When disaster occurs for institute's detection zone, sense the node of disaster by broadcast-disaster message first, the node for receiving the message calculates weight increment by the hop count apart from disaster node, the weight that this system designs interior joint includes initial weight and increment weight, wherein the value of increment weight is inversely proportional at a distance from away from disaster, and initializes weight and then complete in the algorithm initialization stage.When there is multiple disasters, node takes an increment as oneself for maximal increment weight.The selection of channeling direction is judged with the weight size of nodes neighbors, is unconditionally directed toward Egress node if this node is Egress node, if not Egress node is directed toward the smallest node of weight in neighbours.

title_en: A kind of library bank falling zone landslip array early warning system
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of library bank falling zone landslip array early warning system, the array of a 3*3 specification including tilt alarm composition, each tilt alarm passes through conducting wire respectively and connect with a total control device；Tilt alarm includes shell, and power supply unit and monitoring device interconnected are from top to bottom successively arranged in shell, and shell lower end is connected with fixed part.The application array early warning system, when reservoir level is minimum, when namely falling zone is in maximum exposing area, it may be arranged at the library bank falling zone region of landslide or avalanche danger, once soil body run-off the straight or displacement, photo resistance will because inclination caused by illuminance change due to change, micro-current electric signal receiver will communicate information to processing module at this time, after processing identification warning information will be issued by transmitting module, it helps resident to withdraw in time and water reservoir management personnel is notified to be disposed, avoids the loss of lives and properties.

title_en: A kind of Intelligent prompting device based on Internet of Things

title_en: Fire disaster early warning system using beacon
title_ko: 비콘을 이용한 화재 재난 조기 경보 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and a method for fire disaster early warning using beacon capable of spreading an urgent situation and supporting a fire report. According to an embodiment, the method for fire disaster early warning using beacon comprises the steps of: receiving a beacon signal from at least one or more beacon device through a near field communication; identifying the beacon device from the received beacon signal; determining whether specific information included in the beacon signal corresponding to the identified beacon device is changed; and generating a warning in accordance with determining that the specific information included in the received beacon signal is change.
abstract_ko: 비콘을 이용한 화재 재난 조기 경보 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다.  일 실시예에 따른 단말에서 수행되는 경보 발생 방법은, 근거리 무선 통신을 통하여 적어도 하나 이상의 비콘 장치로부터 비콘 신호를 수신하는 단계; 상기 수신된 비콘 신호로부터 비콘 장치를 식별하는 단계; 상기 식별된 비콘 장치에 대응되는 비콘 신호에 포함된 특정 정보가 변경되었는지 여부를 판단하는 단계; 및 상기 수신된 비콘 신호에 포함된 특정 정보가 변경됨을 판단함에 따라 경보를 발생시키는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: In-vehicle Sound Wave Device for Providing Traffic Accident Emergency Rescue Service
title_ko: 교통사고 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 차량용 음파장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sound wave device for a vehicle to provide a traffic accident emergency rescue service, which comprises: a short-range module including at least one short-range wireless communication unit; a location module including a positioning module; a sensor module including one or more sensor units; and a control module. According to the present invention, an emergency mobilization service is automatically requested even if a user falls unconscious by a traffic accident.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 교통사고 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 차량용 음파장치에 따르면, 음파신호를 입력받는 음파 입력부와 음파신호를 출력하는 음파 출력부를 구비한 음파모듈과, 통신망에 연결하는 적어도 하나의 통신부를 구비한 통신모듈을 포함하는 음파장치에 있어서, 근거리 무선 통신을 처리하는 적어도 하나의 근거리 무선부를 구비한 근거리모듈과 GPS를 통해 측위된 위치좌표를 획득하는 위치 측위부를 구비한 위치모듈과 가속도를 센싱하는 가속도 센서부와 방향을 센싱하는 자이로 센서부와 지자기 센서부 중 하나 이상의 센서부를 구비한 센서모듈 및 상기 근거리 무선부를 통해 차량 OBD와 연결된 OBD모듈과 근거리 무선 통신하여 상기 차량 OBD로부터 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보를 획득하는 OBD 연동부와, 상기 음파 입력부를 통해 입력되는 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호에 대응하는 음파데이터를 판독하여 사용자의 발화를 인식하고 자연어 처리한 발화내용인식정보를 획득하는 절차를 수행하는 발화 인식부와, 상기 위치 측위부를 통해 획득된 위치좌표에 대응하는 위치정보를 확인하는 위치 확인부와, 상기 가속도 센서부를 통해 센싱된 가속도정보와 상기 자이로 센서부와 지자기 센서부 중 하나 이상을 통해 센싱된 방향정보를 하나 이상 포함하는 센싱정보를 확인하는 센서 확인부와, 상기 OBD 연동부를 통해 차량 OBD로부터 획득된 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보와 상기 발화 인식부를 통해 인식되어 자연어 처리된 사용자의 발화내용인식정보와 상기 센서 확인부를 통해 확인된 센싱정보 중 하나 이상의 정보를 통해 차량의 실제 교통사고 발생 상황을 파악하기 위한 절차를 수행하는 상황 파악부와, 지정된 연락처를 이용하여 교통사고 발생 상황에 따른 긴급출동 요청 상황을 알림하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보나 상기 긴급출동 요청의 취소를 위한 사용자 발화를 유도하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보를 확인하는 음파 확인부와, 상기 음파 출력부를 통해 상기 확인된 발화정보를 발화한 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호를 출력하고 상기 확인된 위치정보를 포함하는 긴급출동요청정보를 구성하여 상기 통신부를 통해 지정된 연락처로 통지하는 절차를 수행하는 서비스 처리부를 구비한 제어모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: In-vehicle Sound Wave Device for Providing Emergency Rescue Service for Puncture of Tire

title_en: In-vehicle Sound Wave Device for Providing Emergency Rescue Service for Battery Charging

title_en: The broadcast system for judging a status of broadcasting and existence of error using a realtime PC self-diagnosis
title_ko: 실시간 pc 자가 진단을 이용한 방송의 상태 및 고장 유무의 판단이 가능한 방송 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a broadcasting system capable of determining a state of broadcasting and presence of a fault using a real-time PC self-diagnosis comprises: a speaker output unit (1); a sound source driving switching unit (2); a sound source unit (3); a main control unit (4); a personal computer (PC) (5); and a power supply unit (6). An operator can diagnose a state of broadcasting and presence of a failure of the broadcasting system in a short time through a PC.

title_en: A kind of anti-collapse bracket of coal mining

title_en: A kind of mountain flood monitoring and early warning platform

title_en: Enhanced alert/notification system for law enforcement identifying and tracking of stolen vehicles and cargo
abstract_en: A law enforcement (LE) data processing system (DPS) includes a processor that executes a LE security event notification and dispatch (SEND) utility. The LE DPS receives, from a tracking system communicatively coupled to the LE DPS, an enhanced security event notification (ESEN) that includes information identifying a security event, a location at which the security event occurred, and additional distinguishing details corresponding to entities involved in and affected by the security event. The LE DPS selectively transmits information from the updated ESEN to at least one LE dispatch server supporting LE personnel within one of (i) a geographic vicinity of the location of the security event and (ii) a calculated zone of recapture, the additional distinguishing details enabling the LE personnel to receive a more complete set of relevant details at a LE field device that enables more accurate identification, tracking, and resolution by LE personnel of the security event.

title_en: Grating displacement testing system and method based on ten-axis sensor
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a grating displacement testing system and method based on a ten-axis sensor, comprising the following steps: the ten-axis sensor chip is embedded in the geogrid; the ten-axis sensor chip collects various data information of the monitoring point and uploads the data information to the management monitoring cloud platform; the management monitoring cloud platform obtains the change of the deformation and displacement of the geogrid of the monitoring point through comprehensive analysis according to the collected data information, performs error correction processing on the data information, reduces the data error rate and improves the data integrity rate; the management monitoring cloud platform synchronously updates data information acquired by the ten-axis sensor chip and an analysis result to the monitoring database server; the remote monitoring center extracts data in the monitoring database server, obtains the width of cracks generated by the whole structure of the geogrid and the extending trend thereof after further processing, monitors the damage trend of the whole geogrid in real time, and finally realizes automatic monitoring and geological disaster early warning of the whole state of the geogrid.

title_en: Tunnel integrated disaster prevention system capable of accident monitoring, fire disaster prevention, and refugee relief into a tunnel
title_ko: 터널 내 사고 감시, 화재 방재, 및 피난자 구제가 가능한 터널 통합 방재 시스템
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, an integrated tunnel disaster prevention system comprises: a cable tray having a pair of upright side rails and a bottom plate formed in an H shape, and a power supply cable in an inner part which forms a track rail supporting the bottom plate with a wire bolt to be suspended and supported at a predetermined height on the ceiling of a tunnel, to attach a lighting device of the tunnel, wherein a rack gear is formed on the bottom plate; and a disaster prevention device traveling on the track rail to move to an accident site so as to monitor an accident site in real-time, spraying fire extinguishing liquid upon fire to extinguish the fire, and dropping emergency supplies to victims to save the victims when the victims occur due to thick smoke generated by the fire. The disaster prevention device comprises a moving pulley to be traveled along the track rail and a portable disaster prevention means. The portable disaster prevention means comprises: an image photographing means to photograph traffic flow and accident images in a tunnel; a detection means to detect a traffic accident, fire, and thick smoke in the tunnel; a fire extinguishing device to extinguish the fire when the fire occurs in the tunnel; a wireless communication device to wirelessly communicate with a control room; and a microphone/speaker device to output traffic control and evacuation guide broadcasting. Accordingly, the traffic flow and accident images are monitored in real-time through ordinary turning traveling, such that lane change and speeding of a vehicle traveling in the tunnel are prevented, thereby preventing a traffic accident in the tunnel in advance, and quickly coping with the traffic accident when the accident occurs in the tunnel.

abstract_en: Disclosed are a real-time disaster broadcasting system using a mobile device, and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the real-time disaster broadcasting system using a mobile device comprises: a slave terminal for generating a photographed image; a master terminal for generating a broadcasting channel for providing a broadcasting image for the slave terminal, displaying a library for the photographed image received from the slave terminal connected to the same broadcasting channel, and transmitting any one of a plurality of photographed images configuring the library, selected by control of a user as the broadcasting image; and a management server for controlling the broadcasting image to be streamed to the slave terminal, controlling to change the photographed image photographed by the slave terminal positioned at the closet to a place where event information is generated, into the broadcasting image when the event information on a disaster situation or an emergency situation is confirmed as generated, and controlling to display an augmented reality object indicating an evacuation path and an evacuation place on the changed broadcasting image.
abstract_ko: 모바일 기기를 이용한 실시간 재난 방송 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 모바일 기기를 이용한 실시간 재난 방송 시스템은, 촬영영상을 생성하는 슬레이브 단말, 상기 슬레이브 단말에 방송영상을 제공하기 위한 방송채널을 생성하고, 동일한 방송채널에 접속한 슬레이브 단말로부터 수신되는 촬영영상에 대한 라이브러리를 표시하고, 상기 라이브러리를 구성하는 복수의 촬영영상 중 사용자의 제어에 의해 선택된 어느 하나의 촬영영상을 상기 방송영상으로 송출하는 마스터 단말 및 상기 방송영상이 상기 슬레이브 단말에 스트리밍 되도록 제어하되, 재난 상황 또는 긴급 상황에 대한 이벤트정보가 발생되는 것으로 확인되면, 상기 이벤트정보가 발생한 장소와 가장 근접한 위치에 위치한 슬레이브 단말에 의해 촬영된 촬영영상이 상기 방송영상으로 변경되도록 제어하고, 대피 경로 및 대피 장소를 나타내는 증강현실 오브젝트를 변경된 방송영상에 표시하도록 제어하는 관리서버를 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of self-control Housthold earthquake siren
abstract_en: A kind of self-control Housthold earthquake siren, it is made of longitudinal wave detection circuit, shear wave detection circuit, illuminating circuit and sound warning circuit, by the judgement for carrying out early earthquake to the detection of horizontal plane, when an earthquake occurs, longitudinal wave reaches ground first, and ground is made to generate wavy lifting, longitudinal wave detection circuit of the invention detects ground rise or fall signal, light bulb LD issues the light of kermesinus, and Integrated circuit IC 4 issues police whistle sound, and people is reminded to flee from rapidly；After shear wave arrives at ground, ground swings, and shear wave detection circuit detects the signal that swings, light bulb LD becomes normal light from kermesinus, people are facilitated to withdraw, while the alarm song that loudspeaker SW is issued is bigger, to remind more people to withdraw rapidly；It is simple that the beneficial effects of the invention are as follows structures, and warning effect is significant, is particularly suitable for night use.

title_en: Emergency alert system to secure golden hours and method for emergency alert system thereof
title_ko: 골든아워 확보를 위한 긴급출동 알림시스템 및 이를 이용한 긴급출동 알림시스템 제공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for automatically changing an outgoing call number for securing a golden hour in emergency dispatch. More specifically, provided is the system for automatically changing an outgoing call number, which automatically changes a mobile phone number of a caller such as a fire officer or the like to an emergency disaster number (such as 119, etc.) to notify an emergency situation to a receiver in order to prevent an accidental golden hour from missing due to illegal parking and stopping in case of emergency dispatch for fire or rescue. In order to achieve the goal of the present invention, the system for automatically changing an outgoing call number for an emergency situation comprises: a mobile phone for public service (200), which is installed through authentication of a public servant and is converted into a security mode; and a mobile communication system (300) identifying the public servant connected in the security mode to provide a two-number service.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Playback method and system based on the network direct broadcasting of HLS protocol after fault recovery
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of playback method and system based on the network direct broadcasting of HLS protocol after fault recovery, it is related to the downloading of HLS protocol Streaming Media and plays field.The step of this method includes: client requests M3U8 list to local to server-side, includes the duration of several TS fragments and each TS fragment in M3U8 list；Client downloads TS fragment according to local M3U8 list；The TS fragment of downloading is decoded and is shown by client；Client regularly updates local M3U8 list；After network failure and network disaster recovery occurs, client, which obtains, needs the duration T3 for the TS fragment downloaded to update local M3U8 list if T-T4 >=T3, and wherein T represents network failure generation duration, and T4 represents client download requests duration.The present invention can save the time-consuming expense of unnecessary request, quickly restore to play as far as possible with this, and then improve user experience.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting signal butterfly valve with warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire-fighting signal butterfly valve with warning device, valve rod are rotatably set on valve body, and one end of valve rod is connect with dish plate, and dish plate is located at valve inner, and the other end of valve rod is connected with the output shaft for executing control device；The side of dish plate excircle is equipped with magnetic part, and magnetic part is completely in inside dish version, and valve body is provided with the magnetic switch for detecting magnetic part；Braced frame is fixedly connected with the end of valve rod, and actuator and fault alarm are equipped with inside braced frame, and RFID electronic label is equipped with below the lateral wall of braced frame, and braced frame lateral wall middle is equipped with display, and the top of braced frame is equipped with buzzer；It can quickly identify abnormal butterfly valve occur by RFID electronic label, when actuator breaks down or powers off, alarm will occur for fault alarm, trigger buzzer；The utility model structure is simple, easy to operate, high production efficiency, can effectively reduce human cost.

title_en: Safety alarm method, device, control system and storage medium
abstract_en: This application involves a kind of safety alarm method, device, control system and storage mediums.Method includes obtaining security alarm signal, and according to the security alarm signal, determine warning location information, according to the warning location information, obtain the device identification of indicating equipment to be controlled, it generates and pushes more new signal to the indicating equipment to be controlled, the more new signal is used to the instruction information update of the indicating equipment to be controlled be predetermined warning information.By obtaining the device identification of indicating equipment to be controlled and the instruction information of update instruction equipment, it can be to avoid under dangerous or emergency, due to the phenomenon that indicating the misleading of information, personnel is caused to enter danger zone generation, the reliability and security of instruction information is improved.

title_en: Escape indicating means, device, control system and storage medium
abstract_en: This application involves a kind of escape indicating means, device, control system and storage mediums.Method includes when receiving security alarm signal, obtain warning area information, according to warning area information, obtain default best-effort path, obtain the device identification of the corresponding each escape prompt equipment of default best-effort path, when detecting default best-effort path, there are when personnel, it generates and pushes multiple and different more new signals respectively to the corresponding escape prompt equipment of each device identification, each more new signal is used to make the instruction information update of each escape prompt equipment, and preset rule variation is presented in the instruction information updated in counterpart personnel's escape direction of default best-effort path.So that the prompt information of each escape prompt equipment is distinct, escape personnel can intuitively determine best-effort path according to the instruction information of rule variation, increase the escape probability of escape personnel, to improve the escape reliability of escape personnel.

title_en: Detecting personal danger using a deep learning system
abstract_en: A mobile electronic device such as a smartphone is used in conjunction with a deep learning system to detect and respond to personal danger. The deep learning system monitors current information (such as location, audio, biometrics, etc.) from the smartphone and generates a risk score by comparing the information to a routine profile for the user. If the risk score exceeds a predetermined threshold, an alert is sent to the smartphone which presents an alert screen to the user. The alert screen allows the user to cancel the alert (and notify the deep learning system) or confirm the alert (and immediately transmit an emergency message). Multiple emergency contacts can be designated, e.g., one for a low-level risk, another for an intermediate-level risk, and another for a high-level risk, and the emergency message can be sent to a selected contact depending upon the severity of the risk score.

title_en: Live broadcast method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a live broadcast method, a live broadcast device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of Internet and can effectively improve disaster tolerance performance of network live broadcast. title_en: A kind of emergency communication processing system based on cloud perception
abstract_en: The invention proposes a kind of emergency communication processing systems based on cloud perception, the system mainly consists of three parts: realizing empty world information collection storage in cloud center, assimilate forecasting centre and realize information assimilation and forecast, warning information distribution platform realizes that warning information updates and publication.Firstly, cloud center is completed the acquisition of information by satellite main website, the meteorological equipment such as airship and weather radar and is stored based on cloud framework；Secondly, assimilation forecasting centre carries out assimilation processing to acquired various information using 4D-WRF-EnSRF algorithm as core, and warning information distribution platform is sent into a manner of cloud resource；Finally, warning information distribution platform establishes warning information delivery network, warning information is being sent at the first time in a manner of DAB, internet and network etc. to disaster field, guarantee rescue action performs effectively and masses' rapid evacuation.

title_en: Integrated rescue management system based on personal position for ship
title_ko: 선박용 개인위치기반 안전구조 통합관제시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety rescue integrated control system for a ship based on a personal location, which comprises: a tag device for inputting a unique tag to a mobile device of a ship passenger when boarding on a ship; a ship warning system installed in a ship to monitor a disaster situation of the whole ship; an evacuation support device for storing various disaster states in the ship, and storing each evacuation scenario therefor; an integrated control server for inputting and outputting location-based mobile device information, and receiving ship disaster information from the ship warning system; a communication connection network connected to the integrated control server to transmit a ship disaster state, and receiving external evacuation instruction information; and a dashboard installed in an evacuation control center in the ship to output each evacuation information on the passenger and the ship disaster state. According to the present invention, when an internal warning of the ship is input by the ship warning system to the integrated control server, the ship disaster state is determined using the location-based mobile device information and an internal warning state of the ship, and an optimal evacuation scenario is selected to output individual evacuation information to each passenger mobile device. Also, the dash board is operated to display evacuation information and a disaster progress state of the ship, an evacuation state in the ship is transmitted via the communication connection network, and the external evacuation instruction information is received to update entire evacuation information. According to the present invention, the spread of the dangerous situation during evacuation of a passenger is prevented in case of emergency of the ship, an overall instruction action for emergency can be performed, and an external rescue can be effectively performed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박용 개인위치기반 안전구조 통합관제시스템에 관한 것으로서, 선박 승선자의 모바일 디바이스에 승선시 고유 태그를 입력시키는 태그 장치와; 선박 내 설치되어 선박 전체의 재난상황을 감시하는 선박 경보시스템과; 선박 내 각종 재난상태와 이에 대한 각 대피 시나리오가 저장되는 대피지원장치와; 상기 위치기반 모바일 디바이스 정보가 입출력되고, 상기 선박 경보시스템으로부터 선박 재난정보를 입력받는 통합관제서버와; 상기 통합관제서버에 연결되어 선박 재난상태를 전송하고 외부대피 지휘정보를 입력받는 통신 연결망과; 선박 내 대피관제소에 설치되어 승선자의 각 대피정보와 선박의 재난상태를 출력시키는 대시보드로; 구성되어, 상기 통합관제서버에 상기 선박 경보시스템에서 선박 내부 경보가 입력되면, 상기 위치기반 모바일 디바이스 정보와 선박 내부 경보 상태로 선박 재난 상태를 판단하고 최적 대피 시나리오를 선택하여, 각 승선자 모바일 디바이스로 개별 대피정보를 출력시키고, 상기 대시보드를 가동하여 승선자의 각 대피정보와 선박의 재난 진행상태를 디스플레이시키며, 상기 통신 연결망으로 선박 내 대피 상태를 전송하고, 외부대피 지휘정보를 입력받아 전체 대피정보를 갱신하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A kind of library bank falling zone landslip array early warning system
