title_en: First communication device, third communication device, and methods performed thereby to monitor a second communication device comprised in a group of communication devices
abstract_en: Method performed by a first communication device (111) operating in a wireless communications network (100). The wireless communications network (100) comprises a group of communication devices (110). The first communication device (111) determines (204) that a number of communication devices, comprised in the group of communication devices (110), having reported that data about a position of a second communication device (112) comprised in the group of communication devices (110) has not been received within a time period, is above a threshold. The first communication device (111) then initiates (205) transmitting an indication to at least one receiving device (114), indicating a result of the determination. Also disclosed is a method by a third communication device (113) comprised in the group. The third communication device (113) starts (301) a timer defining the time period and, in the absence of the data received within the period, sends (303) a notification of expiration of the timer.

title_en: Escaping direction providing method and system based on location information
title_ko: 위치정보에 기반한 피난경로 제공 방법 및 피난경로 제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation route providing method and an evacuation route providing system based on location information, which, in case of an emergency such as fire, earthquake, etc., provides an optimal evacuation route for each situation based on information on the location of a fire occurrence and the locations of an evacuee and a fireman and separately guides for each floor or location such that evacuees in a dangerous zone can evacuate more properly, quickly and safely. The present invention comprises: a fire information acquiring step of acquiring fire information including fire occurrence location information, location information on evacuees, and information on an untenantable zone due to smoke; a population density calculating step of calculating the population density of the evacuees for each floor of a facility based on the acquired fire information; an evacuation path calculating step of calculating at least one evacuation path of the evacuees based on the calculated population density and information on a previously constructed facility by floors and/or predetermined zones; and an evacuation notification step of notifying at least one position of each floor and predetermined zone based on the calculated evacuation route. The steps are repeated in real time, and the evacuation path calculating step includes determining an evacuation path changing condition in consideration of moving time to an evacuation stair.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재, 지진 등과 같은 비상상황의 발생시, 화재발생위치와 피난자 및 소방대원의 위치정보에 기반하여 상황별 최적의 피난경로를 제공하고, 층별 또는 위치별 구분 안내하여 위험구역 내의 피난자들이 보다 정확하고 신속하며 안전하게 피난할 수 있도록 하는, 위치정보에 기반한 피난경로 제공 방법 및 피난경로 제공 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 화재발생 위치정보와, 피난자들의 위치정보, 및 연기로 인한 거주불가능구역 정보를 포함하는 화재정보를 취득하는 화재정보 취득단계; 취득된 화재정보에 근거하여 시설물 각 층에 대한 피난자들의 밀집도를 산출하는 밀집도 산출 단계; 상기 산출된 밀집도 및 미리 구축된 시설물의 정보에 근거하여 피난자들의 피난경로를 층별 및 소정 존(zone)별 중 적어도 하나로 산출하는 피난경로 산출 단계; 및 상기 산출된 피난경로에 근거하여 층별 및 소정 존별 중 적어도 하나의 개소로 고지하는 피난고지 단계;를 포함하며, 상기 각 단계들은 실시간 반복 실행되고, 상기 피난경로 산출 단계는 피난 계단으로의 이동시간을 고려하여 피난경로 변경조건을 판단하는 것을 특징으로 하는 위치정보에 기반한 피난경로 제공 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: A kind of quick evacuation method of virtual machine based on the disaster early warning time
abstract_en: A kind of quick evacuation method of the virtual machine based on the disaster early warning time is claimed in the present invention, belongs to field of cloud computer technology.This method is seriously threatened caused by backbone network physical node for mass disaster, according to disaster early warning time, virutal machine memory size and virtual machine downtime, the virtual net and its interdependent node that are on the hazard is reconstructed and is withdrawn.The present invention replicates migrating technology after using, optimal evacuation path and initial bandwidth are distributed in the case where migrating flow equalization principle for virtual machine to be withdrawn, and the bandwidth on evacuation path is adjusted according to network resource conditions dynamic, virtual machine withdraws completion rate in maximization pre-warning time.

title_en: Smart home Disasters Prevention and Rescue System
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of smart home Disasters Prevention and Rescue Systems, comprising: cabinet comprising outer container and interior case；The level-one discharge pipe line being connected, water tank, the first connecting tube, the second connecting tube, the first water pump and the second water pump is respectively set with inside in outer container top, realizes circulating for water；When pressing control button, then processor controls the first delivery device respectively and interior case is released outer container, and water receiving tank is released groove by the second delivery device；The signal enabling line memory module that processor receives control button transmission obtains conduct route information, passes through the conduct route of driving mechanisms control cabinet；And fire protection warning platform is sent to processor by the location transmission of locating module positioning cabinet.For the present invention in the case where that can not withdraw, trapped person can be to self-insurance be carried out in cabinet, and starting water circulation waits for rescue, while being positioned by intelligent control, and signal transmission reduction rescue period has greatly ensured the life security of trapped person.

title_en: Intelligent guide propaganda and education screen
abstract_en: It is suitble to the present invention provides a kind of in the fire fighting and rescues such as park, sight spot or the smart machine conducted a sightseeing tour to the public, propagated and educated in the tourism relevant departments such as hotel, it can actively or interact with tourist answer tour guide's problem, it preferentially can also continuously play civilized moral education program, and realize it is unattended under automatically update broadcasting content, it greatly simplifies the management work of propaganda and education's broadcasting and improves communication and education effect, fire fighting and rescue is become to the school of citizen's civilization moral education；It can also provide a variety of services such as background music, unattended dancing party and shared wifi for the live public simultaneously, it will significantly promote the enjoyment effect and cultural taste of the public venues such as park, sight spot.
assignees: FUJIAN CHUCAI EDUCATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of intelligent concrete, which pours, sets template method for managing security
abstract_en: A kind of intelligent concrete, which pours, sets template method for managing security, belongs to technical field of concrete construction.Method is applied to cloud system, cloud system receives the signal for carrying out self-template installation end sensing mould group, it include: to pour the safe sex determination for setting formwork for template installation end sensing module signal progress concrete after concrete pours and sets template installation: obtaining structure change numerical value after algorithm calculates through template installation end sensing module signal；Compared with by structure change numerical value safety value corresponding with cloud data bank, if structure change numerical value is greater than the safety value, determine that concrete pours that set formwork dangerous, and send caution signal；Otherwise determine that concrete pours and set formwork safety, then the safety value of cloud data bank is updated to current structure variation numerical value.The present invention can obtain the sensing signal of template installation end in real time, and progress concrete in side pours the safe sex determination for setting formwork beyond the clouds, can alert in time, make emergency response processing convenient for construction personnel.

title_en: Portable alert communication system
abstract_en: A portable alert communication system for use in a health care facility comprising a local display device for use by a healthcare administrator, with the local display device having a level-of-care mechanism, a display screen, and an acknowledgment indicator; and a remote display device for use by a healthcare provider, with the remote display device having a level-of-care indicator and an acknowledgment mechanism; and whereby the healthcare administrator can use the local display device to send a level-of-care alert relating to the needs of a patient to the remote display device, which can display the level-of-care alert to the healthcare provider, who can then use the acknowledgement indicator to send an acknowledgment response to the local display device, which can use the acknowledgment indicator to display the acknowledgment response from the healthcare provider to the healthcare administrator, indicating whether the healthcare provider accepts or declines the healthcare administrator's request to attend to the needs of the patient.

title_en: A method of forest fire footprint is extracted based on remotely-sensed data
abstract_en: A method of forest fire footprint is extracted based on remotely-sensed data, belongs to remote sensing technology field.The present invention passes through selected target list scape brulee image, it counts the number of tested fire detecting point and extracts ranks number of all tested fire detecting points in the target list scape brulee image and be used as a data set, then the data set is clustered using DBSCAN algorithm, to divide event of fire, extraction obtains the brulee information of event of fire each time.The present invention provides a kind of new tools that fire footprint is extracted based on remote sensing technology, and are suitble to all remote sensing brulee data products.Since DBSCAN algorithm realizes the applicability of space clustering, so that the accuracy for obtaining result is high, it can be used as an important supplement of fire risk assessment, the accuracy and validity for improving fire risk assessment, also can be used as important parameter and participate in the early prediction of forest fire management, plan for fire protection and fire, early warning.

title_en: Environmental sensor platform, system and method
abstract_en: A platform, system, method, and computer readable media is provided which is configured for monitoring water level height of one or more bodies of water. In a version the system generally comprises one or more of the following components: (a) a plurality of sensor nodes, each sensor node associated with a predetermined geographical location near water, wherein each sensor node comprises: (i) a detector configured to collect environmental data pertaining to changes in water surface height; and (ii) a telemetry module configured to wirelessly transmit the environmental data collected by the detector; (b) a gateway device configured to receive and route the environmental data, the gateway device comprising a gateway device processor and non-transitory computer readable storage media encoded with a computer program including instructions executable by the gateway device processor to create a gateway device application comprising: (i) a software module configured to receive the environmental data; (ii) a software module configured to apply an algorithm to the environmental data to parse, clean and aggregate environmental data; (iii) a software module configured to wirelessly transmit the environmental data; (c) a cloud based platform configured to support real-time stream processing of sensor node environmental data, the cloud based platform comprising one or more cloud based servers comprising a cloud server processor and non-transitory computer readable storage media encoded with a computer program including instructions executable by the cloud server processor to create a server application comprising: (i) a software module configured to receive the environmental data; (ii) a software module configured to apply an algorithm to the environmental data to determine an environmental trend or condition; (iii) a software module configured to generate an environmental data report comprising environmental trend or condition; and (iv) a software module configured to transmit the environmental data report when certain environmental data parameters exceed predefined thresholds in the form of an alert; and (d) a device comprising a report processor configured to provide a report application comprising a software module configured to receive and display the environmental date report.

title_en: The method that coal mine fully-mechanized mining face based on SLAM technology is maked an inspection tour unmanned vehicle and independently maked an inspection tour
abstract_en: The method that the coal mine fully-mechanized mining face that the invention discloses a kind of based on SLAM technology is maked an inspection tour unmanned vehicle and independently maked an inspection tour, first initializes fully mechanized coal face SLAM module, and obtain coal mine initial environment map；Feature Points Matching will be carried out in the collected coal mine environment image information in current location and initial environment map, if successful match, unmanned vehicle constantly adds the environmental map point of new position during tour, current coal mine environment map is constituted, while current coal mine environment map is ceaselessly updated；After the completion of fully mechanized coal face makes an inspection tour unmanned vehicle to the corresponding tour task in current mine position, fully mechanized coal face tour unmanned vehicle will be reached next target point with optimal path and be maked an inspection tour.The actual change situation and geographical location and environmental change below entire mine that the present invention can make staff easily grasp fully-mechanized mining working very much, and the work such as can give warning in advance to the condition of a disaster, largely save manpower and financial resources.

title_en: The tube incubate ropes.
title_ko: 밧줄을 품은 튜브
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a tube having a rope embedded therein to enable an ordinary person to quickly rescue a drowning person within the golden time. According to the present invention, a rope is overlapped with the outer surface of the tube and is covered with waterproof cloth. A whistle is tied to an end portion of the cloth and is used to enable the drowning person to alert the surroundings first in case of an emergency. In the event of an emergency, the cloth attached by Velcro tape is detached, the rope is withdrawn, and an end portion of the rope and the cloth are crumpled into one body to be thrown at the drowning person. The other end portion of the rope is connected to the tube.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 밧줄이 들어가 있는 튜브에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 물놀이를 할 때 안전사고가 났을 때 튜브에 있는 밧줄을 빼어 밧줄을 둘러싼 원단을 함께 뭉쳐서 익수자를 구조할 수 있게 함으로써 익수자를 미리 구할 수 있게 하는 튜브에 관한 것이다. 
따라서 본 발명은 상기한 바와 같은 문제점을 해결하기 위해 제안된 것으로, 본 발명의 목적은 튜브 본연의 기능을 유지하면서도 익수자 발생 시 일반인이 골든타임동안 빠른 시간 내에 구할 수 있게끔 하기 위해 튜브 겉 표면에 줄을 덧대고 줄을 방수 천으로 감쌌다. 그 천의 끝부분엔 호루라기를 달아 긴급 상황 시 호루라기로 주변에 위험을 먼저 알릴 수 있게 하였다. 
긴급 상황 시 벨크로로 붙어있는 천을 떼어내고 줄을 빼내어서 줄 끝부분과 천을 함께 뭉쳐서 익수자에게 던져준다. 줄의 또 다른 끝부분은 튜브와 연결 되어있다. 익수자는 그 부분을 잡고 해경이 구조하러 올 때까지 기다린다. 
만약 구조 자가 물 밖에서 목격을 했을 경우, 줄 부분을 기둥에 묶고 튜브를 던져주고 끌어서 구조한다. 
본 발명은 앞서 본 목적을 달성하기 위하여 다음과 같은 구성을 가진다. 
본 발명에 따른 밧줄을 품은 튜브는 튜브 외부에 줄을 소방호스 형태로 감아 놓았고, 줄을 방수 천으로 벨크로를 이용하여 고정시켜 놓았다. 
또한 천의 사이에 부력 재를 넣었고, 천 안부분에 줄의 끝부분이 붙어있다.  
또한 천의 끝부분(줄의 끝부분)쪽에 호루라기가 달려있다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 물놀이에서 즐겁게 놀기 위해 반드시 챙겨가는 튜브에 물놀이 안전에 필요한 인명 구조용 밧줄을 하나로 결합하여, 반드시 챙겨가는 튜브에 꼭 필요한 물건을 함께 갖고 다닐 수 있도록 하였다. 평소처럼 튜브를 챙기지만 안전한 수중 레저 활동을 할 수 있다. 
또한, 평소에는 기존의 물놀이 튜브로 사용하다가 위급 상황에서 튜브를 벗기면 안전용품인 인명 구조용 밧줄이 바로 나와 사용 할 수 있고, 
구명환은 부피가 크고 딱딱해서 물놀이에서 사용하기에는 적합하지 않지만, 밧줄을 품은 튜브는 기존 튜브처럼 부드럽고 가볍기 때문에 물놀이 활동에서 사용하기 좋다는 실용적인 효과가 있다. 
 기존 튜브에 약간의 변형만으로도 인명 구조를 할 수 있다는 점은 어떠한 경제적인 효과보다 크다고 할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of Internet of Things fire-alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Internet of Things fire-alarms, including fire alarm host, the output end of the fire alarm host is electrically connected with the input terminal of output module, the output end of the output module is electrically connected with the input terminal of signal receiving module, and the output end of the signal receiving module is electrically connected with the input terminal of signal processor.The Internet of Things fire-alarm, fire alarm host receives fire alarm, information is passed to signal receiving module by output module by fire alarm host, the information received is passed to signal processor by signal receiving module, signal processor is in alert status, the information received is fed back to fire alarm host by signal processor, after fire alarm host determines that fire condition is true, acknowledgement key on signal processor determines, warning lamp lights, determining information is passed to signal transmitting module by signal processor, the information received is passed to fire-fighting detachment cloud platform by signal transmitting module.

title_en: Device and method for handling system information change
abstract_en: A base station (BS) for handling SI change comprises at least one storage device for storing instructions and at least one processing circuit coupled to the at least one storage device. The at least one processing circuit is configured to execute the instructions stored in the at least one storage device. The instructions comprise broadcasting a plurality of synchronization signal (SS) blocks (SSBs) and a SI block (SIB) in a first bandwidth part (BWP) of a first carrier; communicating with a first communication device in a second BWP of the first carrier; updating a content of the SIB to an updated content, and broadcasting the SIB comprising the updated content in the first BWP; transmitting a SI change notification in the second BWP to the first communication device; and broadcasting the SIB comprising the updated content in the second BWP.

title_en: A kind of generation method, device and the storage medium of building evacuation route
abstract_en: The present invention relates to generation method, device and the storage mediums of a kind of building evacuation route, this method comprises the following steps: obtaining the characteristic parameter of multiple structure nodes of building and the change rate of characteristic parameter, structure node is the structure support point or binding site in building；The security level of each structure node is determined according to characteristic parameter and change rate；When security level is greater than or equal to default warning level, warning message is exported, and best evacuation route is determined in pre-stored evacuation route according to the security level of each structure node；Best evacuation route is exported, best evacuation route is for guiding evacuating personnel.In dangerous situation preceding user's early warning into building can occur for technical solution of the present invention, guidance people withdraw as early as possible, it can better ensure that the personal safety of people, simultaneously, best evacuation route is determined according to the security level of structure node, people can be made to avoid a dangerous zone during evacuation, safely and fast withdrawn from building.
assignees: MICRO CLOUD WUHAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting and emergency management and rescue individual combat command methods and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire-fightings and emergency management and rescue individual combat command methods, comprising the following steps: the location information and physiologic information of acquisition individual soldier and/or teams and groups；Obtain the real-time body posture and historical track of individual soldier；Obtain the working condition of individual soldier and/or the taken equipment of teams and groups；Obtain the real time data of fire-fighting and emergency rescue scene；It is generated according to all information of acquisition and suggests sending scheme and the corresponding prediction scheme that executes to be executed by commanding's selection；The corresponding execution prediction scheme of scheme is sent to assign a task instruction to corresponding individual soldier and/or teams and groups according to selection；It is disposed for fire-fighting and emergency management and rescue, the physiological status for providing the decomposition of prediction scheme, the distribution of task, the assigning of instruction, fire-fighting and emergency management and rescue personnel is obtained to be obtained and the indoor and outdoor location information of the corresponding early warning of scene, fire-fighting and emergency management and rescue is obtained and collected and update with region danger early warning and field data with early warning, fire-fighting and the behavior of emergency management and rescue personnel and posture.
assignees: SHANGHAI JUCHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of elevator rescue channel based on fault pre-alarming mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of elevator rescue channels based on fault pre-alarming mechanism, including security control center, cloud server, lift car, elevator monitoring terminal, ladder carries monitoring, ladder carries screen, elevator data collector, photoelectricity leveling inductor, weight sensor, linear velocity trans, elevator monitoring terminal, ladder carries monitoring, ladder carries screen, elevator data collector, photoelectricity leveling inductor, weight sensor, linear velocity trans are respectively mounted on the elevator car, and it is interconnected by conducting wire, elevator monitoring terminal is connected with the power supply system that elevator is run, elevator monitoring terminal also passes through network connection cloud server, the cloud server is connected by network with security control center.This system realizes that elevator faults early warning and lift facility operating status monitor in real time, when elevator malfunction accident occurs, trapped person and quick response processing are remotely pacified, upgrading updates cloud algorithm model in time, elevator significant trouble probability of happening is reduced, ensures boarding safety.
assignees: GUANGDONG COUNTRY GARDEN PROPERTY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: In-vehicle Air Cleaning Device for Providing Emergency Rescue Service for Battery Charging
title_ko: 배터리 충전 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 공기정화장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air purifying device for providing emergency dispatch service for battery charging and, more specifically, to an air purifying device which is provided with an air purifying module in which a photocatalyst panel and a UV lamp unit are arranged and an operation module including an acoustic wave module and a communication module. To this end, the present invention comprises a near-field module, a position module, a power module and a control module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 배터리 충전 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 공기정화장치에 따르면, 광촉매 물질을 코팅한 복수의 규소 성분 구슬들을 패널 형태로 집적 성형한 지정 개수의 광촉매 패널과 UV(UltraViolet)-A 파장 대역의 UV를 방출하는 지정 개수의 UV램프부를 지정된 기하학적 관계로 배치한 공기정화모듈을 구비하고, 상기 공기정화모듈을 통해 차량 내부의 공기 정화를 운영하면서 차량내의 상황을 인식하여 서비스를 제공하기 위해 음파신호를 입력받는 음파 입력부와 음파신호를 출력하는 음파 출력부를 구비한 음파모듈과, 통신망에 연결하는 적어도 하나의 통신부를 구비한 통신모듈을 포함하는 운영모듈이 구비된 공기정화장치에 있어서, 근거리 무선 통신을 처리하는 적어도 하나의 근거리 무선부를 구비한 근거리모듈과 GPS를 통해 측위된 위치좌표를 획득하는 위치 측위부를 구비한 위치모듈과 차량 전원을 공급받아 인가하는 전원 공급부와 상기 차량 전원에 대응하는 전원을 충전하는 전원 충전부를 구비한 전원모듈 및 상기 근거리 무선부를 통해 차량 OBD와 연결된 OBD모듈과 근거리 무선 통신하여 상기 차량 OBD로부터 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보를 획득하는 OBD 연동부와, 상기 음파 입력부를 통해 입력되는 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호에 대응하는 음파데이터를 판독하여 사용자의 발화를 인식하고 자연어 처리한 발화내용인식정보를 획득하는 절차를 수행하는 발화 인식부와, 상기 위치 측위부를 통해 획득된 위치좌표에 대응하는 위치정보를 확인하는 위치 확인부와, 상기 전원 공급부를 통해 차량 전원이 인가되는지 상기 전원 충전부에 충전된 충전 전원이 인가되는지 확인하는 전원 확인부와, 상기 OBD 연동부를 통해 차량 OBD로부터 획득된 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보와 상기 발화 인식부를 통해 인식되어 자연어 처리된 사용자의 발화내용인식정보와 상기 전원 확인부를 통해 확인된 차량 전원과 충전 전원 중 어느 한 전원의 인가 상태에 대한 전원인가정보 중 하나 이상의 정보를 통해 차량의 배터리 방전 상황을 파악하기 위한 절차를 수행하는 상황 파악부와, 지정된 연락처를 이용하여 배터리 방전 상황에 따른 긴급출동 요청 상황을 알림하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보나 상기 긴급출동 요청의 취소를 위한 사용자 발화를 유도하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 확인하는 음파 확인부와, 상기 음파 출력부를 통해 상기 확인된 발화정보에 대응하는 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호를 출력하면서 상기 확인된 위치정보를 포함하는 긴급출동요청정보를 구성하여 상기 통신부를 통해 지정된 연락처로 통지하는 절차를 수행하는 서비스 처리부를 구비한 제어모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: In-vehicle Air Cleaning Device for Providing Traffic Accident Emergency Rescue Service
title_ko: 교통사고 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 공기정화장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air purifying device for providing emergency dispatch service in case of a traffic accident and, more specifically, to an air purifying device which is provided with an air purifying module in which a photocatalyst panel and a UV lamp unit are arranged and an operation module including an acoustic wave module and a communication module. To this end, the present invention comprises a near-field module, a position module, a sensor module, and a control module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 교통사고 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 공기정화장치에 따르면, 광촉매 물질을 코팅한 복수의 규소 성분 구슬들을 패널 형태로 집적 성형한 지정 개수의 광촉매 패널과 UV(UltraViolet)-A 파장 대역의 UV를 방출하는 지정 개수의 UV램프부를 지정된 기하학적 관계로 배치한 공기정화모듈을 구비하고, 상기 공기정화모듈을 통해 차량 내부의 공기 정화를 운영하면서 차량내의 상황을 인식하여 서비스를 제공하기 위해 음파신호를 입력받는 음파 입력부와 음파신호를 출력하는 음파 출력부를 구비한 음파모듈과, 통신망에 연결하는 적어도 하나의 통신부를 구비한 통신모듈을 포함하는 운영모듈이 구비된 공기정화장치에 있어서, 근거리 무선 통신을 처리하는 적어도 하나의 근거리 무선부를 구비한 근거리모듈과 GPS를 통해 측위된 위치좌표를 획득하는 위치 측위부를 구비한 위치모듈과 가속도를 센싱하는 가속도 센서부와 방향을 센싱하는 자이로 센서부와 지자기 센서부 중 하나 이상의 센서부를 구비한 센서모듈 및 상기 근거리 무선부를 통해 차량 OBD와 연결된 OBD모듈과 근거리 무선 통신하여 상기 차량 OBD로부터 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보를 획득하는 OBD 연동부와, 상기 음파 입력부를 통해 입력되는 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호에 대응하는 음파데이터를 판독하여 사용자의 발화를 인식하고 자연어 처리한 발화내용인식정보를 획득하는 절차를 수행하는 발화 인식부와, 상기 위치 측위부를 통해 획득된 위치좌표에 대응하는 위치정보를 확인하는 위치 확인부와, 상기 가속도 센서부를 통해 센싱된 가속도정보와 상기 자이로 센서부와 지자기 센서부 중 하나 이상을 통해 센싱된 방향정보를 하나 이상 포함하는 센싱정보를 확인하는 센서 확인부와, 상기 OBD 연동부를 통해 차량 OBD로부터 획득된 차량의 운행정보 또는 상태정보와 상기 발화 인식부를 통해 인식되어 자연어 처리된 사용자의 발화내용인식정보와 상기 센서 확인부를 통해 확인된 센싱정보 중 하나 이상의 정보를 통해 차량의 실제 교통사고 발생 상황을 파악하기 위한 절차를 수행하는 상황 파악부와, 지정된 연락처를 이용하여 교통사고 발생 상황에 따른 긴급출동 요청 상황을 알림하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보나 상기 긴급출동 요청의 취소를 위한 사용자 발화를 유도하기 위해 사용자에게 발화 출력할 발화정보를 확인하는 음파 확인부와, 상기 음파 출력부를 통해 상기 확인된 발화정보를 발화한 가청 주파수 대역의 음파신호를 출력하고 상기 확인된 위치정보를 포함하는 긴급출동요청정보를 구성하여 상기 통신부를 통해 지정된 연락처로 통지하는 절차를 수행하는 서비스 처리부를 구비한 제어모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: In-vehicle Air Cleaning Device for Providing Emergency Rescue Service for Puncture of Tire
title_ko: 타이어 펑크 긴급출동 서비스를 제공하는 공기정화장치
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an air purification device for providing an emergency rescue service for a puncture of a tire comprises: a photocatalytic panel; an air purification module; a sound wave module having a sound wave input unit receiving a sound wave signal and a sound wave output unit outputting the sound wave signal; and an operation module including a communication module having at least one communication unit. The air purification device includes a short distance module, a location module, and a sensor module. The air purification device further includes an OBD interlocking unit, an ignition recognizing unit, a location checking unit, a sensor checking unit, a situation grasping unit, a sound wave checking unit, and a control module.

title_en: A kind of wireless smoke sense early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of wireless smoke sense early warning systems, are wirelessly transferred using NB-IoT, are not necessarily to self-built base station, and alert is made to be sent to cigarette sense application server and types of applications terminal, wide coverage by carrier network, and network is stablized, and input cost is low；New-type smoke sensor device internal battery wirelessly communicates, and works independently, without wiring, and suspension type main body on positioning base can easy removal, deployment is convenient, and maintenance is quick；Each new-type smoke sensor device is provided with temperature monitoring and voice light warning function, is quick on the draw, and early warning is timely, and when fire occurs, indoor occupant can know and withdraw at the first time；Overall intelligence is horizontal high, realizes in space the real time monitoring of fire behavior everywhere, loss is reduced to minimum level by timely early warning when fire occurs, and has ensured the security of the lives and property of the people, and the utility model is suitable for fire-fighting and intelligent building.

title_en: Compressed air foam fire-extinguishing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of compressed air foam fire-extinguishing system, including fire alarm detection unit, linkage control unit, valve control unit, compressed air foam extinguishing unit, fire alarm detection unit connects linkage control unit, temperature-detecting device and warning device are equipped in fire alarm detection unit, linkage control unit is equipped with fire signal acknowledgement key；Each fire zone is equipped with valve control unit, and linkage control unit connecting valve control unit is equipped with subregion selector valve between linkage control unit and valve control unit；Valve control unit connects the motor-driven valve being arranged on power source supply line；Compressed air foam extinguishing unit connects linkage control unit, and compressed air foam extinguishing unit includes mixing chamber, is the mixed liquor of water, compressed air and foam in mixing chamber.Fire zone is in parallel, and compressed-air foam can be directly injected into disaster area by fire extinguishing system, forms foam blanket on fire zone surface, fuel shutoff effectively stamps out a fire.
assignees: HEBEI ANGONG FIRE PROTECTION SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of wireless ad hoc network construction method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to self-organizing network application technologies, it is therefore an objective to a kind of wireless ad hoc network construction method is provided, for constructing disaster field monitoring early-warning system.Technical solution of the present invention is characterized in that: monitoring disaster keypoint part with photographic device, live prompt person is prompted to withdraw with warning device, the photographic device and warning device are carried and installed with cushion cap, photographic device sends data to server by wireless receiving and dispatching terminal, and server sends instructions to the photographic device and warning device by wireless receiving and dispatching terminal.The present invention is for common radio network, it does not need to increase any network infrastructure, without wiring between radio receiving transmitting module, install, migrate it is more convenient, system has better robustness, and it is suitble in disaster field rapid build and implementation, to carry out auxiliary rapidly and assist the work such as earthquake relief work.The present invention plays video monitoring, and secondary disaster early warning commands the effects of providing foundation for Disaster relief countermeasure.
assignees: CHENGDU HENGAN POLICE EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: A kind of extremely frigid zones Mine Geological Disasters warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of extremely frigid zones Mine Geological Disasters warning devices, including integrated Temperature Humidity Sensor and multipoint displacement meter, integrated temperature-humidity signal transmitter is installed at the top of the integration Temperature Humidity Sensor, displacement display instrument is installed at the top of the integration temperature-humidity signal transmitter, it is mutually fixed by connecting plate between the integration Temperature Humidity Sensor and integrated temperature-humidity signal transmitter and integrated temperature-humidity signal transmitter and displacement display instrument, the signal input part of the signal output end access displacement display instrument of the multipoint displacement meter.The utility model has installed loudspeaker in combined aural and visual alarm side, it is more than critical value settling and being displaced, pass through the effect of loudspeaker, it is released again after the alarm signal that original combined aural and visual alarm occurs being amplified by circuit, original alarm range can be expanded, in order to which neighbouring mine staff stops working and withdraws as early as possible, it is conducive to increase safety.
assignees: BEIJING GEOLOGICAL AND MINERAL EXPLOR AND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Transmission tower method for early warning under a kind of typhoon weather
abstract_en: The present invention relates to transmission tower method for early warning under a kind of typhoon weather, the method comprises the following steps: step 1: determining that early warning starts point；Step 2: point Short-term Forecast information is started according to early warning and issues initial early warning result；Step 3: according to meteorological observatory during typhoon conduct by when the nowcasting information issued constantly update real-time early warning result.This method sufficiently combines the Short impending information of meteorological department's typhoon forecast to provide the initial early warning and real-time early warning result of shaft tower failure for grid company, to ensure the accuracy of early warning result and improving early warning result computational efficiency, in entire prealarming process, the present invention has comprehensively considered the Flood inducing factors such as mima type microrelief, shaft tower material, typhoon cumulative function time and wind speed, it is ensured that the reasonability and validity of early warning result.

title_en: Multistage network control center implementation method towards satellite emergency communication system
abstract_en: The multistage network control center implementation method towards satellite emergency communication system that the invention discloses a kind of.Web service is provided by basic network service processes ABS, pass through unified interface proxy requests to network control program NCP, NCP passes through RPC administrative center station Channel Elements, the unified interface that ABS is provided from differentiated control device LTL obtains rating information, LTL constantly updates the information of topological network by way of broadcast, ABS transmits event message to message server MTW, the real-time upload information of MTW to user browser by unified interface.The each network control center for using the method for the present invention to design can be with independent operating, the accessible lower rank network control center, upper network control centre.
assignees: NANJING COM WAVE COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of staple crops Low temperature disaster remote sensing monitoring forecast system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to crops disaster monitoring technical fields, disclose a kind of staple crops Low temperature disaster remote sensing monitoring forecast system and method, it is provided with central operation device and controller, central operation device and controller connect with infrared remote sensing information monitor and control its working condition, then can send Low temperature disaster early warning to Low temperature disaster precursor.Crops Low temperature disaster index collector, modifier is improved with infrared remote sensing information monitor, disaster index and information-storing device is connected, the information that acceptable infrared remote sensing information monitor is sent, and modifier is improved with disaster index and is communicated, the index being collected into can also be sent in information-storing device and store by timely synchronized update.The present invention is stored and is compared to data target, and the Low temperature disaster that can may be arrived to future is forecast, the peasant of region crops is made to carry out precautionary measures in advance, is influenced from Low temperature disaster suffered by the crops of region is reduced, is ensured the interests of peasant.

title_en: A kind of early warning system of geological disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of early warning systems of geological disaster, comprising: monitoring data for obtaining the geologic data of field monitoring instrument acquisition, and are transmitted to data processing module by data acquisition module；Data processing module, data in abnormality in the monitoring data for identification, and the data in abnormality are rejected；Data management module, for saving treated monitoring data and basic data；Forecast analysis module, for obtaining geological hazards prediction value according to the monitoring data after preset BP neural network algorithm calculation processing；Alarm commander's module, for after hazard prediction value is more than preset geological disaster secure threshold, determine corresponding disaster loss grade according to hazard prediction value, and according to disaster loss grade determine it is corresponding withdraw information, by the disaster loss grade and it is described withdraw information and be sent to mobile terminal show.Solve the problems, such as that prior art geo-hazard early-warning is not accurate enough.
assignees: GUANGZHOU URBAN PLANNING & DESIGN SURVEY RES INST;GUANGZHOU GEOLOGIC SURVEY INST

title_en: A kind of comprehensive security monitoring management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of comprehensive security monitoring management systems, including processor, monitoring obtains module, data processing module, route planning module, broadcast sub-control module, SMS transmission module and database, service interface is electrically connected on the processor, the processor and monitoring obtain module, data processing module, route planning module, broadcast sub-control module, SMS transmission module and database are electrically connected, steps are as follows for a kind of this realization of comprehensive security monitoring management system: monitoring obtains, the condition of a disaster and personnel's distributional analysis, data are sent, best route planning, broadcast sub-control, synthesis security monitoring management system design is reasonable, when the condition of a disaster occurs, it can know that personnel withdraw with most fast speed and optimal route, so as to effectively improve the safety of personnel.
assignees: XIAMEN QIHE INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-Invasive Handling of Sleep Apnea, Snoring and Emergency Situations
abstract_en: A monitoring non-invasive device for handling of sleep apnea, snoring and emergency situations operates for breathing assistance by means of transdermal stimulation of muscle groups including the pectoralis majoris, the serratus anterior, and the abdominal muscles. A wrist mounted version may alarm drivers or others requiring focus or concentration when they fall asleep and may alert a medical center. The invention may have a pulse oximeter on a person's wrist/finger to monitor their breathing while asleep, and in the event of a serious snoring or sleep apnea episode, activate the breathing assistance pulses.

title_en: Method For Supporting Connected Car Services In Shaded Area Based Mobile Device
title_ko: 모바일 디바이스 기반 음영지역에서의 커넥티드 카 서비스 지원 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile device-based connected car service supporting method in a shadow area, which receives position information and an emergency message through fixed type geo-fence transmitter in a shadow area difficult to receive the GPS. The mobile device-based connected car service supporting method comprises: a step of allowing a mobile device of a vehicle passenger to collect position information by using a GPS signal; a step of allowing the mobile device to generate a mobile virtual fence based on the collected position information; a step of allowing the mobile device to change the coverage of the generated mobile virtual fence according to a moving speed; a step of receiving position information and an emergency message from a fixed type geo-fence transmitter installed in a shadow area when a vehicle enters the shadow area difficult to receive the GPS signal; and a step of receiving the emergency message from a mobile device of another vehicle included in a connectivity group by recognizing the position according to the GPS signal when getting out of the shadow area.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 GPS 수신이 어려운 음영지역에서 고정식 지오펜스 발신기를 통하여 위치 정보와 긴급 메시지를 전송받는 모바일 디바이스 기반 음영지역에서의 커넥티드 카 서비스 지원 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 차량 탑승자의 모바일 디바이스가 GPS 신호를 이용하여 위치 정보를 수집하는 단계; 상기 모바일 디바이스가 수집된 위치 정보에 기초하여 모바일 가상 펜스를 생성하는 단계; 상기 모바일 디바이스가 생성된 모바일 가상 펜스의 커버리지를 이동속도에 따라 변경하는 단계; 상기 GPS 신호를 수신하기 어려운 음영지역에 차량이 진입한 경우 상기 음영직역에 설치된 고정식 지오펜스 발신기로부터 위치 정보와 긴급 메시지를 전송받는 단계; 상기 음영지역을 벗어나면 GPS 신호에 따라 위치 인식하여 연결성 그룹에 속한 다른 차량의 모바일 디바이스로부터 긴급 메시지를 전송받는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: GANGNEUNG WONJU NAT UNIV IND ACAD COOP GROUP

title_en: Method For Transmitting Alarm Message Based Mobile Device In Connected Car Services
title_ko: 모바일 디바이스 기반 커넥티드 카 서비스를 위한 긴급 메시지 전송 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for sending an emergency message for a mobile device-based connected car service. The method comprises: a step of allowing a mobile device of a vehicle passenger to collect position information by using a GPS signal; a step of allowing the mobile device to generate a mobile virtual fence independently applied to a relevant client based on the collected position information; a step of allowing the mobile device to change the coverage of the generated mobile virtual fence according to a moving speed; a step of allowing the mobile device to sense the latitude and the longitude at regular intervals, and determine the moving direction of a vehicle corresponding to the mobile device according to a latitude difference between the previous latitude value and the current latitude value, and a longitude difference between the previous longitude value and the current longitude value; a step of allowing a management server, which receives the determined direction information from the mobile device, to be connected to at least one mobile virtual fence and recognize a vehicle included in a connectivity group forming a fence network; a step of allowing the management server to relatively compare the latitude value and the longitude value of the mobile device included in the connectivity group, determine the order of mobile devices included in the connectivity group, and transmit the order to the mobile device; and a step of allowing the mobile device to select a following vehicle among a plurality of vehicles included in the connectivity group according to the order information of mobile devices from the management server, and send an emergency message. According to the present invention, a preceding vehicle is capable of avoiding unnecessary or overlapping messages.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 모바일 디바이스 기반 커넥티드 카 서비스를 위한 긴급 메시지 전송 방법은, 차량 탑승자의 모바일 디바이스가 GPS 신호를 이용하여 위치 정보를 수집하는 단계; 상기 모바일 디바이스가 수집된 위치 정보에 기초하여 해당 클라이언트에 독립적으로 적용하는 모바일 가상 펜스를 생성하는 단계; 상기 모바일 디바이스가 생성된 모바일 가상 펜스의 커버리지를 이동속도에 따라 변경하는 단계; 상기 모바일 디바이스가 일정 간격으로 위도와 경도를 감지하고, 이전 위도값과 현재 위도값의 위도 차이와 이전 경도값과 현재 경도값의 경도 차이에 따라 모바일 디바이스에 대응하는 차량의 이동 방향을 결정하는 단계; 상기 모바일 디바이스로부터 결정된 방향 정보를 전송받은 관리서버가 적어도 하나의 모바일 가상 펜스로 연결되어 펜스 네트워크를 형성하는 연결성 그룹에 속하는 차량을 인식하는 단계; 상기 관리서버가 연결성 그룹에 속하는 모바일 디바이스의 위도값과 경도값을 상대 비교하여 연결성 그룹에 속하는 모바일 디바이스의 순서를 결정하여 상기 모바일 디바이스로 전송하는 단계; 상기 모바일 디바이스가 관리서버로부터의 모바일 디바이스의 순서 정보에 따라 연결성 그룹에 속하는 복수 차량 중 후행 차량을 선별하여 긴급 메시지를 전송하는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: GANGNEUNG WONJU NAT UNIV IND ACAD COOP GROUP

title_en: Apparatus for Informing Door Opening and Indicating Position of Panic Bar
title_ko: 도어 개방 알림 및 패닉바 위치표시장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for informing door opening and indicating location of a panic bar. Specifically, the apparatus for informing door opening and indicating position of the panic bar notifies the disabled that a door is opened, so that it is possible to effectively prevent the collision with an opening door, and since location of the panic bar is easily acknowledged, the disabled can quickly open the door and evacuate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도어 개방 알림 및 패닉바 위치표시장치에 관한 것으로, 도어의 반대편에 있는 사람 특히 장애인에게 도어가 개방됨을 알려줌으로써 개방되는 도어와의 충돌을 효과적으로 방지하고 화재발생시 패닉바의 위치가 용이하게 시인될 수 있어 도어를 신속하게 열고 대피할 수 있도록 한 도어 개방 알림 및 패닉바 위치표시장치이다.
assignees: IDGATE CO LTD;YUNZUTECH CO LTD;LEE KWANG HYUN

title_en: Instruction, method of reseptance and the device of paging control information, storage medium, base station, terminal
abstract_en: A kind of instruction of paging control information, method of reseptance and device, storage medium, base station, terminal, the indicating means of the paging control information comprises determining whether carrying first kind paging control information and the second class paging control information, the first kind paging control information includes the instruction of system information update notification, the instruction of ETWS notice and CMAS notice instruction, and the second class paging control information includes the instruction of paging message scheduling information；According to the first predetermined bit domain of determining result configuration DCI, first predetermined bit domain is 2 bits.The technical solution provided through the invention, it can indicate the paging control information while the first kind paging control information and the second class paging control information occur, it can support connected state UE, Idle state UE and inactive state UE while receive and obtaining respectively required paging control information, save resource, paging efficiency is improved, defect of the existing technology is overcome.
assignees: BEIJING SPREADTRUM HIGH TECH COMMUNICATIONS TECH CO LTD

title_en: An system and method for preventing child safety accident using an intelligent boarding and alerting apparatus
title_ko: 지능형 승하차 알림 장치를 이용한 어린이 안전사고 방지 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system which applies an intelligent getting on and off system to provide a system which can prevent the number of remaining children and car accidents through event occurrences such as shock detection, movement detection, pressure detection, and voice detection, when children fall asleep or hide in the car and a person in charge is not aware off whether the children got off the car. As a result, parents monitors school bus route to and from school buses for young children in daycare centers and kindergartens with software in real time, and a location to and from the school can be changed and modified through two-way communication means when an emergency situation occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지능형 승하차 시스템을 적용하여 잠 들었을 때, 숨거나 하는 경우 하차유무를 책임자가 인지를 못하는 경우에 대하여 잔류인원의 충격 감지, 움직임 감지, 압력감지, 음성감지를 이벤트 발생을 통해 어린이 잔류인원과 차량 사고를 방지할 수 있는 시스템을 제안하고, 그에 따른 소프트웨어로 어린이집이나 유치원 등을 다니는 어린 자녀들이 타고 있는 통학버스의 등하교 경로를 부모가 실시간으로 모니터링하고 긴급 상황 발생 시 양방향 통신수단을 통하여, 등하교 위치를 변경신청 및 수정할 수 있는 지능형 승하차 알림 장치를 이용한 어린이 안전사고 방지 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Validating the operation of a transducer and an audio signal path
abstract_en: Systems and methods for validating the operation of a transducer and an audio signal path to the transducer. An example method includes switching, with an audio switch, the audio signal path between an audio power amplifier and an analog-to-digital converter. The method includes routing an audio signal received from the transducer to the analog-to-digital converter when the audio power amplifier is not enabled. The method includes, upon receiving a button signal, processing, with an electronic processor, a digital version of the audio signal received from the analog-to-digital converter to generate a sample. The method includes comparing the sample to a reference audio sample. The method includes generating an alert when the sample does not match the reference audio sample.

title_en: A kind of safety early warning device for blast working
abstract_en: The utility model relates to Technology of Blasting fields, and disclose a kind of safety early warning device for blast working, including bottom plate, and the lower rotation of the bottom plate is connected with universal wheel, and the inside of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with screw fastening frame.This is used for the safety early warning device of blast working, the device is located at spacious and common place by setting, the outside of the device is fixedly connected to warning lamp and warning horn to early warning, and warning lamp and warning horn are powered by power supply, and electric quantity of power supply can be charged after using up by charging interface external circuit, it can early warning needing explosion to sound an alarm warning lamp and warning horn, quick early warning is achieved the effect that, regulation handle need to be only shaken when passing through dismounting keeps chassis contact ground or disengaging ground i.e. detachable, device dismounting can be made very convenient, it is set to have the problem of life danger to which effective solution staff has little time to withdraw blast working on-the-spot meeting.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting emergency headlamp with antenna
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of fire-fighting emergency headlamp with antenna, circuit block, battery, antenna element, illumination lamp part, power supply line are expanded including emergency lighting lamp housing, control panel component, master control, the utility model has the beneficial effects that: for the radio transmission antenna on fire-fighting emergency headlamp, multifarious radio function can be achieved to expand, be effectively utilized the space advantage of fire-fighting emergency headlamp and the resource of long-time power supply and spare storage battery；Inside, which uses MCU monitoring, can effectively improve the reliability that bright circuit block is looked after in photograph, can provide prompt when its circuit has exception and use is done in protection；Increase loudspeaker pronunciation prompt, there are when fire hazard, security personnel or security system can radio speech prompting correctly personnel is guided to withdraw, ensure life safety；On the basis of original function, fire-fighting emergency headlamp can be expanded and be used from preparation, accomplish the function of prevention or early warning.
assignees: SHENZHEN TYCO CORE TECH CO LTD

title_en: System is monitored based on wireless sensing and the geo-hazard early-warning of the communication technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses the geo-hazard early-warnings based on wireless sensing and the communication technology to monitor system, and a point emergency platform is in communication in main emergency platform；Point emergency platform is provided with the acquisition module for collection site data；Acquisition module collection site data, point emergency platform will be sent to main emergency platform after on-site data processing；By treated, field data generates disaster alarm data to main emergency platform in conjunction with geography information；When disaster alarm data be more than warning value when, main emergency platform to divide emergency platform sending early warning；Warning information is sent to the corresponding area of disaster alarm data more than warning value according to geography information by point emergency platform.The present invention is based on wireless sensings and the geo-hazard early-warning of the communication technology to monitor system, by the way that above-mentioned platform is arranged, it realizes comprehensive early warning to geological disaster and its secondary disaster when geological disaster occurs, and for subsequent rescue work and withdraws work good reference is provided.

title_en: Wireless communication method, communication device, chip and system
title_ko: 무선 통신 방법 및 통신 장치
abstract_en: Provided are a wireless communication method, a communication device, a chip, and a system, which can reduce the complexity of a UE and power consumption. The method is applied to the terminal equipment in the connection state, and comprises the following steps: the terminal equipment receives a special signaling sent by the network equipment; and the terminal equipment acquires the updated system broadcast information according to the special signaling. According to the wireless communication method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the terminal equipment in the connected state acquires the changed system broadcast information by receiving the special signaling sent by the network equipment, so that the situation that the change indication information of the system broadcast is acquired by acquiring the paging message is avoided, and the complexity and the power consumption of the UE can be further reduced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 무선 통신 방법, 통신 장치, 칩과 시스템을 제공하여, UE의 복잡성 및 전력 소모를 낮출 수 있다. 해당 방법은 연결 상태의 단말 장치에 적용되고, 해당 방법에는, 해당 단말 장치는 네트워크 장치가 송신하는 전용 신호를 수신하며; 해당 단말 장치가 해당 전용 신호에 의하여, 업데이트된 시스템 방송 정보를 취득하는 것이 포함된다. 본 발명의 실시예의 무선 통신 방법에서, 연결 상태에 처한 단말 장치는 네트워크 장치가 송신하는 전용 신호를 수신하는 것을 통하여 변경된 시스템 방송 정보를 취득하여, 페이징 메시지를 취득하는 방식을 통하여 시스템 방송의 변경 지시 정보를 취득하는 것을 피하고, 나아가 UE의 복잡성 및 전력 소모를 낮출 수 있다.
assignees: OPPO GUANGDONG MOBILE TELECOMMUNICATIONS CO LTD

title_en: Determination of seismic notification to reduce seismic notification time of earthquake early warning system for artificial earthquake and natural earthquake
title_ko: 인공지진 및 자연지진에 대한 지진조기경보 시스템의 지진통보시간을 단축하기 위한 지진통보 결정방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an earthquake notification determination method performed in an earthquake early warning system for artificial earthquakes and natural earthquakes, which collects earthquake information measured in real time at each earthquake observatory through an integrated earthquake observation network, which comprises: a step of receiving new earthquake information renewed when a combination of new Assoc. observatories is added while a trigger observatory increases as a P-wave phase propagates from an epicenter (S100); and a step of quickly notifying an earthquake when the new earthquake information has a noticeable reliability and is determined as a quick earthquake notification by a logical condition considering spatial characteristics of the earthquake observatory and the magnitude of energy of P waves and S waves.

title_en: Back safety display apparatus
title_ko: 후방 안전 표시장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rear safety indicating device comprising: a display panel and sunshade installed on a rear windshield of a vehicle; a rear horn unit installed at a rear end of the vehicle; and a control unit provided in an interior space of the vehicle and connected to the display panel, the sunshade, and the rear horn unit to control driving of each device. The device stores, in a memory, text and voice messages corresponding to a danger signal including forward accidents or vehicle breakdown conditions of a driving vehicle, a rescue request signal following abduction or patient occurrence, and a reminder signal to change lanes, refrain from retaliatory driving, and notify a government office if necessary. The device may select the stored message and output the message to a vehicle or pedestrians in a rear side.
abstract_ko: 후방 안전 표시장치에 관한 것으로, 자동차의 후측 윈드글라스에 설치되는 디스플레이 패널과 햇빛 가리개, 자동차의 후단부에 설치되는 후방 경적 유닛 및 자동차의 실내 공간에 마련되고, 상기 디스플레이 패널과 햇빛 가리개 및 후방 경적 유닛과 통신 가능하게 연결되어 각 장치의 구동을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 후방의 차량이나 행인들에게 주행 차량의 전방 사고 상황이나 차량 고장 상태를 포함하는 위험신호, 납치나 환자 발생에 따른 구조 요청신호, 차선 변경, 보복운전의 자제를 요청하고 필요 시 관공서에 신고를 알리는 알림 신호에 대응되는 문자 및 음성 메시지를 메모리에 저장하며, 저장된 메시지를 선택해서 출력할 수 있다.

title_en: Label and timing device
abstract_en: A label is disclosed including a fixing portion to fix the label to an object and a timing device. The timing device includes a timer to monitor a predetermined first time period, a signalling apparatus that provides an alert signal on expiry of the first time period, a power source to supply power to the timer and the signalling apparatus, a reset device operable to restart a monitoring of the first time period, and a reset controller configured to permit operation of the reset device only if it determines that one or more conditions are met. In an additional or alternative arrangement, the reset controller is configured to permit operation of the reset device based on receipt of an external signal from an external source.

title_en: Traffic accident situ anti-intrusion warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses traffic accident situ anti-intrusion warning systems, including prevent swarming into alarm system and radar velocity measurement alarm system and Cloud Server；It is described to prevent that swarming into alarm system includes prior-warning device and radio alarming lamp end；The radar velocity measurement alarm system includes the radar velocity measurement alarm system front end for vehicle speed measuring, the radar velocity measurement alarm system rear end for alarm；Radar velocity measurement alarm system rear end includes the second handheld terminal and warning device；Radar velocity measurement alarm system front end includes the first handheld terminal and radar velocity measurement device.The utility model can judge scene of a traffic accident back car speed, if overspeed of vehicle is alarmed rapidly；When there is vehicle to knock the prior-warning device on cone tank down, can and alarm, remind live fire-fighting and rescue personnel to withdraw in time；The life security of Field Force is effectively ensured；Improve safety warning effect and alarm accuracy.
assignees: SICHUAN REX SMART TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of sensing control robot based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of sensing control robot based on artificial intelligence, including robot body, data acquisition module, Data Analysis Services module and intelligent decision module, when Infection probability reaches certain threshold value, robot can issue automatically alarm using combined aural and visual alarm, and further according to the analysis to different zones air quality and Infection probability, intelligent decision module can be robot planning route automatically, keep it intelligently poor to air quality, the high region of Infection probability is mobile, sensing control processing is carried out to the panel region, distributed storage and calculating can be carried out to sensing control monitoring data simultaneously, so that medical staff grasps environment in institute whenever and wherever possible, infection control situation, realize the real-time of sensing control work, validity and the accuracy present invention intelligently can carry out decision to data analysis result, in time to the infection state of an illness potential in institute It is effectively controlled and is alerted, avoid huge medical treatment loss and casualties caused by Epidemic outbreak of disease.
assignees: BIANYUAN INTELLIGENT RES INSTITUTE NANJING CO LTD;UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Flood risk early warning and evacuation system based on GIS positioning technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood risk early warning and evacuation system and method based on a GIS positioning technology, which comprises the following steps: the information storage module is used for: aerial pictures of landforms on two sides of the river channel are provided for the geographic information module, predicted flood flow at a specific time point is provided for the flood dynamic monitoring module, and predicted single-flood peak maximum flow is provided for the flood area division module. The geographic information module is used for: river channel section information is provided for the flood dynamic monitoring module, and geographical information on two banks of the river channel is provided for the flood area dividing module, and the information is provided on a public coordinate map in the geographical information module. The flood dynamic monitoring module is used for: and providing the flooding water level for the flood area dividing module. The flood area division module is used for: and providing flood inundation area and flood influence area range information for the early warning evacuation module. The invention has the advantages that: the three-dimensional characteristic curved surface information, the three kinds of flood area range information and the public coordinate map are combined, and the processes of actively releasing the early warning information and withdrawing schemes are flexible and convenient.

title_en: Method for providing low-power iot communication-based geo-fence service on basis of context awareness information of position tracking device
title_ko: 위치 추적기의 상황인지 정보를 기반으로 한 저전력 iot 통신 기반 지오펜스 서비스 제공 방법
abstract_en: A method for providing a low-power IoT communication-based geo-fence service on the basis of context awareness information of a position tracking device can comprise the steps of: allowing a context analysis engine of a position tracking device to measure context awareness information, obtained from peripheral sensors capable of receiving signals from the surroundings, such as a user's heart rate, body temperature, and movement state; determining whether a situation is emergency or ordinary on the basis of the context awareness information measured by the context analysis engine of the position tracking device; transmitting an emergency message and a measured position value to a server by using low-power IoT communication when the situation is determined to be emergency; after transmitting the emergency message, selecting a module capable of stably tracking a position from among a global positioning system (GPS), wireless fidelity (Wi-Fi) sniffing, Bluetooth low energy (BLE), and ultrawide band (UWB) modules of the position tracking device for position tracking; measuring mobile position information of a position tracking device user by using the selected position tracking module; checking whether the measured mobile position information, and the context awareness information, obtained from the peripheral sensors capable of receiving signals from the surroundings, such as the user's heart rate and body temperature can be transmitted by being converted through real-time communication; transmitting the context awareness information to the server at a frequent transmission cycle and at a data rate higher than that of ordinary times through real-time communication, if transmission through real-time communication is possible; receiving an emergency cancellation message from a server manager on the basis of the mobile position information and the context awareness information; and receiving the emergency cancellation message, and then transmitting, to the server, the context awareness information, obtained from the peripheral sensors capable of receiving signals from surroundings of the position tracking device user, such as the heart rate, body temperature and movement state, by converting the context awareness information through low-power IoT communication at a reduced transmission cycle and at a data rate lower than that of an emergency.
abstract_ko: 위치 추적기의 상황인지 정보를 기반으로 한 저전력 IoT 통신 기반 지오펜스 서비스 제공 방법은 위치 추적기의 상황분석 엔진에서 사용자의 심박수, 체온, 이동 상태,주변에서 신호를 받을 수 있는 주변 센서들로부터의 상황인지 정보를 측정하는 단계, 상기 위치측정기의 상황분석엔진에서 측정된 상황인지 정보를 기반으로 긴급상황인지 평시 상황인지 판단하는 단계, 긴급 상황이라고 판단된 경우, 긴급 상황 메시지와 측정된 위치값을 저전력 IoT 통신방식을 이용하여 서버로 전송하는 단계, 상기 긴급 상황 메시지 전송 후, 위치추적을 위해 위치 추적기의 GPS(Global Positioning System), WIFI(Wireless Fidelity) Sniffing, BLE(Bluetooth Low Energy), UWB (Ultra Wide Band) 모듈 중 안정적인 위치 추적이 가능한 모듈을 선정하는 단계, 상기 선정된 위치 추적 모듈을 이용하여 위치 추적기 사용자의 이동 위치 정보를 측정하는 단계, 상기 측정된 이동 위치 정보와 위치 추적기 사용자의 심박수 및 체온 및 주변에서 신호를 받을 수 있는 주변 센서들로부터 상황인지 정보를 실시간 통신 방식으로 전환하여 전송가능한지를 체크하는 단계, 상기 실시간 통신 방식으로 전송 가능 하다면 실시간 통신 방식으로 평시보다 높은 데이터 rate과 잦은 송신 주기로 상황인지 정보를 서버로 전송하는 단계, 상기 이동 위치 정보 및 상황인지 정보를 기반으로 서버 관리자로부터 긴급상황 해지 메시지를 수신하는 단계, 및 상기 긴급 상황 해지 메시지를 수신한 후 위치 추적기 사용자의 심박수 및 체온 및 이동 상태, 주변에서 신호를 받을 수 있는 주변 센서들로부터 상황인지 정보를 긴급상황시보다 낮은 데이터 rate 및 줄여진 송신 주기로 저전력 IoT 통신 방식으로 전환하여 서버로 전송하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Force transmission system for individual disaster broadcasting
title_ko: 개별 재난방송 강제 송출시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a forced individual disaster broadcasting transmission system. The technical task to be solved of the present invention is to immediately transmit an individual disaster broadcast to a user who uses a radio channel or DMB channel without changing the radio channel or DMB channel in a radio shadow area such as a tunnel or underground parking lot. The forced individual disaster broadcast transmission system, according to the present invention, transmits terrestrial radio and DMB broadcasts through a signal amplifying repeater in underground spaces such as a tunnel and transmits individual disaster broadcast audio signals to all channels of the terrestrial radio and terrestrial DMB through a switching part in case of an emergency such as a disaster.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 개별 재난방송 강제 송출 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해결하기 위한 기술적 과제는 터널이나 지하주차장과 같이 전파 음영 지역에서 이용자가 라디오 채널이나 디엠비 채널을 변경하지 않고도, 라디오 채널이나 디엠비 채널을 이용하고 있는 사용자에게 즉각적으로 개별 재난방송이 송출되도록 하는 개별 재난방송 강제 송출시스템을 제공하는 데 있다. 
그에 따른 본 발명의 개별 재난방송 강제 송출 시스템은 터널과 같은 지하공간에서 신호증폭 중계기를 통해 지상파 라디오 및 지상파 디엠비 방송을 송출하고, 재난과 같은 긴급상황시에 스위칭부를 절체시켜 자체적으로 마련된 개별 재난방송 음성신호 및 영상신호가 지상파 라디오 및 지상파 디엠비 방송의 전 채널로 송출되도록 한다.
assignees: HUTON;DONG SHIN INFORMATION COMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: risk identification rescue method and system based on coordination of smart watch and smart phone
abstract_en: the risk identification rescue method and system based on the coordination of the smart watch and the smart phone are characterized in that a data acquisition component acquires positioning information data and heart rate information data of a field operation user; the data processing component judges whether the field operation user has poisoning, fainting and falling conditions; the data encryption component encrypts and isolates the acquired data; the data transmission component transmits the encrypted data to the mobile phone end; the management user invites the field operation user and the supervision user to form a community space through the invitation component; the data decryption component decrypts the received data; the risk early warning component is used for triggering a risk alarm by a field operation user, a management user or a supervision user, and the field operation user withdraws according to the risk alarm; and the equipment control component is used for shutting down the field operation equipment according to a preset instruction after the risk early warning component triggers a risk alarm. The intelligent identification and interactive rescue of the working staff in the industrial toxic environment are realized, and the limit of privacy disclosure risk examination is avoided.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted satellite antenna non-recovery detection alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection alarm device is not retrieved to on-vehicle satellite antenna. The device includes position detection device and alarm device, position detection device is used for detecting whether on-vehicle antenna is located the recovery position, alarm device is connected with position detection device to receive on-vehicle satellite antenna's position signal, alarm device is connected with car ignition switch, alarm device includes the warning subassembly, works as position detection device detects on-vehicle satellite antenna in the position of not retrieving, and when car ignition switch is located the ACC gear, the warning subassembly is put through with the battery, in order to send the warning suggestion. The utility model discloses a position detection part carries out position detection to on-vehicle satellite antenna, is in when detecting the antenna and does not withdraw the position, and when starting the vehicle-mounted communication, the warning subassembly can send the warning, reminds the user to withdraw as early as possible to it is impaired to avoid the antenna collision, adopts radio communication transmission signal, is convenient for be under construction and uses.
assignees: NANJING CHINA SPACENET SATELLITE TELECOM CO LTD

title_en: Fire fighter emergency rescue auxiliary lamp
abstract_en: The utility model provides a firefighter emergency rescue auxiliary lamp, pastes the layer including the flexibility, and the upside that the layer was pasted to the flexibility arranges the layer for the component, and the downside that the layer was pasted to the flexibility is for pasting the layer, arranges to be equipped with LED banks and ring lamp on the layer at the component, and the ring lamp passes through the lamp stand to be connected with the upside that the layer was pasted to the flexibility, is equipped with power pack and switch on the lamp stand. This kind of fireman emergency rescue auxiliary lamp, solved the fireman in current rescue, the limited problem of partial equipment, the remote illumination problem, solved the fireman at the attack simultaneously and evacuated direction problem and strength and drop into repeated search and rescue problem repeatedly, play the warning on the one hand, safety auxiliary problems such as illumination, on the other hand clearly reflects the fireman whether rescue to the place in the rescue, whether this place rescues and finishes, fireman rescue direction, avoid the fireman to search and rescue repeatedly, waste unnecessary rescue strength and rescue time, it withdraws the instruction direction to attack for the fireman simultaneously.

title_en: Highway construction support displacement monitoring devices
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a highway construction support displacement monitoring device, which comprises a protective box, wherein a fixing device is arranged on the left side surface of the protective box, a limiting device and a strain device are arranged on the left side surface of an inner cavity of the protective box, and a vertical monitoring device is arranged on the top surface of the inner cavity of the protective box; the current value that shows through the ampere meter changes, make the condition that the tour personnel can in time discover that the construction support produces the displacement and in time take effective reinforcement measure, avoid the further deterioration of vertical displacement condition, through the warning light, when the displacement that makes the construction support produce is great, the current increase volume is more, the brightness of warning light obviously increases, constructor can discover the condition of construction support displacement when the construction, so that the warning constructor withdraws as early as possible and takes effective measure to revise and consolidate the construction support, avoid the construction support to collapse and cause the casualties, the security of construction support use has been increased, the practicality of this highway construction support displacement monitoring devices has been improved.
assignees: YUNNAN CONSTRUCTION & INVEST HOLDING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Infrastructure disaster warning system and infrastructure disaster warning method
abstract_en: To provide an infrastructure disaster warning system that accurately grasps the risk of contact between an infrastructure facility and a monitored object even at construction sites where the location of the infrastructure facility may change.SOLUTION: An infrastructure disaster warning device includes: a position information acquisition part for acquiring a position of a monitored object that can move at a construction site based on a GPS signal obtained from a GPS terminal attached to the monitored object; an infrastructure position information storage part for storing infrastructure position information representing the location in a three-dimensional space where an infrastructure facility in the construction site is located; an update part for updating the infrastructure position information according to the construction status of the infrastructure facility; a determination part for determining whether the monitored object is within a predetermined range of the infrastructure facility based on the infrastructure position information stored in the infrastructure position information storage part and the position information of the monitored object; and a warning transmitting part for transmitting a warning to a terminal device that is notification destination based on the determination result.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Road safety early warning system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a road safety early warning system based on the Internet of things, which comprises an early warning safety cone barrel system, an intelligent operation clothes system and a terminal management system which are connected in a wireless way; the utility model discloses a road safety early warning system based on thing networking has the characteristics that information is learnt in advance, can remind the operation personnel to withdraw rapidly construction or accident handling scene, and the operation personnel can learn road surface information in advance, and then ensure personal safety.

title_en: Method for providing low-power iot communication-based geo-fence service on basis of context awareness information of position tracking device
abstract_en: A method for providing a low-power IoT communication-based geo-fence service on the basis of context awareness information of a position tracking device can comprise the steps of: allowing a context analysis engine of a position tracking device to measure context awareness information, obtained from peripheral sensors capable of receiving signals from the surroundings, such as a user's heart rate, body temperature, and movement state; determining whether a situation is emergency or ordinary on the basis of the context awareness information measured by the context analysis engine of the position tracking device; transmitting an emergency message and a measured position value to a server by using low-power IoT communication when the situation is determined to be emergency; after transmitting the emergency message, selecting a module capable of stably tracking a position from among a global positioning system (GPS), wireless fidelity (Wi-Fi) sniffing, Bluetooth low energy (BLE), and ultrawide band (UWB) modules of the position tracking device for position tracking; measuring mobile position information of a position tracking device user by using the selected position tracking module; checking whether the measured mobile position information, and the context awareness information, obtained from the peripheral sensors capable of receiving signals from the surroundings, such as the user's heart rate and body temperature can be transmitted by being converted through real-time communication; transmitting the context awareness information to the server at a frequent transmission cycle and at a data rate higher than that of ordinary times through real-time communication, if transmission through real-time communication is possible; receiving an emergency cancellation message from a server manager on the basis of the mobile position information and the context awareness information; and receiving the emergency cancellation message, and then transmitting, to the server, the context awareness information, obtained from the peripheral sensors capable of receiving signals from surroundings of the position tracking device user, such as the heart rate, body temperature and movement state, by converting the context awareness information through low-power IoT communication at a reduced transmission cycle and at a data rate lower than that of an emergency.

title_en: eCall Plus to eCall Only transition and recovery path
abstract_en: Responsive to detecting transition from an eCall Plus mode to an eCall Only mode, and to acknowledgement from a service delivery network (SDN) of an alert of the transition sent to the SDN by a telematics controller, the telematics controller reattaches to a network in eCall Only mode. Responsive to transition from eCall Only mode to eCall Plus mode, the controller reattaches to the network in eCall Plus mode.

title_en: Tunnel disaster prevention system
abstract_en: To make it possible to adequately determine a situation of insulation deterioration by continuing measurement and recording of line current without being disturbed by warning of current value abnormality even when the warning of current value abnormality is obtained via periodical measurement of current of a signal line to which a terminal apparatus is connected.SOLUTION: A tunnel disaster prevention system performs monitoring by connecting a terminal apparatus including a notification device and detector 16, 18 to a signal line drawn out from a disaster prevention reception board 10 into a tunnel. The disaster prevention reception board 10 includes line current monitoring means 72 for measuring and recording, in each predetermined period, a value of current flowing through the signal line to which the terminal apparatus is connected, determining current value abnormality and originating warning before notifying an external remote supervisory control facility 27 of the current value abnormality to make the facility originate warning when the measured value of current is equal to or larger than a predetermined threshold or exceeds the threshold, and canceling the current value abnormality before resuming current value measurement in each predetermined period when recovery operation by the disaster prevention reception board 10 or the remote supervisory control facility 27 is detected.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Firefighting alarm system using electricity device of apartment house
title_ko: 공동주택의 전기장치를 이용한 소방용 경보시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting alarm system using an electric device of an apartment house, wherein, when a fire extinguisher is separated from a holder for use because of a fire outbreak, an alarm is sounded from the holder to notify the fire outbreak to unspecified individuals. In addition, the present invention allows a user to input the inspection time and the expiration date of the fire extinguisher in person, in order to automatically inform the user when the inputted set values are reached. Moreover, when a fire extinguisher which has come to the end of the expiration date is replaced, information regarding the fire extinguisher is checked in a management server, such that the same may be replaced with a reliable fire extinguisher.
