title_en: Multifunctional electroacoustic calling device and using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional electroacoustic calling device and a using method thereof, wherein the multifunctional electroacoustic calling device comprises a microcontroller, a key module, a toxic gas sensor array, a voice prompt module, a Bluetooth audio module, a sound pick-up, a power amplification module, a miniature loudspeaker, a calling main cavity, a power supply module, a battery bin, a sensor assembling cavity, an assembling plate, a charging interface, an expiration cavity, a loudspeaker interface and a positioning module; the invention can monitor and early warn various environmental gases while completing sound amplification, and form gas data sharing through the Bluetooth networking of a plurality of electroacoustic devices, further realize the multi-point dynamic monitoring of the gas concentration in an operation area, and early warn the failure time of a filter by combining a timer, thereby realizing the real-time monitoring and early warning of the gas mask filter; the next moving route of the user can be pre-warned according to the regional gas concentration data of the operation site; rescue and evacuation routes may be effectively indicated when the filter is about to reach or has exceeded a threshold.
assignees: HUBEI HUAQIANG HIGH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Early warning method and device for fusion representation of multiple ocean physical fields based on graph convolution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for early warning fusion representation of multiple ocean physical fields based on graph convolution, wherein the method comprises the steps of utilizing a three-layer graph convolution neural network to update characteristics on multiple physical fields, and excavating interrelationships among different physical fields so as to update integral characteristic representations with comprehensive characteristics of different physical fields; the method comprises the steps of inputting integral characteristic representations with different physical field comprehensive characteristics and position coding information corresponding to the integral characteristic representations into double-layer time sequence attention by utilizing double-layer time sequence attention operation to obtain time period multi-physical field data characteristic coupling representation, taking the time period multi-physical field data characteristic coupling representation as global characteristic, mining time sequence information to predict Nino3.4 index, fusing Nino3.4 index with input typhoon observation data, and predicting typhoon intensity. The apparatus includes a processor and a memory. The method solves the problem that the prediction of the typhoon intensity in the sea area near the communication base station in the coastal area is not accurate enough in the prior art.

title_en: Integrated system and method for preventing and treating potential safety hazards and hazards based on production places
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of production safety, in particular to an integrated system and a method for preventing and treating potential safety hazards and hazards based on a production place, which comprises a filing module; a recording module; a timing module; a feedback module; a prompt module; a warning module; a call system and a cancellation module. According to the invention, the position of potential safety hazard and harm in the production place and the name of the object are input into the system, the staff is prompted to carry out regular inspection in a timing mode, the inspection result is input into the feedback module, and the system makes corresponding judgment according to the position information in the feedback module and the state of the name of the object, so that the position of potential safety hazard and harm in the production place and the object can be systematically observed in real time, and the potential safety hazard and harm which are not artificially generated are reduced as much as possible.
assignees: HENAN XINANLI VOCATIONAL HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Acousto-optic alarm device for emergency evacuation
abstract_en: The utility model provides an acousto-optic alarm device for promptly withdraw, include: at least 1 control panel, 1 control box and a plurality of warning indicator lamp boxes; the control panel is provided with a plurality of alarm buttons and is connected to the control box and used for sending alarm instructions of different alarm types to the control box through the operation of the alarm buttons; the control box is respectively connected to each alarm indicating lamp box through a cable and is used for starting the corresponding alarm indicating lamp box according to the received alarm instruction so as to start the indicating lamp corresponding to the type of the alarm instruction; the control box is also connected to the broadcast-in-the-machine and the communication-in-the-machine equipment, respectively, by cables. The utility model discloses technical scheme has solved the traditional lifesaving of aircraft and has reported an emergency and ask for help or increased vigilance the mode, owing to accomplish and adopt artifical propagation form to report an emergency and ask for help or increased vigilance the transmission of information probably has the deviation, and the condition is reported an emergency and asked for help or increased vigilance in timely, accurate reaction to withdraw the safety of personnel on the aircraft and bring great hidden danger problem.

title_en: System and method of reducing energy consumption of datalogger devices while maintaining high sampling rate and real time alarm function
abstract_en: A system for reducing energy consumption of datalogger devices while maintaining high sampling rate and real time alarm function is provided. The system comprises a datalogger device, an algorithm stored in the datalogger device, and an application stored in the datalogger device that when executed implements a regular high sampling interval and extended server update interval for non-emergency situations and based on detection of an alarm, implements an emergency state. Based on the implementation, the application sends an immediate alert to the server, maintains the high sampling rate, shortens update interval in accordance with at least algorithm processing of inputs, continues updating on the shortened interval based at least on continued algorithm processing, determines, based on at least one change in alarm activity, to exit the emergency state, and returns to the extended update interval.

title_en: Electrical fire monitoring system for petrochemical enterprises
abstract_en: The utility model provides an electrical fire monitoring system for petrochemical enterprises, wherein an EEPROM storage module, a communication module, a liquid crystal display module, a key module, an audible and visual alarm module, a relay output circuit and a power module circuit are all connected with a main controller; the temperature sensor and the remaining circuit mutual inductors are connected with the main controller through a signal detection circuit. The utility model has the advantages that: the realization is to the AD sampling of residual current, temperature signal and channel fault detection letter, and every way signal sampling is multiple to with all sampling points storage to the data cache district, main control unit handles the data collection, the residual current after will handling, the temperature, connect the fault signal numerical value and judge the processing, and obtain corresponding fault alarm state, acousto-optic warning module suggestion is unusual, with information update to liquid crystal display module simultaneously, accomplish timely initiative early warning, reach the purpose that reduces the fire loss.
assignees: TIANJIN C POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: The system which provides a disater notification contents
title_ko: 재난 알림 콘텐츠 제공시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for providing disaster notification contents (DNCs). The present invention systematically arranges/provides computer modules that can collect various DNCs by communicating with a sending agency server within a communication structure of a DNC sending agency server, a user information device, and the like. Accordingly, it is possible to select and receive only valid DNCs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 알림 콘텐츠(DNC: Disater Notification Contents) 제공시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에서는 DNC 발송 기관 서버, 사용자 정보기기 등의 통신 구조 내에, <DNC 발송 기관 서버와 통신하여, 각종 DNC를 수집할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <수집 완료된 DNC를 판독하여, DNC 관련 지역을 체크한 후, 체크된 DNC 관련 지역과 기 설정되어 있던 사용자 재난 관심 지역을 비교하여, 기 저장되어 있던 사용자들 중에서, 재난 관심 지역이 DNC 관련 지역과 일치하는 사용자들을 DNC 발송대상 사용자들로 결정할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <DNC 발송대상 사용자들로 결정된 DNC 발송대상 사용자 목록을 판독한 후, 판독된 DNC 발송대상 사용자 목록에 포함된 사용자들이 보유한 사용자 정보기기로 DNC를 발송/처리할 수 있는 전산모듈> 등을 체계적으로 배치/제공함과 아울러, <재난 관심 지역이 DNC 관련 지역과 일치하는 사용자들을 DNC 발송대상 사용자들로 결정하는 국면에서, 기 설정되어 있던 각 DNC 발송대상 사용자들의 '사용자 설정정보'를 판독하여, '사용자 설정 알림 제한 시간 정보'를 체크한 후, 현재의 시간이 '사용자 설정 알림 제한 시간'에 해당하는 일부 사용자들을 DNC 발송대상 사용자들에서 제외시키는 기술구성>, <재난 관심 지역이 DNC 관련 지역과 일치하는 사용자들을 DNC 발송대상 사용자들로 결정하는 국면에서, 기 저장되어 있던 각 DNC 발송대상 사용자들의 '사용자 DNC 수신 이력정보'를 판독하여, '이전 수신한 사용자의 DNC 버전 정보'를 체크한 후, '이전 수신한 DNC의 버전'이 '현재의 DNC 버전'과 동일한 일부 사용자들을 DNC 발송대상 사용자들에서 제외시키는 기술구성> 등을 체계적으로 구현하고, 이를 통해, 사용자 측에서, '모든 DNC를 무분별하게 수신하는 것이 아니라, 자신이 설정한 관심 지역과 관련이 있는 유효 DNC만을 선별하여 수신할 수 있는 이점', '동일한 내용(버전)의 DNC를 중복하여 수신하지 않게 되는 이점', '자신이 설정한 알림 제한 시간에는 DNC의 수신을 차단할 수 있게 되는 이점' 등을 효과적으로 향유할 수 있도록 지원함과 아울러, DNC 발송 기관 측에서도, 'DNC 발송 효율 향상 이점(즉, DNC의 불필요한 발송 남발로 인하여, 정작 DNC의 수신이 필요한 사용자에게는 해당 DNC를 발송하지 못하게 되는 문제점의 해결)'을 효과적으로 향유할 수 있도록 지원할 수 있다.

title_en: Smart city comprehensive safety management remote monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety control remote monitering equipment is synthesized in wisdom city, including the camera, the input electric connection of camera has the image acquisition unit, the output electric connection of image acquisition unit has image transmission module. The utility model discloses a design of this circuit can make this supervisory equipment possess alarming function and warning nature stronger effectively, the practicality and the security of equipment in wisdom city construction management have been promoted effectively and certain functional, satisfy user's user demand at present stage, can monitor the picture in real time with the real-time transmission of picture to distal end staff department and make the staff of distal end can monitor the picture in real time simultaneously, can report to the police and indicate the site personnel to withdraw in time by remote control audible-visual annunciator when producing the potential safety hazard, common remote monitoring equipment ubiquitous problem that does not possess alarming function in the market has been solved simultaneously.
assignees: SHENYANG RENHE XINCHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation test apparatus for fire protection sprinkler equipment and method thereof
title_ko: 소방용 스프링클러 모의 시험 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simulation test apparatus for a firefighting sprinkler and a method thereof. The simulation test apparatus for a firefighting sprinkler has various types of simple sprinkler devices installed on a device mount. The device mount includes: a frame for forming a body; and first and second support panels installed on the frame. The simple sprinkler devices include various firefighting system parts installed on the first and second support panels to demonstrate the working state of a sprinkler head. The simple sprinkler devices include water tanks, pumps, pressure gauges, valves, piping, detectors, alarms, receivers, control panels, and the like. Therefore, the simulation test apparatus has the simple sprinkler devices installed on the device mount so that students majoring in firefighting use the simple sprinkler devices to plan, design, manufacture, test, and evaluate the simple sprinkler devices in an educational field, thereby providing opportunities for the students to design, manufacture, and demonstrate the simple sprinkler devices, being immediately applied to practice in future, and greatly help to understand the importance of firefighting.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방용 스프링클러 모의 시험 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 소방용 스프링클러 모의 시험 장치는 기구물 거치대에 다양한 형태의 간이 스프링클러 설비를 설치한다. 기구물 거치대는 몸체를 형성하는 프레임과 프레임에 설치되는 제1 및 제2 지지 패널을 포함한다. 간이 스프링클러 설비는 제1 및 제2 지지 패널에 설치되어 스프링클러 헤드의 작동 상태를 시연할 수 있는 다양한 소방 설비 부품들을 포함한다. 간이 스프링클러 설비에는 수조, 펌프, 압력계, 밸브, 배관, 감지기, 경보기, 수신기 및 제어반 등을 포함한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 기구물 거치대에 간이 스프링클러 설비를 설치하여 교육 현장에서 소방을 전공으로 하는 학생들에게 간이 스프링클러 설비를 기획, 설계, 제작, 시험 및 평가하는데 활용하여 학생들로 하여금 직접 간이 스프링클러 설비를 설계 및 제작하여 시연해 볼 수 있는 기회를 제공하고, 향후 실무에 즉시 적용할 수 있으며, 소방의 중요성을 이해하는데 큰 도움을 줄 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and Method for stable P2P IoT communication
title_ko: 안정적인 P2P IoT 통신 제공장치 및 제공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for stably providing IoT communication, wherein the apparatus comprises: a stabilization device (1); and a specific server S (3), and the specific server S (3) includes an emergency message broker (4), and further comprises a smart power control device (2). By the apparatus for stably providing IoT communication, the method provides stable IOT communication when the public IP is changed and the stabilization device (1) detects the public IP change. In addition, when there is an emergency situation such as a power outage, the public IP address of the Internet router can be changed instantaneously, and communication may be interrupted the moment the public IP address is changed. For P2P communication between devices that are far away from the Internet, if the CPU of the Internet router directly performs the message broker function or if the message broker is operated in the device connected to the back of the Internet router, devices located remotely through the Internet router and Internet may cause communication failures. Accordingly, the present invention is to provide stable communication even at an abnormal moment by using an LPWAN communication device or a smart power control device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 안정적으로 IoT 통신을 제공하는 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로서,  
안정화장치(1) 및 특정서버"S"(3)를 포함하고, 상기 특정서버"S"(3)는 비상용 메시지브로커(4)를 포함하고, 스마트전원 제어장치(2)를 더 포함하는 안정적인 IOT 통신 제공장치에 의해 공인IP가 변경되고, 안정화장치(1)가 공인IP 변경을 감지한 경우 등에 있어 안정적인 IOT 통신을 제공하는 방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한, 정전 등과 같은 비상상황이 있게 되면 인터넷공유기의 공인IP 주소가 순간적으로 바뀔 수 있게 되고, 공인IP 주소가 바뀐 순간 통신이 중단될 수 있어, 인터넷에서 원거리로 떨어져 있는 장치들간에 P2P통신을 위하여 인터넷공유기의 CPU가 직접 메시지브로커 기능을 수행하거나 인터넷공유기 뒷면의 연결된 장치에 메시지브로커가 운용되는 경우, 인터넷공유기와 인터넷을 통하여 원거리에 위치한 장치들은 있는 통신장애가 발생할 수 있는 바, 본 발명에서는 LPWAN 통신장치를 이용하거나 또는 스마트전원제어장치를 이용하여 비정상적인 순간에도 안정적으로 통신을 제공하고자 하는 것이다.

title_en: Distributed disaster recovery drilling data early warning method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based distributed disaster recovery exercise data early warning method and system, wherein if a local edge node does not train a model, a central early warning model is uploaded to a local area for training, a local edge node server receives the central early warning model and then carries out associated data analysis and classification aggregation, a local prior probability, a local condition probability, a local adjustment factor and a local posterior probability are calculated and then input into the central early warning model for training to obtain an optimal disaster recovery exercise occurrence warning probability, data of the optimal disaster recovery exercise occurrence warning probability of each area are submitted to a central server to update the central early warning model, a headquarter exercise result database is updated, updated indexes after each training are stored, and a new round of model training is executed again by a central server program, so that the whole process is completed. According to the invention, disaster recovery drilling is taken as a main line, history drilling data is taken as an analysis basis, and artificial intelligence is introduced to replace artificial experience to replace an early warning model, so that the labor cost is greatly reduced.

title_en: Active power failure early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power failure active early warning method and device based on a Kafka message queue, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a plurality of terminal devices monitor power outage and restoration real-time messages at different nodes of a power grid and issue the power outage and restoration real-time messages to a Kafka cluster; the Kafka cluster server receives the power-off and power-on real-time message and pushes the power-off and power-on real-time message to a consumer subscribing the power-off and power-on real-time message; the dispatching automation platform subscribes to the power outage real-time message, generates an early warning power outage event and a power outage event according to the power outage real-time message, matches the early warning power outage event and the power outage event with the power outage event in the current power outage market, and if the matching is successful, combines the early warning power outage event with the matched power outage event to update the current power outage market; or deleting the power failure event corresponding to the power restoration event to update the current power failure bazaar, generating power restoration notification information, and sending the power restoration notification information to the mobile terminal of the corresponding power utilization client. According to the invention, the electricity consumption experience of the user can be improved.

title_en: Non-standard unsafe behavior detection system in campus
abstract_en: The invention discloses an irregular unsafe behavior detection system in a campus, which comprises a detection processing system and a warning system, wherein the detection processing system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module and a network updating module; the invention is arranged in any place needing to be supervised by the portable characteristic of the external mobile adjusting camera, increases the monitoring detection range, realizes real-time monitoring without dead angles, simultaneously detects and judges the acquired video image data through the behavior detection model, acquires the irregular behavior and the unsafe behavior of students, carries out early warning and reporting criticism, helps the students to improve the self-supervision habit and parallelism, updates the behavior detection model based on the neural network model, effectively improves the credibility of the detection result, has high intelligent degree, avoids safety accidents, and simultaneously reduces the labor intensity of the teacher for patrol.

title_en: Smart seismic device with life span and earthquake warning function
title_ko: 수명 및 지진 경보기능을 갖는 스마트 내진장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart seismic device with a lifespan and earthquake warning functions, which is installed under seismic-protected equipment such as a distribution board and the like. More specifically, between an upper base (20) below the seismic-protected equipment and a lower base (10) on the bottom, installed is a cushioning means (30) composed of a plate spring (32) as a core component for seismic isolation, a vibration-proof rubber (33), and a buffer spring (34), to provide cushioning support against vibrations and shocks caused by earthquakes. A switch operating portion (40) is provided in the center of the upper base (20) to be able to move up elastically. The switch operating portion (40) descends when the lifespan of the cushioning means is over, and stops at a stop operating portion (50) on the lower base, causing an operating rod (62) of a warning switch (60) installed on the upper base to be automatically pushed. When an earthquake occurs or the lifespan of a cushioning means expires, an automatic alarm is activated, so the smart seismic device helps the safe operation of the seismic-protected equipment can be promoted.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수배전반 등과 같은 내진 보호 설비 하부에 설치하는 수명 및 지진 경보기능을 갖는 스마트 내진장치에 관한 것으로서, 좀더 상세하게는 내진 보호 설비 하부의 상부 베이스(20)와 바닥의 하부 베이스(10) 사이로 내진을 위한 핵심 부품인 판스프링(32), 방진 고무(33), 완충 스프링(34)으로 구성된 완충 수단(30)을 설치하여 지진에 의한 진동 및 충격에 대해 완충 지지하도록 하되, 상기 상부 베이스(20) 중앙에 상부로 탄발 이동 가능하게 설치되는 스위치 작동부(40)가 지진 또는 완충 수단의 수명이 다하여 하강시 하부 베이스 상부의 스톱 작동구(50)에 스톱되면서 상부 베이스 상부에 설치되는 경보 스위치(60)의 작동 로드(62)를 푸쉬 작동하는 것에 의해 지진 또는 완충 수단의 수명이 다하게 됨을 자동 경보 작동하기 때문에 내진 보호 설비의 안전한 운전을 도모하도록 하는데 그 특징이 있다.

title_en: Method of updating new pattern on stretchable display bag, recording medium and device for performing the method
title_ko: 스트레처블 디스플레이 가방에 신상 패턴을 업데이트하는 방법, 이를 수행하기 위한 기록 매체 및 장치
abstract_en: A method of updating a new pattern on a stretchable display bag comprises the steps of: wirelessly communicating with a design provider of the stretchable display bag periodically; notifying a user that a design update is available when a new pattern for the stretchable display bag is released; activating an interface to enable the design of the stretchable display bag to be updated through a user's touch; providing the user with a list of updatable designs for the stretchable display bag; and downloading a design selected by the user to change at least one of the color, pattern, and texture of the stretchable display bag. Accordingly, the method allows users to change the color and pattern of the bag to their desired design by providing trend colors and pattern designs announced every season.
abstract_ko: 스트레처블 디스플레이 가방에 신상 패턴을 업데이트하는 방법은, 스트레처블 디스플레이(stretchable display) 가방의 디자인 제공사와 일정 주기마다 무선 통신하는 단계; 스트레처블 디스플레이 가방의 신상 패턴이 출시된 경우 사용자에게 디자인의 업데이트가 가능함을 알림하는 단계; 사용자의 터치에 의해 스트레처블 디스플레이 가방의 디자인 업데이트를 가능하도록 인터페이스를 활성화하는 단계; 업데이트가 가능한 스트레처블 디스플레이 가방의 디자인 리스트를 사용자에게 제공하는 단계; 및 사용자가 선택한 디자인을 다운로드하여 스트레처블 디스플레이 가방의 색, 패턴 및 질감 중 적어도 하나를 변경하는 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 따라, 시즌마다 발표되는 트렌드 컬러와 패턴 디자인을 제공하여 사용자가 원하는 디자인으로 가방의 컬러와 패턴을 변경할 수 있다.

title_en: Mining process data monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mining process data monitoring system, including central processing unit, central processing unit's input difference electricity is connected with information input module, power module and voice input module central processing unit's output difference electricity is connected with voice broadcast module, display module and dangerous processing module central processing unit's input electricity is connected with signal reception module's input difference electricity is connected with environmental monitoring module and information acquisition module. The utility model discloses possess the advantage of planning evacuation route and locating the staff, solved current mining process data monitored control system, only can simply monitor the internal environment of ore deposit usually, can not in time withdraw for staff's planning evacuation route when dangerous appearing, be unfavorable for the staff in time to break away from danger, can not fix a position each staff, be not convenient for to the problem that can not in time break away from dangerous staff and search for and rescue.

title_en: Automatic monitoring and early warning device for collapse danger of foundation pit construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of foundation pit construction, and discloses an automatic monitoring and early warning device for danger of foundation pit construction collapse, which comprises a shell, wherein a displacement sensor is arranged outside the shell, an alarm clock is arranged inside the shell, a rotating rod II is arranged inside the shell, one end of the rotating rod II is provided with a sliding rod II, the outer wall of one side of the sliding rod II is provided with a knocking rod, and one end of the knocking rod is positioned inside the alarm clock; the utility model discloses a warning clock, including casing, displacement sensor, circuit board, signal line two, motor, dwang one, dwang two, striking pole, alarm clock, the internally mounted of casing has the motor, the motor is used for the drive to strike the pole and removes, through setting up casing, displacement sensor, circuit board, signal line two, motor, dwang one, dwang two for strike the pole, alarm clock, remind the operation personnel to notice, when slide bar one and two separation of slide bar, drive slide bar two under the effect of spiral spring one and reset, thereby make to strike the pole and can repeat to strike alarm clock, make the operation personnel can in time withdraw.
assignees: BEIJING MUNICIPAL CONSTR CO LTD;BEIJING HIGH NEW MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Environment and gas detection device based on wireless technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment and gas detection device based on wireless technology, in particular to the technical field of environment and gas detection, which comprises an upper protective shell, wherein a wireless output control module is arranged in the upper protective shell, and an alarm component is embedded and installed at the top end of the wireless output control module; the alarm assembly comprises a buzzer which is embedded in the top end of the wireless output control module, and a temperature and humidity sensor is arranged on one side of the buzzer. The utility model discloses a set up the warning subassembly, on carrying the data display screen after wireless receiving module handles, wireless output control module starts bee calling organ and buzzes and reports to the police, and also can appear red warning area on the display screen, and mine personnel can report to the police through outside personnel suggestion and in-hand check out test set suggestion after knowing, reaches the effect of dual suggestion and warning, reminds personnel to withdraw fast, and the security is better.
assignees: FUZHOU YILI POWER ENG CO LTD

title_en: Alarm device for accurately positioning and installing extruded bleed-out of casting blank withdrawal and straightening machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an alarm device for accurately positioning and installing extruded bleed-out of a casting blank withdrawal and straightening machine, which comprises three cooling chambers, a withdrawal and straightening machine and a flame cutting machine which are sequentially arranged, and further comprises an infrared casting blank thermodetector, wherein the infrared casting blank thermodetector is arranged between the three cooling chambers and the withdrawal and straightening machine, a main controller is connected to the infrared casting blank thermodetector, and the main controller is a main control chamber computer and/or a local control PLC (programmable logic controller) capable of realizing serial port communication; and the early warning alarm is connected with the master controller. The utility model discloses an alarm device of accurate location installation casting blank withdrawal and straightening machine extrusion bleed-out has realized remote control, monitoring and management, will get into the temperature setting within range before the withdrawal and straightening machine to guarantee that the casting blank gets into the withdrawal and straightening machine smoothly, prevent in advance to get into and cause the personnel's injury that the bleed-out arouses on every side through the extrusion behind the withdrawal and straightening machine, and equipment damages thereof.

title_en: Integrated control monitoring system for live fish transport vehicles

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a monitoring system used for a live fish transport vehicle and, more specifically, to an integrated control monitoring system for a live fish transport vehicle, which measures and controls the state of water quality using various types of sensors and devices, thereby providing an environment optimized for long-distance transportation to maintain freshness, and preventing theft and accidents in advance by having an additional security function. title_en: Method and device for reporting MSD through RTCP
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for reporting MSD through RTCP, which comprises the following steps. Step S1, adding 6 seed types into an RTCP packet of the APP type. Step S2, after the eCall is established, the IVS sends an RTCP synchronous packet to the PSAP, the PSAP replies an RTCP confirmation packet to the IVS after receiving the RTCP synchronous packet, the IVS calculates round trip time RTT of the RTCP synchronous packet and the RTCP confirmation packet transmitted in the network after receiving the RTCP confirmation packet, and replies an RTCP notification receipt confirmation packet carrying the RTT to the PSAP. Step S31, in the eCall process, the IVS sends an RTCP MSD data packet to the PSAP, wherein the RTCP MSD data packet carries MSD data, if the PSAP successfully receives the RTCP MSD data packet, the IVS replies an RTCP notification to the IVS that the MSD data packet is received, when the IVS still does not receive the RTCP notification to the IVS after the retransmission time, the IVS retransmits the RTCP MSD data packet to the PSAP, wherein the RTCP MSD data packet carries MSD data, and the retransmission time is in direct proportion to RTT. The invention sets the retransmission time proportionally according to the round trip time, thereby improving the retransmission efficiency of lost packets.

title_en: Early warning information processing method and device for multiple disasters based on time-space correlation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for processing early warning information of multiple disasters based on space-time correlation, and belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning. The method comprises the following steps: responding to the received disaster early warning information report, and acquiring early warning stage types of a first historical disaster early warning information report and at least one second historical disaster early warning information report; under the condition that the obtained early warning stage types are all judged to be finished reporting, when the current disaster early warning risk level is higher than a threshold value, determining that the current disaster early warning information is reported as the first report of a new disaster early warning event; and under the condition that the acquired early warning stage type is determined to be non-end report, determining that the current disaster early warning information report is an updated report or an end report of the disaster early warning event corresponding to the first historical disaster early warning information report or the second historical disaster early warning information report according to the information generation category and the early warning end condition of the current disaster early warning information report. The disaster early warning system can realize the time-space correlation of disaster early warning information reports of different monitoring areas and perform the fusion of disaster early warning events.

title_en: Method and System for Providing OTP to Integrated Emergency Broadcasting System
title_ko: 통합 재난 비상 방송 시스템에 otp를 제공하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for providing an OTP to an integrated disaster emergency broadcasting system. More specifically, a QR code is generated with information including a seed key loaded from an installation file by a first computing device including a management terminal, a multimedia device, a service server, and a camera, which are components of an integrated disaster emergency broadcasting system. The information including the seed key is received by recognizing the QR code by a user terminal, and an OTP is generated based on the seed key and a generation time. When the OTP is input to the first computing device, the first computing device verifies the OTP and determines whether the OTP is valid to unlock the first computing device. According to the present invention, the first computing device can provide the OTP providing method without a separate network environment.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 통합 재난 비상 방송 시스템에 OTP를 제공하는 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 통합 재난 비상 방송 시스템의 구성요소인 관리단말, 멀티미디어기기, 서비스서버 및 카메라를 포함하는 제1컴퓨팅장치에 의해 설치파일로부터 로드한 시드키를 포함하는 정보로 QR코드를 생성하고, 사용자단말에 의해 상기 QR코드를 인식하여 시드키를 포함하는 상기 정보를 수신하고, 상기 시드키 및 생성시간에 기초하여 OTP를 생성하고, 상기 OTP를 상기 제1컴퓨팅장치에 입력하면, 상기 제1컴퓨팅장치에서 상기 OTP를 검증하고 유효한지 판단하여 상기 제1컴퓨팅장치의 잠금을 해제하는, 통합 재난 비상 방송 시스템에 OTP를 제공하는 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Apparatus for determining whether or not an arc abnormality to prevent fire of photovoltaic system
title_ko: 태양광 발전 시스템의 화재예방을 위한 아크 이상 유무 판별 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for determining the presence of anomaly in an arc to prevent a fire in a photovoltaic system, wherein when an arc detection analog circuit unit (56) matches and amplifies an electrical current and an arc detected by an electrical current/arc sensor (52) with an analog signal, an AD conversion unit (57a) converts the analog signal into a digital signal and an FFT (57b) interprets the digital signal of the AD conversion unit (57a) in a frequency area to identify signal power distribution, further allow an unnecessary band removal unit (57c) to remove a noise band from the signal power distribution of the FFT (57b), allow an effective band power calculation unit (57d) to calculate power of an effective band in the signal power distribution, direct an arc band power calculation unit (57e) to calculate power of an arc band when the electrical current/arc sensor (52) detects an arc, and then allow a power comparison/warning issuing unit (57f) to compare the power of the effective band of the effective band power calculation unit (57d) with the power of the arc band of the arc band power calculation unit (57e) and issue a warning signal when a different therebetween is greater than or equal to a critical point, thereby enabling presence of anomaly in an arc on a transmission line to be accurately determined.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 아크검출아날로그회로부(56)에서 전류/아크센서(52)로부터 감지된 전류 및 아크를 아날로그신호로 정합 및 증폭시키면 AD 변환부(57a)에서 아날로그신호를 디지털신호로 변환시키고, 이어서 FFT(57b)는 AD 변환부(57a)의 디지털신호를 주파수영역에서 해석하여 신호전력분포를 파악하고, 나아가 불요대역제거부(57c)를 통해 FFT(57b)의 신호전력분포로부터 잡음대역을 제거, 유효대역전력계산부(57d)를 통해 신호전력분포에서 유효대역의 전력을 계산 그리고 아크대역전력계산부(57e)를 통해 전류/아크센서(52)에서 아크 감지시 아크대역의 전력을 계산토록 한 후, 전력비교/경고발생부(57f)로 하여금 유효대역전력계산부(57d)의 유효대역의 전력 및 아크대역전력계산부(57e)의 아크대역의 전력을 비교하여 상호간의 차이가 임계치 이상일 경우 경고신호를 발생토록 함으로써 송전선로상의 아크 이상 유무에 대한 판별을 정확하게 실현케 한 태양광 발전 시스템의 화재예방을 위한 아크 이상 유무 판별 장치에 관한 발명이다.

title_en: Method for small data transmission in power saving state and related devices
abstract_en: A method for small data transmission (SDT) in a power saving state is provided. The method includes applying at least one SDT related timer during the SDT on a first SDT bandwidth part (BWP) for the UE in the power saving state; and if the at least one SDT related timer is not running on the first SDT BWP, switching from the first SDT BWP to a second SDT BWP for receiving at least one of updated system information (SI) or public warning system (PWS) information from the network. With this method, monitoring SI change and/or PWS information on associated BWP during the SDT can achieved.

title_en: Intrusion alert system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intrusion alert system, defence area extension module all is provided with independent code, defence area extension module passes through the code and the front end detector is corresponding, defence area extension module passes through ALARM control center system and ALARM host computer communication, ALARM control center system and video monitoring system communicate mutually, ALARM control center system and access control system communicate mutually, the front end detector sets up in the deployment area, be provided with the emergency button of seeking help in the deployment area, emergency button and front end detector all communicate with audible-visual annunciator mutually, if certain ALARM signal sensor is triggered when the system is in the deployment state, through connecting defence area extension module on the bus, with signal transmission on the ALARM host computer, the police number that the ALARM host computer is connected can sound production, demonstrate the detailed place of taking place the warning simultaneously on the display screen of IP-ALARM ALARM system workstation, the control personnel at center can withdraw the defence to the system through 6160 keyboard, handle the warning.
assignees: SHENZHEN IB TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Elevator emergency rescue system and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elevator emergency rescue system and a rescue method, relates to the technical field of elevator emergency rescue systems, and aims to solve the technical problems that the warning condition in an elevator cannot be evaluated and the comprehensiveness and timeliness of rescue cannot be guaranteed according to actual conditions in the prior art. The rescue system comprises a system management module, an elevator management module, an alarm rescue module, a communication module and a control center; the system management module is used for managing basic information of the system and comprises a user management unit and a role management unit, wherein the functions of the user management unit comprise adding a user, modifying the user and canceling the user, and the functions of the role management unit comprise adding a role, modifying the role and deleting the role. According to the rescue system and the rescue method, the alarm condition in the elevator is evaluated, and then the response level of the elevator is judged, so that the waste of public resources can be avoided while the comprehensiveness and timeliness of rescue are ensured.

title_en: Fast-assembling prevents mistake and touches safe emergency alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a quick-mounting type false touch prevention safety emergency alarm device, which comprises a mounting seat, a cover body and an alarm system; the mounting seat is a circular seat, and a wire passing hole is formed in the center of the mounting seat in a vertical penetrating manner; a plurality of opposite edges of the mounting seat are rolled up to form buckles; a plurality of mounting holes are formed in the edge of the mounting seat; the cover body is in a hollow hemispherical shape, and a pressing hole is formed in the center of the top surface of the cover body; the periphery of the cover body is provided with a plurality of clamping blocks, and the positions and the number of the clamping blocks and the clamping buckles are corresponding and matched; the cover body can be covered on the mounting seat through the matching of the buckle and the clamping block. A ready-package mistake proofing touches safe emergency alarm device, convenient dismantlement and maintenance can avoid careless mistake to touch the warning, avoid causing unnecessary panic, have guaranteed the validity of in-service use.

title_en: Alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an siren technical field just discloses an siren, detect the mechanism including base, bracing piece, alarm mechanism, water level detection mechanism and rainfall, bracing piece fixed mounting is in the upper end of base, alarm mechanism is located the outer end of bracing piece, water level detection mechanism is located alarm mechanism's below, rainfall detection mechanism is located water level detection mechanism's the outside. This siren, through setting up alarm mechanism, first solar panel provides electric power for the inside component of alarm box, the electric energy storage of electricity storage module with the conversion gets up, and supply power by each electrical component of power module case, in hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering flood prevention work, when the flood season water level surpassed the warning line, water level sensor and rainfall detector give main control unit with water level signal and rainfall signal transmission, main control unit control warning light scintillation, control bee calling organ buzzes, in order to remind peripheral masses to hurry up to evacuate and withdraw, remind anti-flood emergency personnel to make the preparation of anti-flood.

title_en: Message updating system for electronic label
abstract_en: The present invention is a message updating system for an electronic label. The system comprises a message updating device, wherein a controller thereof controls a power-supply transmission unit and a message-update transmission unit to respectively transmit a charging signal and a message-updating to the electronic label for charging the electronic label and updating label information of the electronic label. A detection device picks up the label information to generate label content information, transmits the label content information to the controller to make the controller compare the label content information with update comparison information, and generates an alert message if the label content information is different from the update comparison information. The present can charge the electronic label that is mounted on an article and update label information simultaneously while the article is being transported.

title_en: Synchronizing data between fire panels and the mass notification system
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method and system for synchronizing a mass notification. A method includes detecting an update in a configuration at a control panel over a first communication channel, and generating an update notification message based at least in part on the detection. The method can also include transmitting the update notification message over a second communication channel to synchronize an MNS with the update in the configuration at the control panel.

title_en: Early warning information processing method and device for multiple disasters and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an early warning information processing method and device for multiple disasters and terminal equipment, and belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning. The method comprises the following steps: responding to the received disaster early warning information report, and acquiring the early warning stage type of the previous disaster early warning information report of the same disaster type of the monitoring area corresponding to the current disaster early warning information report; when the early warning stage type is the end reporting condition, determining that the current disaster early warning information report is the first report of a new disaster early warning event; and under the condition that the early warning stage type is not finished reporting, acquiring an information generation category of the current disaster early warning information report, and determining that the current disaster early warning information report is an updated report or finished report of the disaster early warning event corresponding to the previous disaster early warning information report according to the information generation category of the current disaster early warning information report and an early warning finishing condition. The invention can perform the integration of disaster early warning events on the received disaster early warning information report, and is beneficial to the user to process the current disaster early warning information report.
assignees: CHENGDU MEIHUAN TECH CO LTD;INST OF CARE LIFE

title_en: Abnormality notification device, method, and system
abstract_en: This abnormality notification device that notifies a plurality of users of an abnormality in a facility installed in an environment includes: a communication unit that performs data communication with a plurality of terminal devices respectively associated with the plurality of users; a control unit that controls operation of the communication unit to transmit/receive information; a state information acquisition unit that acquires state information indicating a state of the facility; and a positional information acquisition unit that acquires positional information indicating positions of the users in the environment. The control unit identifies that the facility is in an abnormal state on the basis of the state information and then transmits abnormality notification indicating that the facility is in the abnormal state to the plurality of terminal devices, detects, after transmission of the abnormality notification, a user who is to move to the facility being in the abnormal state from among the plurality of users on the basis of the positional information, and transmits, upon detection of the user to move, cancellation notification indicating cancellation of the abnormality notification to a part of all of the plurality of terminal devices to which the abnormality notification has been transmitted.

title_en: Lamp for swichboard case
title_ko: 배전반 함체용 램프
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a lamp for a switchboard case, wherein a light, a warning light, and a speaker are operatively installed in a switchboard case, so that the light, the warning light, and the speaker can automatically operate depending on mode settings of a controller when a door is opened, thereby ensuring a visual field of a worker and calling the attention of surrounding workers to establish a safe work environment. In case of an accident such as a fire and current leakage during work, countermeasures can be rapidly induced through changing the mode of the controller. The lamp for a switchboard case according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a lamp body installed to be able to flicker inside the switchboard case and having a light located on one side and a warning light located on the other side; a controller installed to be electrically connectable to the lamp body inside the switchboard case, having a built-in speaker that outputs an alarm sound, and allowing the light, the warning light, and the speaker to operate in various modes depending on settings; and a sensor installed to be electrically connectable to the controller inside the switchboard case to enable the controller to control the power supply to the lamp body depending on whether the switchboard case's door is opened or closed, wherein the operation of the light, the warning light, and the alarm speaker is started depending on the mode settings of the controller when the switchboard case's door is opened and the operation of the operating light, warning light, and speaker is stopped when the switchboard case's door is closed.
abstract_ko:
개시된 내용은 배전반 함체 내부에 조명등, 경광등 및 스피커가 작동 가능하게 설치되어 도어 개방시 컨트롤러의 모드 설정에 따라 조명등, 경광등 및 스피커가 자동으로 작동됨으로써 작업자의 시야확보는 물론 주변 작업자의 주위환기를 통해 안전한 작업환경이 조성될 수 있고, 작업중 화재 및 누전과 같은 안전사고가 발생될 경우 컨트롤러 모드 변경을 통해 신속한 후속대응이 유도될 수 있도록 한 배전반 함체용 램프에 관한 것이다. 
개시된 내용의 일 실시 예에 따른 배전반 함체용 램프는 배전반 함체 내부에 점멸 가능하게 설치되되, 일측에는 조명등이 위치되고 타측에는 경광등이 위치되는 램프본체와, 상기 배전반 함체 내부에 상기 램프본체와 전기적으로 접속 가능하게 설치되고 내부에는 알람음이 출력되는 스피커가 내장되며 설정에 따라 상기 조명등, 경광등 및 스피커가 다양한 모드로 작동되게 하는 컨트롤러와, 상기 배전반 함체 내부에 상기 컨트롤러와 전기적으로 접속 가능하게 설치되고 상기 배전반 함체 도어의 개폐 여부에 따라 상기 컨트롤러에서 상기 램프본체로의 전원공급이 제어되게 하여, 상기 배전반 함체 도어의 개방시 상기 컨트롤러의 모드 설정에 따라 상기 조명등, 경광등 및 알람음 스피커의 작동이 개시되게 하고 상기 배전반 함체 도어의 폐쇄시 작동중인 상기 조명등, 경광등 및 스피커의 작동이 중지되게 하는 센서가 포함되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: V2x communication method and apparatus for sending warning message in v2x communication system supporting sidelink
title_ko: 사이드링크를 지원하는 v2x 통신 시스템에서 경고 메시지를 전송하는 v2x 통신 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present embodiments provide a V2X communication device and a method thereof which change a communication manner with a roadside device based on an adjacent roadside device and another vehicle condition included in a V2X message and receive a V2X message from the roadside device through a direct (PC5) interface between terminals according to the communication manner.
abstract_ko: 본 실시예들은 V2X 메시지에 포함된 다른 차량 상황 및 인접한 노변 장치를 기준으로 노변 장치와의 통신 방식을 변경하고, 통신 방식에 따라 단말 간 직접(PC5) 인터페이스를 통해서 노변 장치로부터 V2X 메시지를 수신하는 V2X 통신 장치 및 방법을 제공한다.
assignees: UIF UNIV INDUSTRY FOUNDATION YONSEI UNIV

title_en: Early warning and monitoring method for preventing collapse of deep foundation pit
abstract_en: The invention relates to foundation pit monitoring, in particular to a method for early warning and monitoring collapse prevention of a deep foundation pit. The method comprises the following steps: step A, constructing a stay wire foundation at the position of a slope toe of the pit bottom of a foundation pit, and constructing a connecting rod foundation at the position, close to a slope wall, of a slope top; b, arranging a spring on the inner side of the slope wall of the foundation pit, wherein two ends of the spring are respectively connected with the cantilever connecting rod and the stay wire foundation through stay wires; step C, installing a contact device by a spring, wherein the contact device comprises a T-shaped inner contact rod and a hook-shaped outer contact rod; and D, connecting the inner feeler lever with an alarm in series through a wire, electrically connecting the alarm with one electrode of a power supply through the wire, and electrically connecting the other electrode of the power supply with the outer feeler lever through the wire. The invention has simple structure and high sensitivity, provides automatic broadcast alarm before the collapse danger of the foundation pit, withdraws people in time, prevents the collapse accident of the foundation pit, and avoids casualties and property loss.

title_en: Method and system for identifying, sensing and early warning mine water inrush source
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine water disaster intelligent prevention and control safety, in particular to a method and a system for recognizing, sensing and early warning a water source with water inrush in a mine. Mine information is obtained in real time; and the acquired mine information is transmitted, stored and analyzed in real time, so that the identification and prediction of the mine water inrush water source and the early warning of the mine water inrush water damage are realized, and early warning information is issued. The system integrates key hydrogeology and water chemistry characteristic information acquisition of a mine, innovatively combines a Python deep learning technology with an Internet of things cloud platform, realizes a real-time monitoring, detecting, forecasting and early warning technology for quickly judging and identifying water inrush hazards of the mine, gives consideration to safe, quick and real-time storage of data, feeds back mine information and analysis results in real time, and realizes real-time monitoring and dynamic continuous perception early warning. The problem of can't carry out all-weather monitoring and early warning to mine water burst water source information among the prior art, the information update that leads to is untimely, can't satisfy the theoretical requirement of current exploitation is solved.

title_en: Radio operational configurations
abstract_en: An electronic device may include wireless circuitry having one or more radios and one or more antennas. For some device configurations such as during a device low-power mode, a radio (operating in a radio on-off mode) may alternate between on and off states based on a duty cycle to reduce power consumption and increase device battery life. Radio operation in the on-off mode and device operation in the low-power mode may accommodate other radio operations such as emergency broadcast message reception, radio operations under an allocated power budget, user equipment periodic registration and update operations.

title_en: Multi-source data dynamic threshold approach alarm method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for dynamic threshold approach alarm of multi-source data, comprising the following steps: according to preset source monitoring equipment, multi-source data are obtained, the multi-source data are subjected to data fusion, standardized data are output, disaster influence conditions are obtained according to monitoring carrier characteristics corresponding to each standard set in the standardized data, disaster threshold rule bases matched with the corresponding standard sets are constructed, disaster dynamic thresholds are configured for the corresponding standard sets according to weather change conditions and combined with the disaster threshold rule bases and updated in real time, first reminding service strategies are set for different disaster dynamic thresholds, second reminding service strategies are set for the corresponding disaster dynamic thresholds according to updating conditions of the same disaster, adjacent reminding service strategies of the corresponding disaster dynamic thresholds are obtained according to the first reminding service strategies and the second reminding service strategies, and corresponding reminding operations are executed. The accuracy of warning to the calamity is convenient for effectual improvement.

title_en: Fusion processing method, device, equipment and storage medium for multi-disaster early warning information
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a fusion processing method, a fusion processing device and a fusion processing device of multi-disaster early warning information, and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of disaster early warning. The method comprises the following steps: responding to the received disaster early warning information report, and acquiring the early warning stage type of the previous disaster early warning information report of the same disaster type of the monitoring area corresponding to the current disaster early warning information report; under the condition that the early warning stage type of the current disaster early warning information report is the report ending, determining that the current disaster early warning information report is the first report of a new disaster early warning event; and under the condition that the early warning stage type of the current disaster early warning information report is non-end report, determining that the current disaster early warning information report is an updated report or an end report of the disaster early warning event corresponding to the previous disaster early warning information report according to the current disaster early warning information report and the early warning end condition. The disaster early warning event fusion method can fuse disaster early warning events to the received disaster early warning information report, and is beneficial to updating, responding and disposing of the current disaster early warning information by a user.
assignees: CHENGDU MEIHUAN TECH CO LTD;INST OF CARE LIFE

title_en: Anti-clamping alarm device for floor crossing of escalator
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic staircase floor intersection prevents pressing from both sides alarm device, including outer box, be used for the response whether have the detection circuitry that the health that probes formed and the warning circuit who plays the reputation suggestion at certain distance within range, detection circuitry and warning circuit connect gradually and set up outer internal portion of container. The detection circuit: if the human body infrared induction sensor detects a human body within a certain distance range, a signal is output, and after the signal is processed by an operational amplifier, a comparator and other components, the relay is controlled to be attracted, so that an alarm loop is conducted. An alarm circuit: the relay in the detection circuit is closed, the alarm circuit is conducted, and the audible and visual alarm gives out audible and visual alarm. The device can sense the body stretching out of the handrail belt; has the function of sound and light prompt; a human body infrared induction sensor is used as a switch to control an audible and visual alarm; the risk that passengers are collided or sheared on the escalator can be predicted, and the passengers are reminded to timely withdraw bodies through sound-light alarm to prevent accidents in the bud.
assignees: SHANGHAI INST SPECIAL EQUIPMENT INSPECTION TECHNICAL RES

title_en: Warning alarm device with anti-falling overweight discharging platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a prevent weighing down overweight platform of unloading police calling organ equipment has, including connecting rod, support steel pole and gravity detect subassembly, the top movable mounting who supports the steel pole has the connecting rod, the sliding block is installed at the top of connecting rod, the bottom of sliding block is installed and is extended to the inside gravity detect subassembly of support steel pole, gravity sensing needle bottom is around installing resistance coil. The utility model discloses an install resistance coil in the bottom surrounding of gravity sensing needle, can produce electric current through conduction assembly connecting wire external power supply, the electric current passes through conduction assembly and resistance coil and forms the return circuit, when unloading the platform roof and take place to warp, can oppress gravity sensing needle downstream, the current increase that diminishes because of the position change of conduction assembly and resistance coil leads to resistance this moment, send out the police calling organ through regulation and control panel control, thereby make the staff's the very first time of unloading make and withdraw the reaction, the security of device has been improved.
assignees: JINAN TUOXING ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Test equipment check validity period prompting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an aeronautical instrument test equipment field especially relates to a test equipment check-up validity period suggestion device. Comprises an installation sleeve (6), an installation sleeve gum (7) and an alarm device; the utility model discloses an installation cover (6), installation cover gum (7) are installed on test equipment, are equipped with the alarm in installation cover (6), are provided with expiry date display electron ink screen, are used for overdue bee calling organ and warning lamp (10) of reminding on the alarm, can set up in a flexible way and remind the day number in advance, initiatively remind the user test equipment expiration condition.
assignees: AVIC BEIJING KEEVEN AVIATION INSTR CO LTD

title_en: Portable energy storage fire hazard early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a portable energy storage fire hazard early warning device, which comprises a box body, and a controller, a power supply, a display screen, an alarm device and a detection device which are all arranged on the box body, wherein the display screen, the power supply and the alarm device are all connected with the controller; the detection device comprises a sniffing tube, an environment detection device, a filtering device, a characteristic gas sensor, a pyroelectric ion detector, a sampling pump and an exhaust pipe, wherein the filtering device, the characteristic gas sensor, the pyroelectric ion detector, the sampling pump and the exhaust pipe are sequentially arranged on the sniffing tube; the characteristic gas sensor, the pyroelectric ion detector and the sampling pump are all connected with the controller. The utility model provides a pair of portable energy storage conflagration hidden danger early warning device adopts the sampling pump to take out the ambient air and sniffs the intraductal detection that detects to a plurality of parameters such as characteristic gas concentration, heat release ion concentration are accurate to carry out conflagration early warning, have effectively prevented the emergence of wrong report, and the precision that detects is high, good reliability, and can provide the warning, in time indicate fortune dimension personnel to withdraw safely.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YUNTONG INTELLIGENT IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Smart city comprehensive safety management remote monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a safety control remote monitering equipment is synthesized in wisdom city, including remote security management case, the remote security management incasement is equipped with the remote alarm that extends to the remote security management case outside and reminds the mechanism, remote alarm reminds the mechanism to include fixed mounting in control processing module, urgent notice module, the light control module of remote security management incasement chamber upper surface. This safety control remote monitering equipment is synthesized in wisdom city, through be equipped with control processing module at remote safety management case, urgent notice module, light control module and warning speaker control module, be equipped with urgent notice speaker, surveillance camera head, alarm lamp and warning speaker on remote safety management case, utilize and inform near personnel in time withdraw and know dangerous information when taking place danger to draw person and withdraw to the safety zone, have the function diversification, the practicality is higher, manage more comprehensive advantage.
assignees: JIANGXI JIMEICHENG SMART TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent voice control method and system based on big data and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent voice control method, a system and a readable storage medium based on big data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring voice data of a user side to identify current user attributes, and determining target audio to play based on the user attributes so as to enable a vehicle to perform voice interaction with the user side; in the process of voice interaction between the vehicle and the user side, the current driving state of the vehicle is identified, and an audio response mechanism is switched based on the driving state; and in the process of voice interaction between the vehicle and the user side, carrying out language attribution recognition based on the voice data so as to switch and broadcast the voice version of the target audio. The invention can adjust the corresponding voice interaction response mechanism according to different driving states of the vehicle, thereby keeping the consciousness of trapped personnel of the vehicle awake when the vehicle is dangerous, and in addition, can carry out voice interaction according to dialects corresponding to the voice response in the vehicle, thereby improving user experience and improving the preference of big data processing.

title_en: Sewage early warning and treatment analysis system based on Internet of things and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of sewage early warning and treatment analysis systems, and particularly relates to a sewage early warning and treatment analysis system based on the Internet of things and deep learning; the invention is that the sewage data collector collects the sewage data parameter of the sewage treatment process, the sewage monitoring module monitors the sewage treatment node in real time, the sewage data parameter is automatically uploaded to the sewage data processing and analyzing platform, and whether the sewage treatment meets the sewage treatment standard is analyzed; the sewage alarm module reminds managers of abnormal data parameters after sewage treatment at multiple positions of a sewage treatment point in multiple modes, and triggers the sewage treatment module to treat sewage; the data of the collection points in the sewage treatment process are stored in a sewage distributed database in a storage and updating mode; the sewage treatment method has various sewage treatment using methods, can arrange treatment according to sewage, can provide detailed data feedback for the sewage internal treatment technology, and can save and update at each detection point by using a distributed database.

title_en: Multifunctional LED fire-fighting emergency lamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multi-functional LED fire emergency lighting fixture, including fire emergency lamp body, the top fixed mounting of fire emergency lamp body has two lights, the left side fixed mounting of fire emergency lamp body bottom has smoke alarm, the right side fixed mounting of fire emergency lamp body bottom has the speaker, the back of fire emergency lamp body is provided with the back lid. This multi-functional LED fire emergency light utensil, through setting up the light, the emergency light is luminous bright, can guide the person of escaping at night, smoke alarm experiences the smell of smoke that the conflagration produced, send alarm effect suggestion field personnel and withdraw, the speaker can take place warning guide signal after the unexpected calamity appears, can guide the person of escaping to arrive escape way according to the sound, the fan will produce wind and dispel the heat to the inside of back lid, and ventilate the heat dissipation through the louvre, thereby guarantee that LED fire emergency light utensil is inside can not the high temperature and the scaling loss, thereby improve the life of LED fire emergency light utensil.
assignees: BEIJING JIAMING WISDOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Inflammable volatile matter monitoring and alarming device
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of monitoring alarm devices, in particular to a monitoring alarm device for inflammable volatile matters, which comprises a box body and a monitoring mechanism for monitoring and detecting the inflammable volatile matters, wherein the monitoring mechanism is arranged in the box body and also comprises a collecting mechanism for sucking, compressing and storing the collected inflammable volatile matters; the beneficial effects are as follows: through being provided with the fan, compression air pump, gas storage tank, can detect the inflammable volatile matter gas that exists in the middle of the environment of locating, the fan rotates, form the air flow, pump the pressurization of sucking gas again by compression air pump, later compress to the gas storage tank in, later unify and handle, still be provided with bee calling organ and warning light, there is inflammable gas in detecting the environment of locating, through warning of reporting to the police, remind personnel to evacuate and withdraw, later open and collect the mechanism and carry out the suction compression processing to inflammable volatile matter.
assignees: DUHUA ELECTRONIC TECH HENAN CO LTD

title_en: Disaster recovery method, device and system and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster recovery method, which is applied to a standby SMF, wherein the standby SMF and a main SMF are in the same SMF set, and the method comprises the following steps: receiving a first session update request, wherein the first session update request is sent to a standby SMF by a first NF after detecting the fault of the primary SMF; pulling session data of the primary SMF from a storage network function (UDSF) according to the first session updating request to take over the SMF; and synchronously taking over the messages with the plurality of second NFs so as to connect the standby SMF with the plurality of second NFs, wherein the taking over messages comprise notification messages for notifying the plurality of second NFs of taking over the standby SMF and confirmation messages returned by the plurality of second NFs according to the notification messages. After the standby SMF in the SMF set reads the session data of the primary SMF from the UDSF to take over the primary SMF, the second NF connected with the SMF set synchronously takes over the message, so that the second NF connected with the primary SMF receives the message replaced by the primary SMF, the communication connection between a control plane and a user plane is realized, and the session continuity of a user is maintained in the disaster recovery process.

title_en: Emergency service vehicle notification and acknowledgement
abstract_en: A processing system including at least one processor may transmit a notification of a presence of an emergency service vehicle to a plurality of entities, obtain, from at least a first entity of the plurality of entities, at least a first acknowledgement of the presence of the emergency service vehicle, determine that at least a second acknowledgement is not obtained from at least a second entity of the plurality of entities, and present information associated with the at least the second entity to a device of the emergency service vehicle.

title_en: Method and apparatus for broadcasting alert service message in wireless communication system
title_ko: 무선통신시스템에서 경보 서비스 메시지 방송 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided is a method for broadcasting a commercial mobile alert service (CMAS) message by a base station in a wireless communication system. The CMAS message broadcasting method comprises the steps of: configuring, when a CMAS emergency occurs, a System Information Block 8 (SIB8) containing CMAS messages; determining a System Frame Number (SFN) corresponding to a default paging cycle value closest to the current SFN in the current system information change cycle as a broadcasting time of the CMAS messages; generating a short message announcing the broadcasting of SIB8; broadcasting system information including the SIB8 at the broadcasting time of the CMAS messages; and transmitting a short message at the broadcasting time of the CMAS messages. According to the present invention, in a wireless communication system, CMAS messages can be transmitted to all terminals within a CMAS broadcasting region as quickly and accurately as possible.
abstract_ko: 무선통신시스템의 기지국에서 상용 모바일 경보 서비스(Commercial Mobile Alert Service, CMAS) 메시지를 방송하는 방법이 제공된다. CMAS 메시지 방송 방법은 CMAS 비상 상황 발생 시, CMAS 메시지를 포함한 SIB8(System Information Block 8)을 구성하는 단계, 현재 시스템 정보 변경 주기에서 현재 SFN(System Frame Number)과 가장 가까운 디폴트 페이징 사이클 값에 해당하는 SFN을 상기 CMAS 메시지의 방송 시점으로 결정하는 단계, 상기 SIB8의 방송을 알리는 단문메시지를 생성하는 단계, 상기 CMAS 메시지의 방송 시점에서 상기 SIB8을 포함하는 시스템 정보를 방송하는 단계, 그리고 상기 CMAS 메시지의 방송 시점에서 상기 단문메시지를 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Pull-through pin withdrawal alarm circuit of coke quenching car traction mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a pin penetrating and exiting alarm circuit of a coke quenching car traction mechanism, and belongs to the field of coke oven locomotive equipment. The circuit comprises a limiter, an intermediate relay and an audio-visual signal warning lamp. Wherein, stopper and audible and visual signal warning lamp are connected with intermediate relay respectively, and intermediate relay sets up in electric locomotive control circuit. The limiter SQ is used for detecting the pin penetrating state, the sound-light alarm lamp LS is used for giving out sound-light alarm when the pin penetrates out, and the intermediate relay KA is used for interrupting the power system and starting the sound-light alarm when the pin penetrates out. The invention can effectively early warn the pin penetration and withdrawal, and prompt operators to check and recover the pin penetration in time, thereby avoiding safety accidents caused by the pin penetration and withdrawal.
assignees: CHONGQING IRON & STEEL LTD BY SHARE LTD

title_en: Distributed medium-level data processing method, system, device, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a distributed middle-stage data processing method, a system, equipment, a storage medium and a program product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: in case that the pre-service detects a data write request, the pre-service forwards the data write request to a first service unit based on the acquired packet information; under the condition that the first service unit is a main service unit, adding a queuing lock to the data writing request by the first service unit, obtaining logic data associated with the data writing request in a first cache, and processing the logic data based on the data writing request to obtain updated data; the first service unit writes the update data into the first cache to cover the logic data, and notifies a broadcast service to perform broadcast notification of the update data, where the pre-service, the first service unit, and the broadcast service are disposed in the same machine room. The disaster recovery capability of data processing can be improved, and the usability is higher.

title_en: Stress behavior monitoring system and method for armored steel wire of marine flexible riser
abstract_en: A stress behavior monitoring system and method for an armored steel wire of a marine flexible riser belong to the field of marine riser monitoring. The system comprises a monitoring module, a transmission module, a control processing module and an early warning module which are connected in sequence. The monitoring module acquires signal source information of the ship body and the vertical pipe, the signal source information is transmitted to the control processing module through the transmission module, a preset system early warning threshold value is further generated, the corrected system threshold value is updated and generated according to the signal source information, the maximum stress value of the armored steel wire is calculated, whether the maximum stress value exceeds the early warning threshold value is judged, and the judgment result is transmitted to the early warning module. And transmitting the obtained maximum stress value and position of the armored steel wire of the vertical pipe at any moment to an early warning module, and carrying out early warning if the maximum stress value and position exceeds a threshold value. The real-time monitoring of the stress safety of the vertical pipe is realized by indirectly measuring the signal source information of the ship body and the vertical pipe, the technical paths are integrated together, the realization is convenient, and the safety of the catenary type vertical pipe and the lazy type vertical pipe in the service process is greatly improved.

title_en: Data analysis and early warning method based on distributed disaster recovery drilling scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data analysis and early warning method based on a distributed disaster recovery drilling scene, which comprises the following steps: step one: training a central early warning model in a distributed manner and carrying out privacy data aggregation; step two: the first step of data is put into a model for training, a local disaster backup exercise early warning model is obtained through training, the disaster backup exercise early warning model data of each place are submitted to a central server for updating the disaster backup exercise early warning model, a headquarter exercise result database is updated, and updated indexes after each training are stored; meanwhile, updating the service identifier and storing the service identifier into a database to serve as an initial service identifier of the next disaster backup scene of the same type, and commanding the central server program to execute new model training again, so that the whole process is completed, and the probability of a real disaster in the training process of disaster backup exercise is obtained. The invention can effectively overcome the problem of model deviation and reduce the calculation complexity.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM SHUZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic elastic power supply recovery method and system for urban power system under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic elastic power supply recovery method of an urban power system under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps that a V2G system performs an operation period and collects road network EV traffic data during disaster early warning; providing electric energy support for the urban power grid by adopting EV resources at a temporary V2G interaction station in the disaster, and dispatching maintenance teams according to traffic data to carry out rush repair operation on a fault line; the maintenance team updates the rush-repair scheme in real time by adopting an optimized scheduling method considering the V2G data and repairs the next fault equipment; repeating the steps until all the fault devices are salvaged. The invention also discloses a system for realizing the dynamic elastic power supply recovery method of the urban power system under typhoon disasters. The invention is beneficial to realizing the quick recovery of the post-disaster system and improving the elasticity of the system; the invention has high reliability, good accuracy and higher efficiency.

title_en: Rural industrial digital comprehensive service system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rural industrial digital comprehensive service system, which comprises a comprehensive service platform; the system comprises a plurality of sub-service platforms, a plurality of service platform modules and a plurality of service platform modules, wherein the user terminals are used for collecting comprehensive information of villagers in the current administrative village, the comprehensive information comprises agricultural product information, travel product information and monitoring information, and each sub-service platform module is respectively communicated with the comprehensive service platform module; the electronic commerce sales platform is electrically connected with the comprehensive service platform, and the product on-shelf condition in the electronic commerce sales platform is updated through the supply information provided by the comprehensive service platform regularly; the travel information of each administrative village is perfected through the travel information provided by the comprehensive service platform at regular intervals; the emergency monitoring platform is electrically connected with the comprehensive service platform and distributes disaster early warning information through environment information provided by the comprehensive service platform regularly; the method has the advantages that various data are collected uniformly through digital platform management and control, and powerful support is provided for village vibration.

title_en: Intelligent display system based on enterprise production management data
