abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent display system based on enterprise production management data, which comprises a server, an intelligent display, a data acquisition module, an interface module and an intelligent algorithm module, wherein the server comprises a dangerous chemical safety production risk monitoring and early warning system, an electronic operation ticket system, an intelligent inspection system, a notification announcement system, an enterprise propaganda language system and an access control system/attendance system. According to the invention, by integrating the dangerous chemical safety production risk monitoring and early warning system, the inspection system, the electronic operation ticket system and the like with the enterprise propaganda system, the information which needs to be shown by an enterprise can be displayed more flexibly, the diversified centralized display of enterprise public information data sources is realized, a manager can know the on-duty condition of the current personnel conveniently, the old public version and public column are replaced, the paperless public of the enterprise key index information is realized, the environment-friendly performance is realized, the running state of the current enterprise is observed more intuitively, and the management of the enterprise is promoted more.
assignees: SHENYANG JINCHENG ELECTRONIC NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Meteorological prediction method, electronic device, and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a weather prediction method, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. According to the embodiment of the application, the good fitting capacity of the weather prediction model can be combined, and the target weather data at the target moment can be accurately calculated according to the initial weather data, so that the accuracy of weather prediction is improved. In addition, because the embodiment of the application can calculate the target weather data at the target moment, and the target moment can be any moment, the embodiment of the application can update the target weather cloud image with higher frequency, so that the electronic equipment can control and display the latest weather cloud image, thereby improving the response speed of weather disaster early warning and alarming.
assignees: NANJING YINGAN INTELLIGENT TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Building secondary collapse monitoring and early warning system under aftershock
abstract_en: The invention relates to a monitoring and early warning system for secondary collapse of a building under aftershock, which comprises a building structure monitoring module and an early warning module; the building structure monitoring module comprises a plurality of sensors, wherein the sensors are arranged at target monitoring points of the local collapse building and are used for monitoring the structural response of the local collapse building under the action of aftershocks; the early warning module is internally provided with a dynamic early warning threshold algorithm, different initial early warning thresholds are set according to characteristic collapse modes of a local collapse building on site, and accurate and timely early warning is provided after data screening processing and sensitivity analysis are carried out by collecting aftershock source signals and structural response signals, and meanwhile, the collapse early warning threshold is dynamically updated and used for next collapse judgment and early warning. Compared with the prior art, the method considers two factors of aftershock and structural response, and enables monitoring and early warning of secondary collapse of the building to be more scientific and accurate through the early warning threshold value of dynamic iteration.

title_en: Directional strong sound warning guiding megaphone system for subway emergency management
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a subway emergency management directional strong sound warning guidance megaphone system, which comprises a host machine, a microphone, a day and night viewing device, a tripod and a portable power supply, wherein the host machine is used for playing a sound source to guide warning, the microphone is connected with the host machine to guide megaphone on site, the tripod is used for supporting the host machine and the day and night viewing device, and the portable power supply is connected with the host machine to provide power for the system; the host comprises a shell, and an external sound source access port and a microphone access port are arranged on a rear panel of the shell; the inside of the shell is provided with a controller and a sounding unit, the input end of the controller is respectively connected with an external sound source access port and a microphone access port, and the output end of the controller is connected with the input end of the sounding unit. The utility model can transmit disaster information or possible damages caused by disasters to people at the first time, so that people can know what happens at the first time, and can withdraw and avoid danger, thereby minimizing life and property loss.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGAN HANGXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Alarm system and safety monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an alarm system and safety monitoring system relates to the electromechanical field, and this alarm system is applied to the power transformation and distribution place, including a plurality of sound monitoring units and audible and visual alarm device, wherein, this a plurality of audible and visual monitoring units distributes and sets up in this power transformation and distribution place, is connected with this audible and visual alarm device. The sound monitoring unit is used for monitoring sound signals in the power transformation and distribution place, and the sound-light alarm device is used for performing sound-light alarm under the condition that the sound signals monitored by the sound monitoring unit are abnormal sound signals. Through increasing this alarm system on personnel's inspection and video monitoring's basis, utilize the monitoring of sound unit to monitor the unusual sound in power transformation and distribution place to under the circumstances that appears unusual sound, utilize this audible and visual alarm device to carry out audible and visual alarm, can in time discover the trouble in power transformation and distribution place through sound monitoring, improve the validity of early warning.
assignees: CHN ENERGY GUOYUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Basin water ecological safety monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ecological safety monitoring, and discloses a watershed water ecological safety monitoring and early warning system.A control mechanism, a communication mechanism, a sensor and a power box are arranged in a box body; the shell main body comprises a lower shell and an upper shell, the lower shell is connected with the upper shell in a sealing mode, an electrical installation groove is formed between the upper shell and the lower shell, and the control mechanism, the communication mechanism, the sensor and the power box are all installed inside the electrical installation groove. The power supply ends of the control mechanism, the sensor and the communication mechanism are electrically connected with the output end of the power supply box; the control end of the communication mechanism and the control end of the sensor are both electrically connected with the control end of the control mechanism. The control mechanism receives signals sent by the sensor and sends the signals of the sensor to the background computer through the communication mechanism. The whole system is simple in structure, convenient to operate, flexible to use and convenient to popularize and use, so that monitoring signals are effectively transmitted, supervision efficiency is improved, detection results are accurate, and data are updated in real time.

title_en: Rapid escape method for deep foundation pit or pit-in-pit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rapid escape method for a deep foundation pit or a pit in a pit, which adopts an escape system, wherein the escape system comprises a steel frame, an upper basket, a winch and an alarm device of the Internet of things; when the foundation pit monitoring data exceeds the early warning value, the foundation pit monitoring data source is transmitted to an Internet of things platform through the Internet of things, the platform automatically sends information to an Internet of things alarm device, a rapid escape system alarm is triggered, red light flashes and gives out sharp alarm sounds, and foundation pit constructors are reminded to rapidly withdraw to a safety zone through the escape system; at the moment, the evacuee enters the basket, the winch is started, and the basket is pulled through the steel wire rope until the basket rises to the ground; when the density of the evacuees in the foundation pit is too high, under the condition that the upper basket is fully loaded, the evacuees escape through an emergency ladder; when the escape device is braked or powered off emergently, trapped personnel in the hanging basket climb over the hanging basket to the emergency ladder for ascending and descending. The invention has the advantages of good safety, rapid escape, strong operability and the like.
assignees: HUAHUI ENG DESIGN GROUP CO LTD;Huahui construction group co ltd

title_en: Training method of magnitude estimation model, magnitude estimation method and magnitude estimation model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake prediction and early warning, in particular to a training method of a magnitude estimation model, a magnitude estimation method and a magnitude estimation model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a sample set, wherein the sample set comprises seismic signals and real results corresponding to the seismic signals; obtaining a prediction result through a magnitude estimation model based on the sample set; calculating an error between the predicted result and the real result, and calculating an error gradient, wherein the error gradient is calculated by using a back propagation algorithm; and (3) building a weight optimizer based on an Adam algorithm to update the weight, wherein the weight is updated, the weight learning rate and the regularization parameter given by the magnitude estimation model are set based on the negative direction of gradient descent, and the weight of the model is updated. The seismic level estimation system has better precision, wider application range and stronger robustness by combining the Transformer with the ResNet and RNN structures and adopting the arrival time and travel time information as a means for data enhancement.

title_en: System for warning floor noise using sensor
title_ko: 센서를 이용한 층간소음 알림시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an inter-floor noise notification system using sensors, and more specifically, to an inter-floor noise notification system using sensors, which is provided with a vibration sensor and a sound sensor, so that when an inter-floor noise generated in the household exceeds a certain level, a sensor detects the inter-floor noise and emits a lamp or outputs a guidance sound, thereby making persons causing the inter-floor noise aware of the inter-floor noise and changing activities style within the household to reduce the inter-floor noise.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 센서를 이용한 층간소음 알림시스템에 관한 것으로, 더 상세하게는 진동센서 및 소리센서를 장착하여 세대에서 발생되는 층간소음이 일정크기 이상일 경우 센서가 이를 감지하여 램프발광 또는 안내음출력이 이루어지게 하여 층간소음 유발자에게 층간소음을 자각시켜 세대내 활동 스타일을 변경시켜 층간소음을 감소시킬 수 있는 센서를 이용한 층간소음 알림시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Multi-dimensional monitoring and early warning method and device for geological disaster risk of oil and gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention provides a multidimensional monitoring and early warning method and device for geological disaster risk of an oil and gas pipeline, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a target disaster risk based on a knowledge graph of the geological disaster risk of the oil and gas pipeline; acquiring a first multi-dimensional feature of a preset reference image, acquiring a second multi-dimensional feature of each frame of monitoring image, and inputting the first multi-dimensional feature and the second multi-dimensional feature into a preset association relation identification model to acquire a corresponding relation matrix between the monitoring image and the reference image; based on the corresponding relation matrix, acquiring the pose of a target object in each frame of monitoring image, and fusing the pose with the coding data corresponding to the monitoring image in the initial coding video stream to obtain a target coding video stream; and playing the target coded video stream through a preset video playing device so as to display the target disaster risk existing in each frame of monitoring image. This scheme is through the validity that can guarantee disaster risk monitoring, accuracy, timeliness.

title_en: Combat training safety control case
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a combat training safety control box, which comprises an upper box cover and a lower box body, wherein a combat duration monitoring mechanism is arranged in the lower box body and comprises a power supply unit and a plurality of duration monitoring units; the power supply unit supplies power to each duration monitoring unit; each time length monitoring unit comprises a circuit board, wherein the circuit board is provided with a magnetic induction detection unit, a controller, a time length display and adjustment unit and a warning and reminding unit; the magnetic induction sensor, the duration display and adjustment unit and the warning reminding unit of the magnetic induction detection unit are connected with the controller. Each duration monitoring unit monitors a firefighter, the magnetic induction detection unit senses a signal to the controller, the controller starts the duration display adjustment unit, the controller signals the duration display adjustment unit after the set time is reached, the controller enables the warning reminding unit to remind the firefighter to withdraw, if the set duration is not returned, the rescue team is organized, and the inside and outside cooperation guarantees the safety of the firefighter.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU FIRE RESCUE DETACHMENT TRAIN BRIGADE

title_en: Mine mining engineering monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mining engineering, in particular to a mining engineering monitoring and early warning device which comprises a base, wherein an adjusting mechanism and a swinging mechanism are arranged in the base; according to the utility model, the photovoltaic power generation can be carried out by utilizing solar energy through the photovoltaic power generation plate arranged at the upper end of the equipment, the generated electric energy is used for normal use of the equipment, the electric power burden of a mining area is reduced, the height of the audible and visual alarm can be manually adjusted through the adjusting rod and the sleeve, the audible and visual alarm is applicable to mining areas in different environments, the prompting range of the alarm can be enlarged by the audible and visual alarm at a higher position, a worker can remotely observe through the camera, so that the worker can be effectively arranged to withdraw, the worker can be conveyed to a safety center through pictures shot by the camera, and the occurrence of early warning deviation and error is reduced through double early warning of the sensor and the camera, and the early warning accuracy is improved.

title_en: Ground surface deformation monitoring method and related equipment based on interference radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing monitoring and discloses an earth surface deformation monitoring method based on an interference radar and related equipment. The method is applied to an interference radar-based earth surface deformation monitoring system, and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps of: the edge equipment adjusts model parameters of the monitoring model based on the regulation and control instruction so as to update the monitoring model; the edge equipment controls the interference radar to acquire multi-frame ground surface radar images based on the monitoring instruction, and sends the multi-frame ground surface radar images to the monitoring management platform so that the monitoring management platform can generate a regulation and control instruction, and according to the multi-frame ground surface radar images, ground surface deformation identification and landslide risk assessment are carried out by utilizing the latest monitoring model, so that a monitoring result of the ground surface deformation is obtained. The invention realizes the automatic early warning of landslide possibly occurring in the process of large-scale surface deformation, and improves the efficiency of the early warning of the landslide of the surface.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CORP EXTRA HIGH VOLTAGE POWER TRANS CO KUNMING BUREAU

title_en: Cross-machine-room database disaster recovery method and system based on network quality monitoring
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster recovery method and a system for a cross-machine room database based on network quality monitoring, which are characterized in that a ping-exporter binary file is distributed to a source host and is modified to serve as a system, a startup self-starting is set, a ping-exporter configuration file is dynamically modified according to monitoring task parameters, monitoring settings are updated, real-time network quality data is pulled by using Prometaus, an alarm is generated according to an alarm rule, and the alarm is pushed to an alert manager; the used components are mature, the deployment mode is simple, users can timely find out network data abnormality to react, loss caused by network faults is effectively reduced, and human resource cost is reduced.

title_en: Geological disaster identification early warning method and system based on remote sensing technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing, and particularly discloses a geological disaster identification and early warning method and system based on a remote sensing technology. According to the invention, a medium-resolution satellite is adopted to periodically scan, and a plurality of suspected abnormal target areas are updated and determined; adopting SAR (synthetic aperture radar) to carry out verification monitoring, and screening and marking a plurality of geological abnormal target areas; adopting a high-resolution satellite to perform key monitoring, and screening and marking a plurality of vegetation coverage areas; fine detection is carried out by adopting an airborne LiDAR, and abnormal states are acquired; and judging the abnormal risk, and performing geological disaster early warning when the abnormal risk exists. The method can effectively and reasonably comprehensively utilize the medium-resolution satellites, SAR, high-resolution satellites and airborne LiDAR, realize overall layout, layered arrangement and complementary advantages, can effectively identify different geological conditions, effectively avoid interference faced by a single remote sensing technology, and realize efficient, rapid and accurate geological disaster early warning.
assignees: SHANXI COAL GEOLOGY GEOPHYSICAL PROSPECTING SURVEYING AND MAPPING INST CO LTD

title_en: Urban flood control early warning system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses an urban flood control early warning system and method, which relate to the technical field of urban meteorological data processing and comprise the following steps: obtaining terrain data of a target city, and constructing a waterlogging dangerous point set of the target city; constructing association relations of waterlogging dangerous points in the waterlogging dangerous point set based on the topographic data of the target city; establishing a plurality of prediction models based on the historical flood data of the target city and the corresponding weather data; collecting future weather related prediction information of the target city according to a preset rule; and matching a corresponding prediction model from each prediction model according to the future weather related expected information, and predicting and updating the waterlogging risk of the waterlogging risk point set by combining the association relation of the waterlogging risk points. According to the method, the terrain influence relationship is considered, the weather related conditions are introduced to predict and update the waterlogging risk, and the accuracy of flood control prediction is improved.
assignees: LIAOCHENG KEHUI MUNICIPAL ENGINEERING DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Automatic emergency disposal system for civil gas explosion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic emergency disposal system for civil gas explosion, which comprises: the system comprises a control processor, a gas concentration sensor, a full-house power-off device, an exhaust ventilation device, an inert gas injection device, an audible and visual word alarm notification device, an automatic door and window closing device and a data analysis transmission module; the gas concentration sensor is used for detecting the concentration of fuel gas, oxygen and inert gas, and the full house power-off device, the exhaust ventilation device and the inert gas injection device are controlled to be opened and closed by the control processor; the audible and visual word alarm notification device is used for sending an alarm signal when the concentration of the fuel gas is abnormal; the automatic door and window closing device is arranged on the user door body and the window body; the data analysis transmission module is used for uploading accident emergency treatment data, and sending the danger alarm signal and the treatment condition to the mobile phone of the user and keeping the information updated.

title_en: Earthquake data information release system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic data information release system and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of seismic data processing. According to the earthquake data information release system and the storage medium, users can be divided into multiple release object grades from near to far by taking a seismic source as a center, so that the earthquake release sequence can release notifications according to the release object grades, the user closest to the seismic source can acquire earthquake early warning notification information in the shortest time, important users who really need to withdraw from danger can be locked to a great extent through the earthquake release notification, meanwhile, the earthquake early warning notification can be carried out on users who have access to the earthquake range or live in the earthquake range and are registered as non-earthquake ranges, the pertinence of the earthquake release is stronger, and the earthquake release is more comprehensive.

title_en: Image processing system for fire monitoring
title_ko: 화재발생 감시 복합 영상처리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an operation method of a complex image processing system for fire monitoring, the method including: a step (S100) of acquiring image information and thermal image information of a monitoring target area; a step (S200) of converting the information obtained in the step (S100) into a digital signal and calculating the signal strength of each pixel; a step (S300) of calculating an overall average value by summing each pixel value of the thermal image information calculated in the step (S200); a step (S400) of comparing the overall average value calculated in the step (S300) with the overall average value in a preset normal state; a step (S500) of generating an alarm if the value compared in the step (S400) is greater than the preset overall average value; a step (S600) of checking whether the network is operating normally if the value is equal to or less than the preset overall average value; a step (S700) of transmitting the calculated overall average value to the central control center and personal terminal if the network is operating normally; and a step (S800) of automatically switching to LTE mode if the network does not operate normally, transmitting information to the central control center and personal terminal and storing in its own memory, and, when the network operates normally again, transmitting the stored information to the central control center and personal terminal. Therefore, even when network conditions are poor, events that occur in the field can be reliably sent to the central control center.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 감시 대상 지역의 영상정보와 열영상정보를 획득하는 단계(S100), 상기 단계(S100)에서 획득된 정보를 디지털 신호로 변경하고 각 픽셀의 신호의 세기를 산출하는 단계(S200), 상기 단계(S200) 단계에서 산출된 열상정보의 각각의 픽셀 값을 합하여 전체 평균값을 계산하는 단계(S300), 상기(S300) 단계에서 계산된 전체평균값과 미리 설정된 정상상태의 전체평균값과 비교하는 단계(S400), 상기 단계(S400)에서 비교된 값이 미리 설정된 전체평균값 일정한 범위보다 클 경우에는 경보를 발생하고(S500) 네트워크가 정상으로 작동하는지를 확인하고(S600), 미리 설정된 전체 평균값보다 같거나 적을 경우에는 네트워크가 정상으로 작동 하는지를 확인하여(S600) 네트워크가 정상으로 작동할 경우에는 계산된 전체평균값을    중앙관제센터 및 개인단말기로 정보를 전송하고(S700), 네트워크가 정상작동이 안될 경우에는 LTE모드로 자동전환 되어(S800) 중앙관제센터 및 개인단말기로 전송하고 자체메모리에 저장하고, 네트워크가 다시 정상으로 동작될 시 저장된 정보를 중앙관제센터 및 개인단말기로 전송하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 화재발생 감시 복합 영상처리시스템의 작동방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Wearable protective device with help calling function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of protective devices, in particular to a wearable protective device with a help calling function. The invention provides a wearable protective device with a help calling function, which can perform high-temperature early warning on firefighters. The wearable protective device with the help calling function comprises a clamping ring and an early warning mechanism, wherein the front side of the clamping ring is rotationally connected, and the clamping ring is provided with the early warning mechanism; the breathing mechanism, the early warning mechanism and the clamping ring are provided with the breathing mechanism. According to the invention, the temperature of the rescue site is increased to reach the critical point of gas thermal expansion, the gas in the gas sealing tank expands to drive the piston rod to move upwards, so that the prompting rod moves inwards to squeeze the neck of the firefighter, thus the firefighter can be reminded of the possibility of overhigh temperature and bombing in the space, the firefighter can timely withdraw from the site, the situation of no fear of sacrifice is avoided, and when accidents happen, a button can be pressed, so that the distress call device can give out sound and light to give an alarm, thereby attracting the partner to help and improving the safety of the firefighter.
assignees: GUANGZHOU S AIRBAG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Train broadcasting control box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a train broadcasting control box, which comprises a broadcasting control box shell, a main board arranged in the broadcasting control box shell, and an Ethernet connector port, a power connector port, an address dial switch board, a grounding column, a loudspeaker connector port and an analog audio connector port which are arranged on the side wall of the broadcasting control box shell; the main board is also provided with a power amplification chip, an echo cancellation chip and a buzzer which are connected with the embedded processor, and a sound card which is connected with the power amplification chip and the echo cancellation chip; a buzzer sound outlet hole, a microphone, an equipment indicator light and a button are arranged on a panel of the broadcast control box shell. Compared with the prior art, the utility model plays alarm prompt tone and broadcast through the buzzer and the loudspeaker respectively, and the alarm prompt tone and the broadcast are not mutually interfered; the address dial switch board is utilized to flexibly configure the equipment address; the use state of the utility model is shown by the equipment indicator lamp.
assignees: NANJING MINGXIAO INTELLIGENT MANUFACTURING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Control device for dangerous source detection
abstract_en: The utility model provides a control device for hazard detection relates to forest fire prevention technical field, including a protection section of thick bamboo, protecting crust and infrared detector, the both sides of the protecting crust of a protection section of thick bamboo with it is connected with the rotation axis to rotate between the inside wall of a protection section of thick bamboo, the bottom fixedly connected with mount pad of protecting crust, the mount pad is top surface open-ended shell structure, the interior diapire central point of mount pad puts fixedly connected with motor of department. The utility model discloses an inside electric telescopic handle accomodates infrared detector the protecting crust, rotatory rotation axis half-turn makes the protecting crust overturn, and the warning lamp upset that the messenger is in top in the protective cylinder is downward, starts the alarm lamp, makes the strong dazzling illumination of alarm lamp heat dissipation, reminds the inside personnel of forest to withdraw, and the starter motor makes the motor drive the rotor plate and rotates, makes the rotor plate drive the alarm lamp and rotates, makes the radiating warning lamp light irradiation range increase of alarm lamp, has realized the effect that further plays the warning to the resident of forest.

title_en: Disaster early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster early warning method applied to a cloud edge cooperative system, and belongs to the field of disaster early warning. The cloud edge cooperative system comprises a cloud server, edge nodes and a plurality of edge terminals, wherein the cloud server is connected with the plurality of edge terminals through the edge nodes, and a plurality of disaster early warning models are stored in the cloud server. The method comprises the following steps: the cloud server selects a target early-warning model from a plurality of disaster early-warning models according to task properties, and transmits the target early-warning model to a plurality of edge terminals through edge nodes; the initial confidence coefficient threshold value of the target early warning model is regulated down, result data with the occurrence probability of the predicted target being greater than the initial confidence coefficient threshold value is summarized to an edge node, and the result data is uploaded to a cloud server after being re-marked; the re-labeled data is used as a training set, the target early-warning model of the edge node is trained again, and the target early-warning model is updated; replacing the current target early warning model; and carrying out disaster early warning through the target early warning model.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE OF TECH YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RESEARCH INSTITUTE JIAXING

title_en: Block for guiding visually handicapped person with weak radio wave transmission function
abstract_en: To broadcast information for a visually handicapped person, etc. to support their walking or provide guidance to an emergency evacuation place, with FM weak radio waves as analog technology with already completed infrastructures, incurring no large cost burden in transmission and reception without using digital technology in the core of the system.SOLUTION: A device constituted to broadcast appropriately updated broadcast content by using an FM radio broadcasting band weak radio wave transmitter 2 and an antenna 4 which can control a direction and a range of transmitted radio waves to enable a visually handicapped person, etc. who listens to the broadcast to determine a place and the direction in which he/she walks is integrated into a block 41 for guiding the visually handicapped person.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Dangerous rock collapse monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dangerous rock collapse monitoring and early warning system, which belongs to the technical field of early warning and comprises a base, wherein a protective shell and a rotary table are fixedly connected to the upper surface of the base respectively, a pressure sensor is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the rotary table, a buffer spring is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the pressure sensor, a support column is fixedly connected to the top end of the buffer spring, and a first movable frame is fixedly connected to the top end of the support column. This dangerous rock body monitoring early warning system that collapses through screw nail, fixed plate, second movable frame, spliced pole and first movable frame, can fix and cushion the rock body, avoids the rock body to appear collapsing, can not timely early warning the problem, through infrared ray obstacle avoidance sensor, controller and pressure sensor, can conveniently detect rock displacement, play the effect that guarantees that the staff can in time discover the collapse and withdraw in time, just can carry out the early warning after avoiding detecting data to need analyzing, causes the problem of harm to the staff easily.
assignees: SHAANXI EXPRESSWAY TESTING & INSPECTION CO LTD

title_en: Landslide safety early warning method and equipment based on reservoir water level dip
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide safety early warning method and device based on a sudden drop of a reservoir water level, wherein the method establishes the relation between the sudden drop amplitude of the reservoir water level and the penetration rate and the safety coefficient of a landslide plastic region according to an actual water level scheduling scheme and by combining analysis such as geological conditions, engineering experience analogy, numerical calculation, safety coefficient discrimination and the like, and determines a critical drop amplitude value according to the penetration rate and the standard requirement of the design safety coefficient of the sudden drop of the reservoir water level so as to determine the early warning value of the sudden drop amplitude of the reservoir water level. The system is clear in concept, convenient to operate and wide in application range, and can be suitable for the disaster prevention and reduction application of landslide caused by reservoir water level suddenly drop in a watershed reservoir. According to the invention, landslide safety can be checked regularly with the guidance of environmental protection and disaster prevention and reduction, the reservoir water level early warning value is updated, and the reservoir water level early warning signal is issued, so that the landslide safety early warning and forecasting technical method based on reservoir water level suddenly drop is formed.
assignees: HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Fire disaster intelligent evacuation guiding system based on multi-information source fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire intelligent evacuation guiding system based on multi-information source fusion, which comprises: the monitoring and positioning unit is used for collecting fire conditions, safety exit data and personnel position information; the evacuation guiding unit gives out fire early warning according to the data output by the monitoring and positioning unit, gives warning signals to indoor and outdoor personnel, plans evacuation escape tracks according to the occurrence condition of fire, updates the optimal escape route in real time, and feeds back the updated optimal escape route data to the server end for guiding trapped personnel to evacuate rapidly and safely; the self-rescue help seeking unit is used for receiving data of the server side, transmitting the positions, environments and physical conditions of personnel to fire rescue personnel when all escape routes are damaged, and guiding trapped personnel to save the self or escape to a relatively safe position by the evacuation guiding unit or the server side to wait for rescue.

title_en: Nozzle devide with changeable ejection form and warning system for the nozzle device user
title_ko: 사출 형태의 변경이 가능한 노즐 장치 및 노즐 사용자 경고 시스템
abstract_en: A nozzle device for dividing and ejecting liquid supplied through a fire hose in directions where a plurality of nozzle ends face, respectively, according to an embodiment of the disclosed invention comprises: a plurality of first branch tubes which are detachable from the nozzle device and are configured to deliver the supplied liquid to the nozzle ends; and a plurality of nozzle end units which are connected one by one to the corresponding first branch tubes, receive the liquid from the connected first branch tube, and spray the delivered liquid into the air through the nozzle ends, wherein the ejected form of the liquid can be changed depending on the number of the installed first branch tubes and nozzle end units.
abstract_ko: 개시된 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 소방호스를 통해 공급되는 액체를 복수의 노즐 끝단 각각이 향하는 방향으로 나누어 사출하는 노즐 장치는, 상기 노즐 장치에 탈착 가능하고, 상기 공급되는 액체를 상기 노즐 끝단에 전달할 수 있도록 구성되는 복수의 제1 분기관; 및 대응되는 상기 제1 분기관에 하나씩 연결되고, 상기 연결된 제1 분기관으로부터 상기 액체를 전달받고, 상기 전달받은 액체를 상기 노즐 끝단을 통해 공기중으로 분사하는 복수의 노즐 끝단부;를 포함하고, 장착되는 상기 제1 분기관 및 상기 노즐 끝단부의 개수에 따라 상기 액체가 사출되는 형태를 변경할 수 있다.

title_en: Alarm system states
abstract_en: Devices, systems, and methods for alarm system states are described herein. In some examples, one or more embodiments include a mobile device comprising a memory and a processor to execute instructions stored in the memory to receive a notification from a remote computing device that an event device in an alarm system has detected an event, where in response to the alarm system detecting the event, the alarm system is in a conditional state, acknowledge the event to cause the alarm system to remain in the conditional state, and transmit a signal to the remote computing device indicating whether the event is a true event or a false event, the mobile device further including a user interface configured to display the notification.

title_en: Remote monitoring device for fire engineering
abstract_en: The utility model provides a remote monitoring device for fire engineering belongs to fire engineering technical field, this remote monitoring device for fire engineering, including the crane, crane one side fixed surface installs fire prevention thermal insulation case, fire prevention thermal insulation case upper surface one side fixed mounting has monitor, fire prevention thermal insulation case upper surface opposite side fixed mounting has buzzing alarm lamp device, the both ends fixed mounting on fire prevention thermal insulation bottom of the case surface has smoke detector, and the adjustment subassembly realizes the rotation of probe biaxiaoyang, reduces the limitation of control visual angle adjustment, and the information data that monitor and smoke detector received handles the back by information processing transport module and pass through network transmission to fire control monitoring center, and the monitoring personnel discover that different appearance or smoke detector receive smoke signal in the picture and all can trigger buzzing alarm lamp device, reminds personnel to withdraw, accomplishes to send out the warning to personnel in the danger environment fast, improves monitoring device early warning speed, reduces the loss that the conflagration caused.

title_en: Geological exploration collapse-prevention precaution device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of collapse prevention early warning, and discloses a geological exploration collapse prevention early warning device, which comprises a base and a workbench; a support column is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top end of the base, a workbench is fixedly arranged at the top of the support column, wire reels are fixedly arranged at two sides of the support column, and data wires are wound on the wire reels; and the tail end of the data line is provided with a vibration sensor, and two sides of the bottom of the workbench are fixedly provided with data interfaces. According to the technical scheme, the data wire is arranged on the winder to be unfolded, and the two groups of vibration sensors are attached to the proper slope body, so that tiny vibration can be monitored in real time through the vibration sensors, the buzzer and the warning lamp can be automatically controlled to be lightened to give an alarm when vibration occurs, and then workers can be timely reminded to withdraw in time, the data wire can be arranged on the winder to be freely retracted and released, and therefore the vibration sensors can be flexibly arranged at proper positions, the installation convenience is greatly improved, and the early warning effect is more reliable.

title_en: A method for Simultaneous telemetry of Multiple factors of Radon concentration, Groundwater level, Electrical conductivity and Temperature from Groundwater well
title_ko: 지하수 관정에서 라돈, 지하수위, 전기전도도 및 온도의 다중인자를 동시 원격측정방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of simultaneously and remotely measuring multiple factors such as radon, groundwater level, electrical conductivity and temperature using a groundwater well, and more specifically to a method of simultaneously and remotely measuring multiple factors. The method of the present invention precisely calculates the change in radon concentration by considering multiple measurement factors, such as measurement of the concentration of radon gas emitted from pure groundwater wells while blocking the inflow of radon gas emitted from the ground surface, and measurement and matching of the groundwater level electrical conductivity and temperature at the same time when predicting earthquakes based on the radon concentration, thereby capable of performing earthquake prediction through accurate information. The method of simultaneously and remotely measuring multiple factors in groundwater wells includes a continuous measurement step of radon released from groundwater wells; an environmental factors measurement step; a combined measurement information transmission step; a reference data generation step; a deviation information provision step; a notification signal generation step; and a standard data update step.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하수 관정을 이용하여 라돈, 지하수위, 전기전도도 및 온도 등의 다중인자를 동시에 원격측정하는 방법에 관한 것으로, 더 상세하게는 지표면에서 방출되는 라돈가스의 유입을 차단하면서 순수 지하수 관정에서 배출되는 라돈가스의 농도를 측정하고, 동시간에 지하수위 전기전도도 및 온도를 측정하여 매칭시키는 등 라돈농도에 의한 지진예측시 다수의 측정인자를 고려해 라돈농도변화를 정밀하게 산출하여 정확한 정보를 통한 지진예측이 가능하게 하는 다중인자를 동시에 원격측정하는 방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: DAEJEON UNIV INDUSTRY UNIV COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Measurement system of oxygen concentration and water level in manhole for water and sewerage
title_ko: 상하수도용 맨홀 내부의 산소농도 및 수위 측정 시스템
abstract_en: An embodiment relates to an oxygen concentration and water level measurement system inside a water supply and sewage manhole and, more specifically, combines and measures the oxygen concentration and water level inside a water supply and sewage manhole using a multi-purpose ultrasonic water level sensor. Specifically, the system considers efficiency and economics when installing a device to measure oxygen concentration inside a manhole and adds an oxygen sensor as a parallel circuit to the existing water level sensor without installing a separate oxygen concentration meter. In other words, for this purpose, provided is a multi-purpose ultrasonic water level gauge that combines and measures the oxygen concentration and water level inside the water supply and sewer manhole. Additionally, the oxygen sensor is added to the water level gauge to change a single converter circuit, so measurements are performed in conjunction therewith. So, according to this, one embodiment ensures safety in terms of maintenance while maintaining the main function of manhole operation. More specifically, the oxygen concentration and water level inside the manhole are measured at the same time, preventing the use of dual equipment by a water and sewage worker who previously used an oxygen meter and an ultrasonic water level gauge separately, increasing work efficiency and economy. A manager outside the manhole also understands the internal situation in real time through the alarm sound from an alarm unit and quickly responds to sudden casualties.
abstract_ko:
실시예는 상하수도용 맨홀 내부의 산소농도 및 수위 측정 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 자세하게는 다용도 초음파 수위센서를 사용하여 상하수도용 맨홀 내부의 산소농도 및 수위를 병합하여 측정한다. 
구체적으로는, 이러한 시스템은 맨홀 내부에   산소농도를 측정하는 장치를 설치함에 있어 효율성과 경제성을 고려하여 별도의 산소농도측정기 설치 없이 기존에 설치된 수위센서에 산소센서를 병행회로로 추가한다. 즉, 이를 위해서 상하수도용 맨홀 내부의 산소농도와 수위를 병합하여 측정하는 다용도 초음파 수위계를 제공하는 방식인 것이다. 그리고, 이러한 수위계 내에 산소센서를 추가하여 단일형의 컨버터회로를 변경하므로 측정을 이에 연계하여 수행하도록 한다. 
그래서, 이에 따라 일실시예는 맨홀 운영의 주기능을 유지하면서 유지보수 측면에 안전성을 확보한다. 
더욱 자세하게는, 맨홀 내부 산소농도와 수위가 동시에 측정되어 기존에 산소측정기와 초음파 수위계를 각각 사용하는 상하수도 내부 작업자의 이중 장비 사용을 방지하여 작업의 효율성과 경제성을 높이고, 맨홀 밖에 있는 관리자도 알람부의 경보음을 통해 내부 상황을 실시간으로 파악하여 급작스럽게 발생되는 인명사고에 대해서도 신속히 대응한다.

title_en: Transmission line overhauls warning sign with tower
abstract_en: The utility model provides a transmission line overhauls warning sign with tower, this warning sign is installed in electrified side cross arm, including L type support, alternates in the connecting piece of L type support top side to and install the solar panel at L type support top; one end of the connecting piece is elastically connected with the inner cavity of the L-shaped bracket through a reset spring, and the other end of the connecting piece is connected with a vertically arranged shell, so that when the warning sign is installed, the L-shaped bracket, the connecting piece and the shell can be adaptively adjusted according to the width of the live side cross arm, and the warning sign can be stably hung on the live side cross arm; the front of casing embedding has the LED display screen, can set up corresponding warning sign indicating number that has warning color on the LED display screen in advance, and maintainer can see the warning sign indicating number that shows on the LED display screen like this to avoid the search personnel mistake to go into electrified cross arm, the circuit can not need to withdraw from reclosing, so as to ensure net maintenance time and promote electric wire netting security.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Conditional Access Right Verification and Digital Token Issuance/Management System and Method Based on Zero-Meter Altitude Exclusion Zones
title_ko: 고도 0미터 제외구역 기반 조건부 통행권 검증 및 디지털 토큰 발급·관리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for limiting ground and sea passage in real time and performing condition verification and management with a digital token based on an excluded area set at a reference altitude of 0 meters. It consists of a main server, a verification unit, a blockchain-based distributed verification server, a map information and altitude limit information table, a user operation unit, and a distributed storage, and the altitude, location, and time conditions are comprehensively determined to issue tokens when the conditions are met, and the history is recorded in the distributed ledger. Tokens will be automatically updated and discarded according to changes in situations such as policies and disasters, and warnings, route avoidance, and movement blocking functions will be performed when entering restricted areas. It can be applied to various moving objects such as autonomous vehicles, drones, uam, and autonomous ships.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기준 고도 0미터로 설정된 제외구역을 기반으로, 지상·해상 통행을 실시간 제한하고 디지털 토큰으로 조건 검증·관리를 수행하는 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 메인 서버, 검증부, 블록체인 기반 분산 검증 서버, 지도정보 및 고도제한정보 테이블, 사용자 조작부, 분산 저장소로 구성되며, 고도·위치·시간 조건을 종합 판단하여 조건 충족 시 토큰을 발급하고, 이력을 분산원장에 기록한다. 정책·재난 등 상황 변화에 따라 토큰은 자동 갱신·폐기되며, 제한구역 진입 시 경고, 경로 회피, 이동 차단 기능이 수행된다. 자율주행차, 드론, UAM, 자율운항 선박 등 다양한 이동체에 적용 가능하다.

title_en: Disaster recovery in media broadcast system
abstract_en: An edge device remotely accesses cloud-based media automation services by pointing an interface of the edge device to a cloud-based sequencer. Broadcast logs defining a broadcast schedule and media files specified in the broadcast logs are obtained from the cloud-based sequencer, and local versions are stored in a storage device locally accessible to the edge device. Availability of the cloud-based sequencer is monitored, and if the cloud-based sequencer becomes unavailable, the interface of the edge device is pointed to a local sequencer instead of the cloud-based sequencer. The local sequencer emulates one or more media automation services normally provided by the cloud-based sequencer. In response to determining that availability of the cloud-based sequencer has been restored, the edge device's interface is re-pointed to the cloud-based sequencer.

title_en: Broadcasted information via common or dedicated signalling in connected mode when using ncd-ssb
abstract_en: Systems and methods are disclosed that relate to broadcasted information when a User Equipment (UE) is configured with an active downlink (DL) bandwidth part (BWP) that does not contain a Cell Defining Synchronization Signal Block (CD-SSB). In one embodiment, a method performed by UE configured with an active DL BWP that does not contain a CD-SSB comprises receiving, from a network node, a message on a Physical Downlink Shared Channel (PDSCH), wherein the message comprises information related to a notification for either (a) system information update or (b) Earthquake and Tsunami Warning System (ETWS) and/or Commercial Mobile Alert System (CMAS). In this manner, the need for the UE to retune to a BWP that contains CD-SSB in case the network indicates notification for system information update or ETWS and/or CMAS can be removed.

title_en: Urban flood risk point prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting urban flood risk points, which belongs to the technical field of urban flood risk point identification and prediction, and comprises the steps of obtaining and establishing a rainfall event library according to historical daily rainfall data of a rainfall station and accumulated water data of an urban water collecting area; according to the rainfall event library, calculating the occurrence condition probability of the ponding; obtaining rainfall probability prediction data, predicting future flood risk occurrence probability according to the ponding occurrence condition probability and the rainfall probability prediction data, completing urban flood risk point prediction, and sending out early warning according to the flood risk occurrence probability; and carrying out error analysis on the occurrence probability of the flood risk to obtain an error analysis result, updating a rainfall event base according to the error analysis result, and carrying out urban flood risk point prediction based on the updated rainfall event base. The method solves the problem that the existing urban flood risk point prediction method is low in efficiency.

title_en: TDMA time slot allocation method for underground and underwater wireless Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-overhead TDMA time slot allocation method for underground and underwater wireless Internet of things, which mainly solves the problems of overlong time of time slot allocation process and larger allocation overhead in the underground severe environment in the prior art. The implementation scheme is as follows: constructing an underground Internet of things network model, and establishing a self time slot table, a one-hop node table and a two-hop node table on the same layer by the sensor node to finish initialization of each table item; all nodes update own hop count information through interaction of time slot frames, establish a network layered structure and complete updating of related table items; the sensor node selects the time slot group to which the sensor node belongs according to the hop value, the first layer node designates the sending time slot uniformly by the data sink node, the sensor node does not participate in the time slot allocation process, and other layer nodes send time slot frames mutually to negotiate to apply for the sending time slot. The method improves the transmission reliability of the underground wireless internet of things, reduces the additional communication overhead and reduces the network energy consumption, and can be used for underground environment monitoring, pipeline facility monitoring and disaster early warning.

title_en: Sprinkler system by direct connection of piped water
title_ko: 수도 직결형의 간이 스프링클러 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simple sprinkler system by direct connection of piped water. The simple sprinkler system by direct connection of piped water of the present invention is installed at a utensil holder. The utensil holder includes a frame that forms a body, and first and second support panels that are installed at the frame. The simple sprinkler system by direct connection of piped water includes various fire-fighting facility components installed at the first and second support panels and demonstrating an operation state of a sprinkler head. The simple sprinkler system by direct connection of piped water includes a water tank, a pump, a pressure gauge, a valve, piping, a detector, an alarm, a receiver, a control panel, and the like. Accordingly, by installing the simple sprinkler system by direct connection of piped water to the utensil holder, it is possible to utilize the simple sprinkler system by direct connection of piped water for planning, designing, producing, testing, and evaluating the system for students majoring in fire-fighting, thereby providing the students with an opportunity of designing, producing, and demonstrating the simple sprinkler system by direct connection of piped water to be applied to actual work in the future and greatly contributing to the understanding of the importance of fire-fighting.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수도 직결형의 간이 스프링클러 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 수도 직결형의 간이 스프링클러 시스템은 기구물 거치대에 설치되고, 기구물 거치대는 몸체를 형성하는 프레임과 프레임에 설치되는 제1 및 제2 지지 패널을 포함한다. 수도 직결형의 간이 스프링클러 시스템은 제1 및 제2 지지 패널에 설치되어 스프링클러 헤드의 작동 상태를 시연할 수 있는 다양한 소방 설비 부품들을 포함한다. 수도 직결형의 간이 스프링클러 시스템에는 수조, 펌프, 압력계, 밸브, 배관, 감지기, 경보기, 수신기 및 제어반 등을 포함한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 기구물 거치대에 수도 직결형의 간이 스프링클러 시스템을 설치하여 교육 현장에서 소방을 전공으로 하는 학생들에게 수도 직결형의 간이 스프링클러 시스템을 기획, 설계, 제작, 시험 및 평가하는데 활용하여 학생들로 하여금 직접 수도 직결형의 간이 스프링클러 시스템을 설계 및 제작하여 시연해 볼 수 있는 기회를 제공하고, 향후 실무에 즉시 적용할 수 있으며, 소방의 중요성을 이해하는데 큰 도움을 줄 수 있다.

title_en: YOLOv 7-based intelligent identification and early warning method for landslide of dam slope
abstract_en: The invention discloses a YOLOv 7-based intelligent identification and early warning method for a side slope landslide of a dam, which comprises the following steps: collecting image data of landslide hazard of the dam slope, and labeling the screened image data; preprocessing image data, dividing a data set, and sending a training set into a network model for training; the verification set verifies the training result and updates the weight file of the network model to obtain the optimal weight file of the dam slope landslide detection model; and performing high-resolution processing on the test set, and then testing the network model to evaluate the performance. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the accuracy of identifying the landslide of the dam side slope is improved, the automation level of identifying and early warning the landslide of the dam side slope is improved, the dangerous situation of collapse and landslide of the dam side slope can be automatically identified and positioned, real-time monitoring and early warning of the landslide of the dam side slope are realized, and the safety and stability of the landslide of the reservoir side slope are improved.

title_en: Apparatus for remotely releasing false alarm of alarm receiver
title_ko: 경보 수신기의 오경보를 원격에서 해제하는 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for remotely cancelling a false alert of an alert receiver. More specifically, a false alert remote cancelation device that can cancel a false alert is connected to an alert receiver that is not equipped with a networking function. Accordingly, if an alert sounds in a situation where no actual fire has occurred due to a false alert from the alert receiver, the alert is canceled by physically pressing an alert cancelation button through the false alert remote cancelation device under the remote control of a manager, or a communication port for system maintenance is used to electronically cancel the alert. As a result, conveniences of residents caused by frequent false alerts of the alert receiver can be relieved, and unnecessary firefighting dispatch can be prevented.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 경보 수신기의 오경보를 원격에서 해제하는 장치에 관한 것으로, 네트워킹 기능이 구비되어 있지 않은 경보 수신기에, 오경보를 해제할 수 있는 오경보 원격 해제 장치를 연결하고, 상기 경보 수신기의 오경보로 인해 실제 화재가 발생하지 않은 상황에서 경보가 울리면, 관리자의 원격제어에 따라 상기 오경보 원격 해제 장치를 통해 경보해제 버튼을 물리적으로 눌러주어 경보를 해제하거나, 혹은 시스템 유지보수를 위한 통신포트를 이용하여 전자적으로 경보를 해제함으로써, 상기 경보 수신기의 잦은 오경보에 의한 거주민들의 불편함을 해소하고, 불필요한 소방 출동을 억제할 수 있도록 하는 경보 수신기의 오경보를 원격에서 해제하는 장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Low orbit early warning satellite mission planning model
abstract_en: The invention provides a low-orbit early-warning satellite mission planning model, which comprises the following steps: a high orbit reconnaissance satellite and a plurality of low orbit early warning satellites; the high-orbit reconnaissance satellite reconnaissance the video field range, and sends first target tracking information to the low-orbit early warning satellite; under the condition that the tracked target is positioned in the field of view of the low-orbit early warning satellite, acquiring second target tracking information of the tracked target, and transmitting the second target tracking information to the high-orbit reconnaissance satellite; and the high orbit reconnaissance satellite iteratively updates the first target tracking information according to the second target tracking information, and sends the updated first target tracking information to the low orbit early warning satellite. According to the low-orbit early-warning satellite task planning model provided by the embodiment of the invention, the problem of the high dynamic property of the tracked target in the early-warning task can be well solved by adopting a high-orbit general survey and low-orbit detailed survey mode, and the early-warning task can be timely adjusted, so that the tracked target is always in the field of view of a certain low-orbit early-warning satellite.

title_en: Indication system and method for accident handling guidance and escape route of chemical plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indication system and method for handling instruction and escape route of accident in chemical plant, belonging to the technical field of safety monitoring in chemical plant, comprising a temperature sensor, an air sensor, a monitoring module, an image processing module, a cascade extraction module, a 3D reconstruction module, an instruction database, an intelligent plan module, a route planning module, a voice broadcasting module and a maintenance recording module; the invention can accurately predict and process the accidents of the chemical plant, realize the early prediction and treatment of the accidents, reduce the occurrence probability of the accidents, simultaneously automatically update parameters, reduce the operation difficulty, improve the use experience of staff, design the optimal escape route for each target in real time, avoid casualties caused by untimely escape, ensure the personal safety and improve the escape success rate.

title_en: Computer-implemented method and system for improving blockchain network communications
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a computer-implemented communication method. The method includes a mechanism for distributing blockchain-related communications and/or cryptocurrency-related communications such as alerts, notifications and updates to one or more recipients over an electronic network as efficiently and quickly as possible. Embodiments may use IPv6 multicasting to perform such improved communications. The communication may include code, flags, or filters that enable the communication to be targeted to a particular recipient and enable multicast group members that are not interested in or have no access to the communication to ignore the communication. Thus, there is an improvement in both processing resources and time. In some examples, the present disclosure may facilitate implementing a blockchain-related alarm key or system that may help a network to handle emergency situations or threats, thereby improving the security of the blockchain network.

title_en: Anti-collision system and method based on UE5
abstract_en: The application discloses a collision avoidance system and method based on UE5, which belong to the technical field of port collision avoidance, and comprise a production visualization module, a control module and a control module, wherein the production visualization module is used for carrying out three-dimensional modeling on a scene through a UE5 technical model to obtain a three-dimensional virtual wharf, carrying out management interaction in the three-dimensional virtual wharf and carrying out dynamic update on the motion state of operation equipment according to the acquisition frequency of data of each control system; the platform module of the Internet of things is used for connecting an automatic control system, collecting information data of the PLC and each sensing unit, dividing the wharf into four categories according to the information data, and carrying out merging, classifying and managing so as to form a wharf control data resource pool; the data model analysis module is used for analyzing and obtaining anti-collision early warning information according to the three-dimensional virtual wharf and a pre-constructed AI anti-collision early warning analysis model, feeding the anti-collision early warning information back to a user through a visual means, and constructing the AI anti-collision early warning analysis model according to data provided by a wharf control data resource pool; the application realizes effective anti-collision.

title_en: Contract expiration monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a contract expiration monitoring and early warning device which comprises a cabinet body, wherein a drawer for placing a contract is arranged on the cabinet body, a drawer panel is of a downward overturning structure, and an early warning device is fixedly arranged on the inner side surface of the drawer panel. A plurality of horizontal partition boards are arranged in the drawer, and the space in the drawer is divided into a plurality of interlayers for placing contracts. The alarm is characterized in that a timing module, a singlechip processor and a sound alarm are arranged in the alarm, a display screen and an input module are arranged on the surface of the alarm, and vertically arranged alarm lamps are arranged beside the drawer and correspond to the interlayers one by one. The utility model has the beneficial effects that: the monitoring and early warning device can carry out independent monitoring and early warning on each contract or a plurality of contracts which expire at the same time, is quicker and more convenient when taking the contract, does not need to be turned over, is convenient to take the contract, is provided with the sound warning device and the warning lamp for carrying out double prompt, and can accurately display the position of the expired contract.
assignees: SHENZHEN CITY FUTIAN DISTRICT COMMUNITY HEALTH SERVICE MAN CENTER

title_en: Flood prevention program for enhancing effectiveness of flood prevention, and flood prevention management system for parking/underground road therewith
title_ko: 침수 방지 효과를 높인 침수-예방 프로그램과, 이를 이용한 주차장/지하차도 침수 관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a flooding prevention program and a parking lot/underpass management system using the same, which analyze entry and exit vehicle information received from control equipment to generate/update parking situation information of each parking lot, obtain telephone number information of owners of parked vehicles by linking with an NDMS server, predict flooding by using water level, wind direction, and disaster linking sensors while linking with a weather center server and the NDMS server linked to the national/administrative network, and transmit a notification text to mobile phones of the vehicle owners when flooding is predicted to effectively prevent damage caused by vehicle submergence to reduce economical damage caused by flooding and increase the efficiency and convenience of the management of parking lots adjacent to a river and a riverside.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 각 관제설비로부터 전송받은 입출차 정보를 분석하여, 각 주차장의 주차현황정보를 생성/갱신함과 동시에 NDMS 서버와 연동하여, 주차된 차량들의 차주의 전화번호 정보를 획득하며, 국가/행정망과 연계되는 NDMS서버 및 기상청-서버와 연동하면서 수위, 풍향 및 재난연동센서를 이용하여, 침수를 예측하되, 침수 예측 시, 각 차주의 휴대폰으로 알림 문자를 발송하도록 구성됨으로써 차량 침수로 인한 피해를 사전에 효과적으로 방지하여, 침수로 인한 경제적 피해를 절감시킬 뿐만 아니라 강변 및 하천과 인접한 주차장 관리의 효율성 및 편의성을 높일 수 있는 침수-예방 프로그램과, 이를 이용한 주차장/지하차도 관리시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Context aware doorbell system
abstract_en: A doorbell system includes a doorbell located within a wireless local area network (WLAN) and communicatively connected to a wireless wide area network (WAN), a number of user devices communicatively connected to the WAN, and a controller. The doorbell includes an activation element and a monitoring element. The controller is configured to receive an indication of a user engaging the activation element of the doorbell and to select at least one of the user devices for display of an alert based on a priority status of the user devices. The system may alter or update the priority status of the user devices based on a user-dependent parameter of the priority devices, such as the users' schedules, sleep status, geo-location, or status as a caregiver.

title_en: Alert signal processing method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a warning signal processing method, a warning signal processing device, warning signal processing equipment, a warning signal processing storage medium and a warning signal processing program product, which can be applied to the technical field of fire information processing. The method comprises the following steps: responding to an alarm condition signal of alarm equipment, and acquiring initial alarm condition information corresponding to the alarm equipment; under the condition that the initial warning information meets a first preset condition, upgrading the initial warning information to obtain an updated warning; under the condition that the initial warning information meets a second preset condition, combining the warning information to obtain a combined warning; generating a target warning condition according to the updated warning condition and the combined warning condition; and generating a fire-fighting early warning prompt according to the target warning condition.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION BANK CORP;CCB FINTECH CO LTD

title_en: Visual fire data monitoring system and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a visual fire data monitoring system and a monitoring method thereof. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a preprocessing module, a monitoring module and a data pushing module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring basic information of fire-fighting equipment and is configured to monitor equipment states of the fire-fighting equipment installed in a corridor to acquire monitoring data, the preprocessing module is used for classifying and preprocessing the basic information and carrying out distortion preprocessing on the monitoring data, the monitoring module is used for judging whether the states of the fire-fighting equipment installed in the corridor change according to the monitoring data, if so, the visualization module is triggered to execute alarm operation, the visualization module is configured to construct an equipment layout according to the basic information, respond to the alarm operation of the monitoring module and update the equipment layout and generate alarm information, and the data pushing module is used for sending the equipment layout and the alarm information to terminal equipment. The invention solves the problem that fire-fighting equipment cannot be used normally because early warning cannot be performed when the fire-fighting equipment is moved or shielded.

title_en: Artificial Intelligence-based disaster safety and crime prevention video surveillance system and Method thereof
title_ko: Ai 기반 재난안전 및 방범용 영상감시시스템과 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an AI-based disaster safety and crime prevention image monitoring system capable of determining whether a risk exists based on moving information of a crowd recognized through a camera, and a method thereof. In accordance with the present invention, the AI-based disaster safety and crime prevention image monitoring system includes: a central processing unit extracting image data by sampling an images photographed by a camera at regular intervals; a measurement unit connected to the central processing unit to estimate a risk level based on crowd speed and density recognized from the image data; a determination unit connected to the central processing unit to determine whether a risk exists based on the output of a risk level determination model using the risk level as input, and, when determining that a risk exists, transmitting a risk alarm to a user interface unit; a storage unit connected to the central processing part to store learning data necessary for updating the risk level determination model when the risk determination result by the determination unit is different from actual information about whether the risk exists, received from the user interface unit; and a learning unit connected to the central processing unit to train and update the risk level determination model based on the learning data.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 카메라를 통해 인식된 군중의 이동 정보를 토대로 위험여부를 판단하는 AI 기반 재난안전 및 방범용 영상감시시스템과 그 방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따른 AI 기반 재난안전 및 방범용 영상감시시스템은 카메라에서 촬영한 영상을 일정한 주기로 샘플링하여 이미지데이터를 추출하는 중앙처리부, 중앙처리부에 연결되어 이미지데이터로 인식된 군중속도와 밀집도를 토대로 위험도를 추정하는 측정부, 중앙처리부에 연결되어 위험도를 입력으로 한 위험도 판단모델의 출력 및 중앙처리부에서 제공하는 위험임계값을 토대로 위험여부를 판단하고, 위험으로 판단될 경우 사전위험경보를 사용자 인터페이스부로 송신하는 판단부, 중앙처리부에 연결되어 판단부에서의 위험 판단 결과와 사용자 인터페이스부로부터 수신된 실제 위험여부가 상이할 경우 위험도 판단모델의 갱신에 필요한 학습데이터를 저장하는 저장부, 및 중앙처리부에 연결되어 학습데이터를 토대로 위험도 판단모델을 학습하여 갱신하는 학습부로 이루어진다.

title_en: Water conservancy and hydropower engineering construction safety supervision system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring construction safety of water conservancy and hydropower engineering. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a hub monitoring subsystem comprising a plurality of first sensors in a dam hub area; constructing a landslide body monitoring subsystem comprising a plurality of second sensors in a landslide body area; constructing an early warning rule for single construction risk based on the subset of the first sensor and the second sensor; the pre-warning rules are updated based on periodic and/or incident manual checks. According to the invention, when the deformation of the hub and the landslide body, the groundwater level of the landslide body and other data reflecting engineering risks are monitored through the monitoring subsystem, personnel inspection information which is difficult to obtain through the monitoring data is obtained through manual inspection, an early warning rule is constructed and updated, and the accuracy, timeliness and instantaneity of early warning are improved.
assignees: SICHUAN WATER CONSERVANCY ENG CONSTRUCTION QUALITY AND SAFETY CENTER STATION

title_en: Tunnel tunneling disaster monitoring and early warning system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunneling, in particular to a digital twinning-based tunneling disaster monitoring and early warning system. Comprising the following steps: the system comprises an inversion learning operation module, a tunnel construction entity module, a twin digital model and a twin database. The invention establishes a digital twin model based on the real development environment of the tunnel and the underground space, simulates the whole development process of the tunnel and the underground space, visualizes the whole construction state, gives early warning to the disasters about to happen, and can update and optimize the model according to the on-site construction, thereby developing the driving protection for the traffic country construction and the underground space in China.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION 3RD ENG BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;CHINA STATE RAILWAY INVEST CONSTRUCTION DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Intelligent building dangerous case processing system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent buildings, and discloses an intelligent building dangerous case processing system, which comprises: the system comprises a detection module, a region division module, an danger avoiding route planning module, an information notification module and a control module. The area dividing module is connected with the detection module; the risk avoidance route planning module is connected with the region dividing module; the information notification module is connected with the region dividing module and the risk avoidance route planning module; the control module is connected with the area dividing module, the risk avoidance route planning module and the information notification module. According to the application, people can be guided to withdraw in time sequence, disaster-stricken personnel can scientifically take self-rescue measures, survival probability is improved, and meanwhile, rescue staff can clearly rescue the target place according to the planned safety route, so that the rescue staff can rescue in a destination way, and rescue difficulty is reduced. The application also discloses a control method for the intelligent building dangerous case processing system.
assignees: LINYI CITY HEDONG DISTR URBAN CONSTRUCTION COMPREHENSIVE SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Region-based multi-industry object global weather risk early warning method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a regional-based multi-industry object global weather risk early warning method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring boundary data of a target area and all meteorological factor data at a certain time point; dividing a target area into a plurality of grid areas according to boundary data and the calibrated spatial resolution, and processing meteorological factor data into meteorological factor grid data; constructing a gridding time data layer of each meteorological factor at a certain time point; acquiring position information of a multi-industry object in a target area and a risk threshold value of a meteorological factor corresponding to the position information; and respectively determining the grid areas according to the position information, calling grid data corresponding to the grid areas in grid time data layers with different weather factors and the same time, comparing the grid data with a corresponding industry object weather factor risk threshold value, and simultaneously carrying out weather risk early warning on multiple industry objects. The method and the system can perform global real-time rolling update weather risk early warning on multi-industry objects in the target area.

title_en: Vegetation penetrating type slope deformation monitoring radar system and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a vegetation penetrating type slope deformation monitoring radar system and a monitoring method thereof, which belong to the field of radar detection, and the system is smaller in size and better in portability compared with a conventional radar system, can realize vegetation penetrating detection and complete a slope landslide early warning function of slope topography in a covered area by designing an arc scanning deformation monitoring radar working in an L-band, sending signals to a monitoring area, receiving echo signals, preprocessing the echo signals, imaging according to the echo signals, selecting and updating PS points of imaging results, and then carrying out deformation inversion on an updated PS set.
assignees: SUZHOU RACO SENSOR TECH CO LTD

title_en: Medical supplies supply chain intelligent early warning system and early warning machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning system and an early warning machine for a medical material supply chain, comprising an information input module, an output module, a temperature and humidity monitoring module, a display module, an early warning and alarming module, an input module and a control module; the information input module is used for inputting information of medical supplies; the output module is used for recording the output use information of the medical materials; the temperature and humidity monitoring module is used for monitoring temperature and humidity information of the environment in real time; the display module is used for displaying the medicine information to be invalidated; the early warning and alarming module is used for presenting alarming information sent by the decision executing unit in an acousto-optic mode; the input module is used for setting the expiration date and the quantity threshold of the medical materials when the alarm information is sent out and the temperature and humidity information threshold of the medical material storage environment. The invention can effectively avoid the problems of various resource waste, medical material supply shortage and insufficient supply chain caused by human factors, imperfect management system and the like, so as to ensure the normal and effective operation of the medical supply chain.
assignees: The Second Medical Center Of Chinese PLA General Hospital

title_en: A Fire Detection System for Fire Hazardous Facilities Adopting Self Generation by Fire Heat
title_ko: 화재 열에 의한 자기발전 기술을 적용한 화재 위험 설비용 화재감지시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire detection system for fire hazard equipment using a self-generation technique by fire heat.
