The fire detection system capable of detecting a fire occurrence by applying a self-generation technique by fire heat when a fire occurs in fire hazard equipment including one or more selected from a group including a power device, a distribution board, a cable connection part, a cable insertion part, a cable withdrawal part, an ammunition warehouse, and an oil reservoir comprises: a generation part arranged adjacent to the fire hazard equipment, and including a thermoelement generating electricity by sensing heat generated from a fire when a fire occurs in the fire hazard equipment; an electrophotic conversion part receiving an electric signal generated from the generation part to convert the electric signal into a light signal; a photoelectric conversion part receiving a light signal generated by the electrophotic conversion part to convert the light signal into an electric signal; and a control part receiving an electric signal generated by the photoelectric conversion part in a receiving module to control to transmit a fire signal to generate a fire occurrence warning if the magnitude of the electric signal is higher than or equal to a prescribed value, perform a fire evacuation broadcast, shut off electricity, or operate fire-extinguishing equipment. The electrophotic conversion part and the photoelectric conversion part are mounted in a sealed dark room to prevent external light from infiltrating thereinto to prevent errors. External power can be supplied or power generated by the generation part can be directly supplied to one or more among the control part, a fire occurrence warning part, a fire evacuation broadcasting part, an electricity shut-off switch, and a fire-extinguishing equipment operation part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 열에 의한 자기발전 기술을 적용한 화재 위험 설비용 화재감지시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 전력기기, 수배전반, 케이블 접속부, 케이블 인입부, 케이블 인출부, 탄약고 및 유류저장소를 포함하는 그룹에서 선택된 1종 이상을 포함하는 화재 위험 설비에서 화재 발생 시 화재 열에 의한 자기발전 기술을 적용하여 화재 발생을 감지할 수 있는 화재감지시스템에 있어서, 화재 위험 설비에 인접하여 배치되고, 화재 위험 설비에서 화재가 발생 시 화재로부터 발생된 열을 감지하여 전기를 발생시키는 열전 소자를 포함하는 발전부, 발전부로부터 발생된 전기 신호를 수신하여 빛 신호로 변환하는 전광 변환부, 전광 변환부에서 발생된 빛 신호를 수신하여 전기 신호로 변환하는 광전 변환부, 수신 모듈에서 광전 변환부에서 발생된 전기 신호를 수신하여, 전기 신호의 크기가 일정값 이상이면 화재 발생 경보를 발생시키거나, 화재 대피 방송을 하거나, 전기를 차단시키거나 또는 소화 설비가 작동시키도록 화재 신호를 전송하도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함하고, 전광 변환부 및 광전 변환부는 오류를 방지하고자 외부의 빛이 내부로 침투할 수 없도록 밀폐된 암실 내에 장착되고, 제어부, 화재 발생 경보부, 화재 대피 방송부, 전기 차단 스위치 및 소화 설비 작동부 중 어느 하나 이상에는 발전부에서 발생된 전원을 직접 공급하거나 또는 외부의 전원을 공급할 수 있다.

title_en: Vehicle-related projectile minimization
abstract_en: An example operation includes one or more of determining a danger level of an object in a vehicle, determining characteristics of the object including a weight, a size, and a location, updating the danger level of the object based on one or more of the characteristics, and sending a notification to a device associated with the updated danger level of the object.
assignees: TOYOTA CONNECTED NORTH AMERICA INC;TOYOTA MOTOR NORTH AMERICA INC;TOYOTA MOTOR CO LTD

title_en: Dangerous dynamic early warning method applied to regional landslide disaster
abstract_en: The application relates to a dangerous dynamic early warning method applied to regional landslide disasters. And collecting multisource data of a research area, and establishing a geographic information database of landslide disasters based on a GIS platform. Constructing a landslide susceptibility evaluation index system, carrying out regional landslide susceptibility evaluation to obtain a regional landslide susceptibility static evaluation result, and comparing the static result by adopting various precision evaluation indexes, wherein an optimal regional landslide susceptibility region is preferably obtained. And (3) carrying out data mining on the meteorological information and landslide disaster information to obtain multiple rainfall threshold grading curves of regional landslide occurrence, and preferably obtaining an optimal landslide critical rainfall threshold. Dividing the optimal region landslide risk area into five sections, simultaneously integrating the optimal critical rainfall threshold value divided by probability, and establishing a landslide risk early warning model by means of a fuzzy evaluation matrix. And inputting real-time dynamic rainfall data, and realizing dynamic early warning of regional landslide hazard dangers through continuously updated hour rainfall data.

title_en: Power supply for broadcasting with simultaneous active supply and control of AC and DC power
title_ko: 교류(ac) / 직류(dc) 동시 능동 공급 및 제어가 가능한 구내 방송용 전원공급장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an in-house broadcasting device capable of improving power supply efficiency and seamlessly broadcasting in an emergency. To this end, the present invention provides an in-house broadcasting device comprising: a power input unit which supplies alternating current power; an amplifier unit which is supplied with the alternating current power by the power input unit, amplifies audio, and transmits the amplified audio; a pre-charging unit which performs charging by converting the alternating current power of the power input unit into direct current; a sensor unit which measures a voltage and a current of the power input unit and the amplifier unit; an emergency switching unit which switches power to the pre-charging unit based on data of the sensor unit; and a control unit which controls an operation of the emergency switching unit. Accordingly, the present invention can provide an in-house broadcasting device which can be continuously and stably driven during a power outage, and enables a manager to quickly handle a load abnormality and check the stability of customized equipment.
abstract_ko:
본원발명은 전원공급효율을 향상시키고, 비상시에도 끊김없이 방송을 할 수 있는 구내방송장치에 관한 것이다. 이를 위하여, 본 발명은 교류전원을 공급하는 전원입력부; 상기 전원입력부에 의해 교류전원을 공급받아 오디오를 증폭하여 송출하는 앰프부; 상기 전원입력부의 교류전원을 직류로 변환하여 충전하는 예비충전부; 상기 전원입력부 및 앰프부의 전압 및 전류를 측정하는 센서부; 상기 센서부에 의한 데이터에 기초하여 상기 예비충전부로 전원을 변경하는 비상전환부; 상기 비상전환부의 작동을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하여 구성되는 구내방송장치를 제공한다. 
따라서, 본 발명은 정전시에도 끊김없이 안정적으로 구동할 수 있는 구내방송장치를 제공할 수 있으며, 부하이상시 관리자가 신속하게 대처할 수 있고 커스터마이징된 장비의 안정성 여부를 확인할 수 있는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Method for monitoring, reporting and early warning of COVID-19 streaming based on wireless communication and ranging
abstract_en: The invention has the following names: a method for monitoring, reporting and early warning of the covd-19 streaming based on wireless communication and ranging. Technical field: wireless ranging and wireless communication applications. The technical scheme is as follows: the distance information and the time information between devices are detected by taking the standards of 802.11AX and 802.11ac, namely the standards of VHT and HE as a test method in a 2G-5G environment through portable communication devices such as mobile phones, tablet personal computers or other portable devices, and the detection distance reaches the distance precision of 20cm and more. The system and the implementation of the application device comprise the following subsystems: the system comprises a radio frequency front end, a baseband signal processor and a central processing unit of the system. The device is used for testing the approaching distance and time of people, epidemic prevention and epidemiological investigation can be accurately carried out, the contact distance of potential new crown positive personnel can be recorded, monitored and early-warned in real time, and the database is updated at the central control position. Can also be used in other fields.

title_en: Train interval evacuation method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to a train interval evacuation method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the train automatic protection system controls the vehicles to stop to the interval evacuation platform after detecting the vehicle alarm information and generates an interval evacuation application, the line control system performs validity check according to the interval evacuation application after receiving the interval evacuation application, if the line control system determines that the vehicle is legal after checking, the train automatic protection system sends a notification message that the interval evacuation protection area is established, and the train automatic protection system controls the vehicles to open the doors on the corresponding sides of the train evacuation platform after receiving the notification message so as to evacuate passengers. The application solves the problem that the fire disaster is more serious because the train can only enter the front platform for emergency evacuation when the train runs in a long interval to generate the fire disaster in the related technology, and achieves the purposes of quickly and accurately finding the vehicle danger and avoiding the danger and minimizing the accident hazard.
assignees: BEIJING URBAN CONSTRUCTION INTELLIGENT CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Material pile real-time monitoring and early warning method in loading process based on 3d point cloud
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of stockpile monitoring, in particular to a stockpile real-time monitoring and early warning method in a loading process based on 3d point cloud, which comprises the following steps: s1: scanning the material pile through a 3D laser scanner to obtain three-dimensional point cloud data of the material pile; s2: calculating according to the three-dimensional point cloud data to obtain optimal material taking and loading positions; s3: in the material taking and loading process, data of material pile deformation and displacement in the material taking process are obtained through a 3d laser scanner, the material pile is monitored in real time, the data of the material pile deformation and displacement are calculated, material pile change trend data are obtained, analysis is carried out according to the material pile change trend data, early warning is sent to technicians according to analysis results, early warning is carried out on site workers through a loudspeaker and an alarm lamp, and therefore the on-site workers can withdraw from a landslide in time conveniently.
assignees: ZAOZHUANG XINJINSHAN INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Emergency positioning method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an emergency positioning method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: each emergency positioning device arranged in the preset area broadcasts own equipment information and scans signals of the equipment information broadcast by other surrounding emergency positioning devices; the equipment information of the other emergency positioning devices is reported to a background server by each emergency positioning device, so that the background server can determine the distance identification of each emergency positioning device relative to the appointed position in the preset area according to the equipment information of the other emergency positioning devices reported by each emergency positioning device; each emergency positioning device receives the distance identification of the emergency positioning device relative to the appointed position from the background server and displays the distance identification. Through the method and the device, the problem that the relative position of the related personnel in the disaster scene cannot be determined is solved, and the effect of guiding the related personnel in the disaster scene to withdraw rapidly is achieved.
assignees: SHENZHEN KUANG CHI SPATIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Novel portable block terminal ground connection alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel mobile type distribution box grounding alarm, which relates to the technical field of distribution boxes and comprises a distribution box main body, wherein an alarm main body is arranged at a 40D aperture at the side of the distribution box main body, and a power supply, a time control relay, an alarm lamp, a resistance controller and a buzzer are respectively arranged on the alarm main body. When the distribution box main body of the warning device does not adopt effective grounding, the resistance value is infinitely large, and the resistance controller can take the value through instructions at the moment: when the main body of the distribution box is grounded, the resistance value is effectively controlled to be lower than 4 ohms, the control instruction of the resistance controller is automatically withdrawn and in an open circuit state, and no voltage and no current are generated in the whole circuit.

title_en: Cloud disaster recovery backup method and system for big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud disaster recovery backup method and system for big data, which relate to the technical field of cloud disaster recovery backup and comprise a backup data acquisition module, a first acquisition unit, a backup engine module, a backup storage module, a second acquisition unit, a server, an anomaly sensing unit, an accidental anomaly removal unit, an early warning unit and a cloud disaster recovery module. According to the invention, the process of carrying out data backup on the cloud capacity backup system is monitored, when the abnormal hidden danger of incomplete or lost data backup exists in the data backup of the system, an early warning prompt is sent out to prompt backup personnel to know the situation, and related measures are taken to deal with the situation in advance, so that the data integrity of the data backup of the system is ensured, the latest data version can be recovered through the system in the data loss, and the serious damage to the service caused by the incomplete data backup is avoided.

title_en: Stress wave P-wave component pickup sensor based on hollow piezoelectric ball and application method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stress wave P-wave component pickup sensor based on a hollow piezoelectric ball and an application method thereof. According to the invention, by constructing the hollow piezoelectric ball with radial polarization and symmetry, P waves with right-symmetrical properties generate the same potential on two hemispheres of the piezoelectric ball, so that excitation charges are mutually overlapped to form P wave signals, S waves with anti-symmetrical properties form opposite potentials on adjacent quarter spheres and finally cancel each other, the purpose of filtering the S waves is realized, the operation is simple, the separation precision is high, and the method is well applicable to earthquake early warning systems needing P wave real-time monitoring.

title_en: Data backup processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data backup, and provides a data backup processing method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: creating a remote copy relationship between the production volume and the disaster recovery volume, and sending a creation notification to the slave device, so that the slave device sets a mark of the remote copy relationship as a first mark, and the first mark represents that the disaster recovery volume is in a normal state; enabling a remote copy relationship, and executing data backup between the production volume and the disaster recovery volume; the mark of the remote copy relation is determined to be updated from the first mark to the second mark, and incremental data backup between the production volume and the disaster recovery volume is executed; the second identifier characterizes that the failure of the disaster recovery volume has been recovered and a portion of the data is lost. The invention realizes normal backup and even incremental backup of the data after the recovery of the original disaster recovery volume under the original remote copy relationship, so that the resource is not wasted and the use cost is not enlarged.
assignees: SUZHOU INSPUR INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

abstract_en: To ensure accuracy in narrowing down the conditions requested by a user for event information that may vary in timing and frequency of updates.SOLUTION: An information processor includes: receiving means 201 for receiving event information from an information acquisition device; management means 203 for managing a plurality of attributes to be associated with the event information; and notification means 201 for notifying of results obtained by identifying the event information based on at least a first attribute and a second attribute selected by a user among the plurality of attributes.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Interactive emergency prompt report processing method and device based on intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses an interactive emergency prompt report processing method and device based on an intelligent terminal, comprising the following steps: when an emergency public event occurs, the intelligent terminal reports the emergency event and triggers an active reporting mechanism of the emergency event; acquiring emergency details filled in according to the active reporting mechanism of the triggering emergency, and reporting the emergency details to a server; based on the reported emergency details, automatically constructing an intelligent terminal registered by a base station where the emergency occurs as a current base station tight flash report temporary group, and controlling the mass-sending of corresponding emergency notification information to the intelligent terminal registered by the base station where the emergency occurs; and the intelligent terminal registered by the base station where the emergency occurs updates the current emergency progress in real time through mass information. The invention can effectively utilize the intelligent terminal at the place where the emergency occurs to trigger and update the latest progress of the current emergency, and can perform quick interaction to complete the early warning and update notification of the current emergency.
assignees: SICHUAN KUBI COMMUNICATION EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for monitoring agricultural meteorological disasters, wherein the method for monitoring agricultural meteorological disasters comprises the following steps: constructing a knowledge graph of agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring based on the obtained multi-source heterogeneous data related to the agricultural meteorological disaster monitoring; updating the weather data in the weather grids in the knowledge graph based on the updated weather forecast data to obtain an updated knowledge graph; determining whether an abnormal weather grid exists in the updated knowledge graph based on weather data in the updated knowledge graph and preset disaster conditions; determining a geographical area corresponding to the abnormal weather grid and an agricultural weather disaster grade of the area corresponding to the abnormal weather grid in the geographical area; and screening out farmland patches for planting specific crops from the areas corresponding to the abnormal meteorological grids in the geographic area, and sending early warning information of agricultural meteorological disasters to an administrator of the farmland patches.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Disposable emergency warning lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disposable emergency warning lamp which comprises a lamp shade, a base, a circuit board, a battery and a negative electrode spring, wherein the lamp shade and the base are assembled together to form a cavity, the circuit board, the battery and the negative electrode spring are arranged in the cavity, an LED lamp is arranged on the circuit board, the circuit board is arranged inside the lamp shade, the circuit board is fixedly connected with the lamp shade, the base is provided with a turnbuckle block, the lamp shade is correspondingly provided with a guide groove, the guide groove is provided with an anti-withdrawal block, the anti-withdrawal block divides the guide groove into a sliding groove and a limiting groove, one end of the anti-withdrawal block, which is close to the sliding groove, is an inclined surface, one end of the anti-withdrawal block, which is close to the limiting groove, is a vertical surface, the turnbuckle block can slide in the sliding groove and enter the limiting groove through the anti-withdrawal block, and the circuit board and the negative electrode spring can be contacted by rotating the lamp shade. The utility model can keep a normally-bright state, and can reduce the risk of the device being extinguished when not being attended to affect the subsequent rescue speed; adopt disposable structure, select cheap, light material and component, can reduce cost, conveniently carry.
assignees: SICHUAN TENGHUA INTELLIGENT CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Moving ring fault prediction and linkage control method and system based on machine vision
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring, and particularly discloses a dynamic ring fault prediction and linkage control method and system based on machine vision. The method comprises the steps of extracting feature information from early warning information to obtain early warning feature information, extracting feature information from alarm information to obtain alarm feature information, generating fault prediction strategy information according to the early warning feature information and the alarm feature information, judging whether the fault prediction strategy information is in preset strategy library information, and updating the fault prediction strategy information into the preset strategy library information if the fault prediction strategy information is not in the preset strategy library information, so that the existing database can be continuously updated in real time, the machine room fault can be comprehensively predicted according to the database updated in real time, and meanwhile, the real-time updated database can also comprehensively link emergency equipment which needs to be timely linked after the occurrence of a problem, so that the risk of the machine room after the occurrence of safety fire fighting safety can be reduced through timely linkage.

title_en: A system based on ai and crowd dynamics invented to improve safety and efficiency while traveling in groups or clusters during crowded events like hajj and umrah
abstract_en: A wearable electronic travel aid device is disclosed for monitoring and guiding pedestrians in crowds, including those with visual impairments. The device uses positioning sensors and Al to generate accurate location estimations within a twenty-cubic-centimetre frame. It also includes a guidance communication system, audio signals, 3D Haptic communication, and a human-machine interface. The system uses RSSI and CSI techniques to characterise human presence and activities, and uses Wi-Fi fingerprinting for active localization. It is designed for crowd dynamics management, particularly for crowded Islamic rituals like Hajj. The system is based on active particle dynamics principles. The system uses particle dynamics to model crowds with discrete sets of pseudo-particles, allowing for realistic dynamic behaviour and event change detection. It also includes pedestrian dynamics, integrating groups of different sizes for crowded situations like Al Kaaba, Masjid al- Haram, and the Holy City of Makkah during Hajj or Umrah pilgrimages. The system uses clustering algorithms and supports vector machines to process pedestrians and optimize their paths. It also includes a dashboard for managing simultaneous requests and positioning data, ensuring safety for individual travellers or pilgrims. The dashboard uses big-data analysis to detect and predict crowd congestion in real-time, enabling timely interventions in emergencies or potential security threats. This crowd motion summarization approach can benefit industries such as public safety, event management, and urban planning by accurately estimating crowd density, predicting precise crowd motions, and forecasting trajectories. The system is designed to guide individuals to services such as restrooms, food, and medical care stations. It uses real-time crowd data analysis to estimate occupancy levels and propose alternatives. The system also functions as an intelligent traveling guide and companion, with a multitude of chatbots providing services like accommodation reservations, purchase requests, and site seeing. The bots use crowd dynamics to provide comprehensive guidance, hints, and alerts. They can assist with Islamic rituals, travel, tourism, and evacuation. The Evacuation Bot uses crowd dynamics and real-time data to manage evacuation procedures and ensure safety during emergencies. The Near Services Bot assists in finding nearby amenities and provides real-time updates on wait times. The system uses deep neural networks to suggest shortest paths and cost functions to ensure efficient and cost-effective travel.

title_en: Solar power plant with wireless automatic module power cut-off function by earth leakage detection
title_ko: 누전감지로 모듈전원 무선 자동차단하는 태양광발전장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a solar power generation device for wirelessly and automatically cutting off module power using detection of a leakage current. The solar power generation device includes a function for automatically cutting off a leakage current by measuring, by sensors provided at the front end of a junction box, a leakage current due to the remaining magnetic flux corresponding to a difference between the magnetic fluxes of the positive (+) and negative (-) currents of a DC power circuit after the magnetic fluxes are canceled, wirelessly transmitting a cut-off signal when a leakage current of 20 mA or more that can affect the human body is generated, and wirelessly receiving DC power to a cut-off relay installed near solar modules, to detect, in the early stage, electrical accidents caused by poor connection, insulation breakdown, or current leakage in positive (+) or negative (-) wires or the related equipment in the DC power circuit that transmits, to an inverter, the power generated from the solar modules and prevent the spread, a notification function, and a monitoring function, to suppress, in the early stage, the electrical accidents due to current leakage, thereby preventing the spread of the electrical accidents and minimizing damage to life and property.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 태양광 모듈에서 발생한 전력을 인버터로 전달하게 되는 직류전원회로에서 양극(+)이나 음극(-) 배선로나 관련설비에 접속불량, 절연파괴, 누전으로 인한 전기사고를 초기에 감지하고 확산을 미연에 방지하기 위해 직류회로의 양극(+)과 음극(-)전류의 자속이 상쇄되고 남는 차이의 자속에 의한 누설전류를 측정하는 센서를 접속함 전단에서 측정하고, 인체에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 20mA 이상의 누설전류가 발생 시 차단신호를 무선으로 송신하고, 직류전원을 모듈 가까이에 설치된 차단릴레이에서 무선으로 수신하여 자동적으로 차단하는 기능과 알림 기능 및 모니터링기능을 포함하여 누전으로 인한 전기사고를 초기진압을 실현하여 전기사고의 확대방지, 인명 및 재산 피해 최소화가 가능한 누전감지로 무선자동차단기능을 갖는 태양광발전장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Indoor fire hydrant for building firefighting
title_ko: 건축물 소방용 옥내소화전
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an indoor fire hydrant for building firefighting, which is installed indoors in a building to supply firefighting water to extinguish a fire. To this end, according to the present invention, the indoor fire hydrant for building firefighting comprises: a fire hydrant enclosure composed of an upper enclosure and a lower enclosure each having an opening open on the front, accommodating a water hydrant through which firefighting water is supplied inside the lower enclosure, and accommodating a spray hose connected to the water hydrant; an enclosure door which opens and closes the opening of the lower enclosure to withdraw the spray hose to spray the firefighting water in the event of a fire and forms an evacuation space for rescuers in the event of an earthquake; and a notification device which is detachably mounted on the opening of the upper enclosure to notify a fire in the event of a fire and is detached from the upper enclosure in the event of an earthquake to notify the rescue of a person in need.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물의 옥내에 설치되어 화재를 진압하기 위해 소방수를 공급할 수 있도록 하는 건축물 소방용 옥내소화전에 관한 것으로, 이를 위한 본 발명의 구성은, 전면이 개방된 개구가 형성된 상부함체 및 하부함체로 구성되고 상기 하부함체 내측에 소방수가 공급되는 급수전이 수용되면서 상기 급수전과 연결되는 분사호스를 수용하는 소화전함체; 상기 하부함체의 개구를 개폐하여 화재의 발생시 방화수를 분사하기 위해 상기 분사호스를 인출함과 더불어 지진의 발생시 요구조자의 대피공간을 형성하는 함체도어; 및 상기 상부함체의 개구에 착탈 가능하게 장착되어 화재의 발생시 화재를 알림은 물론 지진의 발생시 상기 상부함체로부터 분리되어 요구조자의 구조를 알리는 알림기;를 포함한다.

title_en: System and method for analyzing vehicle false intrusion data in road construction area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for analyzing vehicle false intrusion data in a road construction area, and relates to the technical field of road construction early warning. According to the invention, the running track of the vehicle in front of the working area is monitored in real time through the main early warning device, whether the target vehicle has a trend of running into the construction area or not is analyzed to perform the prior early warning, so that a driver is prompted to timely make a measure of decelerating or changing the road to drive into a safety lane, constructors are prompted to timely withdraw from the construction area, and the safety protection effect of the constructors is greatly improved.
assignees: JIANGSU BIANSHI SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: User order return risk early warning method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, and discloses a user order withdrawal risk early warning method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of receiving a return risk prediction request, wherein the return risk prediction request comprises target object information; acquiring external platform data and internal platform data matched with target object information; preprocessing external platform data and internal platform data to obtain data to be analyzed; carrying out feature extraction processing on the data to be analyzed through a preset feature extraction model to obtain feature data; carrying out risk prediction processing on the characteristic data through a preset risk prediction model to obtain a return list risk prediction result; and generating the form withdrawal risk early warning information according to the form withdrawal risk prediction result, and generating a risk control strategy according to the form withdrawal risk early warning information. The invention can realize more comprehensive risk prediction, improves the intelligent degree and the accuracy of the form withdrawal risk early warning, and is beneficial to improving the recognition capability of novel form withdrawal blackout products in the financial field.
assignees: PING AN LIFE INSURANCE CO CHINA LTD

title_en: Space object alert management and user interfaces
abstract_en: A display system can be configured to identify a space object and an object alert associated with a change in one or more movement parameters of the space object. The system can generate data configured to display a display region and an object alert indicator within the display region. The system can display the object alert indicator at a location within the display region and display, within a second display region, a listing of a plurality of alerts comprising the object alert. The system can receive a user selection of an alert from the plurality of alerts configured to be displayed in the second display region and automatically generate updated data configured to display an updated display region based on the user selection of the alert. The updated display region can include a panned, rotated, and/or zoomed perspective of the display region.

title_en: Administrative safety monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an administrative security monitoring and early warning system, which comprises: a plurality of data acquisition modules; the safety early warning modules are responsible for receiving signals sent by the corresponding data acquisition modules; the safety early warning module is internally provided with a singlechip, and the singlechip is based on a machine learning algorithm model; the monitoring end is connected with the safety early warning modules and the data acquisition modules and comprises a central processing module, a central learning module and a judging module. And the singlechip in the safety early warning module updates and corrects parameters of the machine learning algorithm model according to the online trained machine learning algorithm model. By adopting a distributed computing and central online training mode, a data acquisition module and a corresponding safety early warning module are arranged around the administrative environment, and online training of real-time change data at a monitoring end is utilized to realize dynamic model updating and correction so as to adapt to the change of the administrative environment and new safety threat and improve safety and emergency response capability.

title_en: Landslide safety monitoring system and early warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide safety monitoring system and an early warning method thereof, and relates to the technical field of safety monitoring. The method comprises the steps of connecting a control end of a cloud server and landslide sensors buried in a soil slope to be monitored, wherein the landslide sensors are uniformly distributed on the soil slope to be monitored, soil layer tightness data and soil layer deviation data of different depths of installation points of the landslide sensors are obtained, the control end obtains the soil layer tightness data and the soil layer deviation data sent by the landslide sensors and combines a three-dimensional image of a region of the soil slope to be monitored, which is obtained in advance, to construct a three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model of the soil slope to be monitored, the control end obtains the data sent by the landslide sensors in real time and updates the three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model, if the three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model change exceeds a preset threshold value, the control end sends out landslide warning alarms, and the three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model change is a comparison value of the three-dimensional real-time soil layer monitoring model and an initial three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model, and the three-dimensional soil layer deviation is obtained.

title_en: Typhoon vortex initialization method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to a typhoon vortex initialization method based on artificial intelligence, which provides more comprehensive typhoon behavior information by combining various meteorological data sources, preprocesses data and converts the data into a data set suitable for a machine learning model, performs feature learning and pattern recognition on the data by applying a deep learning model comprising a contraction path and an expansion path and jump connection, extracts key features and patterns of typhoons, constructs typhoons vortex structures and predicts typhoons paths and strength by applying a trained deep learning model to real-time meteorological data, and updates and improves the prediction capability of the deep learning model by continuous data collection and model training. The method can realize more accurate typhoon vortex initialization, remarkably improve the accuracy and efficiency of typhoon path and strength prediction, and provide effective technical support for typhoon early warning and disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: System for informing risk information in disaster areas using augmented reality
title_ko: 증강현실을 활용한 재난지역의 위험정보 알림 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a danger information notification system in a disaster area using augmented reality. The purpose of the present invention is to promote the safety of the people by transmitting image information to which augmented reality is applied to dangerous facilities in the event of a disaster such as flood, flooding, landslide, heavy snow, fire, earthquake, and tsunami so that the danger information can be intuitively understood and grasped. According to an embodiment of the present invention, disclosed is a system for notifying risk information of a disaster area using augmented reality, which comprises: a field disaster information acquisition unit acquiring field location information and field image information of a corresponding disaster area when a disaster alarm occurs; an AR disaster image information generation unit applying AR content to the field image information to generate AR disaster image information on which AR content is projected; and an AR disaster image information propagation unit identifying a subject located in the corresponding disaster area based on the field location information and propagating the AR disaster image information to a mobile communication terminal of the identified subject.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 증강현실을 활용한 재난지역의 위험정보 알림 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해결하고자 하는 과제는 홍수, 침수, 산사태, 대설, 화재, 지진, 해일 등 재난 발생 시 위험 시설물 등에 대하여 증강현실을 적용한 영상정보를 전파하여 위험정보를 직관적으로 이해 및 파악할 수 있도록 함으로써 국민의 안전을 도모하는데 있다. 
일례로, 재난경보 발생 시 해당 재난지역의 현장위치정보 및 현장영상정보를 각각 획득하는 현장재난정보 획득부; 상기 현장영상정보에 AR 콘텐츠를 적용하여 AR 콘텐츠가 투영된 AR 재난영상정보를 생성하는 AR 재난영상정보 생성부; 및 상기 현장위치정보를 기반으로 해당 재난지역에 위치하는 대상자를 식별하고, 식별된 대상자의 모바일통신단말로 상기 AR 재난영상정보를 전파하는 AR 재난영상정보 전파부를 포함하는 증강현실을 활용한 재난지역의 위험정보 알림 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Assembled antidetonation shear force wall structure
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of house construction, the utility model discloses an assembled antidetonation shear force wall structure, this application includes shear force wall body and floor, install upper junction plate and lower junction plate on the both sides wall of shear force wall body respectively, can cushion the shock attenuation to the shear force wall body through damping spring shock absorber, and damping spring shock absorber can be convenient change, through damping spring shock absorber to shear force wall body shock attenuation and damping spring shock absorber can also convenient and fast change, guarantee that damping spring shock absorber can remain good shock attenuation effect to the shear force wall body all the time, thereby improve the anti-seismic performance of shear force wall body, if the shear force wall body takes place the slope, L template once will contact with pressure sensor, when pressure sensor detects pressure, the tilting volume that the instruction shear force wall body has been too big, then take place the police through buzzing alarm, the personnel in the warning room in time withdraw, lead to the casualties after preventing that follow-up house from collapsing.
assignees: ZHEJIANG LIANYI SURVEY AND PLANNING DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Emergency AM Broadcast Receiver in Card Form
title_ko: 카드형태의 비상용 am 방송 수신기
abstract_en: Disclosed is a card-type emergency AM broadcast receiver. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a card-type emergency AM broadcasting receiver comprises: a housing unit having a card shape, having a radio receiving circuit mounted in an accommodation space inside an upper end thereof, and having an upper end cover mounted to seal the accommodation space inside the upper end thereof; a radio receiving unit including a radio receiving circuit mounted inside the housing unit, and having a structure of changing an AM radio receiving frequency by changing a sliding position on one side of the housing unit; an antenna coupling unit for easily connecting an antenna and a ground wire; and a sound output unit mounted on one side of the housing unit, and having a piezoelectric vibration plate to output a broadcasting signal received through the radio receiving unit. According to the present invention, AM broadcasting can be received by using surrounding objects in an emergency situation such as a disaster in which external power supply is difficult, thereby saving life and maintaining safety.
abstract_ko: 카드형태의 비상용 AM 방송 수신기가 개시된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 카드형태의 비상용 AM 방송 수신기는, 카드 형태이고, 상단 내부의 수용공간에 라디오 수신회로가 장착되고, 상단 내부의 수용공간을 밀페하는 상단 커버가 장착된 구조의 하우징부; 상기 하우징부 내부에 장착되는 라디오 수신회로를 포함하고, 하우징부의 일측면에 슬라이딩 위치 변경되어 AM라디오 수신주파수를 변경하는 구조의 라디오 수신부; 안테나 및 접지선을 손쉽게 연결하기 위한 안테나 체결부; 및 상기 하우징부의 일측에 장착되고, 압전진동판을 구비하여 라디오 수신부를 통해 수신한 방송신호를 출력하는 소리출력부;를 포함하는 것을 구성의 요지로 한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 외부 전원공급이 어려운 재난과 같은 비상 상황에서 주변 사물을 이용하여 AM 방송을 수신할 수 있어, 생명을 구하고 안전을 유지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Deep foundation pit monitoring and early warning system and method based on cloud edge end cooperation
abstract_en: The application discloses a deep foundation pit monitoring and early warning system and a deep foundation pit monitoring and early warning method based on cloud edge end cooperation, and relates to the technical field of foundation pit engineering monitoring informatization, wherein the deep foundation pit monitoring and early warning system comprises a cloud layer, an edge end and a terminal; the edge ends and the terminals are respectively arranged in a designated area of the foundation pit project; the terminal comprises a data acquisition terminal and an acousto-optic early warning terminal, and for the same foundation pit project, the cloud layer is in bidirectional communication connection with the edge end, the edge end is in communication connection with the terminal, the cloud layer is used for transmitting the updated early warning model to the edge end, the acquisition terminal is used for transmitting the acquired original data to the edge end, the edge end is used for transmitting detailed early warning information obtained by analyzing the updated early warning model of the original data to the acousto-optic early warning terminal, and the acousto-optic early warning terminal is used for carrying out visual display and voice prompt based on the detailed early warning information, so that real-time and accurate feedback of the safety state of the foundation pit are improved.
assignees: FIRST CONSTR ENG CO LTD OF CHINA CONSTR 3RD ENG BUREAU

title_en: Event identification and management system
abstract_en: An anomalous/hazardous event or incident identification and response coordination system is provided. Events or incidents that could pose threats to people, property, and/or reputation are identified based on data received from a variety of sources that is filtered based on parameters associated with each user of the system and run through appropriate classifier models. When a potential event is identified, an alert is sent to an appropriate user of the system and the user may confirm, reject, or otherwise modify the event's classification. If the user indicates that a response may be necessary, a pre-established response plan is selected based on the nature and/or severity of the event. Certain aspects of the selected plan may be pre-determined based on the event type and the information received that generated the event alert. The response plan may then be distributed to appropriate personnel and executed, and updated data is provided as warranted.

title_en: Virtual reality assisted security and distress location determination
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for a virtual reality security surveillance system (SSS) to generate a virtual reality map to display virtual reality presentations of a facility. The virtual reality presentations of a facility may display, in real-time, the structure of the facility along with the locations of all devices, persons, incidents, and other objects present in the facility at any given moment in time. The SSS may continuously monitor the facility and locations of devices, persons and incidents in a facility, and update the virtual reality presentations of the facility. In addition to displaying virtual reality presentations, the SSS may detect the presence of new devices and incidents in the facility. The SSS may further communicate with one or more devices to interact with one or more persons in the facility, including providing alerts and/or instructions to the one or more persons regarding any incidents that may concern them.

title_en: Rock burst early warning method for microseismic data long-term and short-term feature comparison
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of dangerous disaster prediction of rock burst and the like in mines, in particular to a rock burst early warning method for comparing long-term and short-term characteristics of microseismic data, which is used for predicting whether a primary microseismic event to be happened in the future is a rock burst event or not, and comprises the following steps of S1: constructing a training set; s2: extracting long-term and short-term microseismic data characteristics of a training set sample; s3: training a rock burst prediction model; s4: an application of rock burst early warning method based on microseismic data long-short period characteristic comparison. According to the invention, priori knowledge is introduced into algorithm design to automatically extract the rock burst early warning implicit early warning index; parameters of the designed feature extraction module can be continuously updated and replaced in training, so that the generalization performance of the early warning method on different mines is improved, and the early warning accuracy is higher than that of other deep learning algorithms.
assignees: Shandong energy group co ltd;CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Protection strutting arrangement is used in factory building construction
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a protective supporting device for factory building construction, which comprises: guardrail main part, setting are in the stand of guardrail main part both sides and setting are in the warning subassembly of stand upper end, still including setting up movable guardrail of guardrail main part top and setting are in the anti-climb guardrail of movable guardrail upper end, movable guardrail's both ends slip is in on the stand and can reciprocate relative to the guardrail main part, movable guardrail's below is provided with trigger switch, trigger switch with warning subassembly connects, be provided with the drive between stand and the movable guardrail upward movement's canceling release mechanical system. According to the anti-climbing guardrail provided by the utility model, the arc connecting part and the arc inner hook part form a bending structure, so that the climbing difficulty is increased; when climbing, the movable guardrail is stressed to move downwards, so that the movable guardrail contacts with the trigger switch below, and the warning component emits an audible and visual alarm, thereby achieving the purpose of warning pedestrians to inhibit climbing.

title_en: Deep soft rock roadway deformation control method under dynamic pressure influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep soft rock roadway deformation control method under the influence of dynamic pressure, which particularly relates to the technical field of measurement and monitoring, and effectively identifies abnormal conditions in the operation of a total station by judging the degree of abnormality of real-time measurement data of the total station and counting abnormal data in the process of real-time acquisition, and triggers an emergency response mechanism when an alarm signal is generated, so that the accuracy of deformation monitoring in the process of withdrawing the deep soft rock roadway to the ground is ensured; the deformation monitoring state early warning coefficient is calculated through the normalization processing of the total station error correction frequency, the output fluctuation variation value and the total station electromagnetic influence index, and the deformation monitoring state early warning coefficient is used for analyzing the running state of the total station, so that the deformation condition of the supporting structure in the deep soft rock roadway can be timely captured under the condition of good state, control measures can be timely taken under the action of dynamic pressure, and the stability of the supporting structure is ensured.
assignees: CHINA COAL XINJI ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus for predicting water level of region using artificial intelligence
title_ko: 인공지능을 이용한 지역 수위 예측 장치
abstract_en: An apparatus for predicting a water level in a region using artificial intelligence comprises: a water level measuring unit installed in a second region included in a first region to measure a water level due to flooding to generate measured water level data in the second region; a CCTV unit installed in a third region included in the first region; a flooding prediction module using a water level prediction model generated through an artificial intelligence algorithm learning process based on terrain data of the third region, real-time rainfall data of the third region, and the measured water level data to generate flooding prediction data in the third region in which the CCTV unit is installed; and a flooding data providing module changing the flooding prediction data into a flooding prediction image and overlaying the flooding prediction image on a local video photographed by the CCTV unit to predict and warn a flooding situation in the third region.
abstract_ko: 인공지능을 이용한 지역 수위 예측 장치는 제1 지역에 포함된 제2 지역에 설치되어 침수에 의한 수위를 실측하여 상기 제2 지역에서의 실측 수위 데이터를 생성하는 수위 측정 유닛; 상기 제1 지역에 포함되는 제3 지역에 설치되는 CCTV 유닛; 상기 제3 지역의 지형 데이터, 상기 제3 지역의 실시간 강우 데이터 및 상기 실측 수위 데이터를 기반으로 인공지능 알고리즘 학습과정을 통해 생성된 수위 예측 모델을 이용하여 상기 CCTV 유닛이 설치된 상기 제3 지역에서의 침수 예측 데이터를 생성하는 침수 예측 모듈; 및 상기 침수 예측 데이터를 침수 예측 이미지로 변경하고, 상기 침수 예측 이미지를 상기 CCTV 유닛에서 촬영된 지역 동영상에 오버레이 시켜 상기 제3 지역에서의 침수 상황을 예측 및 경보하는 침수 데이터 제공 모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: Dynamic context aware response system for enterprise protection
abstract_en: Arrangements for providing context aware response functions are provided. In some examples, sensor data may be received from a plurality of sensors in a sensor data farm associated with an enterprise organization. The sensor data may be received from various types of sensors and/or from sensors from various vendors or manufacturers. a machine learning model may be executed to analyze the sensor data. Based on an output of the machine learning model, a determination may be made as to whether one or more enterprise-specific thresholds have been met or exceeded. If not, additional, subsequently received data may be analyzed. If so, one or more notifications or notification actions may be identified. In some examples, the notification or notification actions may be executed and response data may be received. The response data may be used to update and/or validate the machine learning model.

title_en: On-line monitoring system of air respirator for firefighter
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an on-line monitoring system of a firefighter air respirator, which comprises the following components: the monitoring system comprises a monitoring host and a plurality of monitoring terminals in signal connection with the monitoring host; the monitoring terminal comprises: the monitoring unit is used for monitoring the air pressure in the air source of the fire-fighting respirator; the terminal communication unit is used for realizing remote signal connection with the monitoring host; the communication horn unit is used for broadcasting the calling information in the monitoring host; the monitoring host comprises: the host communication unit is used for realizing remote signal connection with the terminal communication unit in the monitoring terminal and receiving information signals in the monitoring unit; the monitoring display unit comprises a plurality of monitoring display screens and call keys, wherein the monitoring display screens correspond to the monitoring terminals one by one; through the cooperation of monitoring host computer and monitor terminal, realize firefighter's fire control respirator's oxygen surplus's real-time remote monitoring work, ensure that firefighter can have enough safe time to withdraw from the scene of a fire, ensure firefighter's personal safety.
assignees: DONGGUAN FIRE RESCUE DETACHMENT HUMEN BRIGADE

title_en: Control method and system of warning lamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a warning light technical field discloses a control method and system of warning light, this application has add ultrasonic transducer on the warning light, ultrasonic transducer sends a plurality of ultrasonic signals in real time, ultrasonic monitoring equipment real-time supervision is received at least one ultrasonic signal, if receive ultrasonic signal, then predict the azimuth information of first warning light according to this ultrasonic signal, and send the azimuth information to the second warning light, search and rescue personnel are equipped with the second warning light, can remove to the direction of first warning light based on azimuth information, in order to avoid the direction to take place the mistake, can be in the removal in-process, whether continuously monitor the ultrasonic signal that the first warning light sent is received, so be convenient for search and rescue personnel continue to search along current direction, and in search the in-process, continuously receive ultrasonic signal, with real-time update azimuth information, thereby be convenient for search and rescue personnel confirm the positional information of waiting rescue personnel as early as possible, improve search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Vehicle-passenger assistance facilitation
abstract_en: Vehicles may be associated with a variety of different types of events, including events associated with vehicle operations and/or events associated with vehicle passengers. The present disclosure is related to, when an event is detected, exchanging information with a vehicle passenger, such as via the passenger's mobile device and/or wearable device. In some instances, an event may be detected, and examples of the present disclosure may provide an application notification presenting various information. The notification may, in some examples, be configured to help the passenger locate the passenger device, to alert the passenger to the event, to provide instructions, and/or to provide a control interface for controlling a vehicle operation. In some examples, the notification may supersede operations of the passenger device, such as by being presented even if the device is in a locked state or has an unrelated application open and in the foreground.

title_en: Process management system using blockchain based on stakeholder agreement
title_ko: 블록체인을 이용한 관계자 합의 기반의 공정관리 시스템
abstract_en: A process management system based on a related party agreement using a blockchain comprises: a registration terminal for establishing a process plan; a use terminal for discussing the established process plan; and a process management server for providing a solution for the process plan to the use terminal. An object of the present invention is to maximize the quality of the process according to more careful decision-making by performing an agreement of related parties on items requiring consultation, such as changing the schedule of the process.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공정 계획을 수립하기 위한 등록 단말, 수립된 공정 계획을 협의하는 사용 단말 및 사용 단말에 공정 계획에 관한 솔루션을 제공하는 공정관리 서버를 포함하고, 공정관리 서버는 등록 단말로부터 수집된 공정 정보를 기반으로 사용 단말에 제1합의 문의 알림을 제공하고, 제1합의 문의 알림에 대응하여 형성된 초기 합의 정보를 기반으로 등록 단말에 업무 지시 알림을 제공하는 블록체인을 이용한 관계자 합의 기반의 공정관리 시스템을 제공한다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따르면, 공정의 일정 변경 등 협의가 필요한 항목을 대상으로 관련자의 합의를 거치기 때문에 보다 신중한 의사결정에 따른 공정의 품질 극대화가 가능하고, 무리한 공정 강행 등 리스크에 노출되는 것을 방지할 수 있어 공정의 갑작스러운 중단 등에 따른 인명피해 및 물적피해를 최소화할 수 있으며, 최종 합의된 공정 정보는 블록체인에 기록됨으로써 사후 조작 및 임의 변경이 불가하기 때문에, 해당 공정에 관한 기록의 불변성을 제공하고, 추후 동일 또는 유사한 공정의 수행 시 공정 효율의 극대화 방법을 모색할 수 있는 참고자료로 활용할 수 있다.

title_en: System for detection of missing person based on wireless network and method for operation thereof
title_ko: 무선망 기반 실종자 탐지 시스템 및 이의 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an operation method of a missing person detection system operated by at least one processor, the operation method comprising: interlocking with a mobile base station newly installed in a disaster area where a missing person occurs; generating base station setting change information to be transmitted to a plurality of service base stations, the plurality of service base stations previously installed within a preset range including base station coverage of the mobile base station; transferring the base station setting change information to the mobile base station and the plurality of service base stations; if a plurality of terminals located in the base station coverage is connected based on the base station setting change information which the plurality of service base stations respectively broadcasts, confirming the terminal connection information of each terminal; and confirming the terminal user identity of each terminal based on the terminal connection information.
abstract_ko: 적어도 하나의 프로세서에 의해 동작하는 실종자 탐지 시스템의 동작 방법으로서, 실종자가 발생한 재난 지역에 새로 설치된 이동 기지국과 연동하면, 이동 기지국의 기지국 커버리지를 포함하여 미리 설정된 범위 내에 기 설치된 복수의 서비스 기지국들로 전송할 기지국 설정 변경 정보를 생성한다. 이동 기지국 및 복수의 서비스 기지국들로 기지국 설정 변경정보를 전달하고, 기지국 커버리지에 위치한 복수의 단말들이 복수의 서비스 기지국들이 각각 방송한 기지국 설정 변경 정보를 기초로 접속하면, 각 단말의 단말 접속 정보를 확인한다. 그리고 단말 접속 정보를 기초로 각 단말의 단말 사용자 신원을 확인한다.

title_en: Natural disaster aerial photographing monitoring and big data early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster aerial photography monitoring and big data early warning system in the natural disaster early warning field, which comprises a data processing base station and an unmanned aerial vehicle; acquiring and storing a historical environment model around a river channel through a data processing base station; collecting real-time image information and real-time weather information around the river channel in real time through the unmanned aerial vehicle; the data processing base station marks the historical environment model again based on brightness change or brightness change of plant coordinate points in the real-time image, so that disaster-affected water areas and lands can be distinguished according to the image data of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the early warning is conveniently carried out by predicting the follow-up trend of water flow based on boundary establishment of the disaster-affected water areas in the updated historical environment model.

title_en: Early warning method, device, equipment and medium for 5G network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 5G network early warning method, a device, equipment and a medium. Sending a detection strategy to the 5G base station, wherein the detection strategy comprises the perception frequency of the 5G base station to the user equipment; receiving sensing data acquired by a 5G base station, wherein the sensing data is the sensing data of at least one user equipment in an operation environment; determining a perceived distance between two user devices based on perceived data of any two user devices; and generating distance early warning information for the user equipment based on the perceived distance, and/or obtaining a detection strategy based on the perceived distance update, so that the user equipment in the operation environment can be subjected to timely distance early warning, and the safety of the operation environment is improved.
assignees: NANJING BESTWAY INTELLIGENT CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Prediction evaluation method and related equipment for fault tunnel damage
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a fault tunnel damage prediction and assessment method and related equipment. The prediction evaluation method comprises the steps of constructing a fault tunnel model, wherein the fault tunnel model comprises at least one solid particle and at least one fluid particle, parameters of the solid particle and the fluid particle are respectively endowed with corresponding initial values, the parameters comprise target parameters, the target parameters are circularly updated until the preset times according to a preset time step and a preset target parameter control equation, and the impact pressure of a water body is determined according to the target parameters after the fluid particle updating. The scheme provides effective basis for disaster prevention and disaster early warning in tunnel construction.

title_en: Disaster recovery processing method and related equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a disaster recovery processing method and related equipment, and relates to the technical field of communication. The disaster recovery processing method comprises the following steps: if the UPF network element detects that the first SMF network element fails or the first SMF network element recovers from the failure, the UPF network element sends a PFCP node report request message to the target SMF network element, wherein the PFCP node report request message carries a disaster recovery identifier and session disaster recovery data; the target SMF network element sends a service update request message to the NRF network element according to the disaster recovery identifier and the session disaster recovery data; the NRF network element sends a status notification request message to the subscribing network element, so that the subscribing network element updates the SMF network element identifier to the target SMF network element identifier. The disaster recovery processing method solves the problem that the service is interrupted because the original session of the failed SMF network element cannot be taken over in real time by the taken over SMF network element.

title_en: Meteorological early warning system
abstract_en: The invention provides a weather early warning system, which is used for executing a weather early warning method, and comprises a data acquisition module, a data analysis module, an early warning release module, a receipt module and an updating module, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, a data acquisition module acquires weather early warning data and geographical position data of a ship in a navigation warning area; s2, analyzing the acquired weather early warning data in the navigation warning area and the geographical position data of the ship by the data analysis module and obtaining an analysis result; s3, generating an early warning report by the early warning module according to the analysis result; s4, the early warning issuing module issues weather early warning to the ship according to the early warning generation report and generates a receipt; s5, the receipt module sends the receipt to the ship; and S6, when the receipt is sent to the ship, the updating module updates the geographical position data of the ship receiving the receipt. The invention can inform the ship of the weather early warning in time, thereby guaranteeing the safety of the ship.

title_en: Regional landslide vulnerability updating and evaluating method
abstract_en: Firstly, acquiring data such as DEM, landslide, soil parameters and the like of a research area according to site survey investigation; performing sensitivity analysis of input parameters based on the physical model; a Bayesian updating method is adopted, new landslide information is used as observation information to respectively construct likelihood functions of a landslide region and a stable region, and update of sensitive parameters is realized; and (3) carrying out regional slope stability analysis and failure probability calculation through a physical model, and drawing a landslide failure probability distribution map. And finally, fusing the landslide susceptibility result with the failure probability result by adopting a matrix analysis method to obtain an updated regional landslide disaster early-warning level distribution map, thereby realizing regional landslide susceptibility update. The method has the advantages of definite physical meaning, strong pertinence, low cost, easy operation, accurate result, good visualization and the like, overcomes the defect that the mechanical mechanism and timeliness cannot be considered in the traditional landslide susceptibility evaluation, and can present the dynamic distribution condition of landslide disasters.

title_en: Smart city fire safety system and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a smart city fire safety system and a working method thereof. A smart city fire safety system comprises a plurality of fire units, an unmanned aerial vehicle fire monitoring system and a fire control organization. The fire-fighting unit comprises a building body, a plurality of fire-fighting boxes, a plurality of fire-fighting corridors, at least two fire-fighting stairs, a fire-fighting control system, an electric power main valve and a gas main valve. The fire control case comprises a fire control voice broadcasting device, a case body and a standby power supply. The unmanned aerial vehicle fire monitoring system comprises a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles and a fire control general control center. The unmanned aerial vehicle is used for cruising the city, and comprises a machine body, a distance calculation module, a broadcaster and a fire detection module. The invention solves the technical problems of how to find fire in time and give fire alarm and how to guide residents of the building to withdraw orderly when fire occurs by arranging the fire-fighting voice broadcasting device and the unmanned aerial vehicle fire monitoring system.

title_en: Vehicle beacon mode
abstract_en: Method of using a vehicle to alert to potential risks includes determining that a user of the vehicle will be absent; determining an estimated absence time; and sending an alert to authorities, via a control system, if the user does not return within the estimated absence time. The method may include receiving the estimated absence time from the user, or the control system of the vehicle determines the absence and the estimated absence time. The user may define the absence and input the estimated absence time through a centralized location, such that the alert is sent from the centralized location. Following expiration of the estimated absence time, detecting a pedestrian near the vehicle, and then playing a pre-recorded emergency message through speakers, such that the pedestrian is made aware of the pre-recorded emergency message. Vehicle lights/horn may operate to guide the user, possibly in decaying fashion.

title_en: Wisdom community data management platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data management, and particularly discloses a smart community data management platform, which comprises: the system comprises a community basic information importing module, a fire control monitoring information importing module, a fire control patrol correction judging module, a fire control patrol update confirming module and a fire control patrol update feedback terminal. According to the invention, the firefighting inspection correction judgment is carried out according to the firefighting hidden danger tracking log, firefighting monitoring information and regional weather information of the target community, and the corrected firefighting hidden danger inspection clearing information corresponding to the target analysis community is confirmed, so that the problem of insufficient attention to the firefighting hidden danger processing at present is effectively solved, the defect that the firefighting hidden danger monitoring and early warning are only focused at present is avoided, the defect of the firefighting hidden danger processing at present is overcome, the processing capacity and coping capacity after the subsequent firefighting hidden danger occurs are improved, the prejudging and processing capacity of fire risks can be improved, and the optimization of resource allocation is realized.

title_en: Dynamic forecasting and early warning method and device for mountain torrent disasters in small river basin and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a dynamic forecasting and early warning method and device for mountain torrents in a small river basin, and electronic equipment, comprising the following steps: collecting topography and topography of a small drainage basin and early rainfall information, and determining factors which have obvious influence on the flow of a control section of the small drainage basin at the next moment by using a gray correlation analysis method; establishing a multiple linear regression model according to the factors to simulate and forecast the flow of the control section at the next moment; calculating early rainfall information at the next moment according to forecast information of a weather forecast department so as to update the early rainfall information; repeating the steps to obtain the control section flow in a future period of time; calculating the over-designed flow proportion, occurrence probability and early warning duration of the control section flow according to the control section flow and the weather forecast information; and determining whether to start early warning according to the over-designed flow ratio, the occurrence probability and the early warning duration. The application provides reliable technical support for flood disaster prevention and has important significance for flood disaster risk treatment and decision.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Network-based informatization supervision terminal for electric power construction site and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network-based informatization supervision terminal for an electric power construction site and a use method thereof, belonging to the technical field of terminal position positioning, and comprising a real-time positioning unit: the position information of the personnel is obtained in real time by using a satellite positioning technology and is uploaded to the central processing module by using a wireless communication technology, and the current position of the personnel can be displayed on a map and updated along with the change of the position; track recording unit: the method is used for recording the moving track of the supervision personnel; alarm notification unit: the position change of the supervision personnel is monitored, and an alarm notification is sent when an abnormal situation occurs; management and scheduling unit: the management end can check the real-time position of personnel, and perform task allocation and resource scheduling according to the needs, so that the efficiency and accuracy of construction management are improved. The invention tracks and records the personnel position in real time, and is convenient for the superior management department to manage and schedule.

title_en: Dynamic disaster monitoring system and method for coal and rock mining area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic disaster monitoring system and a method for coal and rock mining areas, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a model construction module, a monitoring module, a data processing module and an early warning module; the model building module generates a virtual mining area model based on internal construction data of the coal and rock mining area; the monitoring module collects coal and rock condition data of the non-mining area and the mining area working face all over, and comprises the non-mining area coal and rock condition data, mining area working face stress information, mining area working face microseismic signals and corresponding coordinates; the data processing module updates the virtual mining area model in real time based on the coal and rock condition data, and analyzes the coal and rock disaster condition based on the coal and rock condition data; the early warning module sends out early warning based on the disaster condition of the coal rock and displays the disaster place in the virtual mining area model. The invention is based on the digital twin technology, and can more accurately predict the occurrence and development trend of dynamic disasters in coal and rock mining areas through the fusion of the actual monitoring data and the digital twin model.

title_en: Fire-fighting linkage alarm bell
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire alarm, and particularly discloses a fire-fighting linkage alarm bell, which comprises a shell, wherein a control main board, an alarm horn, a flash warning lamp, a fire button, an emergency button and a power battery are arranged in the shell, the alarm horn, the flash warning lamp, the fire button, the emergency button and the power battery are all connected with the control main board, the control main board comprises a power management module, a CPU (central processing unit) module, a wireless transceiver module, a storage module and a 4G (fourth generation) module, the wireless transceiver module is used for sending stored information data to the periphery and receiving information sent by similar products around, the CPU module is connected with a cloud server through the 4G module, the cloud server is used for being connected with a mobile phone end, and the mobile phone end is used for setting fire alarm position information. The invention has reasonable design, solves the problem that people around the fire disaster can not be notified to withdraw to the safety zone immediately at present when the fire disaster occurs, and effectively ensures the life safety of people.
assignees: DONGGUAN LE PU ELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster early warning information closed loop response calling method based on position calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning information closed-loop response calling method based on position calculation, which comprises the following steps: s1: designing a data structure, an early warning information data state and an intelligent calling interface of a geological disaster early warning position model; s2: building a geological disaster early warning position model, analyzing hidden danger points of the geological disasters by using meteorological data of a meteorological observation site, and sending early warning information; s3: developing an application program to interact with the intelligent call interface to develop closed loop call of early warning information; s4: after the intelligent call sends the early warning short message, the early warning short message information is uploaded to an early warning position model, and the data state of the early warning short message information is updated; s5: after the intelligent caller shall send the early warning voice, uploading the early warning voice information to an early warning position model, and updating the data state of the early warning voice information; s6: after the intelligent call starts the manual call, the manual call information is uploaded to the early warning position model, and the early warning information data state is updated.
assignees: Sichuan Rural Economic Comprehensive Information Center

title_en: Cloud inspection system and method with matched size models
abstract_en: The application discloses a cloud inspection system and a method matched with a size model, wherein the cloud inspection system comprises the following components: the cloud policy center, the business data service center, the model optimization center, the log analysis and optimization center and the backup disaster recovery center; the cloud policy center is responsible for issuing a cloud policy to an edge and issuing a cloud instruction to the edge; the business data service center is used for receiving event data and/or log data returned by the side end; the model optimization center is used for optimizing a large model to obtain an optimized large model version, the optimized large model version is updated into a cloud OTA version library, and the cloud OTA version library is stored in the cloud policy center; the log analysis and optimization center is used for analyzing and early warning log data of the business data service center to obtain a log analysis result, and the log analysis result is transmitted back to the side in the form of abnormal table data and log table data; the backup disaster recovery center is used for data backup.
assignees: BEIJING DAOYI SHUHUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: The system which provides a disaster notification contents
title_ko: 재난 알림 콘텐츠 제공시스템
abstract_en: The objective of the present invention is to support a user to easily resolve the problem of quality deterioration of various electronic devices due to excessive battery consumption of a DNC service app. A DNC providing system comprises: a DNC distribution agency server which communicates with a disaster notification contents (DNC) production agency server via a wired/wireless communication network, collects the DNC, and distributes the collected DNC to a user information device; a firebase cloud messaging (FCM) server which processes inter-platform messages and data transmission between the DNC distribution agency server and the user information device; and a location-based DNC service application which is installed in the user information device, generates a DNC subscription request message, transmits the DNC subscription request message to the FCM server, receives the DNC from the FCM server, and outputs the DNC through the user information device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 알림 콘텐츠(DNC: Disaster Notification Contents) 제공시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에서는 DNC 배포 기관 서버, 사용자 정보기기 등의 통신 체제 하에, <DNC 배포 기관 서버와 통신하여, 이에 의해 배포되는 DNC를 수집할 수 있음과 아울러, DNC 배포 기관 서버 및 사용자 정보기기 사이의 플랫폼 간 메시지 및 데이터 전송(즉, 플랫폼 간 메시지 및 데이터 푸쉬(Push))을 처리할 수 있는 FCM 서버(Firebase Cloud Messaging 서버)>, <사용자 정보기기에 설치되면서, 상기 사용자 정보기기의 위치정보가 포함된 DNC 구독요청 메시지를 생성한 후, 생성된 DNC 구독요청 메시지를 상기 FCM 서버로 전송함과 아울러, 상기 FCM 서버 측으로부터 상기 DNC 구독요청 메시지에 상응하는 DNC가 전송되면, 해당 DNC를 접수한 후, 접수된 DNC를 상기 사용자 정보기기를 통해 출력시킬 수 있는 위치기반 DNC 서비스 앱> 등을 추가 설치하고, 이를 통해, DNC의 제공 패턴이 '사용자 정보기기 측 DNC 서비스 앱과 DNC 배포 기관 서버 측의 직접적인 교신에 의한 위치정보 보고/수집 기반 패턴'(즉, DNC 서비스 앱이 DNC 배포 기관 서버 측에 주기적으로 사용자 정보기기의 위치정보를 전송/보고하면, DNC 배포 기관 서버 측에서 그에 상응하여, 사용자 정보기기가 위치한 지역의 DNC를 제공하는 패턴)이 아니라, 'FCM 서버를 우회 기반으로 하는 푸쉬 데이터(Push data) 형식의 DNC 토픽 구독 패턴'(즉, DNC 서비스 앱 측에서, DNC 배포 기관 서버에 대한 별도의 주기적인 위치정보 전송/보고 절차 없이, 단순히 FCM 서버 측에 DNC 토픽의 구독을 요청하기만 하면, FCM 서버 측에서 DNC 배포 기관 서버 측과 통신하여, DNC를 우회 접수한 후, 접수된 DNC 중 사용자 정보기기가 처한 위치에 상응하는 특정 지역의 DNC를 DNC 서비스 앱 측으로 푸쉬해주는 패턴)으로 대폭 변경될 수 있도록 유도함으로써, 결국, 사용자 측에서, DNC 서비스 앱의 배터리 과잉 소모에 기인한 각종 전자기기 품질저하 문제점을 손쉽게 탈피할 수 있도록 지원할 수 있다.

title_en: Improving method for Kiosk utilization of Elderly people
title_ko: 노인의 키오스크 활용도 개선 방법
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a method for improving utilization through remote support, a start signal device, a cognitive ability improvement game, and the like so that elderly people may more easily utilize a kiosk.
