A method for improving the utilization of a kiosk of elderly people comprises the following steps: a preparation step (S10); an activation step (S11); a step (S12) of activating a button on a screen of a kiosk (200); a step(S13) of activating a video play list; a step (S14, S15, S16) of activating a menu; a step (S17) of connecting a video call between an assistant terminal (30) and the kiosk; a step(S18) of displaying a video chat window on one side of the assistant terminal and the kiosk screen; a step (S19) of activating an event promotion and disaster safety menu by a central server (10); and a step(S20) of activating the menu by the central server. According to the present invention, the elderly people naturally learn how to use the kiosk, prevent power consumption, and improve cognitive ability through family help.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에서는, 사용자 신원정보가 기록된 사용자 DB(40)를 준비하는 준비단계(S10); 키오스크(200)의 시작신호로써 키오스크(200)의 첫화면이 활성화되는 활성화단계(S11); 중앙서버(10)가 키오스크(200)의 화면에 여행, 교육, 알림 및 게임 버튼을 활성화하는 단계(S12); 상기 여행이 선택되면 중앙서버(10)가 복수의 영상을 재생하는 영상재생목록을 활성화하는 단계(S13); 상기 교육이 선택되면 중앙서버(10)가 스마트폰 배우기, 키오스크 배우기 및 키오스크 체험해보기 메뉴를 활성화하는 단계(S14); 상기 스마트폰 배우기가 선택되면 중앙서버(10)가 스마트폰 이해하기, 스마트폰 기본상태 설정하기, 인터넷 연결방법, 인터넷 접속방법, 앱의 종류 및 설치방법, 앱 관리 및 삭제방법 및 스마트폰 장애 대처법 메뉴를 활성화하는 단계(S15); 상기 키오스크 배우기가 선택되면 중앙서버(10)가 키오스크 이해하기, ATM이용방법, 무인발급기 이용법, 패스트푸드점 키오스크 이용법, 카페 키오스크 이용법, 기차표 예약 키오스크 이용법 및 고속버스 키오스크 이용법 메뉴를 활성화하는 단계(S16); 상기 키오스크 체험해보기가 선택되고 중앙서버(10)가 헬프 신호 및 사용자 신원정보의 스캔 정보를 받으면 키오스크(200)에 구비된 화상카메라(333), 스피커(444) 및 마이크(555)를 켜고 사용자 DB에 저장된 보조자의 연락처를 이용하여 보조자 단말(30)과 키오스크(200) 간에 화상 통화를 연결하는 단계(S17); 중앙서버(10)가 보조자 단말(30)의 화면에 키오스크(200) 화면을 동기화시키고 보조자 단말(30) 및 키오스크 화면의 일측에 화상 대화창을 띄우는 단계(S18); 상기 알림이 선택되면 중앙서버(10)가 행사홍보 및 재난안전 메뉴를 활성화하는 단계(S19); 및, 상기 게임이 선택되면 중앙서버(10)가 같은 그림 맞추기, 두더지 잡기 및 우리 마을길 찾기 메뉴를 활성화하는 단계(S20);를 진행하는 것을 특징으로 하는 노인의 키오스크 활용도 개선 방법이 제공된다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 노인들이 현장에 있는 키오스크를 사용하는데 있어서 신분증만 있다면 원격에 있는 가족이나 타인의 도움을 받아 자연스럽게 친숙해지도록 함으로써 노인들에게 다양한 사회참여 기회를 제공할 수 있는 유리한 효과가 있다.

title_en: System and Method for Subscribing household Medicine
title_ko: 가정용 상비약 구독 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a home household medicine subscription system that enables a delivery and collection service of a home household medicine delivered through a first aid kit, and a method thereof. The home household medicine subscription system comprises: a communication part; a user management part that stores and manages information for a user; a subscription information collection part that collects subscription information of a household medicine; a subscription information renewal part that updates subscription information by applying at least one of modification, change, addition, and deletion based on the subscription information collected in the subscription information collection part; a payment processing part; a subscription processing part that selects the household medicine packaged in the first aid kit based on subscription information requested from the user, and selects a delivery terminal based on the personal information of the user to ensure that the first aid kit containing the household medicine is delivered to the user during the subscription period; and a delivery processing part that delivers the personal information of the user to the delivery terminal that can deliver the packaged first aid kit to the user who has subscribed. According to the present invention, the present invention has an effect of preventing the use of household medicine past its expiration date due to long-term storage by providing the user with notification information when the expiration date is reached through management of the expiration date of the home household medicine delivered through the first aid kit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 구급상자를 통해 배송되는 가정용 상비약의 배송 및 수거 서비스 할 수 있도록 한 가정용 상비약 구독 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공하기 위한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 가정용 상비약 구독 시스템의 특징은 사용자 단말기 및 배송자 단말기와 네트워크를 통해 유무선 통신방식으로 통신을 수행하는 통신부와, 상비약을 구독하는 사용자에 대한 정보를 저장하여 관리하는 사용자 관리부와, 상기 통신부를 통해 접속된 사용자 단말기로부터 입력되는 상비약의 구독정보를 수집하는 구독정보 수집부와, 상기 구독정보 수집부에서 수집된 구독정보를 기반으로 수정, 변경, 추가 및 삭제 중 적어도 어느 하나를 적용하여 구독정보를 갱신하는 구독정보 갱신부와, 사용자가 상비약 구독을 원하는 경우 정기 구독 금액을 결제할 수 있도록 하는 서비스를 제공하는 결제 처리부와, 사용자로부터 요청된 구독정보를 기반으로, 구급상자에 포장되는 상비약을 선별하고, 사용자의 개인정보를 기반으로 배송자 단말기를 선택하여 상비약이 포장된 구급상자가 구독 정기 배송 기간에 사용자에게 배달되도록 처리하는 구독 처리부와, 포장 완료된 구급상자를 구독 신청한 사용자에게 배달 가능한 배송자 단말기로 사용자의 개인정보를 전달하는 배송 처리부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Methods and systems for vehicle data collection
abstract_en: Embodiments of a method and non-transitory computer readable mediums for vehicle data collection are disclosed. In an embodiment, the method for vehicle data collection includes receiving, at a cloud computing system, vehicle data that indicates a location of a vehicle and a data reporting mode of the vehicle, determining, by the cloud computing system, whether the vehicle is located in an alerting zone using the vehicle data, determining, by the cloud computing system, if the data reporting mode of the vehicle needs to be changed based on the alerting zone determination, and generating, by the cloud computing system, a policy message for transmission to the vehicle when the data reporting mode needs to be changed, where the policy message indicates an updated data reporting mode of the vehicle.

title_en: Dangerous gas on-line monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous gas on-line monitoring system and method, and belongs to the technical field of gas monitoring. In order to solve the problems that the lack of an effective early warning and response mechanism and the incapability of providing effective evacuation guidance in emergency result in personnel evacuation confusion and panic, a real-time monitoring module compares the concentration of dangerous gas with a preset safety threshold value, once the dangerous gas is found to leak, dangerous marks can be immediately carried out, an alarm is triggered through the dangerous early warning module, the timely early warning and response mechanism is helpful for reducing the possibility of accidents, the evacuation guidance module can simulate the layout of a monitoring area, forecast the trend and range of dangerous gas diffusion, plan a safe evacuation route based on the forecast result, provide scientific basis for personnel evacuation in emergency, help reduce personnel casualties, and the system can adjust and update the evacuation route in real time by continuously receiving data in a gas diffusion forecast unit so as to adapt to the continuously-changed dangerous situation.
assignees: ZHONGKAIDA ELECTRONIC TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Emergency alert systems and methods for differently abled persons
abstract_en: Emergency alert systems and methods for disabled and/or differently abled persons are disclosed. Upon receiving an alert message, the system translates the alert message to an audio message (text to speech) when the text to speech feature is enabled. In some implementations, the system waits fora threshold period of time (e.g., 30 seconds) to receive a user acknowledgment of the alert message, and translates the alert message to an audio message if no acknowledgment is received within this time. The user acknowledgment can be received via a selection of an option (e.g., by clicking an “OK” button) and/or via an audio option (e.g., by saying “Ok, received”) when the text to speech feature is enabled. The system then outputs (e.g., reads out loud) the translated message so that the disabled or differently abled persons can be informed of the emergency situation. After outputting the translated message, the system can further wait for a user acknowledgment of the translated audio message.

title_en: Remote sensing satellite geological disaster early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, in particular to a remote sensing satellite geological disaster early warning method. According to the invention, the accuracy of geological risk prediction is improved by analyzing various geological features, the understanding of soil erosion mechanism and landslide risk is improved by simulating water-soil interaction, the effectiveness of disaster early warning is optimized, the identification capacity of landslide areas is enhanced by comparing with historical data patterns, the disaster spatial association information is analyzed, the disaster diffusion trend prediction and risk level adjustment are optimized, the dynamic update of real-time disaster risk assessment and disaster risk monitoring is combined, the timeliness and accuracy of early warning information are improved, and comprehensive technical support is provided for geological disaster early warning.
assignees: TAIAN JINTUDI SURVEYING AND MAPPING CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic early warning system and early warning method for landslide disasters along pipeline
abstract_en: The system comprises a database, a pipeline landslide susceptibility evaluation module, a slope unit influence condition evaluation module, a regional surface displacement data processing module, a pipeline landslide dynamic early warning module and an early warning information release module. According to the invention, by comprehensively utilizing the earth surface displacement data and the related geological environment factors, the slope body which threatens the pipeline safety can be more accurately judged, and the early warning level is reasonably issued; the invention not only provides early warning at the initial stage, but also updates early warning information in time according to the real-time change of the earth surface displacement, thereby ensuring the timeliness and accuracy of early warning; the method is particularly aimed at specific geology and environmental conditions along the pipeline, so that the early warning is more targeted and applicable, and the effectiveness of the early warning is improved in practical application.

title_en: Efficient emergency communications fallback
abstract_en: The authorized IP addresses configured at components in an IMS network may become out of sync with a first pool of IP addresses provided by a core network to UEs. This may result in emergency communications being received at the IMS network from a UE using a first IP address of the first pool of IP addresses that is not recognized by the IMS network. A session management component of the core network may automatically assign a second IP address from a second pool of IP addresses based on determining the session management component has not received an update notification from the IMS network within a threshold time (e.g., 500 milliseconds, 1000 milliseconds, etc.) from transmitting a request to establish a packet data communications session to the IMS network using the first IP address. The IMS network may then receive packets from the second IP address.

title_en: Scenic spot crowd gathering risk assessment and early warning method and system based on multiple features
abstract_en: The invention provides a scenic spot crowd gathering risk assessment and early warning method and system based on multiple characteristics, and relates to the field of model prediction of a deep learning algorithm. The prediction model based on the multi-feature scenic spot crowd risk assessment is a model which is superior to a model constructed by single source data, the multi-feature set comprises a plurality of influencing factors such as passenger flow, weather, other sudden disaster information and the like as feature variable input, the prediction accuracy is effectively improved, and the LSTM long-term memory network algorithm model is used, so that more intelligent passenger flow prediction is effectively realized. In addition, the method combines the historical data with the real-time data, and adds crowd information obtained by real-time monitoring data on the basis of the prediction of the historical data model, so that the prediction model is continuously optimized and updated, the prediction of the evaluation result of the aggregation risk of different time-frequency crowd is realized, and the accuracy and the comprehensive performance of the prediction model in different time periods are greatly improved.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM HONGXIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: IPTV program message publishing system and realization method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of communication, and relates to an IPTV program message issuing system and an implementation method. The implementation method comprises the following steps: the system comprises a message server, a mobile application terminal and a television client; the message server comprises a message management unit, a message monitoring unit, a first message processing unit and a message center storage unit; the client message management system is used for IPTV program message management; the client message management system comprises a message connection establishment unit, a message receiving and storing unit, a second message processing unit, a message display unit and a voice broadcasting unit. When a new program and a channel are online or a user member expires, the method and the system can be timely broadcast to users of the television client; the television client and the message system are communicated, free release of IPTV program messages is realized, and the IPTV program messages are automatically broadcasted to a television screen of the television client; the notification may also be synchronized in real time if an emergency event such as an earthquake, such as weather, time, address activity, etc., is encountered.
assignees: SICHUAN TIANYI COMHEART TELECOM CO LTD

title_en: Distributed healthcare communication system
abstract_en: A graphical audio station of a nurse call system is operable to permit a user to perform one or more of the following functions: establish a two-way voice communication link with another computer device in another patient and/or with a another computer device located in another staff work area and/or with a wireless communication device carried by caregiver and/or with a telephone of the healthcare facility; broadcast a voice page to a group of other selected computer devices; compose and send a text message to a portable device that is carried by a caregiver and that has wireless communication capability; browse web pages and/or view multimedia content, such as videos, hosted on servers of the healthcare facility and/or that are accessible via the Internet; view and/or acknowledge and/or answer and/or cancel alerts or nurse calls originating in a plurality of patient rooms.

title_en: Automatic control system of pneumatic car lifting jack of railway vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an automatic control system of a pneumatic car lifting jack of a railway vehicle, which comprises the following components: the car lifting jack piston rod, safe bolt still includes: the device comprises a diffusion laser ranging module, an infrared curtain sensing module, a video monitoring module and an automatic control module; the diffuse laser ranging module is used for accurately measuring and controlling the lifting height and the lifting speed of the piston rod of the car lifting machine and the inserting and withdrawing state of the safety bolt in real time, automatically comparing and measuring the lifting height and the lifting speed of the piston rod of the two groups of car lifting machines at one end of the same maintenance platform, ensuring the lifting synchronization and the height consistency, and simultaneously monitoring the inserting and withdrawing working state of the safety bolt in real time. According to the utility model, the working state of the safety bolt is monitored in real time through the arrangement, the actions of preventing operators from missing insertion and withdrawing and monitoring and early warning the operators from entering the forbidden area in a illegal way are avoided, the personal safety is ensured, the whole process of field operation is monitored, and the technical level of automation, informatization and digitization of the whole system is greatly improved.
assignees: TIANJIN DEPOT OF CHINA RAILWAY BEIJING GROUP CO LTD;BEIJING STTY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Payment method and system based on-chain through certificate circulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a payment method and a payment system based on-chain through certificate circulation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a pass transfer request of a first user is received, transferring the pass to a transfer contract and adding a time lock; the transfer contract accesses the predictor network to acquire the authenticated real-time price and updates the real-time price to the transfer instruction; transmitting the transfer instruction to an operator server through a transaction notification contract, generating a system payment order and pushing the system payment order to a second user; after the second user pays under the chain, generating a successful confirmation of the transaction and signing; the transaction notification contract signs again after verifying the validity of the transaction to the payment settlement center; and transferring the pass to the receiving address of the second user after the predictor communication contract calls the transfer contract to verify the pass time lock. By the technical scheme, the safety of the payment process and the through certificate circulation process of the buying and selling user is ensured, hidden dangers of merchants and deception questioning behaviors of the user are avoided, disaster tolerance and automatic retrieval of assets on a chain when abnormality occurs are increased.
assignees: BEIJING RUIRONG TIANXIA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent anti-cancellation composite device for electrical cabinet
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, and discloses an intelligent electrical cabinet anti-extinction composite device which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the upper end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a magnet, and the upper end of the bottom plate is provided with a positioning hole. This intelligent regulator cubicle prevents eliminating composite set, when ambient temperature is higher than 170 ℃, heat-sensitive induction line release fire extinguishing substance, when fire extinguishing substance contacted open flame or fire-retardant face, release fire extinguishing gas and fire extinguishing agent after the decomposition, take place many times chain reaction and air formation gaseous mixture, consume the exothermic reaction between active group and the inhibitory group, thereby play the inhibitory effect to the combustion reaction, can put out the condition of a fire in the enclosure space fast, temperature sensor gathers ambient temperature and inputs into the treater, but the user uses cell-phone wireless connection wireless module real time monitoring ambient temperature, the treater has preset warning temperature, when ambient temperature is greater than warning temperature, the treater starts the siren and sends out alarm sound, the warning effect is good.
assignees: SHAANXI WENDING TECH TRADE CO LTD

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based geological disaster monitoring, predicting and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of seismic data fault detection, and discloses an artificial intelligence-based geological disaster monitoring, predicting and early warning method, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring geological disaster related data by using a sensor network, satellite remote sensing and unmanned aerial vehicle technology; s2: integrating multiple data sources to perform multidimensional data fusion analysis; s3: analyzing historical data through a machine learning algorithm, and constructing a prediction model of the geological disaster; s4: automatically learning complex correlations and features in geological disaster data through a neural network model; s5: combining the real-time data with a prediction model to establish a geological disaster real-time monitoring and early warning system; s6: combining with artificial intelligence technology to establish a decision support system; s7: automating and accelerating an emergency response flow; s8: by introducing online learning and incremental learning, the method has higher self-adaptive capacity, and can continuously adjust and update the prediction model according to new monitoring data, thereby improving the accuracy and reliability of prediction.

title_en: The method of noise elimination and update on accident alarm signal of accident notifying device
title_ko: 차량용 사고 알림 장치의 사고 발생 신호에 대한 노이즈 제거 및 갱신 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a noise removal and update method for an accident occurrence signal of an accident notification device for a vehicle. the noise removal and update method for an accident occurrence signal of an accident notification device for a vehicle according to the present invention is implemented by an external server and performs a noise removal and update function of the accident occurrence signal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차량용 사고 알림 장치의 사고 발생 신호에 대한 노이즈 제거 및 갱신 방법에 대한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 차량용 사고 알림 장치의 사고 발생 신호에 대한 노이즈 제거 및 갱신 방법은 외부 서버에 의해 구현되고 사고 발생 신호의 노이즈 제거 및 갱신 기능을 수행한다.

title_en: Comprehensive early warning method for coal mine water damage risk based on multi-element heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive early warning method for coal mine water damage risk based on multiple heterogeneous data, which comprises a space-time data fusion early warning method and a dynamic data and static data fusion early warning method. The time-space data fusion early warning method comprises a threshold value and change rate threshold value combined early warning mode and/or a threshold value and change value threshold value combined early warning mode in the time dimension, and the combined early warning mode can simultaneously give consideration to slow-change abnormal data and mutant abnormal data; in the space dimension, the accurate position of the monitoring equipment is obtained, and the abnormal situation occurrence place is accurately positioned. According to the dynamic and static data fusion early warning method, dynamic data change is considered to cause static data change, so that the water inrush risk evaluation result is changed. The method and the device can solve the problem that the reliability of the early warning result is low due to the fact that the dynamic data do not fully consider the time dimension factors and the static data are not updated in time.
assignees: SHAANXI BINCHANG WENJIAPO MINING CO LTD;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Power grid early warning and scheduling method and system based on extreme disaster weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid early warning and scheduling method and system based on extreme disaster weather, relates to the field of power grid scheduling, and aims to solve the problem that scheduling is unilateral due to the fact that the conventional power grid scheduling method cannot comprehensively consider the influence factors of the extreme disaster weather, and the method comprises the following steps: determining the fault condition of the power grid equipment in extreme disaster weather according to the weather information of the power distribution area and the state information of the power grid equipment; judging whether to send out power grid early warning according to the fault condition of the power grid equipment and the using time of the power grid equipment, and predicting load reduction; acquiring position distribution information and energy information of power grid energy storage equipment, and determining an executed power grid energy storage equipment scheme according to a first execution strategy; and constructing an energy storage execution model according to the power grid energy storage equipment scheme executed historically, and judging whether the energy storage execution model is updated or not. The invention carries out targeted adjustment and scheduling on the fault power grid equipment, and ensures the objectivity and comprehensiveness of the scheduling result.

title_en: ICU patient unplanned tube drawing early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of early warning and alarming, and discloses an ICU patient unplanned tube drawing early warning device which comprises an outer frame, wherein a control module, a singlechip and a switch are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the outer frame, a loudspeaker alarm is fixedly arranged at the top of the outer frame, a flashing lamp is fixedly arranged at the top of the loudspeaker alarm, and an insertion tube is connected to the inner wall of the outer frame in a sliding manner. This ICU patient unplanned tube drawing early warning device uses through the cooperation of rotation blocking piece and stopper, through the inertial potential energy of rotation blocking piece self, can block the stopper to make the intubate by the normal position, avoid taking place patient or patient family members circumstances of misplacing, and when medical personnel need pull out the plug, at first press the switch, make the device outage, secondly clockwise rotation blocking piece ninety degrees and more, make the rotation blocking piece cancel the stopper, can pull out the intubate smoothly this moment.
assignees: PEOPLES HOSPITAL OF DEYANG CITY LUOJIANG DISTR

title_en: Insulin injection pen with expiration date alarm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an insulin injection pen with a validity period alarm, which comprises an electronic alarm arranged on the insulin injection pen and used for reminding the validity period of insulin, wherein the electronic alarm comprises a shell, a control chip arranged in the shell, an input and display module, a power module, a voice broadcasting module and a lamplight flickering prompt module, wherein the input and display module, the power module, the voice broadcasting module and the lamplight flickering prompt module are all connected with the control chip, the control chip receives data of the input and display module, monitors and judges whether the insulin is close to or exceeds the validity period according to a threshold value preset by the input and display module, and then gives an instruction to the voice broadcasting module and the lamplight flickering prompt module for alarming prompt, so that people can know the validity period of the insulin injection more clearly, and the efficacy is ensured.
assignees: THE FOURTH MEDICAL CENTER OF CHINESE PLA GENERAL HOSPITAL

title_en: Urban waterlogging monitoring platform real-time waterlogging early warning method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer vision and deep learning, and particularly relates to a real-time waterlogging early warning method of an urban waterlogging monitoring platform based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring live video stream data of a camera from a video platform; s2: intercepting pictures from live video stream data of a camera to construct a waterlogging identification data set; s3: creating a MobileNetV-based deep neural network model, and loading model weights; s4: configuring an SGD optimizer and a learning rate scheduling function in the training process so as to update parameters and adjust the learning rate when training a deep neural network model; s5: and training the freezing stage of the deep neural network model. According to the invention, by adopting a deep learning-based method and taking MobileNetV as a basic model, the urban waterlogging is monitored rapidly and accurately.

title_en: Safety management information sharing system and method for power enterprises
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety management information sharing system and a safety management information sharing method for an electric power enterprise, wherein the safety management information sharing system comprises an identity authority management module, a safety monitoring early warning module, a device state management maintenance module, an employee training knowledge management module, an emergency response disaster backup management module, a vulnerability management safety update module, a real-time communication notification service module and a compliance audit supervision module.
assignees: CHINA SUNTIEN GREEN ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Communication scheduler
abstract_en: A communications system may include user equipment (UE) devices, communications satellites, gateways, and a terrestrial network. The UE devices may receive broadcast signals from the constellation. The UE devices may transmit registration requests to the gateways via the satellites in response to the broadcast signals. The registration requests may include information identifying the geographic locations of the UE devices and may include two-line element (TLE) identifiers. A scheduler on the terrestrial network may receive forward link traffic requests for the UE devices, each with a corresponding priority. The scheduler may also receive satellite information that includes thermal constraints, position information, and power information associated with the satellites. The scheduler may generate forward link traffic grants for the UE devices based on the forward link traffic requests, the thermal constraints, the TLE versions, the geographic locations, and the priorities.

title_en: Intelligent detection alarm equipment for gas environment
abstract_en: The invention provides intelligent detection alarm equipment for a gas environment, which detects the gas concentration, smoke, the ambient temperature, the existence condition and the activity state of personnel in the environment in real time, and sends detection data to an upper computer at regular time through an RS485 bus or a voice and 4G communication module. When the gas concentration, smoke and environmental temperature of the environment exceed warning values, the equipment reports instant alarm information to an upper computer, and meanwhile, the information is directly sent to a platform server and/or a mobile phone client, and whether personnel in the alarm environment have rescue requirements or not is known at the first time; the distress personnel can carry out voice communication with the control center, and meanwhile, the control center can also send group broadcasting to all users to inform the users whether or not to withdraw and how to withdraw. When the equipment provided by the invention is used for obtaining the dangerous situation, the equipment can be used for obtaining whether personnel needing rescue exist in the environment where the equipment is located, so that limited rescue resources are preferentially used for personnel rescue, and the casualties are avoided to the greatest extent.

title_en: Harmful gas detector with alarm function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of gas detection, in particular to a harmful gas detector with an alarm function, which comprises a main body mechanism, a detection mechanism and an alarm mechanism, wherein a harmful gas collecting pipe can sense leaked harmful gas and automatically start the alarm, a warning lamp is arranged at the top end of the alarm, a loudspeaker is arranged in the alarm, the alarm can be more effectively warned to give out an alarm, a worker can quickly withdraw, a purifying net is arranged at the left end of the alarm mechanism, the purifying net can carry out primary filtration on the harmful gas, harmful components enter the detection mechanism, a water inlet is arranged at the left side of the top end of the detection mechanism, a water reservoir is arranged at the bottom end of the water inlet, the atomizer can convert purified water in the water reservoir into vaporous liquid, and the atomizing pipe can convey the vaporous liquid into a fine net layer to be combined with the harmful gas, so that the vaporous liquid can be converted into liquid to flow out, and the harm to the worker can be better lightened.
assignees: AIKESI ELECTRONIC TECH CHANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Catastrophe sensor network topology control method based on link quality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster sensor network topology control method based on link quality, which comprises the steps that firstly, nodes in a wireless sensor network broadcast and send data packets with maximum transmitting power, after receiving the data packets, the nodes decode the data packet information to obtain node data, a node neighbor list is formed, meanwhile, the nodes read RSSI values in the data packets, and the communication link quality between the two nodes is calculated; filtering based on energy limit value and filtering based on link energy consumption rate, filtering redundant links caused by common neighbor nodes, and updating a node neighbor list; and finally, the node establishes a post-disaster network topology structure according to the updated neighbor list, and transmits and distributes disaster information. Aiming at the network reconstruction process of the residual nodes after the disaster, the method of the invention improves the stability of the topology control method and prolongs the survival time of the reconstructed network by double node filtering and optimizing the communication link.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING;XUZHOU KERUI MINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: independent smoke detection alarm device having escape position indicator
title_ko: 탈출구 지시기를 갖는 독립형 연기 감지 경보기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a standalone smoke detection alarm having an escape exit indicator, and comprises: a smoke detection sensor installed in a housing installed on the ceiling of a building to detect smoke; an escape exit indicator installed in the housing to dynamically display an escape exit direction guidance indication line indicating the direction of the escape exit through a transparent window at the bottom of the housing; and an alarm control unit that controls the display of an escape exit direction guidance indication line from the escape exit indicator when the smoke detection level detected by the smoke detection sensor exceeds a set reference value. According to the standalone smoke detection alarm having such an escape exit indicator, the standalone smoke detection alarm can be installed in an existing building without changing the facility, has a simple structure, and can dynamically display and provide an escape exit direction when smoke is detected, thereby improving the efficiency of escape exit guidance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 탈출구 지시기를 갖는 독립형 연기 감지 경보기에 관한 것으로서,  건물의 천정에 설치되는 하우징 내에 설치되어 연기를 감지하는 연기감지센서와,  하우징 내에 설치되며 하우징 하부의 투과창을 통해 탈출구 방향을 지시하는 탈출구 방향안내 표시라인을 동적으로 표시하는 탈출구 지시기와, 연기감지센서로부터 감지된 연기감지 레벨이 설정된 기준치 이상이면 탈출구 지시기로부터 탈출구 방향안내 표시라인이 표시되게 제어하는 경보 제어부를 구비한다. 이러한 탈출구 지시기를 갖는 독립형 연기 감지 경보기에 의하면, 기존의 건물에 시설변경없이 설치할 수 있으면서도 구조가 간단하면서도 연기 감지시 동적으로 탈출구 방향을 표시하여 제공할 수 있어 탈출구 안내 효율성을 향상시킬 수 있다.
assignees: CHOSUN COLLEGE OF SCIENCE&TECHNOLOGY IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Smartphone-based portable emergency pager equipped with emergency medicine storage box and emergency call method using the same
title_ko: 응급약보관함이 구비된 스마트폰 기반의 휴대용 응급비상호출기 및 그를 이용한 응급비상호출 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a smartphone-based portable emergency pager equipped with an emergency medicine storage box, and an emergency call method using the same, wherein the emergency pager is linked to a smartphone and allows users to request assistance through emergency calls to acquaintances, public officials in public institutions or fire stations through the smartphone without separate equipment like repeaters or gateways. Provided is a portable emergency pager (100), which includes: an emergency medicine storage box (180) which has upper and lower surfaces each formed in a semicircular shape, and is configured to store emergency medicine at the bottom thereof; a volume output unit (110) for producing a warning sound, a call button (120) for emergency calls, and a call cancel button (140) for call cancel which are configured to be exposed to a front cover (101) of the portable emergency pager (100); and a charging indication LED (160) for notifying the charging status and a charging port (170) which are configured to be located on the side of the portable emergency call device (100). The portable emergency call device (100) is paired with a smartphone via Bluetooth, and when the call button (120) for emergency calls is pressed, the device is configured to sound a warning sound through the volume output unit (110) and transmit the GPS information of the paired smartphone to a plurality of pre-set contacts to request rescue.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기본적으로는 응급약을 보관하면서도 응급이나 비상상황 시 주변에 도움을 요청할 수 있는 경고음을 출력하도록 하면서도 스마트폰과 연동되어 중계기나 게이트웨이등 별도 장비없이도 스마트폰을 통해 지인이나 공공기관의 공무원이나 소방서 등에 도움을 응급비상호출을 통해 도움을 요청할 수 있으며, 시각장애인을 위한 점자표를 각인하여 시각장애인들도 유용하게 이용할 수 있고, 상시휴대가 가능한 응급약보관함이 구비된 스마트폰 기반의 휴대용 응급비상호출기 및 그를 이용한 응급비상호출 방법에 관한 것이다.  이러한 본 발명은 응급약보관함이 구비된 스마트폰 기반의 휴대용 응급비상호출기로써, 상기 휴대용 응급비상호출기는, 상부면와 하부면은 각각 반원형 형태로 구성되고, 저면부에는 응급약을 보관하도록 구성된 응급약 보관함(180); 상기 휴대용 응급비상호출기의 전면에 노출되도록 구성된 것으로, 경고음을 출력하는 음량 송출부(110), 비상호출을 위한 호출버튼(120) 및 호출취소를 위한 호출취소 버튼(140); 상기 휴대용 응급비상호출기의 측면에 구성되는 것으로 충전표시를 알리는 충전표시 LED(160) 및 충전포트(170); 스마트폰과 블루투스 페어링되어 상기 비상호출을 위한 호출버튼(120)이 눌려지는 경우 상기 음량 송출부(110)를 통해 경고음을 송출함과 함께 미리 설정된 복수의 연락처로 상기 페어링된 스마트폰의 GPS 정보를 송출하여 구조를 요청하는 것을 특징으로 하는 응급약보관함이 구비된 스마트폰 기반의 휴대용 응급비상호출기를 제공한다.

title_en: Roof subgrade formwork tunnel roof collapse early warning system and disaster-critical safety intelligent control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roof, roadbed, die carrier, tunnel roof collapse early warning system and disaster-critical intelligent control method, comprising the steps of arranging a pressure sensor on the upper surface of a roof/arch shell or the lower end of a vertical rod; and/or a deformation sensor is arranged on the lower surface of the roof/template/arch shell and/or the lower surface of the transverse member, or a deformation sensor is arranged on the guardrail; and/or providing a ranging sensor on the roof/form/arch and/or the lower surface of the cross member and/or the ground; and a loudspeaker and/or a warning lamp and/or a warning applet or APP are arranged; or an invisible door opening and an escape facility are arranged on the wall, and an automatic opening device or an automatic braking device is arranged under the road surface and/or on the vehicle; or simultaneously installing a fire-fighting tool on the wall and/or the roof; when the pressure measured value is more than or equal to the early warning value and/or the deformation measured value is more than or equal to the early warning value and/or the distance decrement measuring value is more than or equal to the early warning value, the system controller starts an acousto-optic alarm to prompt personnel to withdraw or prompt the vehicle to actively stop traveling; or the invisible door opening and the escape facility are opened at the same time to provide quick evacuation.

title_en: Urban waterlogging prevention and control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for preventing and treating urban waterlogging, which are applied to the technical field of rainwater systems. Inverting the global liquid level and flow of a rainwater system pipe network, generating a ground flooding water depth map and a binary flood flooding map at monitoring time, performing rationality check on the global liquid level and ground flooding water depth map and the binary flood flooding map of the rainwater system pipe network, performing fusion processing based on hydraulic connection between a one-dimensional (1D) node and a two-dimensional (2D) ground to obtain a label, generating a new dataset according to the label and forecast rainfall, mixing the historical dataset with the new dataset to obtain a mixed dataset, updating parameters of a urban flooding prediction model, predicting urban flooding by using the model with updated parameters, determining urban flooding early warning grades according to a prediction result, generating a drainage scheme, regulating corresponding drainage facilities according to the scheme, and improving urban flooding prevention and control effects.

title_en: AIoT anomaly identification method, disaster early warning system and road safety system
abstract_en: The invention discloses AIoT anomaly identification method, disaster early warning system and road safety system, wherein the identification method comprises the steps of S1, constructing a double-network feature extractor, S2, acquiring a data set; s3, training and optimizing a double-network feature extractor to obtain an identification model; s4, acquiring data to be identified; s5, identifying multi-category abnormal events to obtain an identification result; the disaster early warning system comprises a sensor computing unit and a base station edge computing unit; the road safety system comprises a road side calculation unit and a vehicle-mounted calculation unit; the complex abnormal mode and the characteristics in the intelligent Internet of things environment can be accurately recognized through the double-network characteristic extractor; the weight update of the local and global features is realized through parallelization of the parallel knowledge migration framework based on the local and global features, and the recognition precision and generalization capability of the overall model are improved; the method is tightly combined with the field of real disaster emergency and road safety, and practical problems of disaster early warning and road safety early warning are practically solved.
assignees: UNIV XIHUA;CHINA UNITED NETWORK COMMUNICATIONS CO LTD SICHUAN BRANCH;SICHUAN ACADEMY OF SAFETY SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Method for emergency notification of a safety threat to a user
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of informing predefined individuals that a user is experiencing an emergency. In the event of signs of a threat to the safety of the user, said user activates a device for generating a signal that is an emergency notification signal about a safety threat. This signal is wirelessly transmitted to a remote server, from which the emergency notification signal is retransmitted to an individual invested with the functions of ensuring the safety of the user. According to the invention, once a user whose safety is threatened has activated their personal device, an emergency notification signal is transmitted only to the personal devices of a trusted set of individuals, at least one of whom checks the validity of the threat, becoming a guarantor of the fact that a genuine threat exists, and either sends a signal to the remote server acknowledging the alert and indicating that they are prepared to react, or redirects the signal to a shared group of individuals recorded in a database.

title_en: Electric control system of rescue excavator capable of realizing self-adaptive spraying in high-temperature environment and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric control system of a rescue excavator with self-adaptive spraying in a high-temperature environment, which comprises the following components: the system comprises an environment temperature sensor, a water level sensor, a controller, an electronic monitor, a spray pump proportional valve, a relay, a spray pump and a vehicle-mounted spray water tank, wherein the water level sensor is arranged in the vehicle-mounted spray water tank and used for detecting the water level in the vehicle-mounted spray water tank, a water outlet of the vehicle-mounted spray water tank is connected with the spray pump through a pipeline, the spray pump is connected with a vehicle-mounted spray nozzle through a pipeline, the environment temperature sensor and the water level sensor are connected with an input end of the controller, the spray pump proportional valve and the relay are connected with an output end of the controller, the electronic monitor is interconnected with the controller through a CAN bus, the spray pump is communicated with a power supply through a switch contact of the relay, the working method of the system is used for planning water spraying flow, improving working time and giving early warning, and prompting a rescue excavator to withdraw from a fire scene in time.

title_en: Rainfall type recognition-based dynamic mountain torrent disaster early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic mountain torrent disaster early warning method based on rainfall rain recognition, which comprises the following steps: based on historical rainfall data containing disaster rainfall in a research area, constructing a research area characteristic rainfall library by using a k-means cluster analysis method; constructing a rainfall similarity association formula of the actually measured rainfall and the rainfall type library based on the shape similarity and quantity similarity principle, calculating the similarity between the actually measured rainfall and the characteristic rainfall, identifying the rainfall type of the actually measured rainfall, and then obtaining a rainfall forecasting process by combining the total rainfall forecasted by the numerical forecasting product; constructing a small-basin hydrologic model to simulate a rainfall-runoff process, and performing model parameter calibration and verification; and as rainfall observation information is increased, a rainfall type recognition result is dynamically updated time-period by time-period, a hydrologic model is used for dynamically forecasting a disaster prevention object to control a section flood process, and flood peak flow rate is used as an early warning index to issue dynamic early warning of the mountain flood disaster or not.

title_en: Power distribution network lightning protection method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network lightning protection method and system based on big data analysis, which relate to the technical field of lightning protection and comprise the following steps: the system collects lightning electrical big data from different sources and performs data preprocessing on the lightning electrical big data; extracting key features from the preprocessed fusion data set by utilizing a big data analysis technology, and training the reinforcement learning algorithm model by using the extracted feature data; predicting the position and probability of lightning occurrence, and automatically triggering an alarm when the probability of lightning occurrence reaches a preset threshold value; and the system updates the lightning prediction model in real time by utilizing the latest big data analysis result, and sends out preset early warning protection measures to the power distribution network operators through the visual platform. According to the invention, the lightning disaster protection capability of the power distribution network is improved, and a powerful guarantee is provided for ensuring the safe operation of the power system and the public safety.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Information provision system and method using telephone calls
title_ko: 전화 통화를 이용한 정보 제공 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for providing information using a telephone call. The system automatically displays a telephone number of a call center of a traffic information center corresponding to a stopped road on a dial screen of an information providing mobile device or on a screen of a running navigation when an abnormal stop occurs due to a failure, an accident, unconsciousness during driving, and a warning of a terminal for a vehicle or a vehicle. When the telephone call is made to the displayed call center of the traffic information center, a report data set including traffic risk information is automatically transmitted to a server of the traffic information center. The traffic information center server automatically analyzes the report data set, automatically generates a shared data set including traffic risk information based on valid information among them, and provides the shared data set to an information receiving mobile device. The information receiving mobile device automatically guides valid traffic risk information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전화 통화를 이용한 정보 제공 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 
고장이나 사고, 운전 중 의식불명 및 자동차 또는 차량용 단말기의 경고 등으로 인한 비정상 정차 시, 정차한 도로에 해당하는 교통정보센터의 콜센터 전화번호를 정보 제공 모바일기기의 다이얼 화면 또는 실행 중인 내비게이션의 화면에 자동으로 표출하고, 표출된 교통정보센터의 콜센터로 전화 통화 시 교통위험 정보가 포함된 신고 데이터 set를 교통정보센터의 서버로 자동으로 전송하며, 교통정보센터 서버는 신고 데이터 set를 자동으로 분석하고, 이 중 유효한 정보를 기반으로 교통위험 정보가 포함된 공유 데이터 set를 자동으로 생성하여, 정보 수신 모바일기기에 제공되도록 하면, 정보 수신 모바일기기는 유효한 교통위험 정보를 자동으로 안내하는 전화 통화를 이용한 정보 제공 시스템 및 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: IOT-based apartment complex distribution board and safety management system using it
title_ko: Iot를 기반으로 한 공동주택의 수배전반을 이용한 안전 관리시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an IoT-based distribution board of an apartment house and a safety management system using the same, wherein the distribution board enables safe and rapid evacuation even in competition of evacuation routes between residents due to the characteristics of the apartment house. The safety management system comprises: a power management part (100) blocking the electricity or supplying the emergency power in the event of fire in the apartment house; a sensing and safety guide part (200) which receives the emergency power by the power management part to sense the fire occurrence and transmit the information about the fire occurrence location, and emits the light ray so that residents of the apartment house visually recognize; and a server part (300) which receives the information about the fire occurrence location from the sensing and safety guide part to transmit an emergency message, and can change the light ray emission angle of the sensing and safety guide part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택의 일부 층에 화재 발생시 모든 전력이 차단될 경우 비상전력 공급을 통하여 거주자로 하여금 명확한 대피 경로를 안내하고, 대피 중 거주자의 오인행동으로 인한 사고를 미연에 방지함에 따라 공동주택의 특성상 거주자 간 대피 경로의 경합에 있어서도 안전하고 신속한 대피를 가능하게 하는 IOT를 기반으로 한 공동주택의 수배전반 및 이를 이용한 안전 관리시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 공동주택의 화재시 전력을 차단하거나 비상전력을 공급하는 전력관리부(100); 전력관리부(100)에 의해 비상 전력을 공급받아 화재발생을 감지하고 화재발생 위치에 대한 정보를 전송하면서 공동주택 거주자들로 하여금 가시적으로 인식할 수 있도록 광선을 방출하는 감지 및 안전안내부(200); 감지 및 안전안내부(200)의 화재발생 위치에 대한 정보를 수신하여 긴급 메시지를 전송하고 감지 및 안전안내부(200)의 광선 방출 각도의 변경이 가능한 서버부(300); 로 구성하여, 화재발생시 광선을 통하여 대피 경로, 대피 안내사항을 표시하여 빛의 굴절과 산란으로 인한 공동주택 거주자들의 오인행동 방지 및 대피과정 중 사고를 방지하는 것에 특징이 있는 IOT를 기반으로 한 공동주택의 수배전반 및 이를 이용한 안전 관리시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Forest fire prevention early warning management method and system based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the field of computers, and provides a forest fire prevention early warning management method and system based on multi-source data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring ground satellite remote sensing data at fixed time; extracting thermal infrared band information in ground satellite remote sensing data; identifying and analyzing thermal infrared band information; generating first early warning information; timely collecting real-time images of a monitoring area; identifying and analyzing the real-time image of the monitoring area; generating second early warning information; uploading the first early warning information and the second early warning information, and generating and sending alarm information; updating alarm information at regular time; the method and the system can acquire thermal infrared band information and real-time images of the monitoring area, acquire data in a diversified manner, identify and analyze the possibility of forest fire occurrence, timely generate and update fire early warning, further improve the reliability of forest fire early warning, and effectively reduce the harm and influence of forest fire.
assignees: NANJING BAINUO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Incident response notification system
abstract_en: An incident response notification system may be provided by identifying, at a central service, a plurality of user devices to receive a reaction plan for an ongoing incident in an environment; customizing the reaction plan to produce a plurality of individualized versions, wherein each individualized version corresponds to an individual user device of the plurality of user devices and is customized based a device type of each individual user device and a role of a user associated with each individual user device in responding to the ongoing incident; and transmitting the individualized version to each corresponding individual user device of the plurality of user devices.

title_en: Portable river flood early warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring equipment, in particular to a portable river flood early warning device. According to the invention, the water level signal acquisition and transmission device is erected on the unmanned aerial vehicle, and is thrown to a proper position through the unmanned aerial vehicle. When flood comes, the control terminal at the downstream side sends out an alarm to prompt the flood of the flying personnel to withdraw as soon as possible, and meanwhile, the unmanned plane autonomously returns to the river along the river at a height which is as close to the personnel in the river as possible, attractive and ensures the safety of the personnel in the river, and simultaneously sends out sound, light and smoke alarm signals to prompt the personnel along the river to withdraw from the river before the flood comes, so that personnel loss is avoided.

title_en: Engineering safety supervision device
abstract_en: The invention provides an engineering safety supervision device, and relates to the field of engineering safety supervision. The engineering safety supervision device comprises a mounting seat, a communication device and a sub-fixing support, wherein a central female support is arranged at the bottom of the mounting seat. This engineering safety supervision device detects the change of the height on the ground of two point positions through the water level in the water pipe to can also trigger and send out the alarm through the inside water of intercommunication hose when taking place the subsidence of less height, thereby can play the effect of early warning, provide more escape time for the staff, through the cooperation between a plurality of intercommunication devices, alarm generator and the connecting device, can realize the ground to a plurality of directions and supervise, can learn whether corresponding position takes place to collapse, be convenient for in time discover subsides and suggestion staff and withdraw, and can avoid the direction of subsideing before withdrawing, further improved the security of withdrawing.
assignees: ZHEJIANG GONGBU CONSTRUCTION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Alarm device for monitoring collapse of mountain
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alarm device for monitoring mountain collapse, which relates to the technical field of early warning equipment and comprises the following components: the solar panel of installation branch and fixed connection in installation branch upper end one side, the bilateral symmetry fixedly connected with loudspeaker of installation branch upper end, the top fixed mounting of installation branch has audible and visual alarm, the upper end of installation branch is provided with smog cooperating structure, smog cooperating structure is including the backup pad of fixed connection in installation branch upper end, open produced smog from holding vessel exhaust pipe department discharge and rise to sky through the smog jar, and form red in this alarm area sky, thereby when having compensatied daytime, the warning light that audible and visual alarm sent is difficult for being seen by personnel, and the mountain obstructs the defect of loudspeaker sound propagation, the visibility of alarm has not only been increased, can also transmit warning information fast, in order to remind nearby personnel to withdraw urgently or dodge.
assignees: QINGHAI CHINACOAL GEOLOGY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Protective helmet for blind person based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent helmets for blind persons, and discloses a protective helmet for blind persons based on big data, which comprises an AI model, wherein the protective helmet module comprises: sensor integration module: a microprocessor integrating a high-speed GPU and an environment sensor, and collecting environment and position data; and a language interaction module: a microphone array integrating noise suppression and echo cancellation technology captures user voice, and an AI model is used for voice recognition; and an intelligent planning module: combining GPS positioning data, a map AP I and an AI model, and dynamically planning a safe and convenient route; anti-tracking security module: the camera captures a rear image, the AI face recognition algorithm recognizes and analyzes the facial expression and the behavior mode of the follower, and judges whether tracking behaviors exist or not by combining the position and time data; an emergency alert and communication module.

title_en: Nuclear power base emergency method, system, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of nuclear emergency, and provides a nuclear power base emergency method, a system, terminal equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining emergency notices corresponding to all users of the nuclear power base, wherein the emergency notices comprise emergency configuration information, and the emergency configuration information is used for indicating the users to withdraw and check in during emergency evacuation; sending the emergency notification to each user; and acquiring the evacuation sign-in information of the user, and determining an evacuation result according to the evacuation sign-in information. The application can improve the accuracy and efficiency of emergency evacuation.
assignees: GUANGDONG NUCLEAR POWER JOINT VENTURE CO LTD;LINGAO NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD;Lingdong nuclear power co ltd;DAYA BAY NUCLEAR POWER OPS

title_en: Colliery geological disaster administers monitoring early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of monitoring and early warning devices, and discloses a monitoring and early warning device for coal mine geological disaster management, which comprises a fixed plate and an adjusting component, wherein a signal receiver is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the fixed plate, the adjusting component is arranged at the upper side of the signal receiver and comprises a mounting seat, the mounting seat is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the signal receiver, the upper end of the mounting seat is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft, the upper end of the rotating shaft is rotatably connected with a transmission rod, and a transmission motor is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the transmission rod. This colliery geological disasters administer monitoring early warning device through installation adjusting part, can send out the alarm when reminding personnel to withdraw at the stereo set, through the cooperation between parts such as driving motor, transfer line, the position of portable stereo set can make the stereo set be circular motion on the fixed plate, can strengthen the diffusion scope of stereo set sound, further promotes the alarm effect of stereo set, has increased the practicality when using.
assignees: SHANDONG HUAYUAN MINING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Microseismic waveform multi-task integrated analysis method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microseismic waveform multi-task integrated analysis method based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a multichannel microseismic waveform data set, wherein the multichannel microseismic waveform data set comprises sample data and tag data; training the neural network by using the multichannel microseismic waveform data set to obtain a multi-task processing model; and inputting the target multichannel microseismic waveform data into a multi-task processing model, and respectively outputting the target focus positioning, the target event energy value and the target moment magnitude through the multi-task processing model. The invention can integrate and output the target parameters more quickly and accurately, so as to update the stability development state of the surrounding rock more quickly, and remarkably improve the reliability and accuracy of disaster early warning.

title_en: Intercom system based on wireless network connection and mobile phone remote control
abstract_en: The utility model provides a talkback system based on wireless network connection and mobile phone remote control, including building talkback terminal module, wireless network connection module, mobile phone application control module, cloud server module, local processing module, intelligent alarm module, remote maintenance module, building talkback terminal module is used for realizing audio and video collection and broadcast, wireless network connection module provides high-speed, low-delay wireless network connection, improve the stability and the coverage of communication, mobile phone application control module provides Android and IOS platform's application program, realize intelligent visitor identification and voice control function, cloud server module is used for handling audio and video data's transfer and storage, local processing module is used for local audio and video data's real-time processing, intelligent alarm module sends alarm notice to user's mobile phone through wireless network in real time when detecting unusual condition, and remote maintenance module provides remote maintenance and update function.

title_en: Public environment safety monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a public environment safety monitoring and early warning device, which relates to the technical field of public environment safety and comprises a shell, the shell is connected with the right end of the multi-group telescopic connecting rod, and the left end of the multi-group telescopic connecting rod is connected with the mounting seat. This public environment safety control early warning device, the multiunit flexible connecting rod through setting up is between casing and mount pad, and the multiunit flexible connecting rod stretches under the drive of drive structure and extends the mount pad a section distance, realizes that the camera body extends to the outside, increases the shooting scope of camera body, adopts this mode simultaneously to withdraw the back with the camera body, and the camera body is at the normal shooting of the bottom side of casing, and the inside of casing can not occupy unnecessary space is accomodate to multiunit flexible connecting rod is complete.
assignees: SHAANXI YICHENG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine emergency rescue command system
abstract_en: The application discloses a mine emergency rescue command system, which comprises: the system comprises an emergency rescue command platform, a ground control terminal and a mobile terminal, wherein the ground control terminal monitors and records the environment of each tunnel in a mine, obtains videos and pictures of the environment of each tunnel, obtains the position of an accident point, marks the accident point in a pre-recorded mine model and confirms the position of the accident point; matching rescue schemes of corresponding accidents based on pre-entered accident data to obtain rescue routes; the ground control terminal updates the accident point position and the field environment of the roadway. The mine emergency rescue command system disclosed by the application can update the rescue scheme in real time according to the field environment, clear the command right in rescue work, avoid the situation that the notification of an emergency event is unreasonable and not in place due to the undefined command right, enable rescue staff to rapidly solve the sudden problem, reduce the waste of rescue time and improve the rescue efficiency.
assignees: JIANGSU DASHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data collection, distribution and analysis methodology for realtime and historical gis data
abstract_en: A method and system for a weather distribution adapted to collect, analyze and distribute user reported flood data, including a user interface adapted for a user to report flood data, receive a flood alert and view displayed analyzed reported flood data relevant to the user, and a central cloud network adapted to collect, analyze, and distribute the reported flood data to the user, the central cloud network including a report handler, wherein the report handler collects the reported flood data, analyzes the reported flood data and distributes the analyzed reported flood data to a memory database and a geographic information system (“GIS”) database, the memory database, wherein the memory database stores user information and locations, the GIS database, wherein the GIS database records the analyzed reported flood data, a notification trigger system, wherein the notification trigger system sends the user the flood alert and displays the analyzed reported flood data based on a user location, wherein the automatic updates display reported flood data in real-time.

title_en: Rural intelligent scenic spot tourist safety service system
abstract_en: The application discloses a rural intelligent scenic spot tourist safety service system, which comprises a processing center, wherein the processing center is connected with a monitoring module, a route planning module, a guiding module and a broadcasting module, the monitoring module is used for capturing image information in scenic spots in real time, the route planning module analyzes the passenger flow of each route according to the image information captured by the monitoring module and plans an optimal route which can reach a designated place under an emergency, the guiding module comprises a marker post and a color-variable indication arrow, and the broadcasting module is used for synchronously broadcasting related information under the emergency. According to the application, the scenic spot images are captured in real time through the monitoring module, the emergency situation is found by utilizing the image analysis algorithm, the multidimensional emergency response is started, the optimal evacuation route is planned, the guidance and the broadcasting of multilingual emergency information are indicated, the rapid evacuation of tourists is ensured, the route planning module dynamically adjusts the route, and the broadcasting module supports multilingual broadcasting and updates the content in real time.
assignees: GANSU NEW SPACE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;GANSU POLYTECHNIC COLLEGE ANIMAL HUSBANDRY & ENG

title_en: Data backup and disaster recovery method and system based on data lake platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a data backup and disaster recovery system based on a data lake platform, which comprises a data backup module, a snapshot module, a disaster recovery module and a control module, wherein the data backup module is used for backing up data in the data lake, the snapshot module is used for generating corresponding snapshots when the data in the data lake is changed, the disaster recovery module is used for recovering the backed up data and the snapshots, the control module is used for judging whether to send information early warning according to the abnormal judgment of the data backup process and the disaster recovery process, and also is used for adjusting the data backup mode according to the average time length of backup data recovery or executing the judgment function of marking validity of metadata information according to the judgment result of marking validity according to the data difference byte quantity ratio of metadata information. The invention realizes the improvement of the effectiveness of data backup.

title_en: Overhead manned device safety early warning system and method based on target tracking
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine safety, and discloses an overhead man-riding device safety early warning system and method based on target tracking, wherein the system comprises the following steps: inputting the current video frame into YOLOv target detection model to obtain first detection result; acquiring an initial state of a first target frame corresponding to a target object; inputting the frame number difference v, the time interval between frames and the initial state into a state transition model to predict the predicted position of the corresponding first target frame, and obtaining a second detection result of the i+v video frame; searching a corresponding second target frame optimally matched with the first target frame, and taking the optimally matched corresponding second target frame as an updating target frame; performing audible and visual alarm according to the category of the first target frame or the updated target frame; repeating the above process until the class of the updated target frame is non-illegal, and ending the cycle; the invention can effectively and safely monitor and pre-warn the riding behavior of the overhead passenger device.

title_en: Wellsite wind direction early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a well site wind direction early warning device which comprises a base, wherein a vertical rod is fixed at the upper end of the base, a movable rod is arranged above the vertical rod, a bearing at the upper end of the movable rod is connected with a mounting block, and a wind vane is mounted on the mounting block; further comprises: the mounting table is connected to the movable rod through a bearing, a hydrogen sulfide detector is further mounted on the movable rod, an alarm is fixed to the upper end of the hydrogen sulfide detector, a fixed rod is fixed to the right side of the mounting table, a photovoltaic power supply system is mounted on the left side of the upper end of the mounting table and used for supplying power to the whole device, and a control device is further fixed to the mounting table. This well site wind direction early warning device adopts and detects alarm mechanism, can in time remind the staff to withdraw when hydrogen sulfide concentration exceeds standard, guarantees staff safety, and the indicating mechanism of cooperation again can make things convenient for the staff to in time judge the wind direction, and the guide staff flees to the exact direction to guarantee staff's escape time.

title_en: Vehicle-event application notifications
abstract_en: Vehicles may be associated with a variety of different types of events, including events associated with vehicle operations and/or events associated with vehicle passengers. The present disclosure is related to, when an event is detected, exchanging information with a vehicle passenger, such as via the passenger's mobile device and/or wearable device. In some instances, an event may be detected, and examples of the present disclosure may provide an application notification presenting various information. The notification may, in some examples, be configured to help the passenger locate the passenger device, to alert the passenger to the event, to provide instructions, and/or to provide a control interface for controlling a vehicle operation. In some examples, the notification may supersede operations of the passenger device, such as by being presented even if the device is in a locked state or has an unrelated application open and in the foreground.

title_en: Intelligent management method and system for paint warehouse-in and warehouse-out and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent management method for paint warehouse-in and warehouse-out, which comprises the following steps: step S1, inspecting and archiving the paint raw materials, wherein the paint raw materials are required to be subjected to qualification product quality inspection, detection and authentication and purchased according to the standard; s2, processing the paint raw materials after passing inspection, detection and authentication, inputting and storing various information of the paint, and generating a unique label serving as quality tracing; step S3, monitoring the service time and the residual storage time of the paint in real time according to various recorded information of the paint, and triggering early warning when the preset threshold value is reached; and S4, reminding a manager to timely process the coating which is about to be or has expired through an acousto-optic or electronic notification mode. Also disclosed are a paint warehouse-in and warehouse-out intelligent management system and an electronic device. The quality of the paint is controlled and traced, so that the physical health and the environmental quality of consumers are further ensured.

title_en: Semi-supervised landslide early warning method integrating concept drift detection and marker migration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a semi-supervised landslide early warning method integrating concept drift detection and marker migration, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a source domain history data set and current landslide data of a target domain; performing feature derivation on the two-domain data, clustering the source domain data, performing feature derivation on clusters generated by clustering, and finally storing the clusters and the features thereof as an initial early warning model; taking the cluster centroid as a training set to train K KNN models; EMD filtering is used for the target domain data stream, and ADWIN algorithm is used for detecting concept drift points of the filtered data, namely data points to be migrated; taking the reciprocal speed and tangential angle characteristics closely related to the landslide curve as the historical label migration basis; and aiming at the classified data, judging the consistency of the migration label and the classification label to update the model. According to the method, the characteristics and the labels of the historical landslide data are utilized to transfer the historical labels to the current data, and the semi-supervised learning is used for carrying out classified early warning, so that the accuracy of landslide early warning is improved.

title_en: Smart automatic braking for forklifts system to prevent industrial accidents
title_ko: 산업재해 예방을 위한 지게차용 스마트 자동 제동시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart automatic braking system for forklifts to prevent industrial accidents, which analyzes videos captured by AI cameras to detect objects around a forklift (C) and calculates a distance (D) from the objects, and controls the speed of the forklift in response to the calculated distance (D), while controlling the recognition distance (d1), the stop distance (d2), and the deceleration rate (r) using a dip switch button, thereby drastically preparing and preventing industrial accidents caused by forklift collisions, and increasing the accuracy and reliability of judgment regarding alarm situations. Further, the system can maximize the distribution rate and interoperability by interworking with forklifts of various manufacturers and models without changing the structure of the forklift.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 AI 카메라들에서 촬영된 영상을 분석하여, 지게차(C) 주변의 객체(Object)를 감지함과 동시에 객체와의 거리(D)를 산출하여, 산출된 거리(D)에 대응하여 지게차의 속도를 제어하되, 딥-스위치 버튼을 이용하여 인식-거리(d1), 정지-거리(d2) 및 감속률(r)을 제어하도록 구성됨으로써 지게차 충돌로 인한 산업재해를 획기적으로 예방 및 방지할 뿐만 아니라 경보 상황에 관한 판단의 정확성 및 신뢰도를 높일 수 있으며, 지게차의 구조 변경 없이도, 다양한 제조사 및 모델의 지게차와 연동되므로, 보급률 및 연동성을 극대화할 수 있는 산업재해 예방을 위한 지게차용 스마트 자동 제동시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Efficient Proximity-Based Alerting
abstract_en: An example embodiment may involve: determining that a requester device is in a state for a response; based on the requester device being in the state for the response, determining respective values for each of a plurality of potential responder devices, wherein for a particular responder device of the potential responder devices, a particular value is based on a weighted combination of: physical distance between the requester device and the particular responder device, temporal recentness of location updates received from the particular responder device, and similarity of affiliations of the requester device and the particular responder device; determining that the particular value for the particular responder device meets a threshold criterion; and transmitting a notification to the particular responder device indicating that a responder associated with the particular responder device should provide the response to a requester associated with the requester device.

title_en: Method for predicting multi-factor landslide settlement by gradient lifting regression optimization model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide monitoring and early warning, in particular to a method for predicting multi-factor landslide settlement by a gradient lifting regression optimization model. The method comprises the steps of training a gradient lifting regression optimization model according to multi-factor sample data to predict landslide settlement, wherein the gradient lifting regression optimization model is formed by a plurality of gradient lifting regression trees in parallel, the model improves model classification strength by training a plurality of weak classifiers, the prediction capacity of the model is improved, in order to enable parameters of each weak learner to be different, a training set is updated in the training process of the model, the plurality of weak learners are learned, the prediction capacity of the model is improved, landslide settlement prediction is carried out according to current multi-factor sample data to obtain a current landslide settlement prediction value, a threshold value of a landslide risk level is determined based on landslide history data, geological conditions, soil types and the like, and the landslide risk level is accurately estimated by comparing the threshold value with the prediction value.
assignees: JIANGSU NANJING GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING SURVEY INST;UNIV NANJING INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Intelligent firefighting visual platform
